comments: We spent a lovely time in Charles' BnB, always welcoming and refreshing after long days visiting London. The room completely met our needs and is truly delicious, well-finished and furnished. Charles (and his wife too) is a great host, very friendly and caring about your stay at his place and your experience in London. His wife gave us a lot of very helpful suggestions. They were both very prompt in meeting our needs and we really appreciated the fact that they allowed us to store our luggage in their home well beyond the check-out time, to help us enjoying our last day. Highly recommended!
summary: Guests had a lovely stay at Charles' BnB, praising the host's welcoming nature and well-finished room.

comments:
very good location and excellent transportations links
easy access and check in and check out anytime
very fast internet really good desk and chair and very comfy bed
amazing and very clean property, very clean kitchen and bathroom too
super clam and peaceful, and everyone we met was polite and friendly
very good price for this location, and facities
very safe and secure, thank you
summary: Guest praised the property's excellent location, cleanliness, and amenities, as well as the friendly hosts.

comments: Dan was super helpful and understanding. His apartment is decorated stylishly with fantastic attention to detail, great new shower, on a lovely leafy street in walking distance to Oval station and bus routes, making it a great position to get quickly into London or around other cool towns south of the river. Nice, short walk to shops, take-aways and cafes, too. Recommended!
summary: Guest appreciated Dan's helpfulness and the stylishly decorated apartment with great attention to detail.

comments: The landlords are very friendly and welcoming, making me feel at home. Everything is clean and tidy. You can cook there, and they set the most basic stuff for you. The surroundings and transportation are also very nice and convenient. In front of the house, there’s a park you can walk. Besides, It's only several mins walk to DLR, bus, train station and near the tube station. You can go to the centre of London in half an hour. There are plenty of shopping markets nearby, and you can buy daily necessities and food there if you need them.
summary: Guest felt at home in the landlords' welcoming property, praising its cleanliness and convenient location.

comments: The flat is located in a really trendy neighbourhood in London. It's super close to a bunch of hip bars and restaurants, so if you're into that sort of thing, you'll love it! Even if you aren't, I'd still recommend staying at this flat. There's always something going on in this area, and it's really close to transit, entertainment, shopping, great restaurants, etc. The entry way/kitchen/living room area is a bit louder and you can certainly hear noise from your neighbours/down the street. The bedroom itself is extremely quiet so it won't be a problem for those who aren't used to being in a central location. My sister and I ended up sharing a bed instead of making use of the sofa, so I'm not sure how it would be to stay out there. The bed was SO comfortable and, for us, the entire situation was great. The place was perfect and we were sad to leave. The only things we would've liked was to have a full length mirror in the entry way, and more counter space for toiletries/make up/skin care etc. My sister ended up getting all of it so I had to use the kitchen table for the my products. It was okay, but it wasn't ideal. Overall, we had a fantastic time and would recommend it to anyone who was considering this area in London. A solid 4.5*.
summary: Guest enjoyed the trendy neighborhood, comfortable bed, and central location of the flat, with some minor suggestions for improvement.

comments:
Ich hatte einen sehr guten Aufenthalt bei Roberto. Ich wurde sofort Nett begrüßt und es wurde sich um mein Gepäck gekümmert. Das Zimmer und das Bad waren sauber und ordentlich.
Die Underground ist auch gut zu fuß zu erreichen, wodurch man die ganze Stadt super erkunden kann. Ich würde wieder bei Roberto Buchen!
summary: Had a great stay at Roberto's place with friendly service and easy access to public transportation.

comments:
Love Stephanie's place! It is a cozy warm apartment, perfect for solo and couples. The location is great, easy access to undergrounds and overgrounds, grocery stores nearby and only 15 - 20 mins to central London. The district is safe and peaceful.
It is clean and with all the necessary amenities. Stephanie is a very friendly host, she provided clear instructions on checking in as well as local recommendations She allowed me to drop off the luggage before check in.
Just a small note that the apartment is on 5th floor with no lift. It is not a problem to me at all and I have a lovely stay in Stephanie's place. Definitely will come back.
Thank you.
summary: Loved Stephanie's cozy apartment in a safe and peaceful area with excellent amenities and friendly host.

comments:
MAY RUINED MY STAY IN LONDON! She wouldn't fix the boiler, 6 days of no hot water, refused to refund me and kicked me out of the flat 1 day before my flight cause I escalated the case to the nocarz customer service!
I stayed in the flat for 32 nights. Let me start by saying that the flat is well located, on a quiet street and has a lot of natural light but these are the only positives. The flat & the building are very very old, the carpet was so dirty i was shocked, it is stained and filled with dust, the corners were so filthy, the bathroom & kitchen are old so is the furniture (be careful the flat looks much nicer in the pictures than it actually is in reality). I wish i could post pictures in my review. The beginning of my stay went well with May, she was quite responsive to my texts (although i did try calling her a few times and she never picked up which is annoying) until the day the boiler broke. This happened 1 week before the end of my 1 month stay. She kept saying that the plumber is coming but then he never showed up but i am not sure if she has ever arranged for him to come cause the boiler was never fixed so i basically stayed WITHOUT HOT WATER FOR 6 DAYS! I had to go shower at some friend's place which was really inconvenient, embarrassing and unacceptable given the price i paid for the flat (definitely definitely OVERPRICED by the way!). The story keeps getting better and better, cause May decides to kick me out of the flat 1 day before my flight cause i had asked her for a refund which she refused so I escalated the case to the nocarz customer service (according to the nocarz rules i am totally entitled to 50% refund). The cherry on the cake is when she kicked me out of the flat 1 day before my trip! I had to leave work early to go pack my bags and leave the flat to go to a hotel for the last night. The funny part of the story is that she came with the plumber to fix the boiler the day i left, of course cause she was going to move into the flat again.
nocarz customer service was very very good and understanding of my case. They refunded me 50% of the last 6 days, a full refund for the last night and offered to pay a part of my hotel fee.
So overall i would DEFINITELY NOT RECOMMEND staying at May's flat, for the same price (or even lower) you can find a much better flat AND a much nicer landlady :)
summary: May's flat was poorly maintained, had no hot water for 6 days, and the host was unresponsive and refused to refund.

comments:
Lovely trendy flat just one block from vibrant Church Street.
Richard was away when I arrived, but always kept in touch even from his holiday abroad and made sure I had everything I needed.
His flatmate Arthur arranged smooth collection of keys and left the room perfectly clean and ready for my arrival.
The bed is so comfortable I had to ask Richard where he got it from and my whole stay here was short but very pleasant.
It was a real pleasure to meet these friendly easy going boys.
summary: Richard's trendy flat was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with friendly hosts who made sure everything was perfect.

comments: Our stay in Kings Cross was great! The nocarz was very close to the train station and the underground which we used a lot to get around! The nocarz was very clean and we used the kitchen a lot which offered tons of great amenities. Would stay here again in the future!
summary: The nocarz in Kings Cross was very clean, convenient, and had great amenities for a pleasant stay.

comments: Despite other reviews and the suggestion by listers the the wifi connection worked well during my stay at this flat with four devices connected at once. Perhaps there weren't many other guests attempting to use it at the time. The flat is in a lovely part of the city just blocks away from two metro lines, multiple bus lines, food and shopping. These are the highlights of this listing. The  price of this accommodation is justifiable based on those factors. The room itself is pretty basic and most suitable for short stays or those who don't mind a "no frills" accommodation. Shower seemed to go from cold to hot with no in between. Microwave was available but needed to be moved in order to use it as it wasn't placed near an outlet. The room features an enclosed outdoor space not accessible from the street (about 7 feet by 7 feet). Mattress was particularly uncomfortable as springs poked through pretty much everywhere, and the mattress itself was thin. The bed features a headboard which frequently made noises that sounded like it would collapse. There were some holes in the wall that seems to be due to some kind of fixture being removed from that portion of the room. Oddly the television had been programmed to automatically change to an adult channel some time after 2am. On a better note communicating with the host was easy and convenient and we were able to arrange getting the keys from a lock box rather than the office when our plans changed and we arrived in London late at night.
summary: The flat's location is excellent, but the room itself is basic and has several issues with the shower, microwave, mattress, and television.

comments: Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt in der Wohnung. Sie ist sehr gut gelegen. Eine Bushaltestelle zur Innenstadt ist fast direkt vor der Haustür. Die U-Bahn Station Goldhawk Road ist nur 5-8 min. Fußweg entfernt; gleich gegenüber der U-Bahn Station befindet sich ein lokaler Supermarkt, in dem man alles bekommt, was man so braucht (bis 23:00 Uhr geöffnet). Die Küche ist gut ausgestattet, ebenso gibt es 2 große Betten (eines davon im Wohnzimmer als ausziehbares Sofa). Wir konnten unser Gepäck vor dem Check in und nach dem Check out in der Wohnung unterstellen, das hat uns sehr geholfen. Vielen Dank noch einmal an unsere Gastgeber Stephane und Ellie, die sich aufmerksam gekümmert haben.
summary: We had a great stay in this well-located apartment with easy access to public transportation and amenities.

comments: I booked this place for my stay in London because of its excellent location. I was first given a room on the 14th floor but due to a broken AC, I was later moved to the 9th floor. Generally speaking, the room was tidy and everything looked good. I did think that the rooms were a bit too dark for my liking and the light control was all over the place. It would also help if the AC control was closer to the bed because when it got too cold, you had to get up and walk into the living room to change the temperature but this is a minor thing. Overall, the staff was very helpful and they even let me check in ahead of the official time so that was nice.
summary: The room was tidy but too dark, and the AC control was inconveniently located.

comments: Great location, good amenities and travel links to London and short bus ride to the O2 arena. Good, we’ll equipped space for a family of 5. Kevin met us and showed us around and helped park the car - our VW Golf fitted neatly in the garden parking.  The tip in the property details to ask advice for paying for travel around London at Maze Hill station was a great tip. Handy umbrellas in property - we were caught out by rain!
summary: This place has a great location, good amenities, and is well-equipped for families.

comments:
Jimmy is a friendly and responsive host, with a place that instantly makes you feel at home. It was in the perfect location for us to attend a nearby music festival.
The place was spotless, and he very kindly left us some milk, bread and chocolates to enjoy during our stay, which was a lovely touch.
We would definitely return!
summary: Jimmy's place is in a perfect location for music festivals, spotless, and the host is friendly and responsive.

comments:
Ben was a responsive host who gave clear instructions for checking in and out. He was also prompt to answer any questions I had.
The area is residential but note that as it is by the road you will be able to hear traffic in the morning but it wasn’t terrible.
As with shared spaces it is always a toss up with the people you get. The ones I got weren’t the cleanest so the bathroom were kinda dirty at times but that is something that can’t be controlled.
The room however was clean and spotless. Sheets were clean, fresh towels provided, and the shower’s water pressure was good. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything you need
Note that the apartment is up two flights of stairs and both showers are also on the second floor of the apartment.
The nearest train station is a short bus ride away and the location was excellent.
I had a pleasant stay here.
summary: The host was responsive and provided clear instructions, but cleanliness of shared spaces was an issue.

comments: Forsythe was an amazing host! My kids (15,12,9) and I stayed for a week and loved the flat! There is a small grocery store 2 blocks away, the train station halfway in between, restaurants and the river also super close. The flat was absolutely perfect! There was nothing we would have changed about our experience! Loved it!
summary: The flat was perfect for a family stay, with great location and amenities.

comments: A great experience overall. It’s in a great location to get to anywhere in the city you need to. We were made to feel right at home. We got shown around the area and even got introduced to some secret beautiful sight seeing spots. Thank you so much to Giulia for being such a great hostess and introduction to our first out of the country Air B&B experience. 10 out of 10 recommend!
summary: The host made us feel at home and showed us around the area, making it a 10/10 experience.

comments: Super séjour tout à proximité commerce restaurant… le métro est vraiment proche du logement et dessert toutes les localisations pour pouvoir visiter Londres très facilement.le Logement est très propre vraiment j’ai rarement vu en louant un rbnb un logement aussi propre j’ai été très satisfaite de mon séjour. Pavlos a toujours été très réactif à mes messages vraiment super . Merci encore
summary: The apartment was very clean and well-located, with easy access to public transportation and amenities.

comments:
Lovely little hidden gem of a flat, walking distance from Newbury Park tube station (zone 4) .
Small flat, but super comfy bed and full kitchen to chill the milk and wine. Modern bathroom with epic shower and toiletries included. Just perfect what a weekend exploring London, I would defy recommend and would stay here again
summary: The flat was a cozy hidden gem with a comfortable bed and modern bathroom, perfect for exploring London.

comments: Tiff, My parents and I had such a wonderful time in London and the location of your apartment was ideal. I was really picky about which place to stay and am so happy we chose your apartment. The pictures are a great reflection of your place and how clean it is. Thanks again! Lisa
summary: Guest had a wonderful time in London and was happy with the apartment's location and cleanliness.

comments: Cesar was best host ever. Friendly and always smiley. I had a problem with the flight and he was very helpful to arrange a new check in solution. We had coffe together in the morning and we also had the chance to have some interesting talk. The house was cozy and clean. Definitely recommended! ✌🏻
summary: Host Cesar was friendly and helpful, and the guest had a great experience at his place.

comments:
Es war sehr schön. Wir durften früher rein da der Flieger schon um 07:00 landete. Wir durften länger bleiben weil der Flieger erst abends ging.
Von der Minute der Buchung waren wir sofort in Kontakt über Telefon / Messenger . Wie wir zügig und günstig von Heathrow zu ihr gelangen. Also besser geht es nicht. Auch die Begrüßung war lieb und herzlich.
Das Zimmer ist gut. Tisch, Bett , 2 Stühle, Kühlschrank , Wasserkocher und ein Bad direkt daneben. Für alle Fragen war Natalia für uns da. Wir empfehlen Natalia gerne weiter und würden beim nächsten Aufenthalt in London wieder bei ihr einkehren.
Frühstücken kann man ca 300 m weiter im Ambassey Café. Die Bahnstation ist in 40 Sekunden zu erreichen. Ebenso der co-op Shop.
Also alles perfekt.
summary: Guest had a perfect stay at Natalia's place, praising its amenities, location, and host's communication.

comments: Leanne is a lovely, friendly host and we had a really comfortable stay at her home whilst up in Woolwich for a party.  Leanne provided the makings of a nice breakfast in the morning and we were off back home well rested and fed.  We would be happy to stay again and recommend to anyone.
summary: Leanne is a lovely host who provided a comfortable stay for the guests, including breakfast.

comments: Very warm and friendly hosts offering a quiet and wonderfully immaculate apartment with a large and comfortable  bedroom, a fully-equipped kitchen, and a lovely living room overlooking the garden -  perfect for "hanging out" but just a short walk to buses or overground trains to get wherever you need and close to a variety of cafes and restaurants.
summary: Hosts were warm and friendly, offering a clean and quiet apartment with great amenities.

comments: The location is fantastic - Basically a half block from Victoria Station. That means not only quick access to transportation (we used rail, underground, city buses, and tour buses on the trip), but a wide range of shops (food stores, drug store). Other people have mentioned hearing the trains underground, but that really wasn’t very noticeable to us. The place is very clean and well kept. The only issue was, as others mentioned, it was a little warm. The fan helped a lot, but ac would have been better during a hot spell in London that week. Overall, a good place to stay.
summary: Guest enjoyed the fantastic location, cleanliness, and amenities, but noted it was a bit warm.

comments: This place is simplistic with lots of great literature and art scattered throughout the house giving great energy and nonchalant vibes. The amenities and the location of this place is phenomenal. The host gave us amazing recommendations and I wasn’t disappointed. I wish I could l pay rent and stay there. Definitely worth it.
summary: Guest loved the simplistic yet energetic atmosphere, great literature, and phenomenal location.

comments:
Was seriously impressed the second we walked through the door. It was a lovely clean apartment and exactly what we needed for our few days in london. The tea, coffee, sugar, oil etc were very handy.
My only grumble is we wish the balcony was the other side of the building so we could enjoy the spectacular night view.
summary: Guest was impressed with the clean apartment, location, and amenities, but wished for a different balcony view.

comments:
What can I say after being let down terribly by another host cancelling on us the morning of the stay nocarz suggested a few other places and Silvia’s place fit the bill perfectly. At very short notice and after some frantic messaging Silvia saved the day and I can’t thank her enough she is very kind and so accommodating even adding little treats for our arrival. The apartment is very stylish beautifully clean and in a fabulous location with easy travel links nearby. Again I can’t recommend this enough and I think we will definitely be back at sometime.
Thank you Silvia for saving our trip xx
summary: Guest was grateful to Silvia for saving their trip after another host cancelled, praising her kindness and accommodation.

comments: Originally, I booked another nocarz, but the host canceled an hour before check in. Hannah came to my rescue, and responded right away, and got me checked in within the hour! I was very impressed and grateful. I loved the area. It was very peaceful and the nocarz was exactly as described. Hannah and her team provided written instructions that included pictures. Very helpful. Thank you, Hannah!
summary: Hannah was very responsive and helpful, getting the guest checked in quickly after another host canceled.

comments: Truly this apartment is exactly as described!!  My two friends and I stayed for one night as we transitioned to the countryside the following day.... probably best for 2 people but fine for 3 for a short stay.  Apartment was very clean and the host was accommodating with our luggage before check in,  super friendly to communicate with and an extremely easy and smooth check in/out..  loved it!!
summary: The apartment was exactly as described, clean, and easy to check in/out with a friendly host.

comments: Je vous recommande fortement de séjourner chez Cathy. Elle est très attentionnée, la maison est très au calme, il y règne le respect ainsi que la bienveillance. La maison est très propre et délicatement décorée, la chambre est superbe. Il y a un magnifique jardin à l'arrière de la maison. Un joli coin de paradis dans Londres!
summary: Cathy's house is peaceful, clean, and beautifully decorated, highly recommended for a stay in London.

comments: Staying with Manuella was simply wonderful. Her house is so lovely and clean - it's also in a fantastic location. Quiet and tranquil yet close to amenities and public transport. Wimbledon itself is a fab place. Manuella waited up for us despite me and my Mum not being so good with directions in London ;-) When we arrived (much later than planned) she offered us tea or coffee and showed us round. The bedroom was so nice and the bed itself was very comfortable. Bathroom was lovely and clean and the shower was fab. Myself and my Mum would very happily stay with Manuella time and time again. It's just a shame that we arrived so late and didn't get to spend more time there. Jesse (is that right?) the dog and Buster the cat were also so friendly! I liked everything about this place and would recommend it to anyone. Thanks Manuella - hope to stay with you again in the future. I'm coming to Wimbledon again next year so will stay with you if you're still doing the nocarz business. Thanks. Nick
summary: Manuella's house was lovely, clean, and well-located, with a friendly host who made the guest feel welcome.

comments:
Evan is very friendly and proactive, he helped us and always replied us quickly.
The flat was a bit small for three people, but well accessorized and nice. The position was good, well linked to the main underground stations.
It had only two points against: it wasn’t specified that the toilet (WC) was in a separate room from the main bathroom and the windows didn’t seal the apartment well and a lot of cold air and noise from the street passed through them.
Thank you Evan for hosting us, we had a great time in London!
summary: Evan's flat was small but nice, well-equipped, and in a good location, despite some minor issues with the bathroom and windows.

comments: David and Allan were both very lovely and helpful. The place looked exactly as described, was very tidy and my friend and I felt safe staying there. The area was nice as well and the tube station was just a short walk from the place. We were both happy with our stay and would definitely stay there again in the future. :)
summary: The place was exactly as described, tidy, safe, and in a nice area.

comments: The location was very nice, it was right next to the portobello market and not that far to the kensington garden in my opinion. You could walk there if you like walking around. There was a kitchen which everyone could use, very clean and a little balcony? Which everyone can use too. The cat next door visits most of the time. Very friendly and the balcony is clean too.
summary: The location was great, the apartment was clean and had a balcony with a friendly cat visiting.

comments: Neo was a great host! It’s always a big help when you can drop off luggage after an early flight and Neo was kind enough to accommodate. Everything was clean and cozy. We took the train every day to get to where we wanted to go and it was very easy. I even enjoyed sitting out on the balcony as cold as it was! Thanks again Neo!
summary: Neo was a great host who accommodated early luggage drop-off and provided a clean and cozy space.

comments:
I can recommend this apartment and the the host 100%!
Don't let the run-down stairway scare you off when climbing up the stairs ;) - the apartment/room itself and bathroom is absolutely clean (and the latter even recently renovated) and there is absolutely nothing to criticize. I really appreciated the little goodies like sknacks and toiletries which were provided for free. Nazrul was always very helpful and polite!
The tube station "All Saints" is a 2 min walk, there are also several bus stops nearby. Perfect if you have a concert at the O2 arena. ;)
I have never heard of the borough Poplar before but it was a really nice surrounding even with a marina nearby. And don't miss the famous traffic light tree! ;)
summary: This apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and in a convenient location near public transport.

comments: Henry was a friendly and responsive host who was flexible with our check-in time when our flight arrived early which we greatly appreciated. We enjoyed our stay at his flat which is accurately described in the pictures; it was clean, comfortable and safe. The sitting room at the sub-level still gets plenty of daylight and the bedroom located down a flight of stairs into the basement level gave us privacy and quiet time. The neighborhood is beautiful with plenty of cafes and restaurants within quick walking distance.
summary: Henry's flat was accurately described, clean, comfortable, and safe with a beautiful neighborhood.

comments: John was a lovely host and greeted us at the apartment to show us everything. He was on hand for any queries we had during our stay, and even let us check out later than the planned time. The apartment was lovely and was ideal for us for the 4 days we were there. Perfect location for the tube and DLR and easy access to central London! Clean, tidy and well kept. Would recommend this host and apartment to anyone.
summary: Lovely host, perfect location, clean and tidy apartment.

comments:
Literally not a single complaint.
Eleonora replied quickly to all messages and was very polite.
The apartment was in a great location based in the heart of Shoreditch. You couldn’t hear any of the night life noises even with being so central, which was great. Apartment was clean and tidy and had everything me and my girlfriends needed.
Would 100% stay again.
summary: Great location, polite host, clean and quiet apartment.

comments: This was my first time using nocarz and I will definitely be using this service more if all my future hosts are like Javier and his wife! The flat is located 50 m from the underground, so it was really easy to get from A to B. I would definitively stay here again next time I’m in London!
summary: Excellent location, friendly host, easy to get around London.

comments:
Jodi is a super host. I don't know how many questions I had for her before and after we arrive and she always tried to answer my questions and made recommendations. She's helping us to find the best way to get to attractions.
London Underground was planning a strike on the day we arrived. She gave us all the information how to get to her place other than underground.
The place is clean. Although we only have our room but we can use her living room and kitchen. Very nice.
Locations is good especial if you leave her place to Heathrow. We had Uber for 7 pounds and hop on Piccadilly line directly to terminal 3. Piccadilly line goes to Heathrow terminals 2,3,4 and 5.
If I ever go to London, I'll book with her again. Highly recommended.
summary: Super helpful host, clean place, great location for Heathrow.

comments: Gemma's place is excellent for a few-day stay - it has everything you need (including towels, shampoo etc.). It was great to feel that someone is living there - many photos, a gramophone player with LPs, a fully equipped kitchen - mainly this is great because some other hosts don't provide everything you might need to cook something. However, the bed is relatively small for two people with only one duvet, which might be a complication for some couples. Also, the apartment is on the ground floor, so you must always keep your blinds closed if you don't like other people looking inside. The last inconvenience was that the neighbour over us had a party at midnight, and since the walls are thin, we heard everything (but I can imagine this was a one-time thing as it happened only once during the week stay).
summary: Good value for a short stay, but some minor issues with bed and noise.

comments:
A lovely flat and welcoming couple in a quit part of a very well connected neighborhood on the central line. The Underground is at 10 min walk and one station away from the overground. There are many buses to central London and other major parts of the city. About 30 min from central London. Very easy to get by. Lots of places to get food on the main street, a supermarket, a great pub, hair salons, you name it!
The flat is very clean and beautifully decorated which makes a very cozy and peaceful atmosphere. All the facilities are great; the heating, washing machine, TV, WIFI, the bathroom is nice, the room is functional, lots of storage space, a full length mirror, comfortable bed, nicely illuminated by the light coming in from the big window. Becky and Matt are the nicest people and very easy to get along with, friendly, welcoming and positive! I highly recommend this place to anyone who visits London !
summary: A lovely flat with a welcoming couple in a quiet neighborhood near central London.

comments: The place is great, clean and enough space for 2 couples or a small family. On 5th floor so far enough away from road to not hear much of it. Aircon in main bedroom and lounge which was nice. Furniture is immaculate and the place is decorated to a high standard. Local eateries and shops nearby and walking distance to tube station etc
summary: A great, clean place with plenty of space for 2 couples or a small family.

comments: We used this property for a school reunion during a hot weekend in July. The place was absolutely perfect for 8 people to stay and it was immaculately clean. The terrace is fantastic and we ate out there on the first night. The rooms were all a good size and two bathrooms meant there were no queues in the morning. Sarah was a great host with quick communication and really helpfully organising a parking permit for me. All in all - would highly recommend.
summary: Perfect property for a group stay with a fantastic terrace and immaculate cleanliness.

comments: Visited London for the first time with our 2 adult children. This flat is bigger than it looks in the pics and is enough space for 4 adults. Really enjoyed the gas fireplace and high quality sheets and pillows. Right by the tube station, which made it easy to get to and from Heathrow. Train noise didn't bother us. Wifi was spotty in the second bedroom so they may want to add a wifi extender. Otherwise it was a great stay!
summary: A spacious flat with a gas fireplace and high-quality amenities near the tube station.

comments:
We had a flight delayed and we suppose to reach home between 10
To 11 and we ended up by 1 to 2 but Rebecca was really nice she was waiting for us till we check in and she was really helpful in all means and the place is really comfortable for travelling and very clean and comfortable room recommend to stay again thank u
summary: A comfortable and clean place to stay with helpful hosts despite a delayed arrival.

comments: Gracias Fabio, el mejor nocarz en londres, esta es la razón por la que existen los superhost, el cuarto es muy céntrico y te da muchas facilidades como un microondas, toalla, shampoo, jabón, mini refri, y una smart tv, no pude pedir mejor estadía, lo recomiendo mucho, fue mucho mejor por lo que pague
summary: Guest had a great stay at Fabio's place in London, highly recommending it for its central location and amenities.

comments:
We stayed at this house for 1 week and it was lovely.. The house is very clean and all the facilities works well. Me and my family felt very welcomed.
Sid has been very helpful with arranging our needs!
The house is located in a quite community which was amazing, moreover all the local stores,restaurants and transports are very close by within minutes.
Had really good time there.
summary: Guest had a lovely week-long stay at Sid's house, praising its cleanliness, facilities, and welcoming atmosphere.

comments:
A very nice flat in a quiet place in Deptford/Greenwich. The room is comfortable, has its own bathroom/toilet. Heating on all day. Umbrellas are available for the rainy day. USB plug available. Within 5-8 minutes walk is Creek street and another 10 munites to Cutty Sark and Greenwich. I would highly recommend it. I would definitely come back.
Thank you, Fatih and Sibel.
summary: Guest enjoyed their stay at Fatih and Sibel's flat in Deptford/Greenwich, recommending it for its comfort, location, and amenities.

comments:
The most comfortable beds that I hv experienced in all the nocarzs that we have stayed - for both the master and the second bedroom. Linen is also very comfortable.
Spacious master bedroom.
Good kitchen. Good washer dryer.
Only thing I would say is that traffic at night is pretty loud - not for light sleepers.
summary: Guest had a comfortable stay at Shameem's place, praising the beds, linen, and kitchen, but noting some traffic noise.

comments:
Truly a home away from home.
My parents flew from Bangkok and had such a lovely time at Shameem's that they hardly felt the need to go out at all even though it's right in the middle of Walthamstow Village and the high street and tube station to central London are just a short walk away. We enjoyed cooking in the spacious and open kitchen area and later lounging and drinking in the garden.
Shameem was very understanding and flexible right from the booking process, and was very helpful and responsive whilst we were staying there.
Very ready to book again next year.
summary: Guest had a wonderful home-away-from-home experience at Shameem's place in Walthamstow Village, praising its location, amenities, and host's flexibility.

comments: We stayed here with two small children and couldn't have hoped to find anything more ideal. The apartment is well-located, comfortable and was spotless when we arrived. Stephen was a great host, always responding to queries. The apartment is especially good if you are travelling with children, with kids books and toys in the apartment which kept our two entertained throughout our stay. Too bad it was raining most days we were there and we didn't get to enjoy the spacious terrace. We would definitely recommend this place and would definitely come back, even if travelling without kids.
summary: The apartment was ideal for families with kids, with a great location, comfortable space, and amenities like toys and books.

comments: Amazing place in a perfect location! Owners were great, extremely responsive, and offered their personal recommendations for touring London. We comfortably slept two families of 4, while utilizing the loft area for two of the kids. Some of the decor is a little “mature” but our kids appreciated the artistic nature of the place. The only issues we really had - which were NOT big issues - were the lower floors were much cooler than the top floor/loft (but there is a skylight window you can open to let cool air in) and we had an issue with getting warm water in one of the showers. Otherwise, we loved it. Would definitely recommend.
summary: This place is perfect for large groups or families, with plenty of space and a responsive owner who offers great recommendations.

comments:
Everything was perfect during our two days in Alejandro's place.
The room was clean and very handsome, no problems with the communication and Alejandro is one of the best host I have ever had, nice and friendly, and me and my girlfriend liked very much talking with him during our (very nice) breakfast.
The location is good, from his house you can reach a metro station in just a couple of minutes walk.
summary: Alejandro's place was clean, handsome, and in a good location, with excellent communication from the host.

comments:
Place was very very small but nice and clean.
Bed was comfy and furnishings were nice.
Very hard to get large luggage up and down the stairs into the apartment and has a very tall step into the bedroom which is difficult if you have hurt legs or mobility issues.
Otherwise a nice stay.
summary: The apartment is small but nice and clean, although it may be difficult for people with mobility issues to navigate.

comments: Nick was a great, responsive host! Many thanks for the personal attention and quick responses throughout. For example, there was a problem with the washing machine, so Nick proactively arranged for a delivery of fresh linens and towels halfway throughout the stay as well as some cash to wash clothes at a launderette nearby.
summary: Nick was a great host who responded quickly to any issues that arose during the stay.

comments:
Charlie’s accommodation is perfect for a little week-end ! With a great location about buses, underground,.., this accommodation is good to discover London. Charlie is cool and we can discuss with him even we haven’t the same language.
If I return in London, I would like to stay in his appartment.

A really uncomfortable poor quality bed, poor communication, and poor hospitality.
have stayed in another one of Julies room before and had great communication and a great stay. this stay was way below par. Code for key was not provided and called several times to ask her for it, and no reply. luckily I found key before.
Had text the next day saying I left porch door open, which was not my recollection but text and communication were very abrupt and not at all welcoming.
There is no kitchen but this definitely needs to be made a lot clearer, had I know this I would not have stayed. I was accused of staining sheets with food, at first I thought I may have, but on reflection it just wasn't a possibility at all . Once again her remarks made to me, were beyond patronizing, rude and really quite insulting. I stated 3 nights as everything else in the area was booked but in many years of being on Air Bnb this was one of the most uncomfortable, most inhospitable stays I have had to date. The mattress in this room is way below par, and I'm amazed it hasn't been changed or considered as poor.

Kamilla’s place is close to the center, location is perfect. Checkin is flexible with codes which is amazing. She provided clear instructions on how to get to her place. You can take metro to Warren Street or Euston Station, same walking distance. The only downside is that room is extremly small, for two people it’s too tight honestly. Also, when we arrived, because it’s a shared bathroom, toilet was in a messy state because of the other guests. They also left hair everywhere etc. throughout their stay. I would suggest adding desinfectant because it’s a shared bathroom. I escalated the bathroom situation to Kamilla and also asked her whether she had power converter for EU, however I haven’t received any response from the check in day when I sent this message which is disappointing. There is no power converter, so bring yours. Also, there was a lot of noise in the early mornings around 7 (possibly cleaning lady doing washing etc.), which woke us up.
All in all, the stay was 6/10.

The location is very convenient, with two tube stations nearby. There are plenty of shops and restaurants in the area, and it’s right next to Kensington Gardens, close to Hyde Park. Across the park, you’ll find the Royal Albert Hall and the three major museums: the V&A Museum, the Natural History Museum, and the Science Museum. The room itself was clean, spacious, and well-ventilated. The host was very responsive to our messages. This is definitely a place I would love to visit again.

Jackson was a great host! The listing perfectly conveyed what you can expect from the stay, and was a good price for where it’s located. Jackson was very responsive while messaging through the app, and was super helpful when we had questions.
For an individual or couple, this is the perfect place to stay when you’re wanting to explore London and not break the bank just for a place to sleep. We would definitely stay here again!

The location was what made this place. Especially for a young person in their mid to late twenties but im sure any other foodie or vintage market enthusiast would enjoy!
The room was good and the bed was comfortable, eventho you might need some earplugs for the night if youre a light sleeper.
I’d definitely recommend this place!! And for sure consider coming back!
summary: The location was great, but the room could use some earplugs for light sleepers.

comments: Die Unterkunft war für den Preis absolut in Ordnung. Es hätte durchaus sauberer sein können, aber auf Hinweis hin, haben sie sich bemüht. Die Lage war top, Abuzer war ein sehr zuvorkommender und netter Vermieter. Die Küche ist für die allgemeine Benutzung, ebenso die Bäder. Das war mir vorher nicht klar, aber in Ordnung.
summary: For the price, it was a good stay with a great location and helpful host.

comments: Nunca conocí a Ayodeji. El check in lo hice por mi cuenta, el dejo las instrucciones claras y fue fácil de entrar. Me gustó esa independencia que me dio durante todo el tiempo que estuve ahí. A pesar de que es una habitación dentro de un apartamento nunca lo sentí. Parecía que estaba solo ahí. El barrio tiene fácil acceso a buses y subterráneo. Si quieres caminar al Tower Bridge lo puedes hacer a tan solo 30 minutos a pie. Esta cerca de varias atracciones turísticas. Excelente lugar.
summary: This independent apartment in a good neighborhood was perfect for exploring London on foot.

comments: Ana was a wonderful host! She ensured that we had everything we needed and was quick to respond. The place was perfect for my husband and I and was in a perfect location in Chelsea walkable to many restaurants and bars. We will definitely stay there again next time we are in London!
summary: The host Ana ensured we had everything we needed and the location was ideal for Chelsea's restaurants and bars.

comments: Max and Billie’s nocarz I stayed at was quite compact with thin walls, allowing for neighboring sounds to be easily heard. The upper living space had notably low ceilings that were not conducive for taller guests. I encountered a delay during check-in, which required around a 30-minute wait for a host response. Fortunately, finding the host's direct contact information in the nocarz instructions helped expedite the process. It's worth noting that another guest experienced a similar check-in issue, which I assisted with. This property may be more suitable for short stays and is best suited for solo travelers.
summary: The compact nocarz had thin walls and low ceilings, but the host was responsive and helpful.

comments: Robert and Antonio were really amazing hosts, hands down the best I've met on nocarz so far! They were really helpful, friendly and went the extra mile to make sure we were taken care of and comfortable, picking us up at the bus stop, being very flexible with our check-in despite multiple mishaps on our part, and driving us to the nearby supermarket. The photos speak for the house, and I'm sure the other reviews here are an equal testament to their outstanding hospitality. Strongly recommend!
summary: Robert and Antonio were amazing hosts who went above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay.

comments:
It was our second time staying in Haly’s flat in London and we loved it so much.
Our flight was at night and Haly allowed us to leave our luggage after checking out which was very important and nice for us!
Thank you so much and we would recommend the flat to friends!
summary: Haly's flat in London was loved so much that we returned for a second stay and would recommend it to friends.

comments: Great central location, so easy to get where we needed to so prrfect for our stay. Had a few initial issues with the WiFi but host was responsive and we got it sorted. We did notice a few minor bits that could do with a touch up which is the only reason not to give 5 stars but the place was comfy, spacious and perfect for our stay.  Great value for the price,Thank you!
summary: The flat had a great central location, comfy space, and good value for the price, but could use some minor touch-ups.

comments: What a fabulous place to stay!  We loved the location, handy to The Tube, a short walk to Portobello Road, lots of good options for meals close-by and a neighborhood with a great vibe.  But once in the flat, everything was quiet and calm and it was fun to watch the activity on the streets below.  Kitchen was adequate for what we needed for breakfast and snacks.  Bed was super comfortable. Internet was reliable and strong.  Keeping this one in mind the next time we are in London.
summary: This fabulous place to stay was loved for its convenient location, quiet atmosphere, and comfortable bed.

comments: Keren's space was an exceptional experience from beginning to end. The decor has been thoughtfully curated and elevated and yet as soon as you walk in, you feel at home. I appreciate the location being just north of Notting Hill (yet an incredibly close to walk to Westbourne Grove) and close to Goldborne Road a street with great character. The flat has been redone to provide great storage / closet space and beautiful features (claw foot bathtub), which were all appreciated during my time spent there. Having a terrace and the spacious footprint in London is hard to come by, so feel lucky to have discovered this gem of a space. Would highly recommend!
summary: Keren's exceptional space had a thoughtful decor, great storage, and beautiful features, making it a gem in London.

comments:
Nous avons logé 8 jours, et la maison correspondait à toutes nos attentes.
Confort des lieux, très bien situé, à distance de marche d'un métro et du stade de foot, wifi qui fonctionne très bien.
Nous avons trouvé la maison parfaite pour nous accueillir.
Beau quartier résidentiel tranquille .
Les hôtes ont répondu rapidement quand nous avons envoyé des messages.
Les défis de cette maison étaient pour nous typique et charmeur : nombre d'étages , quantité de marches et douches qui évacue lentement et étaient connu dès le départ, donc pas de surprise.
Pour une première à Londres, nous avons été très satisfaits.
Merci pour ce beau séjour
summary: The house met all our expectations and was perfect for a stay in London.

comments:
One of the loveliest hosts I have ever met through nocarz! Communication with Vanessa was always quick and clear. Vanessa also decorated the rooms with fresh flowers and welcome notes, which made us feel very comfortable and welcomed at the flat.
The flat itself is very well-equipped, cozy and spotless clean. My mother is a vegetarian but her friends are not. Nevertheless it was an interesting experience to use a vegetarian kitchen at Vanessa's for a week. The flat is close to all the amenities: tesco, boots, local pubs & restaurants etc. and is 5 mintues away from Bethnal Green station, which takes one to central London directly.
Overall my mother & her friends who stayed at Vanessa's place were very pleased with the experience and overall, had a great time in London!
Thanks Vanessa!
summary: Vanessa's flat is well-equipped, cozy, and spotless clean with great amenities nearby.

comments:
l'appartement se situe au 4eme sans ascenseur,
petit studio avec tout ce qu'il faut la ou il faut
pas de soucis particulier, à part un bruit de pompe récurrent toute la nuit, sinon à part ça parfait
je recommande pour la facilité d'accès, les métros à proximité le park et les divers magasins.
summary: A small studio apartment with some minor issues but good location and access to public transport.

comments:
Amazing place, great host!
Filip's place is absolutely lovely, bright and super clean! The room and the bathroom look exactly as you can see in the pics. Filip is a great host. Friendly and polite. The house is located in front of the Marina. You will have an outstanding view from the living room. The apartment is just a few mins walking from the DLR and from many different buses. Very close there is a Tesco express and 10 mins walking a Lidl. House and host highly recommend!!
summary: Filip's place is lovely, bright, and super clean with an amazing view of the Marina.

comments: L’appartement de Denny est bien situé à 10’ de St Pancras et du British Muséum. Simplement meublé, il est fonctionnel et bien équipé (machine à laver séchante), bonne literie. L’appartement se trouve ds un quartier assez tranquille juste au dessus d’une agence de coursier un peu bruyante ponctuellement le soir et le matin.
summary: Denny's flat is well-located near St Pancras and the British Museum but has some minor noise issues.

comments: Beautiful and pleasant place in a quiet residential area. A little away from the main parts but easy access to a tube station ,10mins away.  A very homely place that can accommodate a large crowd. The house instructions were clear and the host responds immediately for anything and they are really helpful !
summary: Beautiful and pleasant place in a quiet residential area with easy access to public transport.

comments:
Le séjour s'est très bien passé. Rubie (co-hôte) est très réactive et très aimable. La communication était très facile.
L'appartement a été refait et ne correspond plus tout à fait aux photos. il n'est pas très grand, mais très bien agencé, et très agréable. Un peu chaud dans la mezzanine l'été.
La cuisine gagnerait cependant à être mieux équipée pour un séjour un peu long (une passoire pour les pâtes ou le riz, un couteau d'office, une quatrième fourchette...).
L'emplacement est absolument parfait, avec un accès facile au centre de Londres grâce à la station de métro (deux lignes parfaites pour les touristes : Jubilee et Metropolitan) à moins de 5 minutes à pieds !
summary: The apartment was well-furnished and located in a perfect spot for exploring London, but could use some additional kitchen equipment.

comments:
El anuncio de Daniella se ajusta perfectamente a la realidad.
El espacio tiene mucha luz, es muy limpio, confortable y permite alojar4 personas con comodidad.
El apartamento está muy bien comunicado con el centro de Londres con dos líneas de Underground muy próximas y el bus 70 que te deja directamente en el mercado de Notting Hill tiene parada justo a 1 minuto de la casa.
Daniella es muy amable y se preocupó en todo momento de que hubiéramos llegado bien y que todo estuviera correcto.
Sin ninguna duda, recomiendo este alojamiento.
summary: The space was very comfortable, clean, and well-communicated with the city center, with a friendly host who ensured everything went smoothly.

comments:
This is a very good location for exploring London.
A short walk from Hammersmith bus station.
No 9 to Soho 23 to Trafalgar square 211 to Waterloo via Fulham and Chelsea.
Or tube to anywhere in the city. right on the doorstep.
The flat was clean and although fairly basic, suited us for our
week in London at a very reasonable price.
Would use again if back in the City.
summary: This is a great location for exploring London, with easy access to public transport and a clean, basic flat at a reasonable price.

comments: The location was perfect. I was apprehensive about this as I had to go to a few different places but I couldn’t have asked for a better place. It was near lots of public transport and in an area that was interesting (often this is the trade off). My only compliant is that the unit is on a busy street so it’s noisy for light sleepers. It also doesn’t have AC (usual for London) so it was quite hot. But honestly, for the price, cleanliness, location and comfort - I had no problem dealing with these issues. IMO location makes or breaks a holiday and this one scores high points for fun and convenience.
summary: The unit's perfect location made up for its noise and lack of air conditioning, offering a comfortable stay at an affordable price.

comments: A great family or group house to stay in. Well equipped with everything you need and plenty of space. There is a lovely private garden which will be perfect in good weather. Well placed for exploring Greenwich which has lots to offer. Kevin was there to meet us and show us round and there is an extensive information pack which was very helpful.

Ewa could not have been more helpful. A mere mention that I'd like to know about restaurants and coffee shops led to two extensive listings complete with reasons for recommendation, when it was crowded, whether it was worth the wait and a sense of pricing. I was grateful.
Ewa also met us and made us feel very welcome. The apartment was well appointed, had everything we needed, and Ewa made sure we understood how things worked. Finally, being from the US and never having used a washer/dryer combination, I emailed her asking if we could use the washing machine and she emailed back immediately telling me how it worked and that it was fine to use it. She was very, very helpful, even by nocarz standards, which we have found are pretty high.

Nous n'avons pas rencontré directement Leonora mais les instructions pour arriver étaient très claires. Nous avons séjourné en même temps qu'une autre voyageuse et les espaces n'étaient pas un problème à partager. Notre chambre était suffisamment spacieuse et équipée comme il fallait (2 grands lampadaires en lumière indirecte en plus de la lumière centrale +Leonora nous a gentiment prêté des prises européennes pour recjarger nos téléphones car nous avions oublié les nôtres 🙂). Nous nous sommes senti "comme à la maison". Ce qui était très appréciable : le train, le bus, le supermarché au pied de l'immeuble ainsi que le pub local! Excellente expérience, très bon rapport qualité-prix. Si nous devions revenir, on reviendrait là. Un grand merci pour votre hospitalité Leonora !

Simone and John represent the epitome of hospitality. They welcomed our little family with such generous arms and took incredible care of us. This was especially true when our littlest got sick and they went out of their way to pick up some food for him and even introduced us to their pharmacist. Our favorite highlights included the delicious daily breakfast and a leisurely afternoon spent in their company learning about our shared interests. While you could certainly stay here and keep to yourself on the top floor, you would be doing yourself a disservice, as Simone and John are such an essential part of the experience.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS - sat in the car park for 2 hours trying to contact host, contacted air bnb and had to wait a further hour as they give an opportunity for host to respond. Ended up driving 2 hours home following our show in London as no where else to stay at short notice in the local area. Host blocked my calls after not answering the first few times. Absolute waste of our night off and looking at the reviews for the last month (after we booked) several unlucky people have had the same experience. Very frustrating and host still will not reply to messages even though they are delivered and read. Shouldn’t be allowed to host as very stressful. We were lucky we could drive home… some people have no where else to stay as travelling from abroad.

We had an absolutely lovely stay in your beautiful home. Great communication with you right from the start. We felt so welcome and the kids thoroughly enjoyed their time in the house. It was very kind of you to offer us access to pretty much everything in your home which was above and beyond anything I expected. Highly recommend!! *****
summary: Guest had an amazing stay, great communication, and felt welcome.

comments: Great location and the flat is nice and stylish. The bedroom is spacious and the kitchen is on the small side if you plan to cook a lot of meals but perfect if you are coming and going, it was as shown in the pictures. Olya was very accommodating and had great communication.
summary: Guest enjoyed the location and stylish flat, with good communication from Olya.

comments: I thoroughly enjoyed my one night at Anne's.  I must admit I was a literary apprehensive about how well I would sleep as it was a really hot day In London, but Anne was helpful enough to suggest I sleep on the bed next to the window. Anne was great at keeping touch with me with regard to my ETA and was at home when she said.  Anne explained everything really well! The home on a relatively quiet street and the bedroom I was in was on ground floor facing the leafy back yard, very picturesque! A lovely room and comfy bed! I will try to book again the next time I'm coming from to London!
summary: Guest had a lovely stay, comfortable bed, and appreciated Anne's helpfulness.

comments:
Great location near many bars and cafes, but still a quiet street. Host was kind and very accommodating, allowing me to check in 3 hours early when she learned my flight was landing earlier in the morning.
Flat is basic with minimal decor/furnishing and those stairs are no joke, but a good value for the location and size.
summary: Guest liked the location, but found the flat basic and stairs challenging.

comments: The bedroom was great! The area is beautiful and to the underground is only a 2 minute walk! Unfortunately the other guests were quite loud and we woke up pretty early since the walls a pretty thin and you can hear the people walking down the staircase. It was also very hot but to be fair apartments in London aren't built for 32 degrees. The room is equipped with a fan so the heat was bearable. The communication with the owners was also very uncomplicated and they're very polite. The vents in the bathrooms should be cleaned sometime but other than that, it was a pleasant stay.
summary: Guest enjoyed the bedroom and area, but was disturbed by loud guests and heat.

comments:
The apartment is very nice and clean!
The position is very good, 15 min walk to the metro station, in a quite neighbour. We haven't met Tomasz but the communication with him was perfect, he gave us all the instruction to easily find the apartment and make the check in without any problem.
summary: The apartment is very nice and clean with perfect communication from the host.

comments: Ed‘s place is in a great location, near Camden and near London city. The area is quite quiet an opposite of a park. The flat is small, but everything in it you need. Only the bathroom is really tiny. All in all good value for a couple of days in London.
summary: Ed's place has a great location but a small flat with a tiny bathroom.

comments: Such a great apartment, in a perfect location. We loved the business of the neighborhood, and the street noise at night was no big deal. We could barely hear it from the third floor. The stairs were only a challenge when leaving, carrying the luggage down the narrow stairs. But other than that, it was perfect.
summary: This apartment is in a perfect location despite some street noise at night.

comments: Staying at Helena's was  great . The area is wonderful, with lots of fabulous shops, cafes and the market, and it is very easy to get around London. Although this is a basement apartment, once you are inside it is lovely, comfortable and quiet. Comfy bed, good heating, hot water ....and many beautiful books to read if you love art and literature. All our communications with Helena were quick and smooth and she was very helpful with check in and check out, even offering to help us after we left with finding my phone which I lost on the last day. She even brought us flowers.  Thanks Helena
summary: Helena's basement apartment is lovely and comfortable with excellent communication from the host.

comments: BE AWARE! This is a trap not a house. The host is cutting corners and running a very unsafe listing. nocarz will not do anything to help you. The whole place was not cleaned on arrival nor during anytime. The sheets were from previous guest, there was no towels, nothing in the house until we told them and they purchased them. On checkout i watched as the “cleaner” folded our used dirty towels for the next guests (arriving that day) to use without washing them, she did not wash the sheets either. My family and i watched as she did this and nocarz could care less. The house has had some kind of major water damage because windows are boarded up with tape and garbage bags, there are burn marks all over the house, strong smell of smoke and dangerous mold. Half of my family had to move out and book a hotel due to mold allergy. The host lied about sending a cleaner when we brought up the dirty sheets, human body hair in the beds. nocarz will not protect you from this. no exaggeration.
summary: The house was dirty and unsafe with major water damage and mold issues.

comments:
This one room apartment is for me a good place to stay if you are not going to spend so much time at the actual apartment.
You basically have everything you need.
The pressure of the shower is a joke. But as the host have explained, it’s noting she can fix due to some piping issues. Just takes a little bit longer to shower.
Also the bed for two people is kind of small. You will feel ur companions every move on that bed. There is a TV and dining table in the same room if you need dose.
The location is great. It’s walking distance to canary warf. If you like walking, or there is a bus station really close as well they will take you there if you don’t.
Getting inside was smooth as well with the instructions you get from the host.
There is a super market (LiDL) really close if you need to buy anything.
I would recommend this place if you are visiting London for a couple of nights.
summary: A good one-room apartment for short stays with some minor issues, but great location near Canary Wharf.

comments: Wonderfully located cozy, clean studio, perfect for solo travelers, so convenient to public transportation everywhere (including central London and all the airports and train stations). Mark gave great local recommendations and keeps the flat well stocked. But keep in mind though that there’s no stove so don’t plan on real cooking. And note that there are stairs to navigate, including a pretty long, narrow spiral staircase. Definitely recommend though!
summary: A cozy and clean studio with a convenient location, perfect for solo travelers, but no stove and stairs to navigate.

comments: Alles in allem eine gute Wohnung die Bäder und Küche hätten etwas sauberer sein können. Generell sieht die Wohnung inzwischen etwas abgenutzter aus als auf den Bildern und die Matratzen sind etwas durchgelegen sodass man die Federn schon etwas spürt. Jedoch ist die Lage für den Preis super. Es ist trotz Großstadt sehr ruhig und man ist schnell an zentralen Punkten.
summary: A good apartment in a quiet area with a great price, but some cleanliness issues and worn-out mattresses.

comments: The host, Karim, was awesome. Right away i felt welcome and at home. He showed us around the apartment and its amenities. He graciously left us the essentials to cook and so forth also. The flat is nice with modern updates and is in the area Limehouse, We enjoyed being close to Canary Wharf as well, Transportation was simple as well, the DLR and tube are close.
summary: A nice flat with modern updates and a welcoming host who provided essentials for cooking.

comments: Clare's place was excellent. We needed a place for my parents while they visited us from Canada. Clare was quick to respond to any questions and very helpful. Check in was simple. The flat is clean, comfortable and has all the amenities you could want. I highly recommend this place to anyone wanting to stay in the area.
summary: An excellent flat that is clean, comfortable, and well-equipped, highly recommended for stays in the area.

comments:
Diana's apartment was easy to find and right near a bus stop that took us straight to the ExCel (the reason we stayed there).
Even though Diana was at work when we arrived, she was very responsive when we arrived.
We felt welcome at the apartment and was offered tea, coffee, milk etc
Towels were left on the bed for us to use to shower but we got there late and left early so did not make much use of the bathroom.
Would definitely recommend.
summary: Diana's apartment was easy to find and welcoming with a responsive host.

comments: Andrew bent over backwards to help us have a good stay. He was incredibly considerate and accommodating despite our error with dates. The flat was immaculate, extremely well appointed, spacious and very comfortable. Very convenient for the tube and other amenities (e.g. New M&S < 5 mins walk). Cannot rate the place or the owner highly enough. It actually CAN sleep 5 comfortably.
summary: Andrew's flat was immaculate, well-appointed, and convenient for amenities.

comments: One of the best nocarz stays my wife and I have ever stayed at. Ronda is very very kind and will help you with anything you need, she even helped me find an amazing hair stylist right around the corner. Everything from beginning to end was pleasant and correct. The mattress is amazing too. Totally recommended.
summary: Ronda's place was one of the best nocarz stays, kind host, and comfortable with an amazing mattress.

comments:
Geräumiges und modern ausgestattetes Haus. Bei der Anreise erwartete uns eine kleine Aufmerksamkeit. (Danke). Schnelle Kommunikation mit Reann und Ade bereits vor und während des Aufenthalts. Es muss mehr Augenmerk auf die Sauberkeit gelegt werden.
Leider konnten wir bei dem schönen Wetter den Garten nicht nutzen (dies wurde uns allerdings erst mit der Check-In Informationen mitgeteilt, obwohl der Garten lt Bewertungen schon seit längerem nicht nutzbar ist)
In der Umgebung befinden sich mehrere Bushaltestellen und die Bahnstation Homerton, mit denen man in die Innenstadt fahren kann
summary: Reann and Ade's house was spacious and modern but cleanliness needs improvement.

comments: John is the very helpful landlord and his response is very quick. We have enjoyed very clean studio and good experience in this trip. Also location is very convenient, we can go central London is very convenient! There have many kinds of shops and restaurants we can buy and enjoy the meal.
summary: John's studio was very clean and convenient for central London with many shops and restaurants nearby.

comments: Wow. Where to start. We’ve just left having spent 2 nights there and have already said we will definitely be returning. The price was amazing and well worth it. It was easy to get too, literally a 5 minute walk from the tube station and was in a beautiful neighbourhood. The room itself was perfect!! So spacious, massive tv which we made use of, and the bed was so amazing! So so comfortable, better than mine at home. We came and went as we pleased but ended up spending more time in the room than expected as it was just nice to relax in. Thank you so so much we will definitely be returning. Very happy :)
summary: Guest had an amazing experience at the accommodation, praising its price, location, room, and host.

comments: Super host! Amelia was an amazing host and her place really exceeded my expectations. Great location, clean, great room and bathroom and access to the kitchen. Amelia is a lovely host, really welcoming and friendly. I was a bit ill with a nasty cough when I arrived and she really looked after me, she brought me soup and cough medicine and I felt so looked after. And it was lovely chatting with her and her daughter. I really enjoyed meeting them both. If I’m ever in the area again I will definitely stay again. Highly recommend!
summary: Guest was extremely satisfied with their stay, praising the host's hospitality, cleanliness, and amenities.

comments:
Mandeep was away the weekend we stayed so unfortunately we didn't meet, but his log cabin was lovely. We were sent clear instructions on how to gain entry to the cabin, his communication was excellent.
The cabin was clean, well equipped and felt bigger than I had expected from the photos. Our party was 2 adults and 2 children and we had plenty of room.
The M&S food at the end of the road is very handy and such a short walk.
I found the wifi a bit hit and miss (but that might have just been me).
summary: Guest had a pleasant experience at the log cabin, appreciating its cleanliness, equipment, and location.

comments: First of all the hole house and the room is great esthetically and practically in my opinion! And transportation is easy don't worry about that...even at night time. The naiborhood is really friendly for london standars ! Colin is a great host he was very considerate and always happy to answer questions and even make conversation 😁 the two cats were also very friendly. I would definitely stay there again if need be with out even considering looking for another nocarz...
summary: Guest was very pleased with their stay, praising the accommodation's aesthetic, practicality, and host's hospitality.

comments:
The pros: Joe is a very welcoming host, a true londoner who's willing to share a ton of useful tips about the greatest places. We had the opportunity to discuss a lot of subjects with him as he definitely seems to be an open-minded person.
The flat is also very conveniently located, about 150m from the Stockwell station from which the centre of London can be reached in less than 10 minutes.

The cons: the flat is not clean, with the worst part being the toilets and the bathroom. We also had to ask twice for Joe to provide the towels on our day of arrival; he did bring one, after 10pm. No toiletries of any kind were provided.
I understand that this is a cheap accomodation according to the London standards, but in our opinion the minimum requirements in terms of cleanliness and service were not met.

Unfortunately the cons negatively influenced our nocarz experience this time. In our opinion, this place is not suitable for a young couple seeking a simple but clean place to stay for a few days in London, and that is why we can only give two stars for Joe's accomodation.
summary: Guest had a mixed experience, praising the host's welcome and tips but criticizing the cleanliness and service of the accommodation.

comments: Lovely stay thank you! Perfect location and flat for what we needed. Well suited for the children with plastic plates/cups which was a bonus! Noisy street at night but expected so, very comfortable flat with great amenities and walkable to ULCH which was just what we needed. Very friendly proactive host. Thanks so much
summary: Lovely stay with perfect location and amenities, despite some noise from the street.

comments:
L’appartamento è perfetto ! Esattamente quello che è descritto . Posizione eccezionale . Ci si muove a piedi e/o con i mezzi con la massima semplicità . Abbiamo trovato l’appartamento Pulitissimo .
Il letto è molto comodo . Perfetto per due persone .
Anna o Jennifer rispondono immediatamente ad ogni richiesta.
Se dovessimo tornare a Londra sicuramente torneremo !
Consigliatissimo!!!!
summary: Perfect apartment in excellent location, very clean and comfortable, with friendly and responsive host.

comments:
Apartment not very big, but for two people who stay around a lot, it is more than good given the price.
Located in a very quiet area and with many means to get around and with many nearby shops that can provide everything you need during your vacation.
Jane was very kind and super hospitable.
Highly recommended
summary: Good value for price, quiet area, and kind host, but not suitable for large groups.

comments:
The location of Fernando’s place was excellent and very well connected if you’re visiting London. Fernando was a very responsive and accommodating host.
The block of flats is a housing estate and was fairly unsafe. Lots of people coming and going, smell of marijuana throughout the block. The pictures in the listing aren’t completely an accurate reflection of the flat, some of the pictures are of furniture that is no longer there and has a different layout.
The water pressure in the shower is really poor and there is a noticeable mould odor in the bathroom.
summary: Excellent location, but flat had issues with safety, cleanliness, and accuracy of listing photos.

comments:
Sj était très accueillante souriante et adorable ,elle m'a mis du café et du thé ainsi que du lait à disposition dans la chambre ,elle était toujours réactif au message ,elle m'a mis à disposition tous les équipements nécessaires ainsi que toutes les instructions nécessaires à l'accès et au séjours dans son logement.
Je la recommande fortement elle était une hôte parfaite .
summary: Host was very welcoming, responsive, and provided all necessary equipment and instructions.

comments:
Isla is very nice and kind. My English is not good and she would listen to me very patiently.
This is a great place to stay in Battersea. The transport is very convenient. The rooms are very cosy. My friend and I had a very pleasant two nights. There are comfortable beds, well equipped, a spacious kitchen and a cosy living room. Also the terrace is a great space. We enjoyed our stay here. Thank you very much!
summary: Isla is very nice and kind, the apartment has a great location and amenities.

comments:
Merci, cet appartement est fidèle à la description.
Une station d’overground est à 10 minutes à pied, et il y a beaucoup de magasins autour qui facilitent le quotidien. L’appartement est bien équipé et suffisamment grand pour un couple et un enfant.
Un petit bémol cependant : mon conjoint est allergique à la poussière et a fait une grosse crise pendant notre séjour. L’appartement est plutôt propre, mais la moquette doit retenir de la poussière.
summary: The apartment is well-equipped and spacious, but be aware of potential dust allergy issues.

comments: Sehr gute Lage, da Hammersmith von 4 U-Bahnlinien angefahren wird und die Unterkunft 5 Min von den 2 Stationen entfernt liegt. Sehr gutes Preis-Leistungsverhäktnis.  Die Unterkunft war sauber, mit Kühlschrank und Kochgelegenheit und Mikrowelle,  allerdings schon der eine oder andere kleine Makel, hat aber nicht weiter gestört, da man sowieso nur zum Schlafen hier weilt.
summary: Good location, good price, clean apartment with basic amenities.

comments:
We had a wonderful stay at this great apartment. The communication and check in instructions were very clear, the key is collected from a security box at a local off licence, an 8 minute walk away, luckily we were driving so this was very easy for us to collect before heading to the property.
The ‘permit parking’ on the street ends around 6pm on Fridays, so we parked for free on the main road outside for the weekend - this is a great bonus especially for London.
The apartment was very spacious and clean. 2 good sized bedrooms, newly decorated bathroom and large kitchen/living area. The hosts left a bowl of welcome snacks and tea which was a lovely touch, there was no milk but we picked some up from the shop when collecting the key.
The kitchen is fully equipped and has everything you need including a coffee machine.
This didn’t feel like a typical serviced apart and felt more like a home. We will definitely stay again
summary: Wonderful stay at this great apartment, very spacious and clean with excellent communication from the hosts.

comments: We loved our weekend stay at Christine's house - it is clean and beautifully furnished. Christine herself is an amazing host, who helped us with directions to the places we wanted to visit and even cooked for us. She was really lovely, friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend Christine's place to anyone. Thank you Christine.
summary: Christine's house is clean, beautifully furnished, and Christine herself is an amazing host.

comments: James’s place is a really good space for one person or a couple staying in London who wants to stay in central London with easy access to lots of places. Great location, stylish apartment, nice touch with the patio  and very clean above all. Would highly recommend and come back again another time.
summary: Great location, stylish apartment, and very clean with excellent service.

comments:
**first time to London and it was a disaster, I dun have British fake kindness so here are some points to note. good luck everyone :))
-heating is timed (8-10am & 7-11pm)
-wifi you will be using is different from which showing on bnb
-host bang on my door complained I used the air dryer for too long
(as an asian with long thick hair, i bet host couldn’t imagine how long it would take to dry my hair)
**hidden house rules (will be reminded upon your arrival)
-place water faucet handle right in the middle after used (not too left, not too right, perfect)
-leave your room door slightly open when you are out (host entered my room to turn wifi off THX)
-10 mins shower is encouraged
**good points
-gorgeous plants
-host is responsive
-room is well equipped and facilities are in good condition
lastly, as a bnb host, I had bad experience during hosting too but that wont change my way of being considerate and sincere to any stranger aka guest(true advice from a girl under 30, hope u enjoy)
summary: Mixed experience with some issues but also some positives such as responsive host and well-equipped room.

comments:
It was a very nice experience from the first contact. His responses to all our contacts were always very fast and friendly. The Flat was exactly as discribed: fully equipped with all household facilities, even electric adaptors and very clean and comfortable, in a quiet area. We would recommend this flat to anyone. By our next stay in London, we will try to book this flat again.
Thanks to Stefano & Maria
summary: Fast and friendly communication from the host, a fully equipped and clean flat in a quiet area.

comments: Maria Teresa is a wonderful and fun person! She let me move in early, and made arrangements for her housekeeper to let me in on my schedule.  Travel weary, I was able to have a glorious bath in the large marble bathroom. This is such a nice feature for travelers. The flat was the most elegant I've stayed in during my 2 weeks in London. The building and neighborhood were both up-market.  She and I hung out and I felt like I'd made a new friend in London. I defiantly hope to go back some day.
summary: A wonderful and fun host who made the stay feel like home with a beautiful marble bathroom and elegant flat.

comments: We couldn’t have had a better stay. The location was perfect. Check in was easy.
