Alexandre was super responsive with any questions prior to arriving and then upon arrival he was always prompt with answering any questions we had. The flat was a large size and very clean. We loved the unit and the location. It’s right next to two tube stations and backs to a park. It’s easy to walk everywhere and is enough off the beaten path that it feels like you’re in a quiet neighborhood. Definitely recommend and would stay here again.
summary: Perfect location, easy check-in, and prompt communication from the host for a great overall experience.

comments:
We really enjoyed our stay at James’s place. The location was unbeatable and the property itself was beautiful. The host was incredibly responsive which was helpful since we visited during a time when there was a heatwave and needed to ensure there were fans (which there were).
Pro’s: location, beautiful property, responsive and kind host. Well worth the price tag!
Con’s: we have kids with allergies to dust and cats/dogs. They normally do best in places without carpets.
summary: Guests enjoyed their stay, praising location, property, and host, but noted issues with allergies.

comments: We were a family of 6. The space was adequate for us. The half bath was convenient to have with multiple people. We really appreciated the tower fans in the bedrooms and the windows opening as there is no A/C. The unit is on the top floor so that was nice to have no one above and the unit and building was very quiet. The first impression of the building was not great (odor and location) but the unit was nice. The washer/dryer was also very nice to have!  The location was not ideal - long walk to any tube station and bringing luggage to and from. The bus stop was very close so we used that multiple times. Overall this was a decent spot to come back to but if we were looking again I would try and find something closer to a tube station or the tourist attractions in zone 1.
summary: Family of six found the space adequate, but criticized location and lack of air conditioning.

comments: Great location, right in the middle of Shoreditch. Easily walkable, with great restaurants and bars close by. The apartment was clean and spacious. It was def hot and I would be wary staying there when it’s hot outside. We also found there were so many rules and extra charges for things we didn’t feel that comfortable relaxing in the home and didn’t spend much time there. The TV was also not working. There also wasn’t enough time between the change over from us and the last guest so there was a ton of wet laundry in our closet we ended up having to deal with.
summary: Guest was pleased with location, but unhappy with rules, extra charges, and TV not working.

comments: Another great stay. Nadia has a lovely house in a great location. We loved the cafes on Roman Rd, and  walking the canals. Santander bikes are close by, we cycled back from Greenwich via the tunnel. There is a lovely cycle route largely along the canal. Ombra in Bethnal Green is great for Italian food. Highly recommend staying at Nadia’s.
summary: Guests had a great stay, praising Nadia's house in a great location with nearby amenities.

comments:
Joanna is such a brilliant host who was quick to respond and helpful in every way which made our stay so relaxing and enjoyable.
Her place is spotless with nice taste of interior design. It is also spacious for four of us and so close to the tube stn.
Would definitely come back again for this lovely place.
summary: Guests praised Joanna as a brilliant host and her spotless, spacious place close to the tube station.

comments:
Superbe séjour que nous avons passé au sein du logement proposé par Isabel ! Nous avons été chaleureusement accueilli par Lou, une amie d'Isabel qui a été très flexible sur notre horaire d'arrivée et qui nous a présenté le logement, en restant disponible au long du voyage.
L'emplacement est idéal pour accéder au centre de Londres (bus, métro) à une vingtaine de minutes à pied de la gare de King's Cross, et proche de plusieurs restaurants et commerces, ce qui est un avantage non négligeable. Nous avons eu la chance de ne pas avoir trop de bruit dans le quartier, malgré la disponibilité de bouchons d'oreille dans le logement (probablement dû au fait d'avoir séjourné en semaine). Nous avons eu cependant des difficultés à dormir à cause d'un matelas un peu dur. De plus, l'escalier permettant d'accéder au logement est un peu étroit, ce qui sera compliqué avec beaucoup d'affaires ou pour des personnes à mobilité réduite.
Merci pour le séjour au sein de cet appartement cosy et chaleureux.
summary: The host was welcoming, but the mattress was too hard to sleep on.

comments: Wir wollten 4 Tage bleiben, jedoch haben wir kurz nach em Einchecken storniert und haben ein Hotel gebucht. Ich möchte nicht zu negativ bewerten, da die Beschreibung und die Fotos schon der Realität entsprechen. Jedoch haben wir uns einfach nicht wohl gefühlt. Es war sehr hellhörig, man alles in der Umgebung und jedes Wort der Mitbewohner im Haus gehört. Die Bettwäsche war definitiv nicht gewechselt, da sie gerochen hat und Haare drauf waren und die Handtücher waren fleckig. Und das relativ weit außerhalb. Wir haben für uns beschlossen in London definitiv künftig auf ein Hotel zu setzen, da wir bei dem nocarz inkl. aller Gebühren fast auf die gleiche Summe kamen wie bei dem spontan gebuchten Hotel MIT Frühstück sogar und deutlich zentraler.
summary: The guest felt uncomfortable due to noise and cleanliness issues.

comments: Everything was just perfectly prepared for our arrival, drinks, towels, soap, snacks etc., the communication was excellent and very detailled via email as well as per phone and text messages, the appartment is nice and clean, close to tube stations directly to the tourist hotspots, with a nice balcony, and we even met Nicholas for a drink in the pub nearby and finally even got some of his rare homebrewn beer - yeah, there would be more to tell, so, it was absolutely great, nicholas very friendly, the sort of host you dream of, so you do not have to worry about anything!!! definetely a place to recommend!!! PS: don't miss the ethno food market on saturdays at saatchi gallery just around the corner...
summary: Everything was perfectly prepared for their arrival, and the host was very friendly.

comments:
The place was wonderful, in a great location, and with all the amenities you’d need.
The host is even better. Sabin is incredibly accommodating. I had some odd needs for this particular trip and he was perfectly responsive, accommodating, organized, and proactively communicated everything I needed to know for my requests.
Highly recommend!
summary: The place was wonderful, with a great location and accommodating host.

comments: I am so glad I found Ariel's room in Hendon, just a few steps away from Hendon Central and another few steps from the institute where I took my course. In the mornings I could enjoy some runs in the park nearby too. Ariel was such a thoughtful and considerate host even before the stay via messages to inform me and make we feel welcome. He also prepared a little booklet with useful information which I found in my room. In the flat he labeled the storages in the hall and kitchen so that the guests could easily find what they need. Thank you Ariel, I will be back when continuing my course next term.
summary: Ariel was a thoughtful and considerate host who made them feel welcome.

comments: Lee was a friendly host. I did however find the amount of noise in the flat past 10pm excessive with cupboards banging, phone calls on speaker phone and what sounded like a hair dryer going on past 11pm. I don't think this was Lee, but someone else in the flat. It wasn't ideal for me as I needed to sleep because of working early the next morning. I also thought the bathroom was quite dirty :( However, Lee was kind enough to let me out of the building and into the carpark at 8am on a Sunday morning when I'm sure she'd rather have been sleeping herself.
summary: Host Lee was friendly but the flat had excessive noise after 10pm and a dirty bathroom.

comments: We loved our stay at this apartment. It was the perfect home base for the 8 days my husband, 2 small children and I stayed in the city. Juan was a wonderful host who welcomed us when we arrived and took the time to go through everything about the apartment, showing us how it all worked! He was super responsive and helpful when we had any questions. The apartment is in the perfect location, so close to St Paul's and only a few minutes walk to Blackfriars and the City Thameslink train station. The neighbourhood was surprisingly quiet in the evening but had lots to offer during the day! I definitely recommend staying here.
summary: We loved our stay at this apartment, perfect location and wonderful host Juan.

comments:
This is our third stay in this beautiful apartment. It’s been a home away from home for the past six months. So nice to come back to in between our travels. Fiona and Tristan are the perfect hosts in every way. Can 💯 recommend. Hope to come back again one day.
Thankyou for everything
Best wishes Rita and Don
summary: This is our third stay in this beautiful apartment, Fiona and Tristan are the perfect hosts.

comments:
This is a lovely flat. I stayed here with my partner and a friend. I love having the luxury of two bathrooms! The bed was very comfortable and it was nice to be able to control the thermostat. The flat is quite well equipped, with a coffee machine and a washer.
The couches were comfortable and the living room was a lovely place to hang out in.
I would recommend this flat! Hopefully I can come back and stay again.
summary: Lovely flat with two bathrooms, comfortable bed, and well-equipped kitchen.

comments: Roly's place is well located , very close to Brick Lane with great curries, lots of fashion thrift shops and street food. Close to tube (10 min walk) and buses. Roly is great communicator and checks in regularly to see if you need everything. Had a jar of Vegemite waiting for us which was a nice touch
summary: Roly's place is well located, great for Brick Lane and a good communicator.

comments:
Hemos tenido una estancia en general muy agradable, en cuanto a la localización y a la predisposición por parte del anfitrión. Es fácil llegar a cualquier punto de Londres gracias a las paradas cercanas de autobús ( no m ás de 5 min andando).
La casa cuenta con todo lo necesario para la estancia de 2 personas, además de estar muy bien climatizada.
Si tuviera que destacar algún pequeño inconveniente sería que en el dormitorio principal se encuentra el calentador de agua y este provoca un ruido molesto durante la noche.
A pesar de esto no dudaría en recomendar o volver a este apartamento.
summary: A pleasant stay with minor issues, but would recommend due to good location and host.

comments: A quiet, friendly, tidy and super convenient place to stay. Chloe and Chanse made us feel very welcome and the room was just as advertised. They were flexible and helpful hosts with good recommendations for local places to eat and do. I hope to bump into them and their lovely dog Darcy in Bethnal Green soon!
summary: Quiet, friendly, and convenient place to stay with welcoming hosts.

comments:
The good stuff first — Julia was very kind and flexible as a host. My flight was delayed by more than five hours, and she was patient and responsive through the many updates. The location is also very convenient — close to paddington so getting there from the airport (and back) was easy, plus access to the underground to go all over town. The immediate surroundings aren’t very picturesque but the convenience to Paddington station was worth it.
As for the not good — we found clumps of hair on the floor in several places (def not ours) and the space was very dusty in places. The pillows were very uncomfortable (felt like lumps of old socks stuffed in a bag) and we ended up going to buy travel pillows so we could sleep comfortably. It is loud at times — a train (or the underground) goes by every fifteen or so minutes and you not only hear but the whole places shakes. The shade in the bathroom was broken and rusty, the shower head broken so that it wouldn’t stay up. We won’t be back.
summary: Convenient location, but space was dusty and had cleanliness issues.

comments: This is a great studio right on the main road by Kings Cross. There’s loads of bars, cafes & restaurants nearby. There’s lots of space, a great shower & very comfy bed. It is right in the thick of it though so if you want peace this isn’t your place! The host had provided excellent ear plugs which meant I slept brilliantly & wasn’t disturbed by the road. Would definitely recommend - it’s well equipped, clean & the host is very friendly & responsive
summary: Great studio in central Kings Cross area, but can be noisy.

comments:
My boyfriend and I spent a beautiful journey at Harriet's.
The house is very central, near to the underground station and bus stops from which it's easy to reach every tourist attraction. There are many pubs in the nearby and the place is very quiet and safe.
Harriet is a very kind and beautiful person, she helped us whenever we needed, and the house is very cozy.
Absolutely recommended!
summary: Central, quiet, and safe house with a kind host.

comments: Half of Number outside apartment missing . Was given code to wrong flat , had to ring but prompt response. Love homely v well  equipped appt . Spotless . Comfy huge bed , lovely linens towels and shower products . Nice kitchen , cold water in fridge very welcome .  A bit noisy late night from restaurants and early morning from scaffolding going up but to be expected from such an amazing central location .
summary: Loved the homely apartment with comfy bed and spotless facilities, but had issues with missing items and noise from nearby restaurants.

comments:
We had a great stay in London and this was a great layout for our family of 4 (two teenage kids).
The location has easy access to many public transportation stops (bus and tube) and there are great, walkable restaurants around from traditional British spots to a wide array of international cuisines (Lebanese, Indian, Middle Eastern).
The apartment was very convenient and clean and a perfect spot to rest and unwind after some big days of touring around the city. Also enjoyed the proximity to Hyde Park which allowed for a great running destination in the morning before our sightseeing days would begin.
Would definitely recommend.
summary: Had a great stay in this convenient and clean apartment with easy access to public transportation and amenities.

comments: Spacious and beautifully decorated one bedroom appartement in a great location. Steps away from Portobello Road and Notting Hill restaurants. Has great amenities including a washing machine (and an inbuilt dryer), dishwasher, and an awesome shower (and a bath as well). Big kitchen and a very comfy bed. Tim left us water and milk, which was very helpful. Check-in was easy and flexible.
summary: Enjoyed the spacious and beautifully decorated one-bedroom apartment with great location and helpful host.

comments:
Essential:
Personal service: Good. Donovan was nice, flexible and helpful.
Information: To be improved. No pro active information about toilet on same floor being closed, or that wifi information was outdated. No pro active advise on how to use bed lights (and you would want advise).
Beds: Good. Clean sheet, towels were fine. Quite hard madrasses, which I liked.
Bathroom: Average. Looks nice and clean, but water pressure was poor.
Nice to have:
Location: Average. Walking distanse to the Old Street Underground and Tesco 24h express. Excellent if closer to Old Street Station.
Design and style: Average. The images in ad do not tell the full story. However, seems to be cleaned. Bed room size was ok.
summary: Found the apartment to be average, with some issues with water pressure and outdated information, but good beds and location.

comments: Sophie's apartment was just as described! We found it it very cosy and neat, just perfect for our stay in London. The location couldn't have been better with nice restaurants and shops around and the tube station just around the corner. Sophie was a very good host and made us feel welcome to her house and we got some good tips about the neighborhood.
summary: Loved Sophie's cozy and neat apartment in a perfect location with great restaurants and shops nearby.

comments:
Great location. Spacious apartment for our family of 5.
Very close to the tube station.
The apartment had everything we needed for a few days stay in London. Beds were very comfortable.
We really appreciated the balcony for an early morning cup of tea or watching the rain in the evening.
The furnishings/cushions were a little worn, some threadbare. However we had everything we needed and enjoyed our stay very much.
summary: Great location, spacious apartment with comfortable beds, but some worn furnishings.

comments: Ali was extremely helpful and after a long flight we appreciated him greeting us on arrival outside of his normal hours. The location was more than we had hoped for - very central to so many great London sights but on a pretty and quiet street. We would not hesitate to recommend or to stay here again.
summary: Excellent host and central location made for a wonderful stay in London.

comments: We spent three nights in London and found Harold's place to be just what we needed. Harold and Tommy are the perfect host. Their guest house is beautiful, quite, clean, and has all the amenities we needed for our stay. We would recommend their place and plan on staying again next time we are in London.
summary: Beautiful, quiet, and clean guest house with perfect hosts.

comments:
Relatively easy journey from Euston to Billie and Max' nocarz, the house was lovely although the electronic keys proved to be stressful manoeuvring your way around the app when life is much simpler with a key.
The room itself was very small but fresh and clean but the bed was absolutely terrible, lumpy and lopsided, not at all a good nights sleep unfortunately.
Alas there was some confusion with the booking and I had to vacate the second night. The biggest surprise was thinking I had booked a £47 per night room that transpired once surcharges had been added (cleaning £26:00 and service fee £12:37 ) the price bumped up to £85:37, I hadn't noticed these charges visibly anywhere so at this point, not at all worth the money.
All that said the hosts were very communicative.
summary: Disappointing experience due to small room, terrible bed, and unexpected price surcharges.

comments: I booked Alberto's place in the evening the day before and although that was admittedly late, everything ran smoothly. The apartment is nearby a vibrant district, there is a supermarket a 10 minute walk away and there are no problems with getting to the city center. I would absolutely recommend it!
summary: Smooth booking process and great location made for a wonderful stay in Alberto's apartment.

comments: Sal is an extremely kind person, always ready to help. The location is incredibly close to tourist attractions, but also to the wonderful Brick Lane - that it has been a great and unexpected discovery. The apartment, as others pointed out, is noisy, but it depends on what you are looking for. A calm place miles away from the city centre or one that is less peaceful, but from which you can reach the city ten minutes by foot. So it's just a matter of choice and interests.
summary: The apartment is noisy but has a great location near tourist attractions and Brick Lane.

comments:
Clean, neat , tidy accommodation with ample space. Bus stop 3 house away, great Turkish restaurant nearby name Ottoman ( big portion & great value for money).
Check in and check out is very easy. Jay is very communicative and sent me details in advance for our travel. Would like to stay here in future as well.
summary: Clean and spacious accommodation with easy check-in and good communication from Jay.

comments: The location of this flat is excellent, its a beautiful part of London and the transport links and local amenitiesare both great and convenient. Check in was really easy, using an electronic pin pad, couldn't have been easier. Note that nocarz says check in is from 11am, after booking the host said it was from 3pm. I then paid extra to check in early because I had booked for a wedding.
summary: Excellent location with convenient transport links and local amenities, easy check-in process.

comments:
Die Wohnung liegt sehr ruhig und man ist per Fuß schnell bei Tube/Bus/Overground.
Wer gerne läuft kommt hier auch auf seine Kosten. Bis zur Tower Bridge ist es nicht weit und auch ein gemütlicher Spaziergang nach Greenwich ist drin.
Das Zimmer reicht vollkommen aus für einen Städtetrip!!
Ewelina ist super nett und auch einen früherer Check-In war möglich!
Des Weitern sind Einkaufsmöglichkeiten für den Alltag schnell zu erreichen.
Ich kann das Zimmer nur empfehlen und würde gerne wieder kommen.
summary: Quiet apartment in a great area with easy access to public transport and amenities.

comments:
This is a lovely airy self-contained attic room in a very pretty area of London. It has a small, pretty private roof top terrace area.
Communication with Peter was very easy and he is a lovely host. The key safe access and on street parking was very handy.
Public transport into the city is straightforward, close and regular.
Highly recommended.
summary: Lovely attic room with private roof top terrace and easy communication from Peter.

comments: An apartment that, as a family,  really blew us away. Incredibly clean and spacious filled with some superb art and clever touches. The location was awesome and the chance to chill out on the balcony after a full day in the City was amazing. I would highly recommend the apartment and would like to thank John for his great communication and hospitality. Don’t miss this one!
summary: A clean and spacious apartment with excellent location and communication from the host.

comments: Wir haben schon vor der Anreise hilfreiche Tips bekommen und unsere Gastgeberin Hilal hat alles getan, um uns den Aufenthalt so angenehm wie möglich zu gestalten - besser geht es nicht! Die Unterkunft ist 10 Minuten von der U-Bahn-Haltestelle Oval entfernt und hat damit Zugang zur Northern Line. Dadurch können viele Ziele einfach erreicht werden. Es handelt sich um eine komplett ausgestattete Wohnung zum Wohlfühlen. Die Nachbarn hört man leider gut, weil die Wände den Schall nicht gut isolieren. Ohrenstöpsel helfen aber. Kleinere Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind ca. 200m von der Wohnungstür entfernt. Insgesamt eine sehr angenehme Erfahrung, wir kommen sehr sehr gerne wieder!!! (;
summary: A well-equipped apartment with good access to public transport, but some noise issues due to thin walls.

comments: la casa estaba bien ubicada pero la habitación era muy pequeña y calurosa y no te dejan usar ninguna zona común excepto el baño asique si quieres descansar es prácticamente imposible,entre el calor de la habitación,el ruido de los vecinos entrando y saliendo y la cantidad de escaleras que hay que pasar,no merece la pena para el precio.
summary: The room was too small and hot, and there were no common areas available for guests.

comments: Needs a full make over very worn out & tired , smells from other apts as you walk indoor ,all smoke / methane detectors out of date or broke , shower broke had to kneel in bath , carpets /settee heavily stained ,poorly decorated , handrail in hall way ready to fall off
summary: The apartment needs a full renovation as it is worn out and poorly maintained.

comments: This is a wonderful place and super host(s).  We are an older couple and have had some less than great experiences with nocarzs but this one totally restored our faith!!  Clean, bright, GREAT bathroom and excellent value.  I was concerned re distance from central London but we could reach all the major sites within 30-40 minutes via bus, overground, underground.  Host right "on site" so any issues/questions can be immediately addressed.  Host soooo hospitable--just a really great experience!!
summary: A clean and well-equipped apartment with excellent value and a very hospitable host.

comments:
Kinga & Marc couldn’t have been more accommodating. Due to a small issue outside of their control, our booked apartment was unavailable for 48 hours but they were able to set us up with another apartment next door which was still great for the beginning of our stay. They kept us updated on progress of the issue and Marc was on hand to help move us into our original apartment.
The apartment was very comfortable and had the added bonus of 2 bathrooms. My teenager loved having his own space to chill out when he got fed up with us!
The area was great, the DLR is 2 minutes walk from the doorstep and gets you to Canary Wharf in less than 5 minutes and Bank station in under 15 minutes. There is also a good choice of shops, takeaways and cafes & restaurants close by.
summary: The hosts were accommodating and provided a great apartment with excellent location near the DLR.

comments:
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. Dave was very helpful and informative and allowed for a seamless experience from the initial booking through to check out. Lovely light room with big windows on one of the more quieter streets in Camden. I felt very safe here with my teenage daughter and we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Wouldn't hesitate to return- thank you!
summary: The host was helpful and informative, providing a lovely light room in a quiet Camden street.

comments: It is small place maybe it is good for a young and male , because  there are many step that everyday should pass to go bathroom or kitchen , there is no mirror in the room that for minor thing we should go to the bathroom .I advised if you book this room bring one portable .location is not bad but still to reach underground station need walk about 10 minute .generally I will give 3 star
summary: The small room had some drawbacks, including many stairs to bathroom/kitchen and no mirror in the room.

comments: We really enjoyed our stay here! Convenient but quiet location, comfy bed, and all the essentials for our quick stay. The washing machine was out when we were there but George was more than happy to coordinate with us to use his in the neighboring unit - a lifesaver as we’d gone a week without and had no clothes left. George also had a couple of great recommendations and had fantastic, very quick communication.  Would definitely stay here again, albeit, not in the middle of a heat wave as we are used to AC (but knew going into this stay it wasn’t offered).
summary: The convenient location and comfy bed made for a great stay, despite no air conditioning.

comments:
Beautiful place to stay! Lovely and warm when we got in later in the day from the cold. Cosy and clean!
Not too far away from Queens Park which gives access to the underground and overground to travel around London.
Local shops and cafes nearby if you want to go out for lunch, get food for a home dinner
summary: The cozy and clean apartment was lovely, with easy access to Queens Park and local shops.

comments:
Totally surpassed expectations, it looked beautiful on the photos but it’s such a unique space for a weekend in the city.
- Location is perfect.
- Host support was 1st class.
- Will 100% stay again and be recommending to friends and family.
Only critique would be a complex and dated media set up but that’s only an inconvenience if you’re a long stay guest or not so tech literate.
summary: Guest had a great stay, praising the location and host support, with only minor complaints about outdated media setup.

comments: Jennifer’s place was a home away from home. The space was incredibly homey and functional, the location couldn’t have been better and Jennifer was helpful, kind and so generous with her time. We would come back and stay in a heart beat! Highly recommend Jennifer’s place for a short or a long stay!
summary: Guest felt at home in Jennifer's place, praising its hominess, functionality, and excellent location.

comments:
Let's talk about the house first: it has a very beautiful garden, the rooms and living room are very warm, and the kitchen is very complete.
Then the host's family was very friendly, making me and my son feel at home.
If there is a chance to come back to London, I will definitely come back to Julie's house.
summary: Guest had a wonderful stay at Julie's house, praising its beautiful garden, warm rooms, and friendly host family.

comments: I had a wonderful stay at Eleide’s nocarz! She was incredibly welcoming and made sure I felt right at home. The room was exactly as described, clean, and comfortable. Eleide was also very helpful with laundry, which I greatly appreciated. The neighborhood felt safe, especially as a solo traveler, and there were plenty of excellent bakeries nearby. Highly recommend!
summary: Guest felt welcome and comfortable in Eleide's nocarz, praising her hospitality, cleanliness, and helpfulness.

comments: Tafon est un hôte acceuillant, et disponible pour toutes demandes. Très bonne localisation. Dommage qu’il n’y ait pas de volet occultant dans la chambre et de possibilité de fermer la chambre à clé. De plus leurs jeunes enfants étaient bruillant jusqu’à presque minuit, ce que je ne trouve pas respectueux pour les invités qui souhaitent dormir. Un matin sans eau chaude à la douche. Pour la propretée, c’est vite fait, il ne faut pas regarder en détail.
summary: Guest had a mixed experience at Tafon's place, praising his welcoming nature but criticizing noise from children and lack of amenities.

comments:
L'appartement correspondait tout à fait à sa description dans l'annonce, d'une propreté irréprochable, situé idéalement dans un bel immeuble près de St Pancras, dans un quartier calme et agréable, à deux pas de plusieurs adresses sympas ( restaurants,pubs, magasins d'alimentation etc) listées par Steve.
L'accueil fut super et même adaptable suite à un retard de train, Steve et Alex sont des hôtes charmant et le fait qu'ils habitent dans l'appartement d'à côté permet une disponibilité pratique si l'on rencontre le moindre soucis. Tout en offrant une réelle indépendance et le sentiments d'être chez soi.
Bref, nous avons passé quelques jours très agréables dans ce joli petit appartement à Londres et le recommandons sincèrement.
summary: The apartment was clean, quiet, and well-located, with friendly hosts who were available to help.

comments:
The apartment is spacious, very comfortable for 4 people, with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. There are all the kitchen supplies needed if you want to cook yourself, otherwise there are many interesting restaurants in the surroundings! The underground station is literally 2 min by foot. a big plus for travellers with kids: the nearby Holland park adventure playground is fantastic!
highly recommended!
summary: The spacious apartment was comfortable for four people, with good amenities and a convenient location near public transportation.

comments:
A great flat in a great location! so fabulous for sightseeing with everything in walking distance . Sahar’s flat is clean, modern, comfortable, well equipped and well laid out. It was also warm, has a spacious bedroom, good sofas, and a great shower, and was very, very easy to rent.
Her communication is superb – from immediate initial contact, to instructions beforehand, to several messages during the stay to check everything was ok. She was just fantastic with everything.
Would highly recommend – a very convenient flat you can book with confidence that it will all work and be very easy!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
summary: Sahar's flat was clean, modern, and well-equipped, with excellent communication from the host.

comments: Great private and quiet place to stay. My wife and I stayed for 5 nights whilst I worked in a nearby area, and enjoyed how peaceful it was. No noise at night, felt like a safe area which was important to us walking home late at night, parked on the road outside the house really easily. Bus gets you to the tube/ overground in no time, so its pretty convenient for getting into London, takes about an hr to the centre. Useful shops nearby. Lovely welcome from Raymond. Does what it says on the tin!
summary: The quiet apartment was a peaceful retreat for two people, with easy access to London and a friendly welcome.

comments: fine place to stay if your standards are not to high.  although adequate, this place lacks a personal touch.  of all the amenities, everything check out just fine,  but there is nothing extra.  6 pieces of silverware, six cups, nothing in excess.  six guest can eat at a 4 person dinner table with 4 seats. the cupboard in the living room is placed halfway into the room to allow for storage space behind it.  beds sleep well, neighbors upstairs somewhat noisy.  window sill quite abhorrently dirty and windows don't do much to keep street noise and draught out.   out for a weekend with friends on the town? this is your place.  romantic getaway with slightly spoiled 40+ group? look elsewhere.  host provides fine communication and is all good intentions, undoubtedly.
summary: The place was fine but lacked a personal touch, with basic amenities and some minor issues with cleanliness.

comments: The apartment is modern and well equipped the entrance lobby and secure door makes it feel very safe. There is great proximity to amenities and travel to wider London with Camden Market being in easy walking distance . The apartment was big with sting WiFi and quiet for being so central.
summary: Modern apartment with great amenities and safe location near Camden Market.

comments:
This Air bnb is worth than what we paid for. Dainius added so many thoughtful touches that added to the experience. My son was loving bring able go play a video when wewere breaking from sightseeing. Location was fantastic. it's only a 15 min walk from Big Ben.
Will definitely be staying again on our next trip. thank for everything Dainius!
summary: Excellent value for money with thoughtful touches from host Dainius and fantastic location near Big Ben.

comments: Stay here, this place is amazing, Monica and Florin are really really really nice, they always asked if we needed something, if we were ok, they always had the house clean, it was the best experience i've had at an nocarz, recommended 100%, worth it 100%, the Elizabeth line is like 10 minutes away and you get to the center of the city in less than 20 minutes by train,it is a really safe and quiet place, we liked it very very much, hopefully we can stay here again in the future :)
summary: Amazing experience at this quiet and safe place with friendly hosts Monica and Florin, highly recommended.

comments:
I booked this place on behalf of my parents, and their experience staying here for about 2 weeks was just perfect!
Checking in was super easy as Mr Saket provided clear instructions on accessing the apartment.
The place itself was absolutely delightful. The room was incredibly comfortable with lots of sunlight, and the huge living room overlooking the canal was the best thing to wake up to every morning for them.
The location was ideal with 2 Tescos just a short 5 minute walk away, and the DLR just a 3 minute walk from the place. Also an added bonus is the step-free access from ground floor to the apartment.
Saket is truly a superhost, always ready to help with any inquiries or requests. He’s super friendly and accommodating, and ensured my parents felt welcomed and comfortable throughout their stay.
Overall I highly recommend Saket’s place. The combination of a cozy and well-appointed space, strategic location and fantastic hospitality of the superhost make it a true gem 😊
summary: Perfect stay for my parents with easy check-in, comfortable room, and ideal location near Tesco and DLR.

comments: I loved staying at this nocarz because it was right near Primrose Hill which is beautiful and has an amazing view of the whole city! James was a wonderful host and made sure I had everything I needed. He was easy to talk to, and when the London Bridge incident happened he made sure to see if I was okay and talked to me about it. The flat is fairly close to a tube station and it is very quick and easy to get to the rest of London, but is also in a quieter area which I really liked! Will most likely stay here again if I return to London.
summary: Lovely stay at this nocarz with beautiful views of the city from Primrose Hill and friendly host James.

comments:
This is a great little studio space. Stylish and modern, and very clean.
We were met by Amy on arrival, who offered us information about the apartment and the area. It was nice to chat art, and we noted the gorgeous artwork around the space!
The resident cats of the flat were also a highlight for me. They are gorgeous and so friendly - I loved giving them a cuddle in the morning. Felt very at home and would definitely visit again.
summary: Guest had a great stay in a stylish and modern studio space with friendly host Amy.

comments: I enjoyed staying with Yolanda. She was easy to contact and happy to let me check in my stuff early. It's a fantastic location only a few minutes from Liverpool station tube and lots of places to eat nearby. The room is very small but the futon thing is comfortable and it's quiet.
summary: Guest enjoyed their stay with Yolanda, who was easy to contact and offered a convenient location near Liverpool station.

comments:
We loved this apartment. So much so that we stayed 2 months, instead of the originally booked one month. It's only metres away from one of London's largest green spaces.
There are great bakeries, coffee ahops, an amazing Italian deli and a host of top restaurants on your doorstep. Our favourite was The Little Thai, closely followed by Mimmo la Bufala (especially for pizzas).
And there are great bus and rail links into central London.
summary: Guests loved the apartment's location near green spaces and amenities, staying for two months instead of one.

comments:
Le logement de Dhimitër proposait un lieu calme et agréable, avec tous les équipements nécessaires et même un bureau pour travailler.
Notre hôte s’est montré amical et attentif, n’hésitant pas à nous envoyer un message de temps à autres pour savoir si tout se passait bien pour nous.
Nous recommandons avec plaisir et si nous revenons sur Londres, nous louerons ce logement sans hésiter !
Merci Dhimitër !
Corentin et Cindy
summary: Guests had a pleasant stay in Dhimitër's calm and well-equipped home with friendly host.

comments: Stayed for 1 night in a group of 6, going to a festival at walking distance Boston Manor Park. The house matched the photos, quite empty and very basic in terms of furniture. Self check-in via lockbox was very easy. Could do with more glasses and kitchen apparatus (e.g. bottle opener) but overall very satisfied. Note there isn’t a hot tub as in the description but this wasn’t an issue for us.
summary: Group of six stayed overnight in the house near Boston Manor Park, finding it basic but satisfactory for their needs.

comments: We stayed for 4 days in Matt’s Apartment. The communication was fast and easy, he gave us many tips for our stay. Matt allowed us to have an early check in and a late check out. We’re happy to stay at his place and would love to come back at any time.
summary: Fast communication, early check-in, and late check-out made for a pleasant stay at Matt's Apartment.

comments:
Would definitely recommend it!

The apartment is lovely, spacious and cosy. it was very clean and well equipped. james was extremely helpful and available, he responded to all messages within a very short time. At some point, the heating and warm water was not working, and he came over in just 10 minutes and fixed it.

The location is also quite convenient, in a relatively quiter area but well connected and close to most points of interest.

I would go back:)
summary: The apartment was lovely, spacious, and well-equipped, with James being extremely helpful and responsive.

comments: May I’d absolutely wonderful! Great host super responsive and very kind. Anytime I had an issue she would get back to me right away and solve the issue. Only thing TV ke just basic cable so I had to stream everything from my compitieron, and the flat is located right in front a bus stop so when ordering cars and stuff it was a bit of pain cause they could stay outside the building, and the shower water pressure isn’t great so it made taking a shower a little tough. But those things are out of host control otherwise. She was an absolute delight. I think it’s very good for something short term, good space bedroom and living room are very big. Good natural light as well. Flats a bit old, but the building is pretty cute.
summary: May's flat was wonderful, but had some minor issues like basic cable TV and low shower water pressure.

comments: The apartment was absolutely wonderful. We were four people, and found it to be plenty spacious, with a really nice kitchen for those communal dinners. Instructions on how to get to the apartment, checking in and checking out were all clear and comprehensive. The host was really nice and was very attentive to every question we had both prior to our arrival and on the day of our arrival. She also helped us out with a lot of extra information, concerning issues with tickets for a concert we were going to attend, which again was so nice of her. The neighborhood was lovely, and it doesn't take too long to get into downtown. All four of us would gladly recommend this apartment!
summary: The apartment was perfect for our group of four, with a nice kitchen and friendly host who helped with extra information.

comments:
I rented Louis's room in Battersea for 3 months and I found it to be nothing short of an amazing experience. He is a fantastic host and a wonderful person. His apartment is clean, well-furnished, and comfortable. It is right around the corner from a bus stop, which makes getting around easy. It is also just a short walk from the beautiful Battersea park along the river.
I will have great memories of my time staying with Lou in Battersea and I would, of course, recommend staying there to anybody.
summary: Lou's room in Battersea was an amazing experience, with a fantastic host and comfortable accommodation.

comments: This is an absolute superb house. Everything is as you can see it in the pictures. Mary takes excellent care of her guests and is always happy to help. Her cakes are brilliant and so is the entire breaktfast. If it were posssible, we would give 6 stars, because Mary-Beth, Billie and Bowie are absolutely splendid hosts.
summary: Guests praise Mary's excellent hosting and delicious breakfast

comments: We had the best stay at Louise's place. It was centrally located for our needs and made me feel like I was back living in the UK!  From the initial booking the communication was superb. The apartment had everything we required for our stay and we would absolutely book again next time we are back from Australia. Thanks Louise for a fantastic stay! Highly recommend!!
summary: Guests had a fantastic stay at Louise's place with great communication and amenities

comments: The house is spacious and clean, decoration is lovely. Simon (and the cats) are friendly and chilled. Very short walk to Orpington station and town centre (plenty of shops, cafes and restaurants). Parking on driveway. The private bathroom has both a bath and a shower. All very good and easy! Thank you!
summary: Guests enjoyed Simon's friendly hosting and convenient location near Orpington station

comments: House typical for this part of London. Very quite neighbourhood. Location is on the - nice view on London. Bus stop just around the corner so yo can reach  New Cross Gate in no time in case you want spare on walking (few minutes). Convenient apt for two persons. Very comfortable bad with many pillows. Everything works.  Ideal place to stay if you want to explore east south London
summary: Guests found the house comfortable and convenient for exploring east south London

comments: Parsons place was perfect for a 24 hour layover in London. We were 4 adults and while a little tight, the apartment met all our needs. The dryer was great when we got rained on while sightseeing. There is a pub right across the street to get a drink at. We would definitely stay again if the opportunity presented itself.
summary: Guests had a great stay at Parsons place with its convenient location and amenities

comments: This accommodation was perfect for us. We had events in Wembley and Excel and both were really easy to get to with the tube station so nearby (but not noisy). We even ventured by bus to the RAF Museum. Spotless, attractive and a very pleasant place to sit and chill one day too. We didn't use the cornershop across from the tube station, but it was good to know it was there. The only challenge during this stay was the immersion heater in the eaves right by the bedroom. This seems like it gets activated whenever anybody in the complex of flats runs a hot tap and so randomly starts-stopd during the night for late night showers and whatever else. You can hear what i assume is the fan of the neighbouring flat bathroom too. Thankfully, I'd seen a previous comment in a review and made sure to pack earplugs and I slept much better after the first night. Syed's instructions were really clear and timed very well. And any additional queries were answered very promptly. :)
summary: The accommodation was perfect for us, but the immersion heater caused some noise issues.

comments:
Der Aufenthalt in dem Apartment war super! Die Mitbewohner waren nett, die Verständigung zwischen Marcelo und uns war auch sehr gut. Schnelle Antworten und immer sehr hilfsbereit bei fragen. Das Apartment ist direkt an einer U-Bahn Station und ein Einkaufsladen direkt nebenan, was sehr viele Vorteile verschaffte. Die Badezimmer waren auch relativ sauber (man muss dabei bedenken, dass dort noch mehrere Leute leben, so kann man nicht immer von blitzblank ausgehen) aber alles komplett im Rahmen. Alles was man braucht ist zur Verfügung gestellt. Shampoo, Duschgel, Spülung und auch Handtücher und ein Fön.
Gerne wieder ! ☺️
summary: We had a great stay in the apartment, with friendly neighbors and excellent communication from Marcelo.

comments: Thank you very much for letting us stay at your nocarz! It was pleasant and welcoming. Your communication was excellent, very attentive. Also loved the subtle, airy & modern room decor. Less is more! Will hope to see you again in the near future. Best wishes to you & Roma X
summary: The room was pleasant and welcoming, with excellent communication from Syed and modern decor.

comments:
The guys who checked us in were great and they quickly arranged an additional key which was delivered the next morning.
When demonstrating the pull out sofa bed he immediately spotted there were crumbs all over the cushions and vacuumed them up but this just underlined that the £50 cleaning fee didn't reflect the cleaning as several of the dining chairs also had stains and the whole place smelt of people having smoked in there. Having left the windows open, the next morning when closed the smell was still not great and it became clear that's because the smell was actually embedded in the sofa cushions.
It's not the owners fault that renters ignore the 'no smoking' rule, but if you are paying £50 for cleaning on top of £850 for 3 nights you do expect that the cleaning staff will ensure it's clean and fresh upon arrival.
summary: The apartment was not clean upon arrival, with stains on furniture and a strong smell of smoke.

comments: This is one of the best host experiences I have ever had. Eric exceeded all of my expectations as a host and was super nice and accommodating and helped me at all times i needed, whilst ensuring I had total privacy and felt completley comfortable. The room and apartment is super nice and in a great location and clean with great WiFi. I can only highly recommend and will defilitley be back. THANK YOU ERIC!!!
summary: Eric exceeded all expectations as a host, providing a great experience in a super nice room and apartment.

comments: It was a perfect stay, Steven is a great host. It’s so easy and pratic to find the apartment, the location is very perfect. Only 15 minutes to reach Victoria Station for example, Madame Tussauds is at 3 minutes walking. Many things to do near from the apartment. The view is also perfect. And each room is clean and cosy.
summary: Perfect stay with great host and location

comments: Small place and nothing too fancy but clean, quiet and best location. Walk to most of the best things to see in London! Host was very kind to let us drop off bags early before check in so we could explore. Easy to find in Chinatown. Good value for the price!
summary: Clean and quiet apartment with excellent location for exploring London

comments:
Had a great time with Will. He’s such a wonderful host and took care of almost everything. He even came to the street to pick me up when i faced issues in finding the place. The bed was very comfortable and the place was spotless clean.
Will definitely visit him again.
summary: Wonderful experience with kind and helpful host Will

comments: Outstanding Air B&B. Room was perfectly clean and beds were delightfully comfy. Exceptionally good value for money considering the quality of the room and how easy it is to get to get into Central London. Hosts were easily contacted and very friendly. When they called to tell us that the room we had originally booked was unavailable due to cleaning, they provided another one of their rooms with no hassle. They even allowed us to use the parking space after our stay was over just for the day, which was a load off of our mind as we still had things we wanted to do in London. Shower was high quality with good water pressure, and room even had a washer/dryer. Very spacious so great for long and short stay, on a very quiet street. For the price offered, this is the closest you will get to a perfect Air B&B.
summary: Outstanding Air B&B with clean room, comfy beds, and great value

comments:
The property is very nice and modern and clean and the pictures do not do it justice. It is a large property with great facilities and in a good position for shopping and the tube.
The only issue we had was that the barber shop directly upstairs (as this is a basement apartment) is very noisy on a morning from 8am every day (even weekends) until around 7 on an evening.
I would definitely stay in this property again but if you haven’t been before it’s definitely something to bare in mind.
summary: Nice modern apartment with good facilities, but noisy barber shop above

comments: This place and host are great.  Danny checked in on us several times to make sure everything was good, and gave us plenty of suggestions while we were there.  We came to London with our 3 children ages 4, 8, 11.  The setup here was perfect for us, as there is great access to public transportation, and Northcote road has a ton of great dining and shopping options.  Would definitely come back again in the future.  Thanks Danny for being a great host.
summary: Great host and location for a family with kids.

comments: Wow! Where to start. Having spent a fair time in nocarz the past 2 months around Europe and UK I can completely understand how Yossi has achieved superhost status!! Not only was the cabin absolutely Devine with all one needs for a relaxing tranquil getaway, Yossi was always on hand to help with any questions I had. I couldn't think of a better place to end my vacation.
summary: Wonderful cabin with excellent amenities and a superhost owner.

comments: Great location in the heart of SoHo. Surrounded by several pubs, restaurants, theaters and the heartbeat of the city! Very close to the theatre district and two underground stations. Picadilly Circus just a 7 minute walk. Check in was a breeze as we were greeted at the door by Harry and he walked us through all of the apartments’ features. The studio apartment is very small, however, great for two persons. The bathroom is very small - particularly the shower and toilet. If you’re a big person, it may be quite uncomfortable. It worked for us. We didn’t use the TV much but it comes equipped with an Amazon Fire Stick. The full size bed was small and could use a mattress upgrade. The studio also comes equipped with a washer/dryer, small refrigerator, stove and some kitchen wares - but who wants to cook with all of the dining options surrounding the apartment? Overall a great stay for us and would recommend it to others.
summary: Good location but small studio apartment with some minor issues.

comments:
Tete is an amazing host. She's kind and caring. Just like our mum haha.
Due to the luggage problem, we checked in at 1 a.m. Tete waited for us til late night and gave us a big hug after we lost our luggage at the airport.
Location is good, not prefect but the neighborhood is very safe and quiet.
There is a supermarket and restaurants nearby within 15 mins walk.
Tete's apartment is clean and concise,we felt comfortable when we stayed there.
The equipment of the kitchen and bedroom are complete. Tete is very welcome the guests to use it. I would definitely recommend for other travellers!!
summary: Friendly host and clean apartment in a safe neighborhood.

comments: Excelente apartamento muy bien equipado y con un nivel de limpieza inmejorable. Hay lavadora, secadora, lavavajillas, tostadora, nevera, microondas, horno y cocina eléctrica. También hay ropa de cama, toallas y toda clase de productos de limpieza. La estación de metro de Clapham South está a 5 minutos. En la avenida al lado del apartamento hay varios supermercados y locales de restauración. La zona es muy tranquila y no parece nada problemática. Los anfitriones estuvieron pendientes de informarnos en todo momento. El precio que pagamos para alojarnos 8 personas lo considero muy razonable.
summary: Well-equipped and clean apartment at a reasonable price for large groups.

comments: You'll be in for a treat here at Genes. Bed- excellent,best in my travels firm pillows-one of ea so you can choose bathroom's-clean good showers   kitchen-well equip. plenty fridge space. Living area off kitchen with table just like the pic. Opens onto sunny garden. Parking easily at the door. Bus 30 walk and Tules Hill station close. Excellent value for you money! Great communication too
summary: Excellent value for money with a clean and well-equipped accommodation.

comments:
Sara's place was located in a good area with two train stations closed by.
The house does need a bit of love with a lot of crack paint and a chipped window in the back bedroom.
The kitchen bench was very sticky, even after we tried wiping it down with wet wipes.
the bed was comfortable and the heating system is very good for the winter temperature.
overall, the place was a good stay for our london visit. beside the minor issues abovs, was happy with everything we saw.
summary: Good location, but the house needs some maintenance and minor issues were present.

comments:
What a great place to stay!
I was slightly worried to have read the previous review which mentioned some mould and damp at this property, however I decided to go ahead and book it due to all the other 5 Star reviews posted about this property.
The place was very clean and tidy and there was NO sign of any mould or damp as indicated by the previous review. The place was immaculate and obviously recently renovated. The beds were very comfortable, there was a great shower and I had everything I needed. It was also great that the property had a private parking spot, so there was no need for street parking.
It was a 1-2 min walk to the Tube station, with bars, pubs, the Co-op, Sainsbury's and restaurants on the way to the tube.
I can highly recommend this place and will definitely stay there again!
summary: Immaculate property with no signs of mould or damp, excellent location and amenities.

comments: My husband and I and our 18 month old daughter had a comfortable stay in Emma’s flat. The flat is well located just off the high street, but on a nice quiet road. The flat is very homely, with comfortable furniture and nice touches like a basket full of mini cosmetics in the bathroom for guests to use. It was also great for our daughter who slept in the cot in the nursery - she really enjoyed reading the children’s books! The only slight downsides were it felt a little cluttered in the kitchen area - there wasn’t much space to put our food, and there isn’t access to a freezer, which wasn’t a problem for us, but might bother some people. Also Emma uses a third party to manage the flat, and I found them slow to respond to messages sent on nocarz. If you need a quick response I found out the best thing to do is call them on the mobile number they send you in the check in instructions. Overall, a comfortable stay in a great location!
summary: Comfortable stay in a homely flat with nice touches, but some minor downsides were noted.

comments:
Hi Everyone,
Adam's apartment was great and have all the comfort that we were needing.
It is well located in close proximity to a few underground stations.
The apartment is in a very quiet street close to everything (pubs, supermarket, restaurants, The Sharp Building, etc).
He was very responsive before and during our stayed.
I will definitely stay at his apartment again in my next trip if it is available.
Good luck!
Max
summary: Great apartment with all comforts needed, well-located and responsive host.

comments: Great value for money stay in Camberwell. The room is compact but does a lot with the space and the entire place is extremely clean. The bathroom in particular was super modern and loved having it to myself. The bus station is literally 1 min from the apartment with buses taking you into central. Mark was also lovely and accommodating!
summary: Great value for money stay in Camberwell, clean and modern room with excellent location

comments:
The pictures didn’t do justice to this modern two bedroom two bathroom apartment. With the big windows, the rooms are actually very bright. We like the simple/ minimalist design. The location and space are perfect for travellers who want to be close to Zone 1 but don’t want to pay a fortune. (We did find a private parking nearby and rode the Tube to central London, both the parking and station are within walking distance). It was spacious and comfortable for my family of four, including one elderly and one teen.
Al, the owner, was very helpful and friendly. We highly recommend this apartment.
summary: Modern two bedroom apartment with perfect location and space for travellers

comments:
Great nocarz - is her personal flat, so was full of amenities, everything you need you have.
Location is great, super friendly nice clean neighborhood, as well as friendly neighbors.
For London, especially central London, the quality to price ratio is fantastic! 2 bedrooms, balcony, living room, kitchen, and 2 bathrooms.
Favorite place i've stayed in London so far. Highly recommend!
summary: Clean and spacious flat with great amenities and friendly neighborhood

comments:
Appartement correct, correspond à la description et très bon emplacement. Néanmoins, faire bien attention aux commentaires sur les problèmes d'eau chaude. Malgré ma remarque j'ai dû passé 2 jours sans eau chaude, jusqu'à ce qu'nocarz intervienne et contacte le propriétaire qui ne répondait pas à mes messages et relances. Finalement un plombier est intervenu.
L'hôte a accepté que je laisse mes bagages à 12h au lieu de 15h à mon arrivée. Ce qui en soit est appréciable. Arrivée, le ménage n'était pas fait après les précédents voyageurs. Ill a fallu que je m'en plaigne. Il a menti sur le fait que la femme de ménage venait à 14h30 (pour un logement sensé être dispo à 15h, c'était donc vraiment pas normal....). Au final quand j'arrive à 18h30 après une promenade, la femme de ménage est présente et me dit de revenir plus tard. C'est pas normal!
Au final c'était sensé être des vacances reposantes mais la moitié de mon séjour était stressant avec les divers problèmes/manque de répo
summary: Apartment had issues with hot water, cleanliness, and communication from host

comments:
Petra is a perfect host responding quickly to emails. We were provided with lots of very useful information about the area.
The coach house is beautifully presented. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you could possibly need. We had a lovely peaceful stay and will definitely return in the summer to make more use of Richmond park which is almost next door.
summary: Coach house was beautifully presented with fully equipped kitchen and peaceful stay

comments:
You will receive a warm and friendly welcome from Geeta.
Everything was organised for check-in. Geeta is serene and beautiful, and this is very much reflected in her lovely calm home.
The road is quiet, residential, tree-lined and well-lit - just a few minutes along from a bus route and mini-supermarket. Further along is the mainline train station and several more bus routes.
It's really great here and without hesitation, I would recommend to friends and family.
summary: The host Geeta provides a warm welcome and the property is well-located with easy access to public transport.

comments:
Unterkunft ist nur wenige Meter von der U-Bahn entfernt und man ist schnell in der Stadt. Durch die angrenzenden Bahngleise ist es aber zwischenzeitlich ziemlich laut. Wohnung ist sehr gut ausgestattet. Ein Kritikpunkt ist die Sauberkeit, vorallem der Teppich im Badezimmer war etwas eklig (die darunterliegenden Fliesen sind Kaputt).
Aber alles in Allem eine gute Unterkunft für ein paar schöne Tage in London.
summary: The apartment is well-equipped but has some noise issues due to nearby train tracks and cleanliness could be improved.

comments: Our room in Fabio's hostel was as advertised and it was perfectly clean and well-maintained. Fabio was continuously responsive to our questions and he had many local suggestions for us, which we took as much as we could. We loved the backyard patio space, I wish we'd had more time to hang out there. I'm so glad that we stayed here for our trip to London! The location was right by an Underground station with two lines, taking us anywhere we wanted to go in the city.
summary: Fabio's hostel was clean, well-maintained, and perfectly located near an Underground station with helpful local suggestions.

comments: If you’re looking for a clean, quiet and affordable location — this is it! Not only are you directly in the heart of Covent Garden, this location is perfect for walking to all the top attractions. The host met us and personally showed us around which was incredibly helpful. This place also felt very safe and secure. We will definitely be returning and couldn’t have asked for a better apartment, location or host!!
summary: This quiet and affordable location is perfect for exploring Covent Garden with a safe and secure atmosphere.

comments: This property is absolutely amazing, great value and perfectly located. There’s 24h parking right next to the property and everything you will ever need is walking distance. The property has everything you will need to cook, clean and have a great time. If I need to stay in this area again I would definitely stay here again. Thank you Michael 🙏
summary: The property offers great value, 24h parking, and easy access to amenities making it an ideal stay in the area.

comments: We had an amazing stay at Valentina’s place. The apartment is very well arranged and furnished, the location in Notting Hill is great and we loved the light coming through the big window. We felt at home and Valentina was available and Nice to answer to all my questions. Thank you so much!
summary: Guests had an amazing stay at Valentina's well-arranged apartment with great location and natural light.

comments:
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l’appartement de Christopher. C’est l’endroit parfait où se reposer après de longues journées de visite à Londres. L’appartement est terriblement bien situé, juste à côté d’un arrêt de bus qui vous permet de rejoindre le cœur de Londres très facilement. Christopher a été très réactif. Nous lui avons demandé un lit supplémentaire pour permettre à nos ados d’avoir plus de place pour dormir, et dans l’heure qui suivait, le lit était installé ! L’appartement est très propre et très pratique. En plus, il est très très calme, parfait pour des nuits reposantes!
Merci Christopher, nous reviendrons avec plaisir!
summary: Christopher's apartment was perfect for resting after long days of visiting London, with excellent location and quick responses to guest needs.

comments:
We loved to stay at Vicki's house.
It is so cute and comfortable cause you can use the kitchen and bathrooms and feel free. You're able to reach the city by bus or overground very fast. She is such a lovely, open-minded person. So helpful with our problems and questions even though we didn't see each other very often.
We would definately come back. Best choice!
xoxo
Anja & Kirsten
summary: Vicki's house was a lovely and comfortable place to stay, with easy access to the city and a helpful host.

comments:
To those who are browsing this page: You are very lucky to find such a nice room/host!!!
I was so amazed at how clean and tidy Tikiri keeps his flat. The bedroom is comfy, and I love the books on the shelf. And the SHINY toilet/bathroom! It is so nice a toilet that I think nocarz should nominate it for 'the loo of the year' (if there is any award like this).
Tikiri is always so helpful and considerate. And it was fun to chat with him.
I really wish I could stay longer!
summary: Tikiri's flat was extremely clean and tidy, with a comfy bedroom and a 'loo of the year' worthy toilet, and he was always helpful and considerate.

comments: What a wonderful, stylish and light-filled space. I really appreciated the design aesthetic, with lovely touches everywhere. For a place so well-connected in London - it was also amazing quiet, no traffic noises at all. It felt very private and had everything you might need in the kitchen. The broadband was a bit bumpy, but I could have happily moved in...
summary: Guests appreciated the stylish and light-filled space with lovely design touches, excellent location, and quiet atmosphere.

comments: Alexi and Jan are great people.  They were friendly and welcoming, I felt like at home. She even offer an extra touch leaving me breakfast every day, with a home made marmalade that was awesome. The house is amazing. It have a beautiful garden. The neighbourhood is calm, and at night you can see for far away some foxes running around the local parks. The location is a bit distant from the center, but it is easy to move around by metro. It is perfect if you want to relax and not being in the craziness of the city all the time. Highly recommend staying with them.
summary: The hosts were friendly and welcoming, and the house had a beautiful garden and calm neighborhood.

comments:
The location is really convenient : right to Euston station. The key safe make checking-in an out really easy since you don't have to arrange a meeting.
The place is nice and tidy and we even had complimentary shower gels (really classy). You have enough space for your clothes.
The only complaint we have is the noise. There's a pub just under the bedroom window and it can be a bit noisy at nights.
summary: The location was convenient but noisy due to a pub under the bedroom window.

comments: Die schöne Wohnung von Nicola ist sehr verkehrsgünstig gelegen. Sie liegt nur einen Steinwurf von der U-Bahn entfernt und von dort aus ist man schnell im Zentrum. Das Bett ist sehr bequem und die Luftmatratze ging leicht aufzubauen und wurde zu einem komfortablem Doppelbett. Ein paar Dinge, die nicht funktionierten, wurden schnell repariert. Alles in allem ist es ein guter Platz für einen Besuch in London.
summary: The apartment was well-located, comfortable, and had good amenities, making it a great place for visiting London.

comments: My bestie and I enjoyed Tania’s place! London is lovely and we thought it was a great neighborhood. Tower bridge is down the street, which was so cool to pass by. The bus stop is right in front and the metro is a short walk. Borough market is also near. Which was so cool to visit. The only thing that was my fault was not properly checking which building to enter to. Make sure to look at the picture of the building and read the numbers correctly because the whole street is basically the same building style from the front just with specific numbers on each building. Everything there was great. The fans in there helped cool us down, the washer was also great. The bed/ couch bed were comfy! I was a bit confused when picking up the keys, because you do pick them up at a store next to the building but Tania helped me get there and it was all good!
summary: Tania's place was great, with a good location, comfy bed, and helpful fans, but be careful when picking up the keys.

comments: Great space, very clean and tidy. Simple with just everything you need. Great communication and answered my questions very quickly and clearly. I'd love to stay here again when I'm in the area. Its not quite the location we thought it was, a lot further out, but for its style, quietness and cleanliness its worth it!
summary: The space was clean, tidy, and had everything needed, despite being further out than expected.

comments: My stay at Samir's house was great. Everything was perfect - my room, kitchen, spacious modern bathroom, fast connection to Central London. There's also a big supermarket in walking distance. Getttika, Samir's wife welcomed me on my arrival and gave me all information I needed and Wifi password. There were other guests staying in the house, all my age (in their 30s) and all lovely people. Overall, it was the best nocarz experience I've had, and I can highly recommend it to anyone.
summary: Guest had a great stay at Samir's house with perfect amenities and friendly hosts.

comments:
Prefect appartement as pic ,super big room with sunshine . You can use everything in here just like living in home . So nice price with great location .

Zdenka and Louis are so nice person , I Checked in so early because of my train and Louis was waiting for me in home , I really appreciate them .

100% Recommend!
summary: Guest loved the apartment's big room, great location, and friendly hosts Zdenka and Louis.

comments: We had a very comfortable stay, the studio was lovely and warm during our stay when the outside daytime temps were -1 deg C. The bathroom has a heated floor with large heated towel rack and lots of storage. Fast Wi-Fi (70Mbps typical). There were a few safety and maintenance issues which I relayed to Host. I would recommend the studio as it offers outstanding value for money in Marylebone.
summary: Guest had a comfortable stay in the studio with good value for money despite some minor issues.

comments: Very comfy and cozy, a perfect little house with kitchen, living room, table and TV on the ground floor, then upstairs a bathroom with tub/shower and a bedroom with TV. Nestled on a quiet street but very close to cafes, shops, and tube stations. Blinds on all windows, full control over heating, bed was very comfortable, and both TVs are logged into multiple streaming services. I booked this property for my mum who was visiting from abroad and she had a lovely stay.
summary: Guest's mum had a lovely stay in this cozy house with kitchen, living room, and comfortable bed.

comments:
We really enjoyed our 11 night stay in this lovely London home. Our group was 2 seniors, 2 adults, and 2 teens. The 4 bedrooms worked perfectly for us and we really felt at home. We also enjoyed the outdoor space each day and were thankful to have a kitchen and washer/dryer.
A couple considerations - there are 3 flights of stairs that will need to be navigated to reach the bedrooms and kitchens. The listing states "central air conditioning" but only the bedrooms are air conditioned. In mild weather it would not be a concern, but it was quite hot weather while we were there.
One of the best features of this home is the location. We walked to Kings Cross/St Pancras every day (5-7 minutes) and could go anywhere by train, bus or Underground from there. There was a grocery store just steps away, and many pubs and restaurants nearby. Despite the central location, the side street where we stayed was remarkably quiet and peaceful. It was a great home base for our London adventure, thanks!
summary: Guests enjoyed their 11-night stay in the London home with great location, outdoor space, and amenities.

comments: Yossi's Cabin got a full five stars from me on everything and they were all well deserved. It's a delightful, comfortable and very well-equipped cabin at the end of a pretty garden. Check-in was a breeze and while staying in the Cabin is very private, Yossi always seemed to be available if there were any questions or if anything was needed, which of course it wasn't. The location is good too for getting into central London as well as for walks into Richmond Park or along the river in Kingston and the excellent fish restaurant at the end of the road is a must-visit. Thank you Yossi, your Cabin is high on my favourite's list.
summary: Yossi's Cabin is a delightful and well-equipped cabin with excellent location and service.

comments:
Despite good communication through nocarz from the host, the accommodation is completely uninhabitable;
- Check in - Had to wait 15 minutes in the pouring rain for someone to turn up, check in and show me round the flat
- Filthy - windows were disgusting and look like they've never been cleaned, the cutlery, pots, pans and utensils were dirty
- Lighting - automating lighting in toilet, bathroom and kitchen did not work, often leaving me in the complete dark
- Noise - constantly noisy throughout the night, traffic and building works first thing
- Entrance - unpleasant smell in the stairwell, corridor and entrance
- Heating - boiler broke and someone had to come out to sort it. Spent the day in the freezing cold
- WiFi and TV - completely intermittent and had to turn on and off constantly
Overall, a really disappointing experience. I've stayed in many nocarz's in London, but this one needs to be unlisted until the issues above are resolved.
summary: The accommodation was completely uninhabitable due to various issues such as cleanliness, noise, and technical problems.

comments:
The flat was fine for my needs, i wasn't in there for long. The steep stairs are a challenge with a heavy case.
Was good to have little kitchen area & nice to have Teabags / sugar / coffee & cooking oils left for use.
Place felt pretty tired & in need of some TLC in some areas.
Felt expensive for what it is but this is London prices & it was nearly half the price of a nearby travelodge so VFM not bad really.
As someone else commented, couldn't get the TV to work which was annoying, despite it being connected to the Internet, none of the channels or apps would load.
summary: The flat was fine for my needs but felt tired and in need of TLC, with some minor issues like the TV not working.

comments: This is a great flat in a very well connected area. The flat itself is very bright and airy, with large window that can let in the natural light. It is spacious, we were a family of 5 (2 adults and 3 young children) and found that it was very suitable for our needs. The kitchen is modern and very well equipped and the bathroom was likewise. We stayed at the flat for 3 weeks and found it to be very comfortable. It is located in an area which has lots of restaurants etc in the very near vicinity, otherwise the closest tube stop is a 5 minute walk away. You're not in the very centre of London but you're very close and the area strikes a good balance. It was never an issue to get around London from the flat, and we had 2 young boys in buggys. The host was also very responsive. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend.
summary: This is a great flat in a well-connected area, spacious, bright, and airy, with modern kitchen and bathroom.

comments: This was one of my best Air BnB experiences to date! Kate was such a wonderful host. The space is amazing - so clean and roomy, bed very comfortable and nice and quiet. The perfect place to unwind after a day in London! The location is excellent too - very well connected and nice area with green spaces and cafes. Kate was so helpful with check in - waiting for us to arrive to personally help us into the home and also with navigating London and helping us make our way back to the airport. Can't say enough good things! I would definitely love to stay here again next time I'm in London.
summary: This was one of my best Air BnB experiences - the space is amazing, clean, roomy, and quiet, with excellent location and host service.

comments:
Elizabeth and Hugo's Sparkling new apartment was a wonderful base to explore all that London has to offer. It is very well located within walking distance of two tube lines, one is particularly close by. There are local shops for the basics and great recommendations for a bite to eat.

The apartment is spotlessly clean and offers every home comfort. The bath is particularly luxurious after a busy days sightseeing! The high ceilings and neutral classical decor are what initially attracted us to the apartment, however, it was the personal touches such as the basic essentials like salt and pepper, olive oil and toiletries that will make us return.

Our family would highly recommend a stay at Lizzie and Hugo's apartment.
summary: Elizabeth and Hugo's apartment is a wonderful base for exploring London with its great location, cleanliness, and personal touches.

comments: Everything about this visit was delightful, from Akbar greeting me when I first arrived to gracious goodbyes on the morning I left. The flat is situated so that travel around London was easy and timely and pubs and restaurants are within walking distance, including the champagne bar in St. Pancras. James and Akbar were welcoming, informative, and accommodating and made my stay a pleasure.  I had a marvelous time with them and hope to stay with them again on my next London visit.
summary: James and Akbar's flat was delightful to stay in due to their welcoming nature, easy travel access, and nearby amenities.

comments: Estuvimos muy bien en el piso de Megan. Nos hizo el uso que buscábamos que era un lugar donde dormir a gusto ya que el resto del día estuvimos haciendo turismo por la ciudad. Tienes supermercados cerca y la estación de metro también, realmente fue una estancia muy buena. Megan se comunicaba con nosotros rápidamente es muy buena anfitriona.
summary: Megan's apartment is a great place to rest after exploring the city with its convenient location and friendly host.

comments: Anna's place is the most amazing property- it's beautifully decorated, spacious, perfectly equipped for even a longer stay and the location is great as it is close to convenient public transport. Anna herself is an immaculate host- she's beyond nice, very accommodating and available at all times to answer questions and help with problems, she even came by on one of our evenings there to personally show us how to operate the gas fireplace!
