This apartment would be our first choice on all our future visits to London.
summary: Anna's beautifully decorated and equipped apartment is an excellent choice for any stay in London due to her exceptional hosting.

comments:
Glenn was a very friendly, helpful host. He gave us lots of informations before we arrived a responded quickly to any questions I had about local travel.
The apartment was lovely, very clean and comfy, perfect for what we needed. Acton Town itself was great, very diverse. We ate in a lovely Thai restaurant just over the road from the apartment.
We’d definitely look to stay here again in the future!
summary: Glenn's apartment was a great place to stay with its cleanliness, comfort, and helpful host who provided lots of information about the area.

comments: Edwards flat was lovely and homely and ideal for the two of us to enjoy a long weekend. The location allowed us to do everything we had planned and was just a short walk to the tube station. Edward was a good at communicating before and during our stay. We would highly recommend!
summary: Guest had a lovely stay at Edwards flat, highly recommending it for its location and communication.

comments:
Posizione PERFETTA: comoda a Earl’s Court (stazione della District line e anche della Piccadilly) e a una fermata dell’autobus. Ha vicinissimo un supermercato (TESCO) enorme è bello.
Non affaccia su strada quindi anche non rumorosa! Arredamenti nuovi, fantastici, bagno pulito, c’era tutto il necessario per stare comodi. Unica pecca il Wi-Fi che l’ultimo giorno non ha funzionato per 24 ore, poi non so se abbia ripreso ma io ho dovuto fare il check out. Comodissimo anche il check-in e il check-out così!
Consiglio vivamente e se mai tornerò a Londra ritornerò di certo qui!
summary: Guest was very satisfied with the apartment's location, amenities, and cleanliness, but had some issues with Wi-Fi.

comments: Beautiful, homey, clean and wonderful house! I loved everything! If you love cooking, you will find your place in the kitchen, fully equipped with everything you need, trust me, everything :-) big dining table and comfortable sofa bed, cute garden at the back of the house. I spent my weekend with my pregnant friend so it was just perfect place for us, quiet, very family and cosy. Thank you Catherine and her family for letting us stay and for the nice present they left for us xxx you are perfect host! Daniela
summary: Guest loved everything about Catherine's homey and clean house, perfect for a quiet weekend stay.

comments: Great stay. The bed is firm, I found it comfy but if you prefer a really soft bed it might not be your favourite. The location is amazing and the bedroom is in the back of the building so it’s super quiet. The place is a bit smaller than expected, but the kitchen is fantastic and fully stocked.
summary: Guest had a great stay at the apartment, praising its location, kitchen, and quiet bedroom, but noting a firm bed.

comments: The apartment is beautiful, comfortable, and well kept. It is spacious and has everything necessary for a great stay, and is perfectly located next to elephant and castle. Being on the seventh floor it also has spectacular views and is very bright, I would definitely recommend it to anyone. Sorina is the perfect host and has been helpful and available throughout, check in and check out were extremely simple. Thanks again Sorina!
summary: Guest was extremely satisfied with Sorina's apartment, praising its beauty, comfort, cleanliness, and perfect location.

comments: El lugar es muy tranquilo pero muy bien comunicado con el centro de Londres en autobús, metro o tren. La casa es muy cómoda y dispone de todo lo necesario. Pero lo mejor es el trato del anfitrión-a, son personas muy agradables que te ayudan en todo. Al llegar encontramos algo de comida en la nevera y luego nos llevaron al supermercado .... y siempre que podían pues te ayudaban, se preocuparon por nosotros y nos hicieron sentir como en casa. Muy recomendable por el lugar, el apartamento y sobre todo por el trato .
summary: The host was very friendly and helpful, making us feel at home with their excellent service.

comments: The host was very friendly. They answered all my concerns quickly and always extended their help to me and my family as we used their accommodation. I highly recommend. The neighborhood is close by bars so it may be slightly loud due to the bar scene some nights but that’s the least of concerns
summary: The host was very friendly and accommodating, answering all our concerns quickly.

comments: Very clean appartment, close to groceries and metropolitan. However i would have liked to know prior that this is a house-share and that i would not meet the owners. Roomates are calm and the flat is absolutely not noisy. Gokhan and Ersal are very responsive and quick to reply. The bedroom is comfy and spacious.
summary: The apartment was clean and comfortable, but we would have liked to know it's a house-share beforehand.

comments:
I remember seeing a review saying that it's his fifth time staying in this apartment and now I know why.
The place is in central London, conveniently located 5 minutes away from Holborn station. The inside of it is exactly shown in the photos - spacious, clean and modern. It has EVERYTHING you need, literally everything: shampoo, shower gel, olive oil, chilli flakes, even Chinese oyster sauce and more. Natalia is so kind that she prepared a basket of food sitting in the kitchen waiting for us. There is chips, chocolates, fruits and cookies. You can also find a loaf of bread, juices, milk and butter in the fridge. Home sweet home.
Natalia was waiting for our arrival and showed us around. She is such a sweet lovely lady. It's been a pleasure meeting her in person. She has brought hospitality to a new level. Thank you so much Natalia!
summary: The apartment is perfectly located in central London with everything you need, and the host Natalia is extremely kind and welcoming.

comments: We didn't get the chance to meet Paloma, however she was very friendly when communicating and helpful. There is a nice restaurant downstairs which Paloma recommended to store our bags. The staff were friendly and it was very safe. It was easy to check in and out, and the area is very convenient with lots of supermarkets, restaurants and a short walk to Victoria station. The space could easily sleep 4 guests, however not a lot of room to store bags. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
summary: We enjoyed our stay at Paloma's place, which was convenient and had a nice restaurant downstairs.

comments: My stay at Camilla's home was perfect. Camilla is a very kind person with a lovely home. She provided the perfect balance of availability and privacy. The location is ideal. Four underground lines and the overground are within 10 to 20 minutes walk, depending on your pace. The stops for six different buses are less than 100 yards from her home for those wanting a shorter walk. The room is on the ground floor and with its own bathroom with shower enables one to come and go without concerns about disturbing anyone else.
summary: Perfect stay at Camilla's home with ideal location and kind host.

comments: I couldn't have asked for a better experience after a long work trip in London. The hosts were like family, welcoming me with open arms and ensuring I felt comfortable throughout my stay. The room was cosy and inviting, with thoughtful touches that made it feel like a true home away from home. I'll definitely be returning!
summary: Excellent experience at the hosts' place with welcoming atmosphere.

comments: I absolutely loved my stay at Abbie’s wonderful apartment. I was desperate for somewhere clean and homely to stay whilst building work was being carried out on my own property, and I instantly felt so at home at Abbie’s place. The interior is stunningly decorated and has everything you need, and the garden is just beautiful. Abbie herself is a great host who is always there to help and is very friendly, but also just let’s you get on with things which really appreciated. I will be recommending this apartment to any friends coming to stay in London in the future!
summary: Loved Abbie's apartment for its cleanliness, homeliness, and beautiful garden.

comments: We really enjoyed staying here - the apartment was spotless, exactly as described and shown in the photos, but felt much larger than expected. It’s in a great location, Angel tube is a short walk away and we walked with our luggage from Kings Cross. Fabulous restaurants, cafes, shops and pubs right around the corner. Highly recommend :)
summary: Great location and spotless apartment in a fantastic neighborhood.

comments: Caroline was an excellent host with a great home! This is a great place to stay if you're looking to explore Hackney, as it's quite close to many of the major sights in the area. Moreover, Caroline went above and beyond as a host, providing recommendations for the neighborhood and good conversation :) Would highly suggest this listing.
summary: Caroline was an excellent host with great home and local recommendations.

comments: Amy was a very nice host, provided us with a lot of information before we arrived and was very responsive when we had a question during our stay. The flat is located out of the centre of London but easily accessible by public transport and in a nice neighbourhood, close to the Broadway market. Everything was clean and exactly like the pictures in the description. We liked the cats, Moo came to say hi a few times 😊 good price-quality, would recommend for a few days in Londen when you don’t want to pay an enormous sum to stay in the centre of London.
summary: Amy was a great host and the flat was clean and well-located for exploring London.

comments: Excellent place if you are visiting London and want to go around. A couple of mins walk from the seven sisters underground station and around 12 mins to kings cross. Hosts are very nice and help you with everything. A small suggestion would be to have chat support for people who'd be checking in late, like I had some trouble getting the main door opened, but nothing too much. Superb, overall!
summary: Excellent place with friendly hosts, close to public transport and good value for money.

comments: Haewon's place was absolutely perfect for my needs - set in Chapel Market, it's close to all of London with easy access to tube, buses, restaurants, pubs and shops. It also happened to be a couple of doors down from my daughter's flat which made it all the  more perfect for me. Great space for a single, couple or family with small child. May be a bit tight for many more people as it is a true studio, as advertised. A fair number of steps from street to flat, so keep that in mind if any disabilities. I will definitely stay here again at another time.
summary: Haewon's studio apartment was perfect for my needs, located in a great area with easy access to London.

comments: I had an amazing stay at Clarissa’s place. The convenience of being just steps away from cafes, shops, restaurants and public transportation made exploring the city a breeze. The room itself was cozy, clean, and well-appointed, providing a comfortable retreat after a day of sightseeing. The host was incredibly welcoming. I couldn't have asked for a better place to stay during my trip, and I will definitely be back.
summary: Clarissa's place was cozy, clean, and convenient, with a welcoming host and great location.

comments: Great experience to stay at Lisa's place.. the house is clean and neat.. really close to the Paddington Station.. just walkable.. public transport is just around the corner..  i advise to take a taxi first to go to the house if you're not familiar with that area.. after that it's really easy to go everywhere since it's only 6 to 8 minutes walk to  Paddington Station..
summary: Lisa's house was clean and close to Paddington Station, making it easy to get around London.

comments:
I recently stayed at Murray Stays' nocarz and had an exceptional experience. The apartment was exactly as described—spotlessly clean, cozy, and equipped with all the amenities needed for a comfortable stay. The location was ideal, situated close to major attractions and public transportation, making it easy to explore the city. The neighborhood was charming and safe, with plenty of great restaurants and cafes nearby.
Murray Stays was an outstanding host, always prompt in responding to my questions and providing helpful local tips. The check-in process was seamless, and the thoughtful touches, such as fresh linens and complimentary toiletries, were much appreciated. Overall, I had a fantastic stay and would highly recommend this accommodation to anyone visiting the area. Thank you, Murray Stays, for making my trip so enjoyable!
summary: Had an exceptional experience at Murray Stays' nocarz with spotlessly clean, cozy accommodations and excellent location.

comments:
We stayed at Sam’s place for the weekend when going to the stadium.
It could not be any closer to the stadium so the location was perfect.
Communication before the stay was faultless, quick responses and always available to help.
Sam met us outside to show us how to get into the building etc, was greeted with a smile and a friendly host.
The space couldn’t have been cleaner, the private bathroom was spotless. The bed and pillows were incredibly comfortable.
We had use of the communal living space but didn’t get chance to take advantage of this space or the kitchen due to our plans.
Sam is the perfect host and can’t rate high enough for the apartment.
Hopefully we’ll visit again!
summary: Sam's place was perfect for the stadium, with great communication, a clean space, and comfortable bed.

comments: We really enjoyed our stay at Marta’s place! The place was just as described, with a good location, also quiet and clean. Wifi worked well to work remotely and the apartment was well equipped. Such a cute flat on the top floor! Beware if you have difficulties to move or a lot of luggage, the staircase is quite narrow with many steps. Super easy check-in and it was easy to communicate with Marta. :)
summary: Marta's apartment was quiet, clean, and well-equipped, but be aware of the narrow staircase.

comments:
it is awesome!
Marie is very considerate and can be as comfortable as my house. This apartment is beautiful, has everything you need for a comfortable stay, and you can feel a lot of ingenuity in the details.
We have 3 peolpe-me, my wife and my daughter as 12 years old. The size of the apartment is very good and compact. It is the best location in central london. Victoria Station is a 10-minute walk away. Buckingham is a 15-minute walk and Big Ben and Westminster are 15 minutes away. There are many restaurants nearby. I will definitely stay at this accommodation again. I highly recommend it!
summary: Marie's apartment is beautiful, comfortable, and in a great location with many amenities nearby.

comments: Ruth is a wonderful host . She is very helpful and friendly and always available. The room is beautiful,the bed very comfortable. I had everything I needed and more . Ruth left some English essentials in the little refrigerator and of course some tea and biscuits. I will definitely go back there .
summary: Ruth's room was beautiful, comfortable, and well-equipped, with a friendly and helpful host.

comments: Lovely home, great hosts! We really enjoyed our stay here. The upstair shower is amazing, beds are super soft and comfortable, the hosts (and their lovely cat) are very friendly. Location is a bit farther out from main attractions but lots of buses around so commute was not a problem, plus side is that it's much quieter. Highly recommend!
summary: Lovely home with great hosts in a quieter location but still accessible by bus.

comments: Really fantastic apartment on the first floor of Kings St - right in the heart of Covent Garden. The apartment is super clean, well equipped with modern and high quality items, and Josh & Adi went out of there way to deal with some unusual check in requests. But the main selling point is that you are right there,  right next to Covent Garden, overlooking St Paul's church and gardens. If you don't mind the people and the liveliness - than you cannot go wrong. Many thanks to the team.
summary: Fantastic apartment in the heart of Covent Garden with modern amenities and friendly hosts.

comments:
Excellent séjour à Londres chez Joseph, en famille, avec nos 3 ados. Le logement est situé à deux pas des 2 gares de St Pancras et King Cross, et donc très pratique en terme de transports en commun. Il est très fonctionnel : la salle de bains est très pratique et la cuisine est super avec 4 feux à gaz et un grand réfrigérateur -congélateur.
Ce logement nous a permis de nous poser en toute tranquillité entre des journées de découvertes intenses! Nous recommandons vivement le logement de Joseph.
summary: Practical and comfortable apartment near St Pancras and King Cross stations with easy transportation.

comments: Jacob greeted us and gave us a personalized orientation to the flat-which was a first and so appreciated. He was extremely friendly and made us feel at home. He also gave us a great history of the building and area. The flat was exactly as pictured-very clean and nicely appointed. Everything you could have needed to make a stay comfortable was available. When we did have a couple of questions Jacob answered them thoroughly and immediately. The area is perfect for walking to many attractions around London. The whole family loved it!
summary: Friendly host Jacob provided a personalized orientation to the flat in a perfect walking location for London attractions.

comments: L'appartement est idéalement situé à proximité de Westminster dans un quartier calme et résidentiel. Cet appartement a du caractère et une âme du à la décoration raffinée. La cuisine est bien équipée et approvisionnee pour cuisiner. La communication avec Alex est facile, ces précieux sont conseils sont agréables pour passer un agréable séjour. L'appartement est propre, la literie bonne. Nous avons passés un excellent séjour dans l'appartement d'alex et sa compagne. Je recommande vivement cette adresse pour un séjour.
summary: Charming apartment in a quiet residential area near Westminster with refined decoration and good amenities.

comments: Great stay here. We stayed with two young kids while I had to work at Chiswick Business Park and was a 5 min walk and perfect. Host was very responsive… we had to turn heat on and he immediately did video call to coach me through. He was also flexible on both check in and check out which saved us with the kids and bags. We would stay there again for sure.
summary: Great stay with a responsive host who was flexible on check-in/check-out times.

comments: We stayed in Mark's accommodation for a work trip. It is remarkably central and close to the Russel Square station, quiet and warm (we previously had experiences of flats badly insulated and too cold in the winter). Mark's instructions for check in were clear and his communications always responsive. Also, it was nice to see one of these Brutalist buildings from the inside :)
summary: Central and quiet accommodation with clear instructions from the host.

comments:
Absolutely perfect experience at Grant’s flat.
It was decorated perfectly and had everything you could require.

The bedroom is huge and the lounge/dining area is one of the best we have ever stayed in.
The area is a great balance of a quiet road but very close to an amazing pub (The Bedford) and multiple great restaurants.
Would definitely love to come back and would highly recommend Grant and Renita as hosts.
summary: Perfectly decorated flat in a great location with a huge bedroom and excellent amenities.

comments: Lyle was a very kind and attentive host. He sent all the information about how to get to the place and received me very well. The room is large, clean and the house is totally organized, I had everything I needed for my stay. It's close to the station and bus stops, so I had no trouble getting around. It was a short but excellent stay. I certainly intend to return!
summary: Friendly and attentive host with a clean and organized room in a convenient location.

comments: Second time staying at Elias's place when visiting London. 10/10  for cleanliness of the bedroom and bathroom. Room looks 100% better than advertised due to being recently renovated. Great value for money. Friendly host and easy to talk to. Will be 1st place to check for availability when visiting London again. Thanks Elias
summary: Clean and recently renovated room at a great value for money with a friendly host.

comments: This was my second time staying at this location, and it was great! Checking in and out was very easy, and Billie and Max were helpful and responsive. The location is nice to walk around, and convenient to the tube. The bed was very comfortable, and though the space is small, you have everything you need for a short stay :)
summary: Great location, easy check-in and out, comfortable bed, and helpful hosts.

comments: This place is great, the bed was a bit hard and pillows a bit flat but we made do! It’s a good location, close to everything. One flight of stairs to get to the first floor, but can take the lift which was helpful with our large suitcases. Very quiet, other nocarz-ers were hardly noticed. The rooms have locks on the doors so our stuff felt safe while we were gone. Kitchen was fully equipped with large refrigerator for food. Market and cafe close by. Easy pickup from Uber! Thanks Eddy!
summary: Good location, quiet, and safe with a fully equipped kitchen, but the bed was a bit hard.

comments: William's place is very conveniently located at walking distance from Earl's Court station and is perfect for a small family. The apartment is clean and has all the basic necessities one may need for a short stay. William is very quick to respond and was always just a message away for all our questions and concerns.
summary: Conveniently located near Earl's Court station, clean, and well-equipped for a small family.

comments:
Great place that is spanking clean, well setup with ample living space. Good safe and quite neighbourhood.
The host Jackson is wonderful and thoughtful. He runs a pub nearby with great drinks and good food. Very warm and great conversationalist. Very genuine.
A great place for families and a good place to explore Kew Gardens, Richmond Park, Westfield, Richmond and Hammersmith areas. Also very near to airport so you don’t need to rush.
Would highly recommend this place.
summary: Clean, spacious, and safe with a wonderful host who runs a nearby pub with great food and drinks.

comments: Wir waren ein langes Wochenende in London mit unseren 2 Kindern. Die Unterkunft  ist schön eingerichtet und man kann gut die öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichen, 10 Minuten bis zur Ubahnstation Mile End. Die Gegend fanden wir mittelmäßig schön, zwischen weniger schönen und schönen Straßen gelegen. Unser Auto haben wir für 10 Pfund je Tag im Innenhof abstellen können.
summary: Well-furnished apartment near public transportation, but the neighborhood was only mediocre.

comments: Abbiamo trascorso un soggiorno fantastico a casa di Katherine e Craig! La casa è ancora più bella di quanto si possa vedere dalle foto: spaziosa e con un bagno privato direttamente nella nostra camera, un vero comfort. Katherine e Craig sono stati padroni di casa eccezionali, sempre disponibili e gentili. Abbiamo avuto modo di conoscere anche i loro due bambini, e ci siamo affezionati particolarmente a Jiro, che è stato davvero adorabile. Se torneremo in zona, senza dubbio sceglieremo di soggiornare di nuovo da loro. Un'esperienza davvero perfetta!
summary: Guests had a fantastic stay at Katherine's house, praising its beauty, comfort, and hosts' exceptional hospitality.

comments:
Two unforgettable days in London, in a typical English neighborhood, well connected to the center. The e house is bright and very cozy, with a lovely indoor garden. The bedroom with a very soft mattress and pillows.
Deborah is the perfect hostess, very helpful and ready to help with advice
We will definitely stay there again as soon as we can!
Francesca e Maria
summary: Francesca and Maria enjoyed their two-day stay in Deborah's cozy London home, appreciating its location, garden, and hostess's helpfulness.

comments:
All about the location. It’s in a walkable and busy section of London right at the center point. Walk across the street to Tesco, shops, plenty of restaurants, and the National Gallery.
It was clean and convenient. It was complicated and overwhelming for a weary traveler to get in, but once I found the key box, it was easy going.
My only constructive criticism is that the beds are not very comfortable, and we didn’t sleep well in them.
Host was very responsive helpful with every question that I had.
summary: Guest found the location ideal, but had issues with bed comfort and complicated check-in process, despite responsive host.

comments: Gute Lage (Farringdon) von da aus ist alles schnell und einfach zu erreichen. Kian Antwortet immer schnell. Leider kann man sein eigenes Zimmer in der Gemeinschaftswohnung nicht zuschließen. Wenn man spät abends oder nachts nach Hause kommt kann es sein das man unten warten muss bis jemand von Security kommt und dir die Tür auf schließt.
summary: Kian's apartment in a good location, but guests were unhappy about not being able to lock their own room.

comments: Things I liked: location - very central. The space and quietness - bedrooms away from road to super quiet. The high thread count sheets. The well equipped kitchen - especially the food disposal unit (made it feel like home away from home). Simons responsiveness - we had some issues with the TV and he reacted quickly to resolve it. All very very good
summary: Guests praised the central location, quiet bedrooms, high-quality amenities, and Simon's quick response to issues with the TV.

comments: I would highly recommend these accommodations for the excellent location, quiet surroundings, and fair amenities. This is about a 3 minute walk to the Sloane Square tube station, which connects to all the main attractions in London. As first time visitors to London, we were able to visit all the main tourist attractions, all within a 10-25 minute tube ride. My family and I were impressed with how quiet the neighborhood was- it was completely quiet at night and we were awoken by birds chirping in the gardens in the morning, which was nice. It seems to be a very safe area as well. It is close to Wulf and Lamb, which is a vegan restaurant we enjoyed visiting several times. I also appreciated the French press for morning coffee. The second (smaller) bedroom near the kitchen/living room does not have a door (which we were told ahead of time and didn't bother us), but is good to know as I imagine this could be an issue for some groups. The apartment was also clean and the check in was easy. I would be happy to stay here again!
summary: Excellent location, quiet surroundings, and fair amenities make this accommodation highly recommended.

comments: Alright to stay in if you’re going for a less expensive option. Kind of anonymous with the other guests in the flat. The location allows you to get around quickly. The building is super dirty from the outside. From the outside the building is. It so nice but inside the flat is equipped with everything you need. The squeaky floor and doors in the flat is a little bit annoying. The communication with the hosts was quick and helpful.
summary: A decent option for those on a budget, but the building is dirty from the outside and the flat has some annoying squeaks.

comments: Very nice, bright, well laid out flat with plenty of room for 2 of us.  Kitchen had essentials for cooking and clean sheets provided for sofa bed along with shower gel/shampoo.  Building work in adjacent flat with banging went on until around 9pm every day but not during the night.  Could get fairly noisy from the flat above the bedroom when people were moving about.  But all-in-all a lovely stay.
summary: This bright and well-laid out flat was perfect for two people, with essentials provided in the kitchen and clean sheets on the sofa bed.

comments:
Extremely impressed with the accommodation and the welcome given on arrival. Coffee making facilities provided. Dedicated bathroom with good quality towels supplied. Host open for sociable conversation and helpful directions to restaurants etc.
Great location with good transport links to central London and Docklands.
.
Highly recommended and will return on my next visit to the UK.
summary: The accommodation exceeded expectations, with a great location, good transport links, and a welcoming host who provided helpful directions.

comments: Questo appartamento è nel centro della zona dei teatri di Londra, ideale per spostarsi a piedi per esplorare la città. Il design degli interni è moderno e funzionale, adatto sia a famiglie che a gruppi. Il team di Welcome London è stato efficiente, comunicativo e gentile durante tutto il nostro soggiorno. Cinque stelle su tutto!
summary: This modern and functional apartment is ideal for exploring London's theatre district on foot, with efficient and friendly hosts.

comments: Gilly’s place is very convenient. It is a few minutes’ walk to a national rail station and a bus stop right out of the front gate. It is a small clean cabin with everything you need. Gilly was responsive and polite, usually responded within minutes and it helped that she lives right next door. She helped wash our laundry and pointed us to a place to dry nearby. Before we arrived she stocked the place with fruit, drinks, and pastries for breakfast as described. She even restocked them during our 6 nights of stay. There is also a park nearby for walks. I would recommend for anyone visiting London to stay at her place. Gilly made our visit a great experience.
summary: Gilly's place is convenient, clean, and well-equipped with a friendly host who goes above and beyond.

comments:
Very pleasant experience!
The apartment was clean, quiet at night, with all the comfort needed for a pleasant holiday in central London.
Donovan, was very kind, both on welcoming, and to provide guidance on how to arrive and to leave the house, from underground and trains station.
Highly recommended by an Italian family, Barbara, Massimo and Matteo.
summary: Donovan's apartment is quiet, comfortable, and centrally located with excellent service from the host.

comments: Really enjoyed our stay at Yvonne's studio - such a gorgeous place and perfect for what we needed on our trip. The studio has everything you need - tea, coffee, ironing board, hairdryer, coathangers, etc etc. Yvonne supplied plenty of information and maps on London and the local area. It's about a 15 minutes walk to the tube but there were plenty of bus routes close by. Yvonne was on holiday during our stay but we were met by her friend. We were much later to check in than expected because of reasons beyond our control but the house-sitter was able to meet us at a later time which was much appreciated. Yvonne remained in contact to answer any questions despite being on holiday herself - overall very happy with both host and accommodation.
summary: Yvonne's studio is perfect for short trips to London, clean, well-equipped, and has a friendly house-sitter.

comments:
This was one the best nocarzs I stayed at (and I use nocarz a lot!). The cottage is very clean, the bed is comfy, the covered terrace area is excellent for your meals and in my case I used it as a work from home station. Wifi connection is great. I stayed here for 8 weeks and felt at home. Also conveniently located next to the Limehouse station (3 min walk) and several bus stops. There is a Tesco store super close by (5 min walk). I also liked that PureGym is only 5 min walking distance also, which for me was great, because I stayed here for a couple month and enrolled at the gym, which is affordable and doesn't require a contract. If you like running, there are several paths close by that go along the Thames.
Tom was very communicative and flexible. He checked in on me to see if everything was to my liking and whether I needed anything. I told him that was a small problem, a ceiling leak when I used the bathtub, but it wasn't too big of a deal for me. He promptly send a plumber that fixed the issue on the following day.
Overall an excellent experience, highly recommend it!
summary: Tom's cottage is one of the best I've stayed at, very clean, comfortable, and conveniently located with excellent service from the host.

comments:
I stayed together with my mother and my sister for 3 days in Francien's house and had a very great time there. Francien supported us with a lot of good recommendations regarding restaurants and shopping locations, directions etc before our trip started.
Francien's house has a very good transport connection to the city center. I totally recommend this accomodation to everyone who looks for an affordable and homelike accomodation.
Thank you Francien for all your help and support.
Bis zum nächsten Mal. Viele Grüße, Patricia
summary: Francien's house is an affordable and homelike accommodation with great transport connections to the city center.

comments: Casa muy acogedora en un barrio precioso. Tiene unos gatos preciosos y super cariñosos. Está a 10 minutos de una estación de tren, 15 de una de metro y 5 de una de bus. Habitación limpia y cuidada. Nosotros no estuvimos mucho con Deborah, pero parece muy agradable. Por la noche el barrio da un poco de miedo, pero solamente el último tramo hasta la casa (porque está muy oscuro).
summary: Cozy house in a nice neighborhood with friendly hosts.

comments: This is what I sent to the lovely hosts:- "Charlie and Lee, what can I say? A truly perfect nocarz experience! I can't thank you enough for sharing your lovely home with me. Needless to say, if I'm ever needing a room in SW London, your place will be my first port of call. Thanks again. Peter." You will not regret staying in this lovely home.
summary: Perfect nocarz experience in a lovely home with great hosts.

comments:
We were 3, including a disabled person on the electric scooter and it was really accessible appartment on a ground floor. It has 2 stairs from bedrooms to the bathroom or kitchen, so we slept on the couch in the kitchen-living room and had free stairs access to the bathroom.
Untill new guest arrived it was surprisingly quiet, no traffic on the road, really awesom.
I strongly reccomend this appartment if you want to enjoy in Camden.
P.s. London is great for tourists with electric scooters or wheelchairs.
We'll be back
summary: Accessible and quiet apartment in Camden with easy access to public transportation.

comments: It’s worth it to be in the right location and this place is just that. This is a quite place located in a happening neighborhood. Conveniently located to the tube or walkable to many sights and locations. I would highly recommend this place to anyone, and plan to stay here when returning.
summary: Conveniently located place in a happening neighborhood with easy access to tube.

comments:
We booked Michelle's house for a family vacation with 7 adults. Everything was perfect and Michelle's house was the ideal accommodation for us. The house is beautifully furnished, and everything was provided as described. The kitchen and outdoor area offer plenty of space to enjoy the time together. The amenities are of very high quality, and the accommodation is in excellent and clean condition.
There are pubs, restaurants and shops nearby and several underground stations are reachable within about 10 minutes walk distance. Michelle is a great host and always responded promptly to our questions.
We thoroughly enjoyed our vacation here and would book Michelle’s accommodation again at any time.
summary: Perfect accommodation for family vacation with great amenities and location.

comments: Sicuramente abbiamo lasciato l'appartamento molto più pulito e rifornito di come l'abbiamo trovato (mancavano: la carta igienica, attrezzature sufficienti per cucinare, prodotti per la pulizia in cucina, per l'igiene e per la pulizia della casa). Per consumare i pasti, il tavolo è per 2 persone perchè ci sono solamente 2 sgabelli per sedersi, essendo in 4 questo era un grosso problema. Reattività di Levan non pervenuta (i codici del wi-fi ci sono giunti la sera prima di partire), non ci ha mai chiesto come andava il soggiorno, il servizio di accoglienza è stato totalmente inesistente, assolutamente non in linea con i canoni soliti di nocarz. L'appartamento non era adeguato a livello di pulizia in generale, non ci sono mobili e quindi non si sa dove mettere i vestiti. Non consigliamo assolutamente di pernottare in questo luogo, non tanto la zona geografica (sicuramente siamo in periferia, ma comunque in circa 20/25 minuti si è in centro con la "tube" da Turnpike Line). Sconsigliato.
summary: The apartment was not clean and lacked basic amenities, with poor communication from the host.

comments:
Our host Tina was there on arrival to show us around and easily contactable. She could not have been more helpful. The flat was exactly as shown, more spacious than we thought and very good quality soft furnishings, it's really charming and comfortable. We felt at home, and have a good experience in London with my colleagues.
And the location is great,5-6 minutes walk to Earls Court tube station and the rest of shops, restaurants and pubs around the area.
Much appreciated, and definitely recommend!
summary: Our host Tina was very helpful and the flat was exactly as shown, more spacious than expected.

comments: A group of 5 of us stayed here for two nights. It was overall a great stay and only a 5-10 min walk from a tube station. We appreciated the provided soaps, and had we needed it, the kitchen seemed well-equipped. We were visiting in July so it was quite warm (no AC or fans). Communication was always great, and we would still recommend to other groups looking to stay together in London.
summary: A great stay in a well-equipped apartment, close to a tube station, with good communication from the host.

comments:
It was fine, just some dirty shared spaces. There was one other person staying there so not sure if the other resident made them dirty, or if the cleaning was inadequate.
Other than that, it’s very close to the airport and Nagendra was quick to respond. I just wish he would have helped more with the cleanliness.
summary: The shared spaces were dirty and could have been cleaner, but the location was convenient for the airport.

comments:
It was a great place to experience life in London. Tim's house has two large bedrooms, the cozy living room with kitchen and one toilet. We stayed just two, but I think it'll be big enough for two couples (four people). It was well heated, hot water was always served. It was a pretty house with cozy interior design. There were a good audio and various cooking tools, we could feel like staying in London. The location is 6 minutes walk from Aldgate Station. It was convenient to use the subway or bus. Check-in/check-out was also very convenient. If you have a point of caution, there are no elevators here, just like most of the Flats in the UK. It may be a little hard for people with heavy luggage to climb the narrow stairs on the third floor. Overall, it was a very satisfying accommodation :)
런던 라이프를 경험할 수 있는 멋진 숙소였습니다. 넓은 거실 겸 부엌과 넉넉한 침실 2개, 화장실 1개로 이루어진 플랫으로 저희는 2명이서 이용하였지만 2커플(4명)이 이용해도 충분할 것 같습니다. 난방도 잘 되고 뜨거운 물이 상시 나왔으며 아침에는 따뜻한 햇살이 비추는 예쁜 집이었습니다. 인테리어도 감각적이고 좋은 오디오와 다양한 요리도구들도 갖추어져있어서 영국의 가정집에 지내는 기분을 느낄 수 있었습니다. 위치는 Aldgate역에서 도보로 6분 정도 소요되는 곳으로 지하철을 이용하거나 버스를 이용하기 편리하였습니다. 체크인/체크아웃도 매우 편리하였습니다. 주의할 점이 있다면, 영국 대부분의 Flat이 그렇듯 이 곳에도 엘리베이터가 없습니다. 짐이 많고 무거운 분들은 3층의 좁은 계단을 올라가기 조금 힘들 수도 있습니다. 전반적으로 무척 만족스러운 숙소였습니다 :)
summary: A great place to experience life in London, with a cozy living room and kitchen, close to Aldgate Station.

comments: I had such an incredible stay with Barbara! The space is lovely and has everything you need, including a perfect balcony to sit and read in the morning sunshine.  The location is perfect- peaceful area but very close to restaurants shops the tube and anything else ur looking for.  Barbara is an incredible and thoughtful host tipping off a perfect stay with incredible hospitality.  Would highly recommend and would definitely go back.
summary: Incredible stay with Barbara, perfect location, lovely space, and excellent hospitality.

comments:
It was my first nocarz experience and I’m so happy that this experience was good. Mark is very helpful and respectful host, always here when you need help or advice. Really nice person.
Room for two was amazing: huge bed, enough place for suitcases and it was so bright and clean.
My partner and I were staying in Mark’s place for 1 month. Absolutely recommend 💫
summary: Great first Nocarz experience with Mark, helpful host, clean and bright room.

comments:
Absolutely perfect!
The apartment is fantastic, nice decor, comfortable living and bedroom, and just what it is needed in the kitchen and bathroom. Beautiful view to a small back garden.
Quiet street, beautiful neighborhood, with gardens nearby, and close to everything we needed. Seconds walking to the bus and rental bikes, 2-3 minutes walk to the tube, supermarket, pharmacy and lots of restaurants.
Ayaz was an amazing host, so kind and ready to answer any question. Thank you so much!
I would definitely recommend and rent it again
summary: Perfect apartment with Ayaz, fantastic decor, comfortable living, and great location.

comments:
My girlfriend and I stayed for 5 nights in late August-early September 2016. It suited us perfectly, being right near Hoxton Overground Station and a 10 minute walk from Shoreditch's busy area. There's also a good coffee place called Beagle right at the station.
Andy's place is clean, spacious and relaxing, as is the guest room itself. It's covered in art and indoor plants. It's a shared bathroom arrangement, but this was no problem. Andy also kindly made fruit, tea and coffee available for us each morning and we felt comfortable using the kitchen and fridge. Communication was easy.
The are two things worth noting. First, the spare room faces the Overground train line, which is a bit noisy with the window open, but fine when it's closed. Also, the blinds aren't great at blocking light.
Overall, we had a great stay and we'd definitely recommend Andy's place.
summary: Clean and relaxing stay at Andy's place, perfect for exploring Hoxton and Shoreditch.

comments:
Robert and Antonio were absolutely exquisite! They both welcomed my boyfriend and I in their lovely house, making feeling just like at home.
It's not always easy travelling with your partner and feeling safe in a stranger's house, but Robert and Antonio never made us feel such way. On the contrary! They were funny, helpful and very sweet. And chatting with them was extremely delightful.
We could have not asked for better and we are so glad we chose them for our short staying in London! We certainly know where we will stay next time we are in town!
summary: Robert and Antonio were excellent hosts, making us feel like home with their lovely house and warm hospitality.

comments:
This is in a great location (15 mins to Kings Cross station, lots of food and groceries). The host, Justyna, is super friendly and very timely and clear with her communication. We never met in person but she definitely exceeded my expectations with how easy she was to reach.
I couldn't rate this stay any higher as this is a family home that is very much lived in with toys and clutter everywhere. It was uncomfortable to walk into a space that didnt feel prepared for paying guests. The pillows on the beds were cushions and very uncomfortable, there was clutter everywhere (unlike the photos in this listing), things shoved behind the couch. We had 5 adults staying and the sofa bed was going to be used. It clearly hadnt been pulled out and checked beforehand as there were things that had fallen down into the lounge. There was also a fair bit of dust and dirty tea towels left in the washing machine. Two of our party (another couple) were so uncomfortable they stayed in a hotel instead.
summary: The host exceeded expectations with communication, but the space felt unprepared for guests due to clutter and uncomfortable pillows.

comments:
A Truly Exceptional Stay - 10/10!✨
I’ve used nocarz countless times, and I can confidently say Gulcan is the best host I’ve ever had! She went above and beyond to ensure my stay was comfortable and enjoyable, even taking care of me when I wasn’t feeling well. Her hospitality, kindness, and genuine care really set her apart.
The flat itself was spotless, well-appointed, and perfectly located in London. Everything you could need is within walking distance—fantastic shops, parks, and the beautiful Victoria Park’s Pavilion just within walking distance. The bus stop nearby (8) connects you directly to Shoreditch, the City, and Liverpool Street, making it super convenient to get around.
Gulcan’s communication was excellent from start to finish, making the whole experience seamless. I couldn’t recommend her place highly enough—it’s truly a gem. If you’re looking for an incredible nocarz stay, this is it! Thank you so much, Gulcan, for making my time in London just peaceful!
summary: This was a truly exceptional stay with a spotless, well-appointed flat in a perfect location, thanks to an excellent host.

comments: Quartier très vivant et tendance, résolument "the place to be" pour plonger dans la vie londonienne ! Proche des transports, de restaurants, bars et marchés sympa. Appart cosy et hôte très accueillant, avec des conseils précieux et des attentions charmantes, comme des fruits ou encore un petit mot laissé le matin ;) On s'est senti à l'aise et dans une atmosphère bienveillante. Merci encore Stepan !
summary: The area is lively and trendy, the apartment is cozy, and the host is very welcoming and helpful.

comments: We thought the area was great but very noisy with train line under bedroom windows and only air con in 1 bedroom. Needed windows open but too noisy. Getting to the apartment was a hassle getting into 2 different lifts and a long walk. But apartment was lovely and comfortable. And very good area . Host was also very helpful.
summary: The area was great but noisy due to a train line under the bedroom windows, and getting to the apartment was a hassle.

comments:
I like the privacy and the great functionality of the pods.
This is a large operation, without a communal kitchen, so less chance for meeting others, outside of the associated bar. Depends what you're looking for.
This is not a very quiet place. But again, depends what you're looking for.
Overall appears well managed and very safe.
summary: This is a well-managed and safe place with private pods, but it's not quiet and depends on what you're looking for.

comments:
10mins walking distance from Westminster Abbey. Supermarket around the corner. Overall the neighborhood seemed pretty safe. The apartment was quiet even if it is a part of a big building with over 50 apartments.
4 stars and not 5 only because the place is super tight! It can sleep 4 people, but if you have a baby and place the crib in one of the rooms, you run out of space.
Overall a good experience though.
summary: Quiet apartment with good location, but small space for 4 people.

comments:
un logement fonctionnel pour quelques jours de vacances à Londres. nous étions 4 amis pour 3 nuits et nous avons très bien dormi. Calme et détente sont de rigueur. Matt le propriétaire toujours réactif en cas de questions sur le logement ou sur la ville de Londres. Très bon rapport qualité prix.
petit bémol : La porte de la salle de bain qui frotte sur le sol et donc difficile à ouvrir. A changer des que possible ou faire quelques petits travaux sur celle ci.
summary: Functional accommodation with good value for money, but bathroom door needs repair.

comments: Absolutely gorgeous stay. The room was so beautifully decorated. Such great attention to detail - heaps of books, coffee and tea, comfy pillows and blankets, lots of towels and so many toiletries for guests to use in the bathroom. I needn’t have brought anything, the hosts covered it all. The bed was so comfortable and I slept so well. Perfect location just a stroll from train stations. Easily got around today and yesterday! Great communication from Steph who was very helpful in giving me info about routes etc. Close to a lovely park, skehans pub and a vibrant cafe too. Would defo recommend this place. Thanks Steph!
summary: Beautifully decorated room with great attention to detail and perfect location.

comments: El alojamiento de Philip nos precio muy bueno, todo estaba limpio y equipado, Phillip no estaba pero estuvo en contacto todo el tiempo pendiente de cualquier cosa, nos dejó hacer el check in más temprano y salir más tarde. La zona queda cerca al metro y es muy fácil llegar al centro. ¡Todo estuvo muy bien!
summary: Good price, clean and equipped apartment with helpful host.

comments: Great place, great host. Lovely flat in a really nice area. The flat is nicely decorated and has everything you need so you can feel right at home. Stephanie is a brilliant host and goes out of her way to make you feel comfortable. Came here already the second time and will probably do so in the future. Highly recommended.
summary: Lovely flat in nice area with everything you need, highly recommended.

comments: Thanks Gary provide such a nice place for staying. The location is very convenient, can easily get to Central London & Gatrick Airport. Station, restaurants and supermarket is nearby. Every details in the apartment is considerate and thoughtful. It makes us had a good time in UK. Before we arrived, Gary answer all my enquires in a timely manner. And while we stay, Gary and Irina also helped us a lot. I would definitely choosing their place to stay if I travel to London again.
summary: Guest had a great stay at Gary's place, convenient location and thoughtful details.

comments:
Absolutely perfect base for our visit to Kew Gardens. Local shops and restaurants top notch and underground nearby for getting around.
Lovely room and welcoming helpful owners. Really nothing to criticise except the regular planes on their way to Heathrow going over the area. But there’s nothing they could do about that.
summary: Perfect base for visiting Kew Gardens with welcoming owners and nearby amenities.

comments: The apartament is very well located, close to tube stations and bus stops. It has everything you may need to enjoy your time in London, comfortable beds, big bathroom, nice kitchen and even a lovely garden! Everything was spotless and the check in was very easy (in a hotel near by). Thanks a lot for everything, Florence!
summary: Apartment is well-located, clean, and has everything needed for a comfortable stay in London.

comments:
This place is amazing! If you're staying overnight near Heathrow and need to sleep, this is your ideal location! It's about 10min from the airport with an Uber. Prem (Nidhi's husband) was there to welcome me, incredible hospitality. The room and bathroom was sparkling clean, slept great. He helped give me directions on how to catch the train to Tower Bridge and also stayed up for me to get back in.
Would definitely stay again and longer if I get the chance next time!
summary: Ideal location near Heathrow airport with sparkling clean room and excellent hospitality.

comments:
Desservi par des bus menant au central London (Kensington via le 6 par exemple) en quelques minutes, le logement est parfaitement bien situé. Nous sommes arrivées très facilement de Gatwick.
Sachant que nous allions arriver plus tôt et que le logement ne serait disponible qu’à 15h, nous avions demandé un early checkin, que nous n’avons malheureusement pas eu. Les informations arrivent donc pile à quinze heures.
La sécurité du logement est top et simple, on accède au bien grâce à des différents codes. Pas de perte de clés possible.
Enfin l’appartement est très agréable, très cosy. On déplore juste une trop « petite » salle de bain par rapport au reste mais elle reste tout de même très fonctionnelle et jolie.
Gros de coup de cœur sur la propreté!
Tout est neuf, le matériel de cuisine ainsi que le mobilier, c’est nickel !
Enfin LA LITERIE est divine : couette et oreillers de qualités supérieurs, matelas parfait ! Mieux que dans certains hôtels 5 étoiles. Nuits de rêves assurées 😴💛
summary: Guest had a pleasant stay at this apartment, well-located and secure, but small bathroom was a drawback.

comments:
El contacto con Ben fue perfecto y rápido. Llegamos un poco tarde por el vuelo y aún así no hubo ningún problema en recibirnos. Muy cerca de la parada de metro y en un barrio bastante bueno con supermercados, restaurantes y demás.
La casa increíble. Con calefacción para ese frío londinense, habitaciones muy confortables, casa bastante moderna con todas las comodidades, patio compartido muy agradable...
Nos facilitó unas instrucciones con el manejo de Internet, calefacción, mapas y demás. Incluso teníamos un regalo de bienvenida para nuestra llegada.
Perfecto y sin ningún problema.
summary: Perfect experience with Ben's contact, great location, and wonderful house.

comments: Alexandrian's place felt not like traveling, more like being home. It has enough space and even a nice garden and the kitchen is super well equipped. You can cook anything you can imagine, wich I have never seen in an nocarz. Very good location close to Jubilee line and tower bridge. We'll definitely come back.
summary: Alexandrian's place felt like home, spacious, well-equipped kitchen, and excellent location.

comments: Nice apartment and location and as described , the only issue which made our stay unpleasant is that  the bed linen had a strong BO smell and felt like someone had slept in it for sometime.. not tolerable at all so we had to make do with the lounge sofa bed
summary: Nice apartment and location, but bed linen had a strong BO smell.

comments: The flat was located in a perfect spot right above the Borough underground, very easy to get to every part of the city and even walkable to the Borough Market which I say is a must see. The pictures don't do the floor to ceiling windows justice, the light was amazing. Very clean and updated, will be back
summary: Perfect spot with easy access to city, great light from floor-to-ceiling windows.

comments:
Aurelie’s place was great for my stay in London. The location is great with buses and trains a short walk (including train to & from Heathrow), plus there is a coffee shop just up the road and a pub in case you want to have dinner close by.
The room was a good size and the bed was super comfortable. I would stay again next time I am in London.
summary: Aurelie's place was great for my stay in London, comfortable room and good location.

comments:
What a fantastic place to stay! We arrived in the early hours so Piers had arranged for us to receive the keys ahead of time and was quick to respond to any questions we had, not that we had many as there was brilliantly clear information before and during the stay.
The apartment is beautifully decorated and was spotlessly clean with possibly the comfiest bed I've ever slept on and a fantastic shower.
The location is also perfect, with a tube station literally a minute's walk away and close to lots of bars and restaurants yet in a very quiet and safe feeling street.
Would definitely look at staying here next time I visit London, we didn't want to leave!
summary: Fantastic place with great location, clean apartment, and comfortable bed.

comments: Overall, our stay at Sole’s place was great. The location was fabulous and it felt very safe. The apartment was spacious, clean, and comfortable and ultimately suited our needs. The only issue was that the water that came out of both showers was extremely hot and we weren’t able to control the temperature. Aside from the excessively hot shower, the apartment was great and I would recommend this place!
summary: Great stay in a spacious, clean, and comfortable apartment with some minor issues with the shower temperature.

comments: Value for money!  It is in the middle of all the sights in London with nearby underground stations. This place is surrounded with pubs and bars, although it wasn't disturbing and we as girls still felt save. Thank you for all the help when we called you and your kindness. We will definitely visit again!
summary: Excellent value for money with a central location, friendly hosts, and nearby amenities.

comments: Wonderful secluded cabin that provides a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of London whilst being close to the Tube station so that you can go out and explore during the day! Amazing feng shui, very comfortable bed, attentive hosts and the most gorgeous furry friends who came to say hello during our stay!  Would definitely recommend staying here!
summary: Wonderful secluded cabin with great feng shui, comfortable bed, and friendly furry friends.

comments:
Ciarans flat is beautiful. Top floor with a brilliant view of London skyline. Watching the planes fly over was also very relaxing and I did not hear them. Parking was brilliant. The bustop is right by the entrance of the court which was great to get in and out of central London. Richmond center was walking distance. The decor is lovely. The flat was spotless. It was very peaceful and there is a lovely outdoor space if needed.
Negatives - There is no radiator in the bedroom (which may not be an issue for some) but we stayed during cold weather which made the bedroom feel very cold through the night (I always pack a hot water bottle which was handy).
I would definitely recommend this flat and area to others.
summary: Beautiful flat with lovely decor, peaceful atmosphere, and convenient location, but some issues with bedroom temperature.

comments:
We can't praise Simon's place highly enough.
We stayed here for a week to escape and study near London and it couldn't have been better. The flat is bright and clean, it was an ideal spot to focus and study whilst also being homely and relaxing.
The outdoor terrace was a particular treat- we had a great time using the BBQ and pizza oven. Evenings sat out with a drink were a highlight.
Simon was an excellent host and always on hand to contact. The guide to the apartment was exceptional.
We enjoyed exploring Crouch End- a lovely family vibe with fantastic parks and places to eat. Getting into London was straightforward on the bus then the tube.
Thank you for a wonderful stay!
summary: Guests praised Simon's place for its cleanliness, comfort, and homely atmosphere, with excellent host service.

comments: John provided a safe and super comfortable space for me and my friend. The breakfast tray in the morning was amazing and super thoughtful, and he made us feel super welcome and comfortable during our whole stay. Barney was also lots of fun! Would recommend this stay to everyone who’s visiting London!
summary: John provided a safe and comfortable space with thoughtful touches, making guests feel welcome and at home.

comments: Tamsin and George are really great hosts - we always felt very welcome during our stay. The apartment itself is very comfortable, with two bedrooms and two bathrooms, a well-equipped kitchen and comfortable couch. There is a washing machine and a lot of other helpfull stuff in the apartment. The apartmen is in a good location, Victoria station is very close and there are lots of restaurants and a supermarket in short walking distance. The apartment is above a fish and chips restaurants, this means that we sometimes noticed the smell from the retaurant and in the bedrooms we heard the ventilation until the restaurant closed in the night (still we could sleep well). Since we arrived late our hosts even bought some food and drinks for our first breakfast for us. All in all we can highly recommend the apartment!
summary: Tamsin and George's apartment was highly recommended for its comfort, location, and helpful amenities, despite some minor issues.

comments: Flat was near St Pancras, but not that close to the underground. Few store and restaurant nearby. But Paul supplied sufficient food and drinks to us like biscuits, croissants, water etc. Wide space, easy to talk, clean bedroom and bathroom. Washstand was so small that I always wet my shoes when washing my face. Stairs were a bit noisy.
summary: Guests found the flat spacious and clean, but noted some drawbacks such as a small washstand and noisy stairs.

comments: The apartment was great with all amenities as listed.  We hadn't stayed in that area before and had no issue with noise at night - this could be because of the apartment we stayed in. The bed was very comfortable, the shower was hot and we had a brilliant stay. Communications were excellent, all information was clear and Alex replied to any questions or comments promptly. We would definitely stay there again
summary: The apartment was praised for its comfort, cleanliness, and excellent communication from Alex, with no issues at night.

comments:
Katyas place is just what it is told. Was good for family of four, walking distance to Big Ben or London Bridge. Tube station next to appartment and many busses go by (to Hyde Park, Westfield shopping center...) Still as peaceful as it can in a big city be.
We got quick answers to anything what we wnted to know.
Thank you Katya! And your collegue too.
summary: Katyas place is well-located for family of four with good transport links.

comments: Steve's place is a 5 minute walk to Camden Market, so there are plenty of things to do both during the daytime and at night. The flat is also a 5 minute walk to Chalk Farm tube stop, so it is extremely well connected. Steve was a very generous host--he responded to messages quickly and tried his best to accommodate our needs. If you are looking for a flat in a lively area with easy access to central London, Steve's flat would be ideal.
summary: Steve's flat is a lively area with easy access to central London and plenty of things to do.

comments:
Peter and his family were great hosts! They were very friendly and accommodating.
The room was on the small side but very cozy. There wasn’t enough space to lay out both our luggages, but the wardrobe had more than enough space for us to unpack our clothes into. It was a small room but we had everything we needed in there!
It was a nice residential neighbourhood so it was very peaceful and quiet at night. We found that the tube station was a little further than expected, but it wasn’t a problem as the bus stop across the road took us to most of the places we needed.
Would definitely stay here again!
summary: Peter's place is a cozy room in a peaceful residential neighborhood with friendly hosts.

comments:
The apartment was amazing. It was very clean and the host Mr. Syed has been of great help. He replies back to any issues within minutes and the service provided by him was amazing. This apartment is at the best location from central London with a bus stop at the doorstep which reaches in 5mins to the nearest underground. There is a local general store just opposite the apartment for any emergency groceries which has been very convenient for me. Overall the apartment has the best location, cleanliness, and the host. I would definitely recommend this apartment further.
Thank you.
summary: Mr. Syed's apartment has the best location, cleanliness, and service in central London.

comments: I booked this private room for my mother who was visiting London for a few weeks: the apartment is in a very convenient location in De Beauvoir Town, a stone's throw from Regents Canal, with a Tesco Express downstairs and a bus stop right outside the front door. The area is within easy access to good pubs, restaurants and cafes. The room and private bathroom were as described, everything was clean and neat. Daniel was amazing with communication, with fast responses and answers. I asked to extend the booking by a couple of days and he was able to accommodate it. Check-in and check-out was such a streamlined process, and Daniel's instructions were clear and easy to follow. My mother enjoyed her stay :)
summary: Daniel's private room is conveniently located for access to good pubs, restaurants, and cafes.

comments:
Had a great stay at Chaims nocarz.
Description and photos all accurate, extremely spacious! A perfect place for a group of friends for a couple of nights, at a great price too
Very close to the Stamford Hill overground station which was great to have
Would not hesitate to book this again in the future, thanks Chaim 👌🏼
summary: Had a great stay at Chaim's place, perfect for groups with plenty of space and close to public transport.

comments: The location was on a quiet road you have the luxury of a  short walk to the trendy part of town, Upper street has plenty of restaurants and bars to choose from. The accommodation is exactly what was advertised it is a lovely quirky place with the luxury of a jacuzzi. I would highly recommend.
summary: The location was quiet but close to trendy Upper Street with restaurants and bars, and the accommodation had a lovely jacuzzi.

comments: The place is locating in a very accessible  place to all tourist areas (within 1 hour). You have the option of traveling by train or bus+subway, so even if one of the transportation stops working (which happens during my stay), you will be able to find a way to travel to the city. The place is located in a safe neighborhood and I felt very cozy. This place definitely gives you a home-stay vibe. The hosts are vey communicative and enjoy having communication with you. Strongly recommend this place if you are visiting London.
summary: This place is located in a safe neighborhood, easily accessible by public transport, and has a home-stay vibe with communicative hosts.

comments: I stayed at Fethiye's for 3 days to show my parents around in London. They were very happy with the room and the amenities. We had a lovely balcony where we had afternoon tea. Fethiye was very helpful and my mum became friends with her. There is a nice walk along the canal to the Limehouse basin. I highly recommend this place!
summary: Fethiye's place was perfect for showing my parents around London, with a lovely room and amenities, and a nice walk along the canal.

comments: This house is absolutely stunning! My family stayed here while in London and everyone was blown away by how beautiful this space was. It was clean, spacious and absolutely gorgeous. Everything was comfortable and the house had plenty of room for everyone. It’s in a good area close to restaurants, shops and not a long walk from the tube. Fern was a delight and everyone loved staying here. Would highly recommend especially if you have a bigger group of people.
summary: This house is absolutely stunning, clean, spacious, and gorgeous, perfect for bigger groups with plenty of room to stay comfortably.

comments: Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour d’une semaine dans cet appartement.  Les instructions étaient claires pour l’entrée, l’utilisation des appareils et elle a rapidement répondu à une interrogation quant au wifi.  Nous considérons l’emplacement comme absolument idéal pour les visites; le quartier est charmant.  Nous avons beaucoup utilisé le métro (Westbound Park) et quelques fois l’autobus (stations à quelques pas).  L’appartement, bien qu’il s’agisse d’un rez-de-jardin, est quand même lumineux. Je crois que l’annonce devrait néanmoins préciser cette information.  Nous n’avons rien à redire sur la propreté des lieux.  De nouveau, nos remerciements sincères à l’hôte Natacha.
summary: Guest had a pleasant week-long stay in the apartment, praising its location, cleanliness, and host's responsiveness.

comments: Everything with our stay at this listing was fine. The room, house and location were all as described and pictured. Roland is very friendly and nice and the rest of the people in the house were nice also, it was a relexed atmosphere. Our room was clean, comfortable and warm. It is a 15min walk to Surrey Quays station but there is a bus stop closer to the house if you dont feel like the walk. Overall good stay and would recommend.
summary: Guest had a good stay at the listing, finding it as described, with friendly hosts and a relaxed atmosphere.

comments:
Das war unsere erste nocarz-Buchung und es hat alles super geklappt. Der Vermieter hat uns alle nötigen Infos gegeben und stand, wenn wir ihn gebraucht hätten, zur Verfügung. Das war top!
Das Apartment ist schön - genau wie auf den Fotos. Die Betten sind bequem und die Küche hat alles, was man braucht.
Die Lage ist etwas außerhalb. Aber mit Bus und Bahn super zu erreichen (vom Flughafen ist man in ca. 45 min da und in die City kommt man in 15-20 min). Bushaltestelle ist direkt in der Nähe und in nur 4 Stops erreicht man die Bahn.
Apartment liegt an einer gut befahrenen Straße. Zum Schlafen aber kein Thema, da die Schlafzimmer nach hinten raus gehen.
Einkaufsmöglichkeiten (Supermarkt, Kiosk) sind in der Nähe und zu Fuß erreichbar. Zum abendlichen Spaziergang mit Bars und Pubs ist es jedoch nicht geeignet.
Alles in allem haben wir uns wohl gefühlt und können das Apartment für einen London-Trip empfehlen.
summary: Guests were satisfied with their first nocarz booking, praising the owner's helpfulness, apartment's comfort, and location's accessibility.

comments: Very good location. Walkable in 10 minutes to Camden Town and tube. Very easy check in. The windows are very old and don’t open well and none of the curtains/voil in the bedrooms block out the light. More decorative than functional. We ended up putting blankets over them to make it dark.  Equipped with plates, cutlery, hairdryer and iron etc which was useful. Nice quiet neighbourhood. The mattresses are really uncomfortable and spring-y so could do with replacing and the bathroom sink was blocked which we mentioned but remained blocked for your stay. Overall fine for us we had a good time. Loir was responsive and nice to deal with
summary: Guest had a good time at the listing, appreciating its location, but noting some issues with old windows, uncomfortable mattresses, and a blocked bathroom sink.

comments:
Great location! Staying on the high street was amazing! So many restaurants, cafes, shopping right there! We loved the area! Communication was fabulous and very helpful. We were a family of 4 (19 and 16 year old kids) and the second bedroom was not big enough for both of them
But there were extra linens and my son slept on the couch. Overall, great stay! Thank you so much!
summary: Guests loved the apartment's great location on the high street, praising the area's amenities, communication, and helpfulness of the host.

comments: This was a great stay--the room was very comfortable, use of the fridge was nice, and Ramona and Aris (her little dog) were great hosts--Aris enjoys lots of people company. =) The location was super convenient, very close to Archway Station, grocery stores, restaurants, everything (as well as the workshop I was attending). I'd definitely recommend this place--thanks, Ramona!
summary: Great stay at Ramona's place with comfortable room, convenient location, and friendly hosts.

comments:
Mike was a great host. Always quick to respond to messages and his instructions were super clear. The space was perfect for us and had all the amenities we needed for a 10 day stay. Mike was so wonderful at making sure that the accommodation was comfortable for us. We had a slight issue in the kitchen upon check in and Mike coordinated for it to be taken care of straight away and without any disruption to our trip. Super grateful to know that if something wasn’t quite right, he made sure it was going to be fixed in a flash. We are very familiar with the area, but Mike’s place is perfectly situated in Hampstead. Easy walk to the tube, restaurants, shops, the Heath - everything you need within a minute or two walking distance.
Thank you Mike and see you next time!
summary: Mike was a great host who provided clear instructions, quick responses, and a perfectly situated accommodation.

comments:
Davey's flat was beautiful and comfortable- just like in the pictures, except a wee bit cold and that could be because it is winter time.
Davey was an excellent host, always texting, asking to see if we were getting on alright. He left some essential food supplies which really came in handy!
Location is perfect, as very close to the DLR station and also a nice walk into the town of Greenwich.
I would stay here again the next time i go to London. Greenwich is a beautiful area and would love to come back when its warmer!
Thank you Davey for being an excellent host.
summary: Davey's flat was beautiful and comfortable, with excellent hosting and a perfect location near the DLR station.

comments:
Debbie & Sean’s home was an absolute pleasure to stay at.
Everything was effortless and smooth; quick response via message when needed, check in and check out was a breeze. Treat their home with respect and care like yours and it’ll feel like you’re right at home. Gorgeous art work and design everywhere. Comfortable and spacious double room, pristine and elegant. Warm and welcoming host with great conversations was just the cherry on top!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and we look forward to returning.
summary: Debbie & Sean's home was an absolute pleasure to stay at, with effortless check-in/check-out, great conversations, and welcoming hosts.

comments: I had a wonderful stay at Momen's place. The check in process was easy and access was private. The neighourhood was safe to walk in with easy access to public or private transport. Momen was super helpful with recommending places to go and things to do and was super responsive whenever I reached out. I will definitely be coming back. Thank you Momen!! You are an awesome host!
summary: Momen's place had a wonderful stay with easy access, safe neighborhood, and super helpful recommendations from the host.

comments:
lovely place to stay, very responsive host, allowed us to check in early which was great, tube station is a short walk away which is ideal, there are also 2 shops next to the station that stay open late for general bits and pieces
no issues with the stay unsure if its mentioned but they provide, towels, an iron, hairdryer, pots and pans for cooking, kettle, so everything you need, smart tv and wifi worked great too, shower has good pressure, bed is soft but more than comfortable enough
towel rail runs off the central heating so be wary as this can run very hot!
cant fault the place to stay, definitely recommend it,
thank you
summary: Lovely place to stay with responsive host, convenient location, and all amenities provided.

comments:
We stayed in London for 4 nights, and this was extremely convenient to three different Underground stations. There is a lift up to the flat, and it is easy to get inside.
The bathrooms, furniture, and floors were all very clean. The towels were super clean and comfortable and smelled nice. The rooms are really spacious for London, and there is plenty of seating in the living/dining area. The washing machine works great and is easy to use.
The building itself (neighbors) is very quiet inside, and the normal London street noise isn’t bad since the building is set back from busy roads. When the windows are closed it’s fine for sleeping.
Nada was always quick to respond and she immediately solved the few issues we had. She is one of the most responsive hosts we’ve had in our stays.
If you are looking for a convenient and affordable place for 5 - 6 people, this is a great option.
summary: Convenient and affordable flat for 5-6 people with clean facilities, quiet building, and responsive host.

comments:
Hôtes très charmants et disponibles pour glaner des informations et discuter de tout.
Ils nous ont même improvisé un soir un petit diner sympa à 4 alors que rien ne les y obligeait, si ce n'est le soucis de faire plaisir.
Nous recommandons vivement leur accueil.
Localisation de leur appartement pratique en plein centre de Clapham South juste à côté de la station de métro, même si le prix à payer pour cette commodité est un environnement forcément un peu bruyant.
summary: Charming and available hosts who went above and beyond to make guests feel welcome in a central location.

comments: Faye konnte mich nicht persönlich in Empfang nehmen, aber sie versorgte mich unmittelbar mit allen notwendigen Informationen, wie ich selbst ins Haus gelangen konnte. Die Kommunikation verlief zu jedem Zeitpunkt reibungslos. Das Haus ist modern und hell eingerichtet, Küche, Bad und Schlafzimmer sind gut ausgestattet. Die Unterkunft is geräumig und ruhig; die Umgebung lohnt es erkundet zu werden. Kann ich auf alle Fälle empfehlen.
summary: Modern and well-equipped flat with easy communication from host, located in quiet area worth exploring.

comments: My first Air BnB experience, and what an experience it was! A truly beautiful and luxurious home from home. Gemma is a great and flexible host, she accommodated not only me but also my daughter who came to visit, and my bicycle. Not only that.. Gemma received on my behalf packages I forwarded to her address. What else can one expect? Walking distance from the tube and a shop, a pub and a bus stop on the doorstep. Thank You Gemma for sharing your home with us!
summary: Luxurious home away from home with flexible and accommodating host, perfect for first-time Air BnB users.

comments:
I didn't actually sleep there the Sunday because the area was having what seemed like a street party with fireworks. However this isn't the hosts fault. She was really nice and the actual apartment itself looked nice. The area was the problem for me, im not used to being started on 3 times for simply looking a certain way.
However if you're not phased by that, her apartment is lovely, as is she :)
summary: The host was nice, but the area had a street party with fireworks that made it difficult for the guest to sleep.

comments: The location is good for travellers visiting London. Overground station is 5 mins walk and 1 stop to Victoria station. Although visitors have to pay 2.50 pounds for 1 stop, there is a cap of 7 pounds a day so it is not too expensive to get around London by train. There is a Tesco nearby for groceries shopping. One thing to note, if visitors are coming with heavy luggages, both nearby train stations do not have elevator so I would suggest taking bus 44 if you are coming from Victoria station. There is an elevator in the apartment building so that is fine. Overall, I would say that the apartment is good for a short term stay in London. We stayed 5 days and 4 nights in this apartment and basic necessities were provided. Please also follow the host instructions closely when checking in.
summary: The apartment is in a good location for travelers visiting London and has basic necessities provided.

comments: Amanda was very patient with my late arrival (flight delays). Her place is super quiet; I heard neighbors just lightly close doors. It’s also an uber creative space—colorful and detailed. Two little foxes came each night outside the bedroom window—sweet creatures that sat side by side. I looked forward to catching a glimpse of them each evening.
