Location is convenient—nearby grocery and Underground stop is very easy once you know your way to the apartment.
summary: The host was patient and accommodating, and the apartment was quiet and creatively decorated.

comments:
No podemos estar más contentos de nuestra primera experiencia en nocarz. Irma fue una anfitriona fantástica. Nos recibió con gran hospitalidad y nos facilitó todo tipo de información. Nos sentimos como en casa. En lo referente al barrio, éste está a una hora del centro en bus y sus casitas adosadas son encantadoras.
La casa de Irma está cerca de un supermercado, de distintos pubs ingleses para tomar una pinta e incluso comer o cenar, de un estanco para recargar la tarjeta del transporte y comprar sellos, un buzón delante de este establecimiento y variedad de sitios para degustar comida in situ o en takeaway.
Y para los amantes de los animales, Sarita es la perrita de Irma. Una dulzura peluda y juguetona.
Recomendamos la casa de Irma si vais a visitar la ciudad de Londres. Quedaréis muy satisfechos.
summary: The host was fantastic and made the guests feel at home in a convenient location near shops and pubs.

comments:
We had a great time in London and this place was a fantastic location to base ourselves. We went to Harry Potter Studios via Euston, France via King's Cross Eurostar, Camden Town by bus, K-Town New Malden, and it was made so easy by the location of the stay.
The house has everything available including kitchen, washing machine and dryer. The house has a really strong feline smell, so it might be a deal breaker for you if you don't like strong animal smells, and the adorable cats like to go everywhere.
Unfortunately, we were so busy for our honeymoon, so we didn't get an opportunity to talk to Caroline much, but she was very accommodating and kind! Thank you very much for hosting us!
summary: The apartment had a great location for exploring London and had everything needed, but there was a strong feline smell.

comments:
I enjoyed my stay with Radhika and Lorenzo. They were very welcoming when I arrived. Lorenzo is a laid-back and creative interesting person. We had great conversations about music, travel, manga, etc. Radhika is very friendly and helpful. When I had a trouble with my Oyster card, she helped me call customer service to clarify the question. The room with a comfortable double bed was very clean. And the bathroom was new and functionable. The location is very convinient to the tube (District line, Hammersmith & City line) and Overground.
I would definitely recommend staying with Radhika and Lorenzo!
summary: Guest had a great stay with Radhika and Lorenzo, who were welcoming and helpful hosts.

comments:
Wonderful stay from start to finish! The apartment is beautifully decorated, very spacious and airy. We spent several night in and it was so so lovely. Super close to the park (London Fields) which was ideal for us with young kids.
Kim and Ben were amazing hosts - very professional, friendly and kind. Quick responses leading up to the booking, and positive interactions.
I would recommend this place to anyone - the pictures don’t do it full justice, and the location is perfect if you are looking to stay in this area of town - lots of cafes, restaurants and bars/pubs within easy walking distance while the house itself is very calm and peaceful.
summary: Guest had a wonderful stay in Kim and Ben's beautifully decorated and spacious apartment.

comments:
This apartment is fantastic. The location is excellent, literally around the corner from a tube station. The apartment itself is furnished beautifully and is fabulously clean. The beds were very comfortable, kitchen had everything you could want. Pauline, our host is so friendly and welcoming- she even provided some welcome snacks and fresh milk!
Highly recommended. Will happily return here next visit to the city.
summary: Guest loved Pauline's apartment, which was clean, comfortable, and perfectly located near a tube station.

comments: Convenience and comfort in a nutshell! Perfect for a short stay if you need to work in London - could not be closer to Borough station. Beds lovely, everything you need in a kitchen, washing machine is a little fiddly, but so convenient - only thing to be warned, the stairs up and down will challenge your fitness!
summary: Guest found the apartment convenient for work trips due to its proximity to Borough station, but noted some minor drawbacks.

comments: This is a fantastic apartment (small like most in London) but very clean and in a good location. Boris was helpful and friendly when we arrived. I would stay at this apartment again. The local area has a few good restaurants and a bit of shopping, but the location to the underground made it super easy to get anywhere.
summary: Guest had a good stay in Boris's clean and well-located apartment, which was suitable for their needs.

comments: Neil was a helpful, efficient and friendly host and his place is definitely a home from home. Well-equipped and beautifully appointed it was a perfect place for our stay in NW London. The apartment is on 3 levels and felt more like a house. We had great weather and enjoyed our meals on the roof-terrace. Great location near a lovely park with excellent transport links. We look forward to staying again. Thanks very much!
summary: The host Neil was helpful and friendly, and his apartment was well-equipped and beautifully appointed.

comments: Das Zimmer war sehr schön. Ich hatte anfangs Probleme beim Schlüsselkasten, doch dabei wurde mir von mehreren Menschen geholfen. Durch Overground und Bus bin ich gut in die City of London gekommen. Ich fand es sehr schön nach einem trubeligen Touri-Tag ins ruhige Hackney zu kommen und dort durch die Hackney Marshes (nur ca 15 Minuten vom nocarz entfernt) zu spazieren. Tesco und M&S sind ebenfalls zu Fuß zu erreichen und die Fußgängerzone bot viele Cafés. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt.
summary: The room was beautiful, and the location in Hackney was quiet and convenient with good transport links.

comments:
It is a nice area in Fulham and the apartment is closed to supermarket, bus stop and tube. Emma is a very good host and our flight arrived London early in the morning and she lets us check in earlier. Everything works fine.
I will definitely stay in this place if I visit London next time.
summary: The apartment is located in a nice area of Fulham, close to amenities, and Emma was a very good host.

comments: This was a great place to stay.  The apartment is comfortable.  If you, like we, are there during hot weather, you'll love the windows you can open in all directions.  All the systems like kitchen, laundry, and bathroom work well.  The location is ideal if you want a quiet retreat a short tube ride from all the main London attractions.  Hampstead itself provides a lot to do.  Fenton House, 2 Willow Road, the Camden Arts Center, and Kenwood House are all reasonable walking destinations.  the high street has useful shopping.  The side streets have cozy pubs - special recommendation for the Holly Bush.  Sam and his friends were easy to work with before and during our stay.
summary: This comfortable apartment in Hampstead was an ideal quiet retreat with easy access to London attractions.

comments:
The place is located at a very convenient site (and right by Arsenal stadium!) The description matches the expectation and worth what you get for the price. We had a limited stay just to sleep the night and so would recommend if the stay is to just have a place to crash. Nothing more!
Hearty thanks to the hosts :)
summary: The place is conveniently located near Arsenal stadium and matches the description for its price.

comments:
Kimberly was a very nice host, the communication with her was good before and during the stay. The flat was very comfy, and the location also was very convenient, quite near to the city centre in a nice neighbourhood. As a negative aspect, the house wasn't all clean as it could be.
Overall, the stay was good and the flat is recommendable, and the value for money very good also.
summary: Good stay with a comfy flat in a convenient location, but not perfectly clean.

comments: Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt bei Ruth von der ersten bis zur letzten Sekunde genossen. Sie war äußerst flexibel und sehr verständnisvoll, als unser Check-in sich wegen ein paar Schwierigkeiten bei der Anreise deutlich nach hinten verschoben hatte und empfing uns sehr herzlich, obwohl es schon spät in der Nacht war. Ruths Wohnung ist sehr liebevoll, kreativ und stimmig gestaltet und sehr sauber. Das Zimmer selbst ist nicht sehr groß, aber groß genug und sehr gemütlich; auch das große Fenster war toll, um bei der Hitze gut lüften zu können. Wir haben ein paar praktische Tipps zur Nutzung des Bussystems und Restauranttipps bekommen und den Aufenthalt in Hackney und London generell für uns perfekt gestalten können. Danke für die super Erfahrung! Wir würden uns freuen, beim nächsten Aufenthalt in London wieder bei Ruth buchen zu können.
summary: Excellent host and accommodation, very flexible and welcoming, highly recommendable.

comments:
We stayed over New Year’s in Kew Gardens, not easy to find a space in London with 3 bed rooms! This felt like home immediately and had a well equipped kitchen and bathroom, living room and 3 decent bed rooms with good beds, exactly what we were looking for! It was also very clean and well maintained
It was a short stroll to the tube and in 35-45 minutes in de city centre, very easy! The area itself is residential but there are some nice restaurants, bakery, organic store and minimarts
Would definitely recommend for family stays!
summary: Well-equipped and clean home with 3 bedrooms, perfect for family stays near Kew Gardens.

comments: Das Haus liegt in einer typischen englischen Siedlung zwischen Brockley und Nunhead. Es ist mit Liebe eingerichtet und sehr gepflegt. Die Kommunikation mit der Vermieterin funktioniert gut, in unserem Fall via Whatsapp. Für wen es kein Problem darstellt, in London nicht unmittelbar im Zentrum zu wohnen, findet hier genug Raum für die ganze Familie. Einziger, kleiner Nachteil: die Kästen sind mit privaten Sachen der Vermieter gefüllt und somit nicht nutzbar.
summary: Lovely and well-maintained house in a residential area, but some rooms are not usable due to owner's belongings.

comments: For 2 people traveling as friends, the place is quite tight and definitely feels small. The photos enhance the look of the size, so I would only recommend this for a solo traveler. Along those lines, no Wi-Fi was extremely difficult for people from different countries and there was no hand soap provided. Overall very clean, good location but complicated to find once you reach the building so clearer instructions for the unit would’ve been helpful. For the right person it would be great.
summary: Small accommodation suitable only for solo travelers or those without Wi-Fi needs, with some minor issues.

comments:
ms.Cherry is really nice host.I spent very good time with her house.It's very clean,warm and Cherry was very kind.I feels like a home.
she help me a lots of things until I stay in London.
I'm very glad to stay at her house.
I'd like to stay her house when I visit in London again :)
summary: Guest had a great time staying at Cherry's house, feeling like home and receiving helpful assistance.

comments:
SUPER CONSIGLIATA! Ho alloggiato con amici nell'appartamento di Jennie per le feste di Capodanno 2017. Lei si trovata all'estero per le vacanze e quindi non l'abbiamo incontrata, ma è stata super carina e disponibile via messaggio per spiegarci tutto sulla vita londinese e le regole di chek in/out. Quando siamo entrati nell'alloggio abbiamo trovato il contratto nocarz sul tavolo con una bottiglia di prosecco (Love u Jennie :) ). La casa è arredata molto bene, dotata di ogni comfort e Jennie mette a disposizione un super televisore, un impianto stereo con centinaia di CD e molto altro!
La posizione è ottimale, a 50 metri dalla metro (Linea Picadilly) che porta in centro in meno di 10 minuti.
Quando tornerò a Londra spero di poter alloggiare di nuovo a casa di Jennie :)
summary: Guest highly recommends Jennie's apartment, praising its cleanliness, comfort, and excellent location.

comments:
Room was really nice and very clean. llona was the perfect host she was really flexible and helpful giving us plenty of recommendations as to where to eat and the best routes to get around. It's a really good location close to Finsbury Park and transport links.
Would recommend 100% and will stay here again next year :)
summary: Guest had a wonderful stay at Ilona's place, appreciating the room's cleanliness, flexibility, and helpful recommendations.

comments:
Our stay at Bronwyns house was a success. The room is nice and quiet and it's great to have breakfast in the garden behind the house. Everything is clean, the bed is comfortable and we could use the kitchen when ever we wanted.
Bronwyn is a very uncomplicated and nice person.
summary: Guest enjoyed their stay at Bronwyn's house, praising its quiet room, garden breakfast option, and friendly host.

comments:
Inna was a lovely and welcoming host! Inna always responded super quickly which is always so reassuring - Inna was kind enough to allow us to check in early so we didn't have to lug our belongings with us. the room itself is lovely and spotless - dining table, mini fridge and kettle all supplied for you. there was wardrobe space which was also a bonus!
not that it was an issue for us at all! but there was a dog at the property which barked initially but did eventually settle and didn't hear them again after this really and we didn't see the dog once - just thought it might be good to mention for future guests.
it is near the 83 bus which takes you to wembley stadium, less than 3 minutes walk away. so easy to find thanks to Google! would definitely come back if I go to another event, thank you so much again! 😄
summary: Guest had a great experience with Inna as a host, appreciating her quick responses, welcoming nature, and convenient location.

comments:
We found Natasha to be an excellent host. She offered very good advice about places to eat, things to see, travelling around etc. The apartment is excellent in every way. We were a group of 4 and we would highly recommend this apartment.
If we were visiting London again, we would love to go back here.
Kilburn tube station is minutes away and provides a direct link to the city centre. Also very accessible from Luton Airport on Thameslink train.
summary: Excellent host and apartment, highly recommended.

comments: Great nocarz in the heart of Angel!   Celine is a very responsive and welcoming host.  Directions and instructions were all clear and concise.  The flat is so bright and cheery!  Very clean with a spacious bedroom and bathroom.  Living area is a bit on the small side with a small sofa and eating area, but very welcoming.   Bed is small for 2 adults, but comfortable.  We arrived and there were no towels, however Celine responded immediately and delivered towels within 2 hours for us.  It was hot during our stay but a great cross breeze can be achieved in the flat, as well as a portable fan.  Would highly recommend this area and flat for visitors to London.
summary: Welcoming host and clean flat with some minor issues.

comments: This neighbourhood is quiet and safe with very easy access to the city. The bedroom was very cosy and the bathroom was spotless. Arianna cooked  a delicious breakfast for me every morning and was a wonderful host overall.. I would happily recommend her to anyone looking to stay in the area!!
summary: Quiet and safe neighborhood with a wonderful host.

comments:
Kommunikation: hervorragend / phantastisch.
Lage: sehr zentral/gut gelegen, wenn auch die Gegend selber nicht unbedingt schön ist, eher ein bisschen heruntergekommen wirkt.
Check-in: verlief absolut problemlos, obwohl wir erst ganz spät einchecken konnten.
Die Sauberkeit entsprach leider nicht ganz unseren Vorstellungen / Ansprüchen:
grundsätzlich staubig, insbesondere auch in den Schränken, Geschirr teilweise dreckig, insbesondere auch Pfannen, Fenster sahen aus, also ob sie noch nie gereinigt waren, die Rollos bei den Fenstern waren klebrig unappetitlich, usw.
Hinzu kam, dass es im Lift immer wieder fürchterlich stinkte.
summary: Central location but cleanliness was a major issue.

comments:
As I had to be in London for 6 weeks, for both work and vacation, Nick’s 1 BR apartment at Clapham Junction was cosy and comfortable, making my 42 days stay a home away from home.
The location is well connected to the City as well as central London by bus, tube and rail. The view from the apartment especially for sunset are just amazing especially after a long day at work.
Good selection of restaurants, cafes and pubs all around the area within 10-15mins walk, depending on which direction one takes. Location, accessibility and amenities are all 5 out of 5.
However, its most unfortunate that during the last two weeks of my stay, the lift leading to the apartment on level 5 broke down. After more than two weeks, the lift was still not repaired which made the climb to the apartment a real chore. Nick was not only apologetic but was kind enough to provide help with my luggages on the day of my checkout.
As the saying goes, there is no perfect apartment, because if there is one, please don’t go, cos we will spoil it! Like a home, things do get spoiled… and I just hope it gets repaired soon.
I know I will definitely be back at the apartment should I head back to London for work or play. Thanks again Nick!
summary: Cosy and comfortable apartment with great location, but lift broke down during stay.

comments: This apartment was very clean and the neighborhood had good restaurants (the Lebanese was our favorite) and handy markets.  It was a little further from the Tube stations than I would have liked.  We were often going into the center and might book closer next time.  It was quiet and comfortable and we appreciated having a lift when moving our luggage from the third floor.
summary: Clean apartment with good restaurants and markets nearby, but a bit far from the Tube stations.

comments: Great place for a stay in Central London, just steps away from St Paul's. The kitchen is fully equipped for a short stay, the shower is great, and the whole studio was spotlessly clean. Hotel quality bed, pillows and sheets made it a joy to sleep. The hosts were very responsive and accommodating to our needs.
summary: Great studio in Central London with fully equipped kitchen, spotlessly clean, and comfortable bed.

comments:
The thing that amazed us most about this place was how quiet and close to nature it was, in spite of being so central and in a very lively part of London.
Our room was spacious and full of light as described, but the description didnt mention that the large window of the room as well as a door from the kitchen opens onto a tiny courtyard with blackberries that were being picked by wild birds, pigeons or a cute grey squirrel. We left the window blinds open, because it was so delightful to watch the animals, and no street or window is overlooking that courtyard.
Rather than taking the tube, we took a ride on the doubledecker bus from the centre of town, driving past Regents Park and its great mosque and other amazing sights to someone coming from another country (Hamburg, Germany in our case). The front door is in quite a busy street with great pubs, stores and restaurants from delicous ans atmospheric persian cuisine to genuine fish and chips.
When you enter, you pass through the house that faces the street, cross a lovely courtyard where Amit and his guests spend warm evenings among potted plants. Then you enter his house, which is tiny and very old - one of the oldest of the district we were told - but renovated to the highest standard on the inside. One little detail - in the glistening white kitchen, instead of a kettle there is a "quooker", which is a function of the tap on the kitchen sink that gives you instant boiling water for your tea or coffee! You are also free to use the gas cooker, a small and large oven with all functions you could wish for, a whole shelf in a clean fridge and free access to spices and condiments you might not want to buy or bring for a short stay. There are two dishwashers as well, which can be handy.
We were sharing the flat with Amit and Trish, who are quiet, considerate and friendly flatmates, making you feel totally at home but also very much at ease and free to move as you wish. Sharing the bathroom with a wonderful walk- in shower was not a problem, since there is a second toilet and Trish let very early to go to work, whereas Amit seemed to only appear when you needed him.
Also not mentioned was the pure spiritual atmosphere that is very important to Amit, the wonderful host, who took a genuine and wholehearted interest in our experiences and feelings at the meditation retreat we went to. He will also advise you on any aspects of your holiday you need help with.
So we were totally happy and will definitely stay here again if we return to this part of London.
summary: Quiet and central location with spacious room, lovely courtyard, and friendly hosts.

comments: The room itself is clean and has everything you need. The host is really kind and gives you a warm welcome. It's easy to get to London Central from this address. There are a lot of busses near the place, so you won't be wainting too long to get there or anywhere else in London
summary: Clean room with everything you need, kind host, and easy access to London Central.

comments:
Highly recommended! Communication was excellent, from both Igor and his assistant. The flat is as per the pictures, it's a lovely place to stay and the location is excellent too, with Tesco and Sainsbury's just around the corner. It would be perfect for 2 people for a short stay, or for one person on a long-term basis.
All in all I'd stay at Igor's place again! Thanks for having me :)
summary: Excellent communication, lovely flat in great location, perfect for short or long-term stay.

comments: Moran’s apartment is lovely. It had everything we needed for our 10 night stay in London. The location was so peaceful and only a short walk from Maidavale tube station. And the cherry on the top was just how accommodating Moran was with regard to checking in and out. Would definitely recommend staying here.
summary: Lovely apartment with a peaceful location and accommodating host.

comments: We had a great weekend at David’s place, we spent 1 night there and would highly recommend. David got in touch really quickly with arrival and check in details which helped us plan our trip and he kindly let us check in a bit early too and leave our bags so we could head off and explore London. Brillant room, fabulous views of central London and the Shard, great location, lovely breakfast and absolutely spotless bathroom - superb value! Thank you David.
summary: Great weekend stay with brilliant room, fabulous views, and spotless bathroom.

comments: This place is so close to tourist spots like Big Ben and London Eye. Train station is nearby as well. The neighborhood is pretty nice and the host is amazing. My sister and I enjoyed and visit to London and we liked the breakfast. The host is very friendly and helpful. I highly recommend this place.
summary: Excellent location near tourist spots, friendly and helpful host, and nice breakfast.

comments:
I had a very nice stay at this accommodation. The few disadvantages are that there is no form of air-conditioning (as noted on the listing) but a fan would have helped a lot. The other is that you can hear whenever anyone enters the building, and between that and the noise from the street it can be a bit much
All interaction with Daniel was great, super helpful host and was easily reachable.
summary: Nice stay but some drawbacks like no air-conditioning and noise from the street.

comments: Appartement calme et idéalement situé (juste en face de portobello road !), quartier convivial et branché. L'appartement est propre avec ce qu'il faut, l'accès et l'entrée dans les lieux est hyper simple, et Roddy est un hôte charmant, toujours à l'écoute et prêt à rendre service. Je reviendrais avec grand plaisir, pour plusieurs jours cette fois-ci !!
summary: Quiet and ideally located apartment with a charming host.

comments: Amazing stay at Lucy’s! The location is perfect and central and easy walk to the stations. Had the best time exploring the city and staying here. Lucy was in constant communication with us and even let us check in early. Can’t say enough good things about our stay in London, and looking forward to coming back!
summary: Guest had an amazing stay at Lucy's, praising the location and host's communication.

comments:
We had a great time in London – the unit's location in Kilburn is very conveniently located to the Kilburn Park tube station, and also very useful buses. The area also has a Tesco conveniently located around the corner, which was great. Michael was very communicative and responsive to messages.
The unit itself was very basic, but comfortable. Definitely make sure to bring things like soap, shampoo, conditioner, detergent, etc. The place also may need a bit of a clean, as there were some ants when we stayed there. The laundry machine was also not working when we stayed, but it seems like that was an anomaly.
Thanks for hosting us!
summary: Guest had a great time in London but noted some issues with cleanliness and amenities.

comments:
Max and Billie were super responsive to messages and went out of their way to help us check on.
However the apartment was a bit worn, had dusty blinds and a bit of a creaky bed. Not so much of a problem though since we were not there that often.
Great location, near Notting Hill Gate (Central, Circle and District lines) so perfect for sightseeing.
summary: Guest appreciated Max and Billie's responsiveness but found the apartment to be worn and basic.

comments: Well-located, no frills accommodation. Room 6 is up lots of stairs so not accessible. The door lets a lot of light through and the hallway light is always on. The room could get quite cold and there’s not much space to move in, but it’s fine for a cheap bed to sleep in.
summary: Guest described the accommodation as no-frills and noted accessibility issues with Room 6.

comments: Kasim is a great host! Very friendly, responsive and always happy to provide useful advice. The place is right in the middle of Wandsworth, close to the river, local parks, shopping centre and many great pubs and restaurants. Wandsworth town train station and East Putney tube station are both a short walk away ensuring great connections with the central and other parts of London. The flat is basic but clean and tidy, and has all you need for your stay. Free parking spot is a bonus. I would definitely recommend to stay with Kasim.
summary: Guest praised Kasim as a great host and recommended his place for its location and amenities.

comments:
The accommodation is placed in a 7-10 min walk to the metro station Wimbledon. Many restaurants and shops are around. The district is calm and safe.
The room is clean, comfortable, and cozy and has many lights and 3 mirrors (ladies will be wondering about them) 😉 A bed is big and so comfy to have a good sleep after a long walking day. You do not need to get up to close/open the curtains, just use a small remote 😉 TV, hair dryer, kettle, coffee/tea, and even small fridge also are in the room. The bathroom is new, and clean and has all you need: cosmetics and even bath salt.
Sue and Andy are very friendly and relaxed people. They help with all the information or sth else you need. Feel free to book this accommodation, you will be satisfied with your choice!
summary: Accommodation is clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with friendly hosts.

comments: Good option in a quiet spot, comfy bed. Sabina was nice and always responsive. Kitchen is well stocked. House is a bit cluttered, fairly clean. Curious cats wander. The adjacent walls are a bit thin so you can hear other guests voices. Reasonable value but a bit expensive for what it is.
summary: Good option in a quiet spot with comfy bed, but some drawbacks like thin walls and cluttered house.

comments:
This stay was clean and a nice stay and prices well for a quick stay over. However I booked this stay on the basis that they could provide us a travel cot on request which I had requested on my initial message although I got no response and brought our own just incase. In the photos on this listing, it provided plenty of space for a travel cot but when we arrived our room had a double bed and a single bed, which may be fine for families with a school age child however I have a 1 year old, so not so convenient. This left us with no option but to put our own travel cot up in the doorway which would’ve posed us an issue should we have needed to evacuate quickly.
I can’t fault the room as it was a good stay but important info for any other families with younger children wanting to use a travel cot or wanting to request a travel cot.
summary: Clean room, but travel cot not provided as requested, which was inconvenient for family with young child.

comments: The flat was perfect for the holiday week with my adult children - plenty of space to gather as well as private places for each of us. Loved the modernist detailing and great light fixtures!  The neighborhood was quiet and very convenient to my son's flat, lovely local park and shops. The hosts were so thoughtful...thank you for the treats, wine and use of your architecture reference book!!  Only wish we had young children with us to make the most of this very child friendly flat.
summary: Flat is perfect for families or groups, spacious, modern, and convenient to local amenities.

comments: Alles war super, bis auf die Lautstärke vom Pub unten. Man hat bis in die Nacht extrem laut das pub gehört und die Leute. Wir waren über das wochende, also war es wahrscheinlich deswegen. Und hat es nicht gestört, aber für Leute die früher schlafen gehen und vll geräusch empfindlich sind ist es nichts :) Lage war top Loved it
summary: Loved the location, but pub noise below was a disturbance, especially on weekends.

comments: Robin was the most responsive nocarz host I've ever met... and that includes me! He's a very kind and helpful guy and the space was as advertised. From a price to value perspective I can't believe you could get a better deal. It was just me, but it could comfortably fit more guests. Highly recommend!
summary: Robin is a kind and helpful host who provided an excellent value for the price.

comments: I had a great time at Lorren and Rob's house. I'd absolutely recommend this place. They were amazing hosts, very predisposed to help me during my first time in London and I felt very comfortable there and would defnitely love to go back! They even prepered supper for my farewell!. Thank you Lorren and Rob!
summary: Lorren and Rob were amazing hosts who made their guests feel comfortable and welcome.

comments: This is how nocarz is supposed to be. Sharring your home with total strangers while you are abroad. The flat is cosy and clean. The view from the 7th Floor on the city and Westminster is fantastic and the heart of London is just a short wallk away. Everything else is reachable via public transport even at night. You can contact the owner any time. Thanks to Ksenia, we had a really good time!
summary: Ksenia's flat was cozy, clean, and had a great view of London with easy access to public transport.

comments:
Sarah provides everything as described and answered to all our questions very fast. The flat is really good located just around the corner of Bethnal Green station, but also not too loud at night. Check-in and Check-out was very easy with the key box outside the house.
We really loved the decoration of the apartment and everything was clean. The kitchen also provides everything you need.
We had a lovely stay, were kind of sad to leave the flat and will definetely look out for Sarah's flat for our next stay in London.
summary: Sarah's flat was well-located, clean, and had everything needed for a comfortable stay.

comments: Simon was an amazing host! Super friendly guy and was helpful throughout our entire stay. Offered recommendations based on what we were looking for! The place was conveniently near a train station and a Tesco. If you’re looking to save money it was very convenient to buy groceries and use the kitchen. We miss his cats Rufus and Bella!!!
summary: Simon was an amazing host who provided helpful recommendations and made his guests feel at home.

comments: We had a great, comfortable stay! We arrived early and she reached out and ensured the place would be ready for us. Most comfortable bed and stay we had our entire trip. Shower was amazing, kitchen was adorable and compact, had everything we needed for our one-night layover before heading back home to the states. Right in the middle of everything, super walkable, and near the Convent Garden station. Would love to stay here again!
summary: Great stay with a comfortable bed and excellent location near Covent Garden station.

comments: Incredibly responsive host, both before and during the stay - have never had such quick turnaround both on responsiveness to messages and also addressing a couple of physical issues in real-time on a Saturday! The place was spotless and obviously well taken care of, and we very much appreciated the fans as we happened to come during warm weather. Would love to stay again at a place maintained by this team.
summary: Incredibly responsive host with a spotless and well-maintained place.

comments: We really enjoyed our stay at Jo’s flat.  The layout was great and it was beautifully presented.  Lovely balcony and a supermarket very close downstairs was really handy.  Great local hotels to enjoy a lovely meal.  Excellent location and transport to city very close by. We stayed at another nocarz as Jo’s wasn’t available for the full period but we would definitely try to get Jo’s as our first choice when we return London.
summary: Lovely flat in an excellent location with great transport links to the city.

comments:
Anthony’s nocarz was a great location for us as we attended Abba Voyage :) it was around 15-20 minutes away as the apartment is ideally located just a few minutes walk from East India Station. We were able to drop our bags early which was very helpful before the event.
The apartment is just as shown in the pictures, very spacious and clean! 5 of us stayed and it was ideal with plenty of space to socialise. Having 2 bathrooms was very handy and the apartment had everything needed.
Anthony has been very responsive and helpful via message, making our stay as easy as possible 😊
Highly recommend staying here, the views of the O2 arena are amazing. We will be looking to book again next time we visit London :) thank you!
summary: Great location for Abba Voyage event with spacious apartment and helpful host.

comments:
Before booking the place I read all the reviews of the quests. They were all positive. So I hoped to get a nice room, but what I eventually got was even better than I had expected. The room was nicely furnished and very cozy. The bed was fantastic! I didn't feel any discomfort sleeping in a new place. The bathroom was very clean. The family was friendly, attentive and always ready to help.
I was also grateful for breakfasts - I had no trouble what to eat in the morning.
It took us about 40 minutes to get to the city centre (we walked to the tube station). The line is central, so it's very comfortable to get to different places.
I would definitely recommend the place to my friends and stay there when I am in London again.
summary: Cozy room with fantastic bed and friendly family, perfect for a comfortable stay in London.

comments: Staying with Hua and Joel was an absolute delight. The neighborhood was very quiet and the house was very tidy. I didn't realize there would be other people staying in other rooms in the house, but the environment still felt very friendly and never crowded. Hua and Joel went out of their way to make us feel comfortable and it made our stay tremendously pleasant.
summary: The hosts Hua and Joel made the stay very comfortable and pleasant.

comments: The flat is literately one minute's walk to the metro station, and only about 30mins to Heathrow Airport and to city center. Although the room is not big, everything is clean and comfy, perfect for travelers who need to catch an early flight but also wants to stay close enough to the museums and theatres.
summary: The flat is clean and comfy with a perfect location for travelers.

comments:
Parfait !
Mon amie et moi avons passées un super séjour.
Dan est quelqu'un d'arrangeant et disponible.
Le logement est très bien placé, silencieux, dans une rue calme.
Il est composé de toutes les commodités nécessaires, même plus.
La literie est très bonne.
Si Dan accepte, je réserverais à nouveau cette chambre avec plaisir !
Merci encore 👍😉
summary: Dan's place was well-placed, quiet, and had all necessary amenities.

comments: This place is all about location. And the host is communicative and responsive. Very close to parks and all public transport and still quiet, minus the (unpredictable) neighbor next door or upstairs. The “hotel quality” of linens etc is definitely not 5 star hotel: everything is squeaky clean but needs maintenance (moldy spots, tile missing, broken closet door). The toiletries and linen would be similar to a 2 star hotel. Very important: if folks have any mobility difficulties they should avoid this place as stairs are really narrow. I’m 1,58 m / 5,2 feet and a size small, and I found the bathroom incredibly small but manageable. My travel companion is 2m/ 6,3ft and one night they hit their  head just going to the toilet at night, waking up to a big and bloody scratch that had to be taken care of. So I’d say anyone over 6ft should also avoid the place for safety. It’s a lovely and clean place to stay overnight and sleep well to then cook eggs in the morning.
summary: The place has great location but needs maintenance and has some safety concerns.

comments: Brilliant stay at Katie's flat. My partner and I stayed for two weeks. We got two sets of keys, some insider info on the neighborhood, and a clean and warm space to call home. The spot's near to the tube, and Camden's walkable, and there's some nice organic and other such natural food shops around. Would strongly recommend anyone looking for a place to stay in London to check this one out.
summary: Katie's flat is clean, warm, and near to the tube with a nice neighborhood.

comments:
we had the Big triple room. myself and my daughter's stayed there. each room of the 4 rooms in the apartment had their own lock with 2 shared bathrooms and a shares kitchen and washing machine and tumble dryer. the rooms were clean and comfortable. this isn't the Ritz but is excellent value. we just wanted somewhere to sleep and a base for visiting the sites in London. the location is 8min walk from limehouse station or 12 min walk from Stepney Green so location is ideal to access l
London city centre. there is also a Stepney green farm round the corner if you have little ones that like visiting the animals.
Jonathan was helpful and always made sure that the rooms were kept quiet, clean and tidy. very happy with our stay thank you, Jonathan
summary: Clean and comfortable rooms at a great value for the location near Limehouse Station.

comments: We had a really nice stay at Jennifer's house top floor en suite, it's a really nice house with a great host who made us feel very welcome, even pickles the cat made us welcome...location for us was great as it's a 5 min walk to the tube, there is a great local pub called the New Inn who do Sunday roasts, have a huge beer garden, also fab BYO Indian close to the pub called Tandoori Villa, great trip sure we will stay with Jennifer again...
summary: Welcoming host and lovely house with excellent location and amenities.

comments: Ram is an excellent host. Very friendly, kind and caring. He was very helpful informing me how to gett around, and also what was near by. He always responded quickly and clearly. His space was great (comfortable bed), I would definitely stay there again the next time I find myself in London.
summary: Friendly and helpful host with a great space to stay in London.

comments: Perfect room in a great location, close to galleries, cafes, public transportation, etc. Though i did not meet Caroline, she was very helpful and easy to communicate with, has great flatmates as well.  The room and apartment were clean and bright, one staircase from the ground, i loved ample supply of towels too; perfect for a short stay in London ...
summary: Clean and bright room in a perfect location for exploring London.

comments:
Harriet was a wonderful host and her nocarz was just as described. Perfect location that is quiet and not in the hustle and bustle of the big attractions yet can catch the tube or bus within steps. We used the bus to get around when we didn’t want to walk too far and it was really easy to use public transportation.
Lots of great food nearby and grocery store. The place was clean, stocked with essentials and could wash and hang dry clothes. Loved every second of being in London. Highly recommend.
summary: Quiet and convenient location with a wonderful host and amenities.

comments:
Great flat, great space to relax. Great neighborhood to walk to bus, train, coffee shops, dinner (and parks). It was quiet except for the church bells and birds singing (wonderful)! There is no A/C but there is an oscillating fan in each bedroom. Luckily, it wasn’t too hot during our stay. We didn’t use the dishwasher nor washing machine.
Overall, lovely stay. Thank you for hosting us!
summary: Great flat with plenty of space and amenities in a quiet neighborhood.

comments:
6 of us stayed here - parents and children with their partners. We loved the location. Very pretty area with lovely walks to the Heath. Walkable to the local tube station - it was really good to stay outside the central part of the city at the end of a busy day of sightseeing.
Another sofa would have been good for us as we all liked to congregate in the living room to catch up on our daily events.
Would visit again.
summary: Lovely location with easy access to public transport and local attractions.

comments: I  had the pleasure of staying at this apartment and was thoroughly impressed with my experience. The apartment itself was not only spacious but also maintained to a high standard of cleanliness, making for a very comfortable stay. Its location was another highlight, conveniently situated to explore the surrounding area with ease. I would definitely recommend this property to anyone looking for a hassle-free and enjoyable stay. Without a doubt, I will be booking this apartment again for my future travels.
summary: Immaculately clean and well-maintained apartment in an excellent location.

comments:
Excellent séjour! Le logement est très bien situé dans le centre de Londres à 15mn à pied du British museum et 10mn en transport de King Cross St Pancras.
Le logement est un duplex avec au rez de chaussée une chambre et une salle de bain avec douche et baignoire. À l’étage un chambre avec sa salle de bain avec douche, le salon/cuisine et une petite terrasse.
Willyan est très arrangeant, il m’a permis d’arriver plus tôt déposer mes bagages pour profiter pleinement de la ville.
Autour du logement il y a bons nombres de commerces, de bars et de restaurants.
Idéal pour passer quelques jours à Londres
summary: Excellent stay in a central London location with plenty of amenities nearby.

comments: Good location in terms of access to public transport into the touristy part of the city. Less so in terms of the immediate vicinity. The property cleanliness was decent. A few things like stale mouldy odour that hits you when the dishwasher was opened and the lack of clean readily usable crockery could be addressed easily before guests arrival. All so called bath towels were indeed hand towel or bath floor mat size. Apparently was advised this was to do with the laundry company supply and management couldn’t do much (?!). The place is palpably lacklustre and in desperate need of some TLC. Seems if you literally want a roof over your head with bare minimal in London then this could be it. It’s shame when a small injection of investment with some careful thought could make a substantial improvement to the experience of the guests!
summary: Good location but property needs TLC to improve cleanliness and overall experience.

comments: Steve’s place was perfect for us! The location was literally a two minute’s walk away from the tube station, making all of London easily accessible. The place was perfectly clean and Steve had left water, soda, and snacks for us. He was super easy to communicate with, always being quick to reply. He let us leave our bags after check in so that we didn’t have to carry them around London before our flight. The area seems safe and there are many shops, bakeries, and restaurants conveniently close by. Don’t miss eating at Steve’s restaurant though - he gives a guest discount and the food is amazing! We hope to be back to stay at Steve’s place, and will recommend it to all of our friends!
summary: Perfect location, clean and well-equipped with a friendly host.

comments: Overall the apartment was mostly as described, and was spacious and in a good location. The main downside was that it was dirty to the point of being problematic and that really detracted from the experience. The host was very responsive and understanding of the cleaning issue, and the location was great. The free garage parking was a big benefit. If there are better cleaners this could be a very good choice.
summary: Good location but cleanliness issues detracted from the experience.

comments:
Amazing location. We stayed here for convenience and so it was. As you exit the front door, there are numerous shops to choose from. Place was very clean with a modern finish.
The hosts were very accommodating to my request for an early check in and also very responsive. The stairs are a bit much but not out of the ordinary for your typical London home.
Over all a 10/10 stay with an amazing location.
summary: Amazing location, very clean and modern with accommodating hosts.

comments:
I spent 2 weeks with Michalia and she’s lovely and very helpful with everything! She made me feel home.
The borough is safe and the apartment is really close to the Piccadilly Line that takes you to Central London in 25 minutes. Definitely will stay there again if I ever come back to London!
summary: Lovely and helpful host in a safe area with easy access to Central London.

comments: This flat is all you need for a visit to London. Clean, comfortable and relatively well positioned to walk to all the tourist sights. Not that close to a tube station but has a supermarket close by, and if you don’t mind walking it is only 15-30 minutes to a lot of the iconic attractions. The best thing about this property is the bed. It was wonderful to return home to that comfy bed at the end of a long day of pounding the pavements. Emily was very helpful. We didn’t bother her at all, but we know that if we needed help, Emily would have been there for us.
summary: Clean, comfortable and well-positioned flat with a great bed and helpful owner.

comments: Lyle was the kindest, and most accommodating host I’ve ever had on air bnb. His instructions were clear and concise, check in/out were absolutely seamless, and his home was beautiful! Very easy to talk to and at your disposal should there be anything needed. He even wished me a happy birthday :) Definitely will stay again my next trip abroad. Thank you for everything Lyle ♥️ Hope to see you soon!
summary: Lyle was an excellent host with clear instructions and a beautiful home.

comments: We had a good stay at this apartment. Located right next to Camden town it was a short way to the next metro station. Self check-in was easy and Stanislav was good to reach via mail all day if we had any issues.  Spacious apartment with everything you need for a few days.
summary: We had a good stay at this apartment with easy self-check-in and a convenient location near Camden town.

comments: We loved our stay at Vito’s. The neighbourhood was lovely. Easy access to anywhere in London. The amenities in the local area were excellent. The flat was clean and Vito was both flexible and an excellent communicator. Would recommend Vito’s flat and the area as a base for your London travels.
summary: Vito's flat was clean, well-located, and had excellent amenities in the local area.

comments:
Subha's apartment is great! The location good if you are working in the City of London, also it is a 5 minute walk to Tower Hill tube station, plus it is really close to Tower Bridge and the Tower of London.
The apartment itself was clean, well furnished, and had pretty much everything we needed, including wifi, a washer/dryer and plenty of space. Subha was very helpful and communication was excellent. We would definitely recommend Subha's place and would be happy to stay again.
summary: Subha's apartment was great for work or sightseeing, with a good location and plenty of space.

comments: This was a wonderful nocarz experience. Anna was unfailingly prompt in responding to questions both before and during my trip. The house is in a small sidestreet, so secluded that none of the cab drivers I came across during my stay knew where it was. This means that though the place is very central (a 10 minute walk from Camden Lock along the canal towpath, it is unbelievably quiet. The house is on a crescent surrounded by neighbours who all seem to know one another, making for a village atmosphere in the middle of central London. The house itself is charming and has everything you need. A nice kitchen, sitting room, and a lovely bedroom on the second floor. I slept like log. I would stay here again in a flash!
summary: Anna's house was quiet, central, and charming, with excellent communication from the host.

comments: Great apartment with lovely views. Hosts were fantastic and really helpful, they walked into Canary Wharf with us and recommended a few nice restaurants. They were always on hand to help too with anything. The location is good, right by Canning Town station. I would defintiely recommend for a short stay in London.
summary: Great apartment with lovely views, hosts were fantastic and really helpful.

comments:
Noi's house is very beautiful, spacious and cozy! The location is also great that is just 5 mins to walk to the station. It's a wonderful place to stay for traveling in London.
In addition, Carol (who organize and communicate with us) is very considerate that she gives all the information in detail to let our check in smoothly. She makes sure that we have no problems to get there and always respond soon. Also, it's so sweet of her to prepare toasts and milk (with the kind we prefer) for us. By the time we're leaving, she even let us have a flexible/late check out which really helps a lot!
My family and I enjoy the time staying here~ Highly recommend!
summary: Beautiful, spacious, and cozy house with excellent location and considerate host.

comments: I did an emergency booking running away from the worst experience ever in a Sonder nearby and this was probably the best experience I’ve had so far with an nocarz!! Starting from the photos, responsiveness, flexibility, cleanness, location , it was so easy to book and get access. Services in the property were excellent and high quality. You have all you need. It was great for a holidays/work mix! WiFi excellent! I would love to stay in any property managed by them! Congrats great service!
summary: Excellent experience with great photos, responsiveness, flexibility, cleanness, and high-quality services.

comments: We had a wonderful stay with Clare and family. The place is neat and clean. Clare is a great host, just the right amount of helpful without being intrusive. We felt welcome and safe in her home. And Towns the cat is adorable, you must meet her. We would recommend this place in a heartbeat. Love the Intrepid Travellers, Becky and Peggy ❤️
summary: Wonderful stay in a neat and clean place with a great host and adorable cat.

comments: Very central location. The room is small but acceptable for a short visit. With a good clean and a lick of paint it would be very well priced for London. I was grateful to have a sink in the room (shame there was no plug). The heater was a god send as it was a very chilly evening when I stayed over. Staff are friendly and helpful.
summary: Central location with small but acceptable room, friendly and helpful staff.

comments: I stayed a couple of weeks at Ollie's apartment. Absolutely positive experience, although it is not a luxurious hotel. When you feel genuine trust and care from a host like Ollie, this is what none of the network hotels can offer. This is a 5 star (*****) experience if you don't need walls of marble and glass.
summary: Guest had a positive experience at Ollie's apartment despite its lack of luxury.

comments: Jenny's home is gorgeous and comfortable -- sunny, filled with books and art, with an exquisite backyard garden, a well-equipped kitchen, even a screening room for watching movies, all of the comforts of home and then some.  Jenny was a perfect host, and her maisonette  is a centrally-located oasis from which to explore London. The presence of her friendly cat was an added bonus.
summary: Jenny's home was comfortable and beautifully decorated with a lovely garden, perfect for exploring London.

comments: Expecting the noise on weekends because there are pubs and bars around, which can be good if you want to have fun! The room has a bit of a fly problem when we were staying but the location is superb! Literally 3 minutes walk to the Kingscross station, very suitable for a transitioning stay!
summary: The room had some issues with noise and flies but the location near Kingscross station was excellent.

comments: Helen was an excellent host! She was wonderful at communicating and gave very clear directions on how to get to her place from the airport. Her space was clean and as described with nice touches like a hot water kettle, hot chocolate, and snacks. Helen is very knowledgeable of the city and has a contagious bubbly spirit. She had some wonderful recommendations for food and places to travel that were off the main path. If I'm in London again I would gladly stay with Helen!
summary: Helen was an excellent host who provided clear directions, clean space, and great recommendations for food and travel.

comments: Jane is lovely, her house was very cozy and very well located, close to attractions and bus stops that get you everywhere. It was very clean, they let you use the kitchen, they have a dog that was very well behaved (I don't love dogs and it was not a problem). The room is in the attic so there are some stairs. Jane has everything that you could need, the room is very well equipped. I definitely recommend
summary: Jane's house was cozy, well-located, and had everything needed for a comfortable stay with a friendly dog.

comments: Lina's flat in Notting Hill was perfect for our stay. Cozy and very well kept home with all the essentials one needs for a brief stay in London. A wide variety of restaurants and shops are only a 5 minute walk away (Portobello St) and certainly should satisfy anyone's taste or appetite. Lina is a lovely host and provided all the information we needed for the flat and area to make our stay as comfortable as possible. As a coffee drinker, the espresso machine in her kitchen was an addictive plus! Lina also left Oyster cards and London's "Best of" books for those wanting to explore the city. A definite repeat stay if it's available on the next trip to London town!
summary: Lina's flat in Notting Hill was perfect for our stay, with a lovely host and great location.

comments:
We had a super stay at this cute nocarz apartment in Bermondsey, London!
The space was cozy, clean, and tastefully decorated, loved the quirky wallpapers and pictures. The kitchen was adequately equipped for a short stay and the bed was nice and comfy.
The location was in a part of London not known to us but proved to a vibrant area with lots of busy eateries and bars within walking distance - lots of tips given by the host.
The apartment is fairly close to public transport - closest tube station about a 15 minute walk, and popular attractions such as Tower Bridge and The Tower of London were just up the road.
The host was very communicative and access was straightforward. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a stylish and comfortable base in London.
summary: We had a super stay at this cute nocarz apartment in Bermondsey, London, with a vibrant area and lots of amenities.

comments: Had the best experience here! The place is in close proximity to the main sights. Also it's a 2 minute walk to Hyde park and to the Lancaster Gate Underground, which is perfect to get around the city. Robert provided so many amenities with his place and went above and beyond what we expected. He was so gracious and helpful.
summary: The place is in close proximity to the main sights, with many amenities provided by Robert and great hospitality.

comments: This is my very first time staying with host on nocarz, and I am so glad I made the right choice to stay with Alex! I'd definitely going back to visit him again! Alex surprised me with his artisan talent and wonderful hospitality, I felt like staying with a friend, a home away from home. Certainly don't need to repeat other guests had mentioned how great Alex's place is, I wanna say thank you so much Alex to make my stay a great experience, I'd strongly recommend anyone to stay with Alex! :-)
summary: Alex's place was like staying with a friend, with wonderful hospitality and an artisan talent that made my stay great.

comments: We had a nice time in Natasa's place. The apartment is really convenient, the underground is just round the corner in one of the best areas in London. It's the kind of apartment everyone would like to have, mixing the charm of an old building with an exquisite taste for the modern furniture.a 10 for the decoration!! Besides, Natasa was really welcoming, she looks so nice. Definitely, whenever we come back to London, we'll try to stay here again.
summary: Natasa's apartment is really convenient, with modern furniture and decoration, and a welcoming host in a great area of London.

comments: El alojamiento es muy bueno, muy limpio y la habitación impecable, con maquina para calentar agua, sobres de té y café incluidos, además de un frigobar; el baño sumamente pulcro y espacioso. Para moverte a la zona turística únicamente puedes llegar en autobús ya que está algo retirado. Una buena opción para quedarte en Londres.
summary: The accommodation is very good, very clean and the room is spotless with a water heater machine, tea and coffee included, plus a mini fridge.

comments: The room was clean and the flat in an amazing location. The bed was comfortable and overlooks private gardens. It felt a little awkward that I was staying in the only bedroom in a very tiny flat with the host in the room next door. However Liz was welcoming and it’s a great base to explore London from.
summary: The flat was in an amazing location, but it felt awkward staying in the only bedroom with the host next door.

comments:
We loved staying here! It was perfect for value, we stayed there with my boyfriend for 5 nights. We walked every day to the city centre (25 min walk), but it was pretty close to the underground station and bus stops. Neighbourhood was quiet but it had a lot of shops nearby.
We would definitely stay here again. Thanks for everything!
summary: We loved staying here for its great value, perfect location, and quiet neighborhood with shops nearby.

comments: La organización del piso es muy correcta. Cada habitación tiene su espacio asignado en la cocina y el baño en mí caso, fue compartido con la habitación de al lado. El lugar de noche es muy tranquilo, el único ruido que se escucha son los pasos de los vecinos de arriba. El colchón para mí gusto, lo mejor de la habitación. Cómo pega, me faltó una televisión. El resto todo correcto.
summary: The organization of the flat is very correct, but I missed a TV in my room.

comments: Lizzy is lovely and her place is great. It's cosy, cute, warm and spacious for the size. It's in such a great area. I wish it was my home I loved it so much. Communication was easy. Great host, great flat. Loved it so much now looking to live in the same area.
summary: Lizzy's place is lovely, cosy, cute, warm, and spacious, in a great area with easy communication.

comments:
This below-street level accommodation seems best suited for the young, vigorous, budget-minded traveler, who will be grateful for it's comfortable mattresses, intimate garden, fully-functional kitchen, good Wi-Fi, and the fact that there is a lively pub just across the way. The discerning renter will appreciate the fact that the flat is excellently situated for access to transportation: being barely over two blocks to the Overground, perhaps four blocks to the Underground, and with a bus line that runs down Hemingford Road itself. If one sets out for a Caledonian Road station at a brisk clip he/she may be able to reach the center of London in 25 minutes or less via one or the other rail system---a blessing. Being the owner's home, the flat is well-equipped, with hair dryer, iron, umbrellas, etc. The owner thoughtfully leaves transportation schedules on the dining table for those who plan to tour the city. She is also flexible about check-in times. Residents of the neighborhood, when asked for advice or directions, seem always to be kind and helpful.

Just north and west of the flat the neighborhood takes on a sketchy appearance, a bit drab, worn and littered. However, safety, even at night, turned out not to be a concern, and should not dissuade potential renters who utilize Google Earth as an aid in decision-making. One has the impression that neighbors and shopkeepers look out for one another and want to keep the area safe for families and visitors.

Advice for future renters: Bring very comfortable shoes and carry a small flashlight (torch). Like most of London the sidewalks and byways, while sometimes charming, are murder on the feet and often poorly illuminated. Light sleepers should bring earplugs for again, as typical, you will hear people walking about upstairs, which seems to be the norm in the older, picturesque buildings. Do make certain to immediately master the thermostat and assure yourself you can enable the heat to rise when you are first introduced to the flat. It may be helpful to clarify with the owner what person, if anyone, will be available to assist in case of breakdown or failure of utilities, facilities, or appliances, or any unexpected mishap that can be the bane of home-owners and, consequently, renters.
summary: A budget-friendly accommodation suitable for young travelers, with comfortable mattresses and a lively pub nearby.

comments:
Inge ist unglaublich freundlich und hilfsbereit. Man kann mit jedem Anliegen zu ihr kommen und sie hilft dir super gerne weiter. Man fühlt sich wirklich wie zuhause.
Die Lage ist mega … 3 U-Bahnstationen in der Nähe und super schnell im Stadtzentrum.
Sehr schöne und sichere Gegend
Ich kann es rundum einfach nur empfehlen!
summary: Inge is a friendly and helpful host in a great location near public transportation and safe area.

comments: Sam was a lovely host. His place is in an excellent location. Right next to notting hill gate metro station, right across from Pret A Manger and 3 markets and Boots and a walk away from portobello market or Holland Park ( one of the best parks in London). Highly recommend.
summary: Sam's place is in an excellent location, right next to Notting Hill Gate metro station and close to several markets.

comments:
Beautiful modern clean flat. Rob was helpful and friendly. The flat is just outside of Central London. Nice neighborhood accessible by bus stop 2 minutes away, train 12 minute walk from flat. It takes about 45 minutes to an hour depending on what time of day you leave to get into the city, as well as Uber rides. Plenty of restaurants nearby. A Sainsbury supermarket just opposite the building opened until 10 pm. Comfortable bed. The windows offered a great view of the city. Water pressure in bath was great! I saw the most insane and beautiful sunrise at 4 a.m.
Highly recommended.
Only suggestion is to offer another door fob or way to get into the building. This would lessen the hassle of coordinating with other parties.
Thank you for hosting!
summary: A beautiful modern flat with a comfortable bed and great views of the city, located just outside Central London.

comments: We loved this small place! It fits everything a small family needs for some days including a fully equipped kitchen and even a washing machine - everything we needed was there (and much more)! It is very well located close to several stations and buses in a super exciting neighborhood that within a 15 minutes walk is full of cafés, bars, restaurants and plenty of culture (We were lucky to be there for the Peckham Festival). We were welcomed by snacks and drinks and with some books and toys for our daughter. Thank you!
summary: A small but well-equipped place for families, located in a super exciting neighborhood with plenty of culture and amenities.

comments: Exactly what it said in the description. Costa was a wonderful host and very responsive. The place is definitely big enough for 3 people to fit in, though it is a bit cozy for 3. The location was close to where we wanted to be and at a pretty convenient spot. Overall would recommended!
summary: The host was responsive and accommodating, and the location was convenient.

comments:
This place was great.
The location was fantastic and the apartment was very clean and kitted out with everything you need. The garden made it for us as it ment my 2 year old could get out to play. The host was fantastic and always responds fast to any questions will definitely be back.
summary: The apartment was clean, well-equipped, and had a great garden for kids to play in.

comments: Staying with Cesar is amazing! The accommodations are exactly as described and pictured. Extremely comfortable / safe place to say. Very clean and quiet as well. Perfect place to come relax after a busy day. This location is very close (2-3 minute walk) to a bus stop which is just a short trip to either the overground or underground. Cesar is a wonderful host and is always around to answer any questions you may have. He makes you feel right at home. Okay Will definitely be booking with him again!
summary: Cesar's place is comfortable, safe, and quiet, with a wonderful host who makes you feel at home.

comments: this apartment was the perfect space for us - a group of friends meeting up with each other and for london film festival! the café downstairs is such a perfect addition for grabbing a quick breakfast/coffee before heading out for the day and the tube station is such a short walk. the only issue we had was with the ambulance sirens on our first night going off regularly at 2/3am (this is no fault of the air bnb or lee though!)
summary: The apartment was perfect for our group, with a convenient location near the tube station and café downstairs.

comments: Bryan and Gian Paolo are the best hosts anyone could imagine. I arrived to a cup of tea and slice of homemade cake (by Gian Paolo, the talented Italian he is). Their home is beautifully decorated and features everything you could need - even an awesome bedside survival kit featuring some very British treats. Having just stepped off a 23 hour flight, the warmth offered by Bryan and Gian Paolo's hospitality was perfect.
summary: Bryan and Gian Paolo are excellent hosts who offer warm hospitality and a beautifully decorated home.

comments: VanZyl's place is in an ideal location, with many eating options within blocks, either direction. It is on a very busy street, but walk one block over and it is quite peaceful. We felt safe there and in the surrounding neighborhoods. We left the windows open, even though it is on the first floor, and enjoyed the cool breezes. The bed is Queen-sized and comfortable. We especially enjoyed our walks in Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park.
summary: VanZyl's place has an ideal location with many amenities nearby, but the common area could be cleaner.

comments: I had a great time staying at Tessa's place. The room was neat, tidy, spacious and the bed was very comfortable! Location was safe and also very convenient. Close to cafes, pharmacy and train stations. Tess was a welcoming and friendly host but also was never intrusive and let you have your privacy. She was super helpful and answered any questions that I had. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend it!
summary: Tessa's place is a welcoming and convenient spot with a friendly host who respects guests' privacy.

comments:
The room is very nice and we felt great in it. The common area is dirty, especially the kitchen (bad smells) so we did our best to avoid this area during out stay, which was okay as we ate outside all the time. The sitting room was convivial and the showers were a bit dirty and small but it was okay. For the price, the quality is quite good but could be better if the common space was perfectly clean.
Ali was very helpful and warm.
summary: Ali's property has a nice room, but the common space needs improvement in terms of cleanliness for the price.

comments: Myself and my partner have just had a wonderful stay in this property. The hosts were able to accommodate us meeting and exceeding all of our expectations. The flat is comfortable and very spacious with everything you could possibly need at hand. Great location and lovely welcome. we were able to come and go as we pleased but also felt that should we need anything this would have been easily dealt with. We even got a the offer of a later check out which we much appreciated. I would recommend this property and it's hosts in the highest possible terms.
summary: The hosts exceeded expectations with their accommodation and service, making it a wonderful stay.

comments:
It’s a shame I stayed at Christine’s lovely home for only a night. It is a very beautiful, cosy home. Located right at the heart of West End and Piccadilly Circus. Near a Boots, Tesco, The Underground and multiple theatres.
Christine is a warm and hospitable host. You won’t regret staying at her lovely home. :)
summary: Christine's home is a beautiful and cozy spot located near many amenities, with a warm and hospitable host.

comments: Robert is a friendly owner. He always respond fast whenever we have questions to him. Robert shared us very clear information from how to get train and to reach the house. He also considerate that what if we come out from another exit and he do guide us the route too. feel warm and lovely. the house is clean and safe. we have home feeling for the six nights stay. highly recommended and value worth. I'll definitely recommend to my friends. thank you so much Robert
summary: Friendly owner Robert provided clear information and excellent service for our stay.

comments: My family and I had a wonderful stay at Stephen’s place. It was surprisingly spacious and exactly what we wanted, a prewar building with the original touches. Stephen was a great host and was on top of communication the entire time. Also, the location was amazing. I definitely recommend a stay at his place!
summary: Stephen's place was spacious, well-located, and had great communication from the host.

comments: More than just a super host- one of the best nocarz experiences I’ve ever had. Great location and really nice place, had everything we needed and more, which made for a very comfortable stay in London. Regan and Wayne were super helpful throughout the stay and gave us some awesome recommendations and helpful tips for getting around and to/from the airport. If I ever return to London I’ll definitely stay here again!
summary: Regan and Wayne's apartment offered a comfortable stay with helpful recommendations and tips.

comments: Pierre is an amazing host. I arrived slightly early before the check in time and he was very hospitable. The flat is so tidy warm and quiet and the bed is so comfortable too. Location is great for transport links to London city. Will definitely recommend his place to other travellers and will use it again the next time I'm in London.
summary: Pierre's flat was tidy, warm, quiet, and well-located for transport links to London city.

comments: A lovely, welcoming apartment with everything you need to enjoy your stay. The furnishings are plush and comfortable; the balcony catches the morning sun and the whole place is spotless. Great location situated on the edge of a park with other parks in the area and a Tube minutes away on foot. Comms with Claudia were good with immediate responses.
summary: Claudia's apartment was lovely, welcoming, and had great furnishings and location near parks and Tube stations

comments: Great location and set up for our family.  Within two blocks of Paddington station, and a few more to Hyde Park.   The bedrooms were perfect for our family (4 adults and 2 children:6/3). Off the busy street so noise was not a factor.  Host was very accommodating and cheerful. We will try to book with Miriam again on our next London vacation.
summary: Great location and set up for our family with a very accommodating host.

comments: We really enjoyed our stay here. Our hosts are a very hospitable family, super responsive, communicative, generous with tips and flexible with checkin. They sent very clear instructions (with photos! :) ) so that we found our way in with no hassles. The place itself is quiet, spacious and comfy with a big usable kitchen. And the location was ideal for us - close to public transport, ExCel and London City Airport. We would definitely stay here again.
summary: Our hosts were very hospitable and the place was quiet, spacious, and comfy with an ideal location.

comments: This place was a perfect start to our trip in London. It was easily accessible from the Tube and quiet and clean. We even had slippers left in the room for our use, along with some breakfast bites and coffee! We really recommend this place to anyone and it set the bar high for future air BnB stays. Thanks so much for the great stay!
summary: This place was easily accessible from the Tube and quiet and clean with great amenities.

comments: Wow. Where do i start. The area was run down and we celt wuite unsafe. The building is old and tired and dirty. The inside of the flat was grotty and very grim. It was dirty, dusty, run down, stains on things, ripped sofa, smelly old bedding, out of date food in fridge, curtains hanging down on wires, light shades missing off ceiling lights. Part used toiletries in bathroom. Toilet seat peeling, stains on shower curtain and walls, all floors dirty, sofa bed mattress so thin and uncomfortable. Crockery and cutlery dirty. Long dark hairs in the bed. Thick dust on things. Lots of plug extensions on kitchen sides and floors which looked overloaded and unsafe. Paint peeling on surfaces, mould on bathroom window. All windows very  dirty.  They was 6 of us, all adults and we slept in our clothes and put other clothing on the pillows so we could lay our heads down. There was an unpleasent odour throughout the flat also. We tried to arrange alternative local accomodation but unfortunately they were all full.  We would definately nit recomend this properly.  A real shame as Kamal was an informative host with good communication.
summary: The flat was dirty, grimy, and run down with many safety concerns and unpleasant odors.

comments:
Lucy’s flat was a last-minute reservation.
The flat is a good size. I needed the space for four suitcases. The beds were very comfortable—no issue with the train sound nearby. It's more like white noise, which I need to help me sleep.
I did have an issue with no hot water, but it was quickly resolved 30 minutes after calling.
The kitchen had essential cooking items when my family and I wanted to stay in for the night. Plus, UberEats can easily find Lucy’s flat.
I would book this flat again.
summary: Lucy's flat was a good size with comfortable beds and essential cooking items, but had an issue with no hot water initially.

comments: I enjoy my stay in Jonathan house ! It was super clean all the time, also you can use the kitchen, wash machine!! At morning there’s some stuff like coffee, Te and others ! To get the house it’s pretty easy and nearly the supermarket and bus and train station really close! I recommended this house! And Jonathan always responds very kind and quickly! :D
summary: Guest had a great stay at Jonathan's house, praising its cleanliness and amenities.

comments: Deben tener cuidado, la calle no es muy segura, a mi salida  exactamente afuera sufrí un robo de mi celular, algo que afecto mis vacaciones. en cuanto al departamento esta muy limpio y con lo necesario para estar agradable. El detalle pasa el tren al lado y si eres sensible para dormir te costará un poco descansar. en general bueno, solo el mal rato por el asalto
summary: Guest had a good experience but was robbed outside the property and found it hard to sleep due to train noise.

comments: Our family of 7 had a pleasant stay at Rami’s apartment. We chose it based on its close proximity to Paddington station (8mins by taxi, 15 mins by bus) as it was convenient to get to by Heathrow Express from London Heathrow. When we arrived, we were pleasantly surprised to find that there convenience stores, takeaway food shops and restaurants at our doorstep. The bus stops and the train stations were close by too. The apartment is very cosy, clean and well heated. It had all the amenities listed. The only downside was that the 3rd bedroom was too small so our children ended up sleeping in the living room.
summary: Family of 7 enjoyed their stay at Rami's apartment, praising its cleanliness and location near Paddington station.

comments: Nigel's place is located in a very beautiful residential area and easy access to Westfield, Oxford street, Gatwick and Heathrow. His house is really warm and sweet, also everything in the room so comfortable. Nigel helped me a lot about my trip to London and he is a very kind person, he provided me so much wonderful information and just let me feel the other side of London!! He knows everything about London also U.K., you can ask him for everything about it, he can recommend good places when you get there. Sometimes I can have company with some super cute puppies during my stay! :) I really love his place and would definitely go back again soon!
summary: Guest had a wonderful experience at Nigel's house, praising its warmth, comfort, and his helpfulness as a host.

comments:
Outstanding experience! Catherine is the best host we've ever met. I can hardly explain our feelings cause it's difficult to find proper words that will describe everything about Catherine and her place.
