There are a lot reviews telling how hospitable Catherine is, how stylish and perfectly clean is the house and all the rooms.
But we didn't expect that she would leave her friends in the house and drive us to metro stations when we lost our rucksack. It was about 12 a.m. when we started our search operation which we finished in the middle of the night. Catherine was with us all that time. She has an amazing talent to find proper words and support people.
Thank you, Catherine! We will never forget this night. :) You are our star!
And we will definitely return :)
summary: Guests had an outstanding experience with Catherine, praising her hospitality, the cleanliness of her house, and her kindness in helping them during their stay.

comments:
We have had a wonderful staying with Tom, Kate and the children. We felt at home. The room is very cozy and the whole house is very beautiful. The breakfast was delicious and the bread freshly baked.
The house is very well located, close to Bounds Green station (Picadilly line) and Bus 141 (to London Bridge).
We highly recommend this nocarz host to all!!
summary: Guests had a wonderful stay at Tom's home, feeling at home in the cozy room and enjoying the delicious breakfast.

comments:
Host incredibilmente gentile, chiaro è disponibile in ogni momento della giornata. È stato un soggiorno meraviglioso, la casa è pulitissima e lo spazio all’aperto è incredibile. Tutto curato nei dettagli: caffè e biscotti per le nostre colazioni e tutto il necessario in cucina ma anche in bagno e nelle stanze.
Grazie jubed torneremo sicuramente per il nostro prossimo viaggio a Londra
summary: Host was incredibly kind and welcoming, providing a clean and beautifully maintained space with lovely outdoor area.

comments: Unfortunately we had to cancel first our eurotrain was cancelled, we immediately booked a flight and then rhat was cancelled too. We were so sad. Ella and Jon were understanding and had empathy. I hope to be able to book again soon and that we can go to their place for real now.
summary: Guests had to cancel their trip but appreciated Ella and Jon's understanding and empathy.

comments: Krishan was communicative throughout, including being available for support during our stay which was not needed, as everything was clear and as advertised. The flat was clean and bright, and surprisingly quiet given the location, a very pleasant base from which we could quickly get to where we wanted to be. Would stay again, no question. Thanks, Krishan.
summary: Krishan's flat was clean, bright, and quiet, making it a pleasant base for exploring London.

comments: We were provided with clear video instructions ahead of check-in for accessing the keys and the space, so check-in was a breeze. We had a car, so knowing that we'd be able to park right at the property really helped with our decision to stay here. It made for a  seamless arrival/departure. The space was as described/depicted in the photos. We stayed during a hot period, so the space was quite warm when we arrived, but we were able to cool it down a few degrees with the oscillating fan that was available in the space before going to sleep. Some folks may find the bed to be a little lumpy, but we were comfortable in it and had good nights' sleeps there. There are nice restaurants and cafes within walkable distance. Hanwell station on the Elizabeth Line was also quite close, which was convenient for trips into central London. Andy was quick to respond and was willing to assist with anything we needed. We would stay here again for our next visit to the London area.
summary: Guests had a seamless stay at Andy's space, with clear instructions, convenient parking, and comfortable accommodations.

comments: The best thing about this apartment is the location! Paddington is a great area, close to the station if coming from Heathrow and also multiple tube lines to explore London. I enjoyed being close to Hyde Park for a morning run. The place itself is adequate but found it unclean, I got a faint gas smell upon entering the apartment each time and the bed is very springy. I appreciated Charlie’s flexibility in checking in and out.
summary: Great location, but apartment had cleanliness issues and a springy bed.

comments:
My recent nocarz stay in Kensington, London, was an absolute delight! Nestled next to Kensington Gardens, the location couldn't have been better. With the park just steps away, I enjoyed leisurely strolls amidst the lush greenery and picturesque landscapes.
The apartment itself was a cozy haven, beautifully furnished and equipped with all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The bedroom was inviting, and the bed was incredibly comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep.
One of the highlights was undoubtedly the proximity to Kensington Palace and its surrounding attractions. I spent hours exploring the palace grounds and immersing myself in the rich history of the area.
Additionally, the host's hospitality was exemplary. They provided helpful tips and recommendations, making sure I made the most of my time in London. Their attention to detail and responsiveness added an extra layer of comfort to my stay.
In summary, my nocarz experience in Kensington was fantastic.
summary: Fantastic experience with excellent location, amenities, and host hospitality.

comments: Petra's flat is spacious, well-appointed and comfortable. It has a lovely outdoor, private patio. My stay was comfortable and Petra made me feel welcome at check in, which she handled remotely and expertly. There are two groceries options on the same block, with easy bus service into central London. And Clapham Common is nearby. I recommend this property and would stay again.
summary: Petra's flat is spacious, well-appointed, and comfortable, with a lovely private patio.

comments:
Excellent Air BNB .. fantastic amenities, thoughtful additional touches eg croissants , coffee & water all included . Very well stocked toiletries and electronics.
Would highly recommend .
Close to the tube station and convenience store . Thanks Matt for an enjoyable stress free stay with lots of extras I’ve never encountered before . Well done .
summary: Excellent Airbnb with fantastic amenities, thoughtful touches, and a convenient location.

comments:
A perfect place to stay while visiting London! Close enough to both public transport and some sightseeing areas.
The apartment itself was perfect for our small group of friends and was exactly as pictured. Paul was super responsive and accommodating. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone looking to stay in London! :)
summary: Perfect place to stay in London, close to transport and sightseeing areas.

comments:
Susan is very communicative. The place is in an excellent location and has an attractive price for the size and location. The bathrooms are new and much larger than typical London bathrooms. The beds are comfortable.
The place is very dark, mainly because it's a basement unit, which was not clear to me when I booked. We also had some issues with appliances not working, although Susan was responsive and communicative when we notified her of the problems.
We had an active water leak the entire time we were in the unit in the larger of the two bedrooms, and it wasn't able to be addressed until our last day.
summary: The place has a great location and price, but had some issues with appliances and water leaks.

comments: Layo was such a friendly host. You'll love his apartment! The few is amazing, especially by night. Its very close to  ExCel London , and the station Canning Town is 5 minutes walk away. The room was very clean and there was enough storage for clothes etc. I'd  definetly stay at Layos place again and would recommend it to my friends.
summary: Layo's apartment is friendly, clean, and conveniently located near ExCel London.

comments:
Tatiana was a great host. She was very friendly. I was only visiting for a day and I was tired from travelling so I mostly stayed in my room but Tatiana was very responsive and showed me the amenities. She also made some space in the fridge for my food. She showed me the kitchen and showed me I can use the dishes and cutlery if I needed it.
As for the place, it is very easy to find and there's a big Tesco just across the road which was very convenient. The single room to me was nice and cosy. And for that price, the service was great. Would definitely want to book this place again in the future when I'm travelling.
summary: Tatiana's place was easy to find, had a big Tesco nearby, and provided great service for the price.

comments: Sophie's place was amazing. Exactly what we were looking for. Sophie had made sure that we found essentials for our first few days, including food for breakfast, and even a bottle of wine. And the few times we asked here for something that we couldn't find in the apartment, she would immediately make sure we got it delivered. Her and Amber were super helpful, and made us feel super comfy. Would definitely recommend anyone to stay at her place!
summary: Sophie's apartment was amazing, with essentials provided and super helpful hosts.

comments: The flat is very spacious and just as beautiful as the photos! It seems Annie has thought of everything even putting together a “bible” with directions, tips, and recommendations. The kitchen is huge and is equipped with anything you would need to entertain. Annie and Andrew greeted us warmly and made sure we knew how everything worked. They were available, but our space was very private. A very convenient and lovely area of London next to Bishop’s Park. We absolutely loved staying here!
summary: Annie's flat is spacious, beautiful, and well-equipped, with a convenient location near Bishop’s Park.

comments:
Alles in allem eine sehr gute Unterkunft in einer guten Nachbarschaft. Die Wohnung ist klein, aber alles so wie beschrieben.
Es ist etwas hellhörig. Wer empfindlich ist, sollte Oropax mitnehmen.
Der Eingang ist um die Ecke in der Seitenstraße und es fehlt die Hausnummer. Da haben etwas länger gesucht.
Check in mit Code einfach.
summary: A good accommodation in a quiet neighborhood with some minor drawbacks.

comments:
Wir haben unsere Tage dort sehr genossen. Die Unterkunft ist mit Bus und Overground sehr gut erreichbar. Sie liegt in einer ruhigen Straße direkt zwischen Victoria-Park auf der einen und lebhafter Gegend (Eastend) auf der anderen Seite. Als Familie mit zwei Kindern eignet sich die Unterkunft hervorragend um von dort Ausflüge zu unternehemen und sich danach zurück zu ziehen und sich zu erholen. Wie beschrieben wird die Wohnung zu anderer Zeit auch privat benutzt. So hat man tatsächlich das Gefühl "zu Besuch zu sein". Dadurch ist das Angebot an Stauraum etwas beschränkt und man kann sich vielleicht nicht so "ausbreiten" wie in einer leeren, neutralen Unterkunft. Uns hat das aber nicht gestört und im Gegenteil das Gefühl eines guten Zuhauses gegeben. Die Aufteilung der Zimmer und Ausstattung der Küche eignet sich für Familien besonders gut und es fehlt hier an nichts.
Vielen Dank für diese Möglichkeit in London unter zu kommen!
summary: A family-friendly apartment with easy access to public transport and amenities.

comments: It was an absolute pleasure to stay at Elena's place. She is a lovely host and we had many engaged, enjoyable, and insightful conversations. Her cute dog and her relaxed cat were the cherry on the top. I can definitely recommend the place to anyone who does not mind staying at someone's private house.
summary: A lovely private home with a friendly host and pets, perfect for those who don't mind staying in someone's house.

comments: Avi has done a meticulous job of creating the perfect home away from home in the heart of London (yet in a quiet and cute block, which helps). She was very flexible with letting us drop off our luggage before checkin. We loved all the special touches that made our stay very comfortable. Would love to come back and stay again in the future. Highly recommended!
summary: A meticulously prepared home away from home with special touches that made the stay very comfortable.

comments:
Nico is an AMAZING host, from day one till the end of my week stay he checked to make sure all was well & that I had everything I needed. The room was perfectly fine & I would gladly make another reservation if I’m heading back to that area.
Clean, cozy, relaxing vibe. Perfect for someone looking to remain comfortable throughout their trip.
summary: A clean, cozy, and relaxing room with a great host who ensured everything was well throughout the stay.

comments:
This was my second stay with Inge. As always, everything was great.
The accommodation is within ten minutes of the Tube station and shopping facilities are also close by. Here I can recommend Sainsburys near Hammersmith Station for a bigger purchase.
The room looks like the photos. There is enough space for one person, but it might be a bit cramped for two. However, since you can use the living room and kitchen, I thought it was fine.
The room can be darkened well, but it is a bit noisy because of the street. For noise-sensitive people like me, I can only recommend earplugs.
The kitchen was well equipped and everyone had their place in the fridge. Food could be prepared easily.
summary: The accommodation is great, but it can be a bit cramped for two people and noisy due to the street.

comments: Flat is in great location, walking distance to the Borough Markets, Modern Tate, Millennium Bridge and London Bridge. Plenty of bars, restaurants and shopping facilities in the surroundings. Flat accommodates easily 4 persons, but a couch was also available for our 10 ys old boy, who really enjoyed it! Flat is nice a well kept. Really recommend it!
summary: The flat is in a great location with plenty of amenities and accommodates easily four persons.

comments: I had a wonderful time in Camden with Jean! The room was cozy and exactly as described. It’s perfect if you like animals, because Jean has 2 wonderful dogs and 4 friendly cats. There’s so much to do close-by, with quick tube trips to all the must-see London destinations. I would recommend it to anyone, and hope to be able to return in the future!
summary: I had a wonderful time at Jean's place, which was cozy and exactly as described, perfect for animal lovers.

comments:
As a family of three I would not stay here again. The studio apartment is extremely small, like 100sq ft. It makes sense maybe for a traveling couple who needs a place to spend the night, but if it were more obvious how small the space was we would not have booked it.
In addition to the small room, we had issues with the app based door locks. We were locked out of our room for 45 minutes. During the summer not having any AC or decent airflow was also uncomfortable.
For a similar price there are several hotels in the area that offer amenities like common spaces, spas and dining.
I love nocarzs because they’re more like homes than a hotel room. However, the entire building has multiple tiny rooms operated by Billie and seemed more like a worse hotel experience ran by someone offsite than an authentic local nocarz experience.
Location is 10/10, rooms were clean and esthetic.
summary: The studio apartment is extremely small and had issues with door locks and no AC or decent airflow.

comments: I recently booked this exquisite nocarz property for two family members. The communication with the host was superb - they were very quick to respond to all of my queries and ensured the stay was as comfortable as possible. The property was clean and cosy, with interior beautifully decorated (exactly as shown on the photos). The location of the nocarz was also very convenient, with an easy access to various types of public transportation. I would definitely recommend this nocarz to others!
summary: The property was clean, cosy, and beautifully decorated, with excellent communication from the host.

comments: I had a great experience staying here - the co-host, Francesco, was always available and extremely responsive to all queries and requests I had. He also gave me a hand with the luggage (for over 3 floors) at the time of both check in and check out which was very generous on his side. It’s a busy street outside, that’s the only watch out if you’re a light sleeper - but it didn’t bother me at all. Definitely worth the price, especially given how easily accessible transport options to the rest of London are (2 mins for bus and 8ish mins for the tube)
summary: Great experience with responsive host Francesco, but noisy street outside

comments: Truly outstanding experience. I was looking for a place quite but not too far from the center where to stay in London and I really found it. Even though is a studio, the flat is quite big, very clean and well organized. it offers everything you need for the stay and it is located very closed to the station. The restaurants and shops around it are lovely. Thank you very much, I will definitively come back!
summary: Truly outstanding experience in a quiet and well-located studio flat

comments: I had a mostly perfectly good experience staying here, with the small caveat that the hosts accidentally booked me into the (quite considerably) smaller room! But they acknowledged the mistake quickly and took steps to reimburse me, which was great. It's worth noting that the room I stayed in is very small, and thought it was fine for my purposes -- basically sleeping! -- it's to be avoided if youre carrying a lot of luggage/require a bit more space to feel comfortable. Overall though, everything else was great. Donna is a kind, clear and responsive host, and the place itself is clean and tidy, and very near Brixton tube station, from where you can get to Central London very quickly. Would recommend!
summary: Good experience despite small room mistake, kind hosts and great location near Brixton tube station

comments:
Erno was great from start to finish. We requested to check in early and he was very accomodating to this. The location is superb as a stones throw from Hampstead Heath and the room was perfect to use as a base.
I will definitely be using this again when we come down to Londan so thanks Erno!!!!!
summary: Great host Erno and superb location near Hampstead Heath

comments:
I almost don't want to write a great review so I can keep this place a secret for myself. Evelyn and her cousin Mikela were amazing hosts, meeting me on-time to deliver the key and providing an excellent experience.
I came and used their flat as a base of operations for business, but being that it's in Camden Town and close to great food, nightlife, pubs, and history (so close to iconic musical landmarks!) not to mention the Camden tube station.
The building, view, people, and living space were amazing. This will be my go-to flat for business trips for the foreseeable future.
summary: Excellent experience with amazing hosts Evelyn and Mikela in a fantastic Camden Town location

comments:
Marianna and Paolo live in a lovely flat, well-placed for exploring central London. They are also very helpful with information about transport and things to do. Marianna was always prompt in replying to messages, and I knew I would feel welcome at their place.
The room is a good size. The bed is comfortable, and everything was very clean. The bathroom is modern and has a great shower. A towel is provided, but remember to bring your own toiletries.
I thoroughly recommend this place, and I have booked to go there again soon!
summary: Lovely flat with helpful hosts, clean room, and modern bathroom.

comments: Overall, the place was great. It was a little tucked away so went to wrong door at first (there was a 14 & 14A so be aware of that). We only had 2 critiques, 1) There should be at least 2 keys. I had a coworker with me and we were often going different directions, which made it awkward. 2) the Checkin and Checkout added time after a long travel day…it was inconvenient to go to another location to get your key and drop it off (especially when you’re trying to catch a plane and the place wasn’t open). I would love to see a Dropbox system or some other plan for that. However, our stay was great and the apartment was very nice and clean.
summary: Great place to stay, but could improve on key management and check-in/check-out process.

comments: Davide's apartment was a very nice house to stay for a few days. His friend Marc met me to give me the keys. It's located on a lovely street in Islington, about a 10 min walk from the nearest tube and a 25 min walk to King's Cross. It was a very comfortable stay.
summary: Comfortable stay in a nice house located in Islington with easy access to public transportation.

comments: Excellent communication, the flat was everything that the owner promised, and we enjoyed the location.  Camden is a great location for people who want to get away from the more touristy areas of central London but still have easy access.  Public transportation is close and convenient, as are many restaurants, shops, pubs, and Camden market.  The flat itself is clean, comfortable, and has all of the amenities advertised by the owner.  Joseph and Perry are professional, courteous, and quite easy to work with.  We enjoyed our stay and would recommend to anyone visiting London.
summary: Excellent communication, clean and comfortable flat in Camden with easy access to amenities.

comments: Looked exactly like the pictures, Daniel was extremely responsive and we felt really comfortable! The place was beautiful and we loved the artwork, also such a cool coffee maker in the cupboard! Originally had planned to go out but we stayed in due to the weather and it was a perfect cosy night in!
summary: Beautiful place that exceeded expectations, responsive host, and perfect for a cozy night in.

comments:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at an nocarz that exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the cleanliness of the space. It was spotless, with every corner meticulously tidied, which instantly made me feel comfortable and at home.
The convenience of the location was another major highlight. Situated near popular attractions, restaurants, and public transport, I found it incredibly easy to explore the area without any hassle. Everything I needed was just a short walk or quick ride away, making my stay all the more enjoyable.
What truly set this experience apart, however, was the responsiveness of the host. They were incredibly attentive, quick to answer any questions I had, and provided helpful recommendations for local hotspots. This level of communication made the whole experience seamless and stress-free.
Overall, I highly recommend this nocarz to anyone looking for a clean, convenient, and welcoming place to stay. I can't wait to return!
summary: The nocarz exceeded expectations with its cleanliness, convenient location, and responsive host.

comments:
The Renovated Apartment near Portobello Road Market is in a wonderful location in London. It's in a very upscale neighborhood with all of the niceties that come with that, but also easily accessible to the things you want to see as a tourist (best of both worlds). The apartment itself is very nice, and well cared for. It's clean and modern. The kitchen has the basics of what you will need including a wine cork opener. There is a book on the back of the front door with valuable information about the apartment, its appliances, and maps of the subways. That's a nice touch I have not had in an nocarz before. The host, Pedro, was in touch with me before, during and after our stay. He was able to answer questions and meet requests quickly. There are major streets on all sides nearby with excellent restaurants and shopping. There are also 3 train stops nearby, making it easy to get where you need to get easily. The apartment is on the edge of Hyde Park which is so pleasant and a great way to start or end your day. There is a washer and dryer in the apartment for clothing but also a laundromat next door if you need to do a lot of laundry! There is also a darling cafe next door for coffee and breakfast in the morning.
Very convenient. The only thing I would want a possible renter to know is that the apartment is on the 5th floor with no elevator. The hardest thing is carrying your luggage up the first time! I would stay here again, we enjoyed it very much and it was a good value for the money.
summary: The Renovated Apartment near Portobello Road Market is a clean, modern, and well-located place to stay with excellent communication from the host.

comments: We couldn’t recommend Maureen’s place more! She is very kind and very accommodating. She helped us with everything we needed. She showed us great places to go and she was great to talk to! The transportation into London is very convenient and her place is very clean and nice. She helped us with our laundry and showed us everywhere in town to get what we need. She picked us up from the train station to show us the quickest way to the house. She will help you with anything you need!
summary: Maureen's place was very clean, nice, and convenient with a kind and accommodating host who helped with everything.

comments:
Katy is such a knowledgeable and friendly host! She goes a love and beyond by sharing many suggestions in town and has such a welcoming a warm demeanor making the stay feel so homey! My dog loved her and she was so sweet with him.
The room is comfortable and clean with all amenities. The shared garden and living space is beautiful and very well-cared for.
The location was great and walkable to parks and Kingston/surbiton high street. Thanks for a great stay!! Would recommend this host!
Moku misses you!
summary: Katy's nocarz is a comfortable, clean, and homey place to stay with a knowledgeable and friendly host who made the stay feel so welcoming.

comments:
Clean and cozy ground floor flat, with a nice garden. The bed is super comfortable and the kitchen is equipped with everything. Great location with lots of transportation options. The house is located in a beautiful area, with lots of shops and restaurants. Easy check-in and very clear instructions for everything needed.
The host was super nice, accommodating us with early check-in and late check-out and promptly answering all our questions.
I will surely stay there again. Highly recommended.
summary: The ground floor flat was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with a great location and accommodating host.

comments: Clean flat with lots of natural light. Comfortable clean beds in the room that was spacious for the three of us. The balcony which overlooks the green catches the morning sun and was a fab place to spend some time. Kitchen also well equipped. Tonnes of coffee shops near by and a stones through to the flower market. Having lived in London, it was awesome going out in the evening and being able to walk home from Shoreditch. Thanks Taylan!
summary: Clean flat with lots of natural light in a great location near Shoreditch.

comments:
Die Wohnung sah genauso aus wie auf den Bildern. Wir haben uns während unseres viernächtigen Aufenthalts wohlgefühlt. Sie war sauber und gut ausgestattet, es hat uns an nichts gefehlt.
Die nächste DLR-Station, die eine schnelle Verbindung ins Zentrum Londons bietet, ist nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt. Ein kleiner Supermarkt mit gutem Sortiment ist ebenfalls in kurzer Distanz fußläufig erreichbar. Der Gastgeber war sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und hat schnell auf unsere Anfragen reagiert. Bei unserer Ankunft wurden wir herzlich von Daniel begrüßt.
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt in London genossen, und Daniel sowie sein Apartment haben wesentlich dazu beigetragen.
summary: The apartment was clean and well-equipped, with a friendly and helpful host.

comments: Luke's flat is bright, airy, and much more spacious than the pictures make out. It is located a short walk from Vauxhall or Waterloo underground stations, and is surrounded by nice pubs (can recommend The Rose and Tamesis Dock). It's also a stone's throw to Westminster and the surrounding area, which was perfect for our short break in London. Check-in was easy and convenient. The flat is kitted out to a fantastic standard, all new and shiny, which made for a very pleasant stay. Thank you so much!
summary: Luke's flat is bright, airy, and spacious, with a fantastic standard of equipment.

comments:
Maggie and Lawrence are a dream to deal with. I arrived slightly early and they let me have access to the flat to drop my stuff off despite that. They are always responsive and helpful.
The place is in such a great location with access to some of the best attractions in minutes, as well as extremely close to the tube.
summary: Maggie and Lawrence are great hosts who made our stay easy and convenient.

comments: Our family of five stayed 5 nights at Christopher's place and had a wonderful time. The apartment is a short walk to the heart of Richmond and is close to buses and the train. The place was extremely clean and had everything we needed. Christopher answered all our questions promptly and was very helpful and considerate. I highly recommend staying at Christopher's place.
summary: Christopher's apartment was clean and well-equipped, in a great location near Richmond.

comments: The shower curtain rod was held together with sticking plaster and the curtain was a major trip hazard. The shower rose would not stay in place and kept falling down. The heated towel rail leaked on the floor. The TV remote was missing and, even though a TV was not mentioned in the amenities list, it was in the photos of the flat. No tea towel to dry the dishes we washed up.
summary: The flat had several issues with the shower curtain rod, shower rose, heated towel rail, and TV remote.

comments: My stay at Maryams exceeded my expectations :) the space has lots of light beaming in from the roof and I appreciated her decor, paintings and plants! Maryam was friendly, accommodating and also respected my privacy. Her place and my room was well equipped with everything I needed. It was warm, clean, comfy and has everything you need for a brilliant stay. I think the price is also very reasonable for the area. I did lots of research on the area and if you are looking to show up and have everything taken care of in a lovely, well cared for home, this is fantastic option for the price! I really felt at home, thank you Maryam x
summary: The reviewer was extremely satisfied with their stay at Maryam's place, praising its cleanliness, comfort, and amenities.

comments:
Guys, I strongly recommend this place for you. Actually it’s a home. Me and my husband we felt exactly like this : “home”. Ethel and Mirek they are so kind, helpful, with a huge heart ❤️. They were so kind to me that our goodbye was difficult for me , I’ll miss your conversations🥲. So yes if you want to be in a place that is beyond your expectations that is the place.
The room is very comfortable, the bathroom is very nice and extremely clean. The kitchen has everything that you need to cook. The location is excellent, just a short walk and you are on Archway Station. Nearby have a lot of options of supermarkets and restaurants. The neighborhood is safe and in front of the house there is lovely small park to enjoy the nature while you walk through the area.
We spent one month and we didn’t have anything to complain. Thanks again for everything!
Next time in London I don’t need to search for a place to stay, for sure it’s going to be here. 🌷
summary: The reviewers were very happy with Ethel and Mirek's home, describing it as 'beyond their expectations' in terms of comfort, cleanliness, and location.

comments: location is good, apartment has everything it needs as a standard. only drawback is the shower, the ventilation system is not working wich makes the whole apartment damp. this also results in mold in Some places of the house. the temperature in the apartment is cool wich is great in hot summer days as we had. We would recommend this apartment when the damp and mold problem is fixed.
summary: The apartment had a good location but was marred by issues with the shower and ventilation system, leading to dampness and mold.

comments: Chris’s place is a real hidden gem. Great location near to Earl’s Court tube station, lots of shops and restaurants nearby. The place was just like the photos and very clean, and we found it very quiet despite it being near a main road. Very easy check in too, definitely recommend staying here.
summary: Chris's place was described as a 'hidden gem' due to its great location, cleanliness, and quiet atmosphere.

comments: Our family of 5 had a great stay in Dani's place. She gave us easy to follow instructions to get there from St Pancras and was there waiting to meet us. We very much appreciated the fresh fruit and chocolate fingers and having the place warm when we arrived. She gave some great advice on how to get to the main attractions and there are plenty of transport options from the accommodation. The kitchen had most cookware needed to do your own meals if thats what you want and enough cutlery/crockery and glassware. There were even somebasic supplies which we were welcome to use. Would definitely recommend my friends and family stay here if they come to London.
summary: The host Dani provided easy instructions and warm accommodation with fresh fruit and chocolate.

comments: Paola is incredibly hospitable with a lovely personality. She is always happy to share many local tips about what to do, see and eat in the area and beyond!  She is also very respectful and you can be 100% independent as well...Her place is fully equipped for long (or short) term stays and is always very well kept. The location is minutes from the tube station and in general very well connected (underground runs 24h on Fridays and Saturdays, multiple buses &trains from Alexandra palace too). Very highly recommend !!!
summary: Paola is an incredibly hospitable host who shares local tips and has a well-equipped and clean apartment.

comments: Seans place is really gorgeous! I loved the decor and it looked exactly like it does in the photos. Very cosy space and the most comfortable nocarz bed I've ever had!! It's super easy to find and a short 5 minute walk from the nearest tube station. Highly recommend staying here to anyone.
summary: Sean's place is gorgeous, cozy, and comfortable with easy access to the tube station.

comments: Le logement est impeccable, il y a tout ce que nous avons besoin dedans. Le jardin est un vrai plus même si nous n'avons pas pu en profiter faute de temps... De plus, l'appartement est très bien situé! A une station de Liverpool Street, qui vous permet de vous mener dans chaque coins de Londres. Nous ne regrettons pas d'avoir choisi le logement de Jane et Colin, qui sont des hôtes très chaleureux!
summary: Jane and Colin's apartment is immaculate, well-located near Liverpool Street Station, and has a lovely garden.

comments:
We had an incredible stay at this nocarz! The location was absolutely perfect, subway is right around the corner.
The neighbourhood felt safe, allowing us to relax and enjoy our time. There are plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby.
The flat exceeded our expectations in terms of comfort, space, and style – everything felt brand new. We especially loved the modern design.
The apartment has a balcony with a delightful view, adding an extra touch of charm to our stay.
A few cons: in the apartment the doors are heavy, so we couldn’t keep them open and there were a couple of minor inconveniences, such as the laundry located in the hallway and some litter in the streets, but these were easily outweighed by the overall positive experience.
All in all we would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a nice stay in the area.
summary: The nocarz exceeded expectations in comfort, space, and style with a perfect location and balcony view.

comments: My expectations were exceeded in every sense. I was a bit concerned by a previous poor review, but that seemed inconsistent with other guests' experience, so I thought maybe I should ignore that as being one of those things. I was right to think that way. Alex was super efficient and clear in her communications and the flat itself is in a really convenient location for transport, dining, shopping, culture and entertainment. The flat was clean and tidy (albeit it is Alex's home, so it holds her possessions - for example, the bathroom is full of products) and well equipped.  Everything I needed worked, the bed (comfy), the fridge (cold), the heating (warm), the shower (warm and wet), the oven (hot), the hob (flames), pots, pans, crockery and cutlery all available. You get the picture - it was great!
summary: Guest had a great experience with Alex's flat, finding it clean, well-equipped, and in a convenient location.

comments:
The room is wide and lightful.
Andrew has been a very good host. He is gentle and helpful, and do everything is possible to make you feeling fine.
The strongest aspect of the location is the position: the area is nice and cool and you can reach very easily Portobello road, for instance.
The Tube stop of Ladbroke grove is so close you can achieve it in five minutes by walking. So Andrew's home is very stictly connected with all city.
I recommend Andrew's home to anyone who like this kind of aspect.
summary: Andrew was a good host, providing a comfortable room in a nice area close to public transportation.

comments: Staying at Grant's place has caused me unnecessary stress that I hope to help future tenants to avoid. The apartment is decorated fairly nicely but if you are an animal lover beware that there are stuffed dead animals everywhere in the apartment including the bedrooms. Grant decided to have the washing machine engineer welcome us as we came in. The repair work took the engineer a while into our check in time and left an unbearable odour due to the drainage from the machine. This odour filled the entire apartment. The apartment came with one single stocking that was draped behind the bath tub. I can't imagine that was part of the furniture so must have been left by a previous tenant and the apartment obviously wasnt cleaned properly. Grant failed to leave us a key and we were not provided with a key until about 4 hours after check in. We checked out leaving the place spotless and even left a bottle of wine to say Thank You for trying. Grant decided to try and accuse us of leaving a mark on one of his side tables and tried to fine us. Fortunately we had taken photos of damage in the apartment at check in so were able to provide images with time stamps showing the damage 18 minutes into check in while his engineer was still there. He then tried to accuse us of having a party for 21 people and having been noisy almost two hours after we can prove we left the flat. Interesting how this didn't come up until his failed attempt at extorting £35 for damage we didn't cause. As Grant had no evidence to back his claims the dispute has now been resolved by air bnb. Best thing about the apartment was the location but it is still extremely over priced.
summary: Guest had a stressful experience with Grant's apartment due to issues with cleanliness and communication.

comments: Clare kept in touch with me from start to finish and was always very polite and helpful. The Apartment itself was very clean and it had everything we needed. The large Double bed was very comfortable indeed and the quality of everything inside was outstanding. The apartment is a 5 minute walk away to the Fulham Broadway Underground station and its also very close to some excellent restaurants and bars. Thank you Clare for a wonderful experience. The apartment was perfect. :)
summary: Clare's apartment was clean, well-equipped, and comfortable, with great location and excellent service.

comments: Lovely apartment with three double bedrooms on a quiet road with easy access to transport. Top bedroom is ensuite with terrace offering views over the rooftops. Great to have an outdoor space. Two bedrooms on the main floor, one is en suite as well as a main bathroom. This is Zara’s home so lots of artwork and nic nacs everywhere. Great pub around the corner serving Thai food and a roaring real fire. Handy corner shop two doors down supplying all basic provisions. 10-15 mins walk to tube stations. We were three friends and loved having our own room and bathroom.
summary: Zara's apartment was lovely, with a quiet location, easy access to transport, and a great outdoor space.

comments: We spent very good time in London, our host was very helpful, aproachable, supporting, always responded to messages quickly. George helped us throgh the reservation and made our nocarz experience pleasant. It was our first trip to UK so we very much appreciated George's assistance. The appartment was easy to find, good instructions given. We had all we needed in it, clean kitchen with all necessery tools, big bath :) 2 separate bedrooms giving privacy to parents and to kids. Nice leaving room with balcony and beautifull view. Bus stop just next to the building, Lewisham DLR and train stations very close making it easy to reach London center. Tesco supermarket walking distance, open till midnight. The surroudings were calm and peacefull so we felt secure and enjoyed every day of our stay.
summary: Guests had a great time in London, praising their host George for his helpfulness and the apartment's cleanliness and location.

comments:
The place was fantastic. It is very well located on the best functioning tube lines in London, has a lovely Saturday morning farmers market nearby. There is a supermarket in super close walking distance and lots of busses in all directions.
Charlotte was a great host and game me lots of tips.
I had a great time
summary: The guest loved the apartment's location, host Charlotte's tips, and overall experience.

comments:
Très bonne expérience.
Nous avons été accueilli chaleureusement par Toby, nous avons pu déposer nos bagages et découvrir aussitôt un pub de qualité au coin de la rue.
Le logement est petit mais très bien agencé, équipé de tout le confort (électroménager, rangements). Des miroirs permettent de donner une belle impression d'espace.
Le spa est vraiment très agréable.
Le logement était particulièrement propre à notre arrivée.
Le quartier est calme et très bien desservi (métro, lignes de bus).
summary: Guests had a great stay in Paris (not London), praising the apartment's comfort, cleanliness, and Toby's hospitality.

comments: This is a great find!  It is very well located with easy access to local shops and the train into central London. There are a lot of local walks which are pretty and easy to find.  The flat is very well equipped and comfortable - with quiet nights, which was unexpected for London! Joan went out of her way to be helpful and made sure that we were happy and everything was fine.
summary: The guest enjoyed the apartment's location, equipment, and Joan's helpfulness.

comments: A beautiful house in a great location. We really enjoyed our stay for Christmas with our party of 7 people. We found the house very well appointed, stylish and comfortable. The host made a lot of effort to make it look beautiful and very clean before we arrived. The host was very responsive and had excellent communication. We would definitely recommend staying here. Just a little warning to those less mobile - there are a lot of stairs!
summary: Guests had a great stay in this house for Christmas, praising its style, comfort, and host's communication.

comments: Needed a place to spend the night after Barry Manilow’s show and Steve’s place was perfect. Location was great and our room was clean and beds were comfy. The common bathroom wasn’t very clean as there were other people staying in the other rooms of the condo unit, but this is something beyond Steve’s control. Overall would recommend his place!
summary: Clean and comfy room in a great location, minor issue with bathroom cleanliness.

comments: Michael & Lara are super hosts, we’ve had a minor issue on the arrival day, but they sorted out in no time, very efficient. We loved their flat, the plants make it warmer. We spent there a weekend. The area has lots to discover. Definitely will recommend Michael & Lara’s place. Thanks!
summary: Super hosts with a lovely flat in a great area, minor arrival day issue was quickly resolved.

comments:
- The flat was nice and clean!
- The instructions were clear and the prepared file was amazing!
- The host was very responsive and helpful!
- The location is not bad, since there was a station nearby.
However, there are some points to be done.
- The fridge was smelly and it wasn’t working at the beginning until I turned it on (maybe the smell was because it wasn’t on? I’m not sure).
- One of the A/C remotes is not working, so I had to use the other one for both A/Cs.
summary: Nice clean flat with good instructions, but some issues with fridge and A/C remotes.

comments:
Location is near to Whitechapel Station, 2-3 mins walk, and walkable to Tower Bridge, approximately 15 mins.
It was abit noisy during the night due to the proximity to the road and junction, especially sirens from ambulances as it was near to a hospital. Rooms are smaller than expected.
Overall, it was still a decent place to stay.
summary: Decent place to stay near Whitechapel Station, but noisy at night due to road proximity.

comments:
A lovely place, a great location, very clean, very smooth communication. You can tell that the owner put an artistic personal touch to the place. The projector in the bedroom was great, loved the selection of French romance movies!
Great kitchen and dining area, lots of great places to work from. Great views!
The only note would be that it could use a fresh coat of paint to freshen the place up a bit.
summary: Lovely artistic place in a great location, very clean and smooth communication.

comments: The house was quite lovely in a minimalistic way. The location in Chelsea was central and fantastic! Amazing for all the sightseeing we did. There were plenty of cafes, bars and a  Sainsbury market nearby. I do wish however that the house had been a little better equipped (especially for the price paid) We were staying for seven days and would have felt more at home had the hosts provided some more essentials like oil, salt-pepper, coffee machine, washing detergent, dishwasher tablets, etc. Also, it would have been nicer to relax some evenings if the tv had a chromecast or some streaming service. However, the hosts were very responsive and provided us with detergent and dish washer tablets when we requested them. They were also flexible and allowed us to check in early. Overall, a smooth and enjoyable stay.
summary: Lovely house in Chelsea with central location, but could be better equipped for the price.

comments:
We were 3 adults and 2 children.
The apartment was spacious enough and very comfortable.
Everything was clean. Everything worked. The kids loved the playstation, Netflix, etc.
The location is indeed perfect!
Even if it gets a bit noisy - it goes quiet at 23:00.
The AC is a huge advantage - end of August can get hot.
Ryan was very helpful. Responsive. Proactive.
The only bad thing I have to say is that the water pressure was very low on the showers.
Ryan did send someone to try and fix it the following day, but it didn't help much.
Overall - AMAZING apartment.
summary: Spacious and comfortable apartment with perfect location, but had some issues with water pressure.

comments: Binit's flat is conveniently located in a central area of London. My friend and I stayed there only for one night. Unfortunately, we didn't have the chance to meet Binit because he was traveling, but he made sure that we had everything we needed. Checking in was not a problem, we collected the keys from the concierge (the security guys were very kind but also made sure that we had a confirmation, etc.) The cleaner was at the flat when we arrived. She was a very friendly woman. The place was very clean and confortable. I highly recommend it.
summary: Conveniently located flat in central London with friendly host and clean accommodation.

comments:
Gabe was a great host! Easy to communicate with and very welcoming.
The room was lovely and spacious for me and my two friends. The beds were super comfy. The accommodation was peaceful and warm. There was a separate toilet as well as the one in the bathroom. Both next to the bedroom. We were given some space in Gabe's fridge and we were able to leave our luggage before check in and after check out which made our short break so much easier to enjoy.
The location is ideal. Just a couple of minutes walk from Paddington Railway Station and tube and not too far to walk to central London if you enjoy walking.
I highly recommend Gabe's place. I definitely hope to return.
summary: Peaceful and spacious room with welcoming host and ideal location near Paddington Station.

comments: Preciosa casa con todo lo necesario para pasar una agradable estancia en Londres.  Después de un ajetreado día en la ciudad, te encuentras con la tranquilidad necesaria para recuperar. Tiene cerca un gran supermercado, dos paradas de metro a 10 min y puedes acceder a pie en 30 min a Westminster.
summary: Quiet and well-equipped house in a great location for exploring London.

comments:
We initially booked a different apartment, but due to an unexpected technical issue, the host promptly offered us a similar alternative. The replacement apartment was larger than the one we initially booked, well-equipped with all the necessary amenities, and located in a very convenient area close to shops, restaurants, and the metro.
What really stood out, though, was the host's hospitality. Ben was proactive and helpful throughout our stay. We were greeted with a welcome treat, and they even offered to do some shopping for us. Their attention to detail and genuine care for our needs made the experience truly enjoyable.
Overall, it was a wonderful stay and I would highly recommend this host to anyone looking for a hassle-free and pleasant nocarz experience!
summary: Host Ben provided excellent hospitality and attention to detail in this convenient London apartment.

comments:
If you are in London for shows or shopping, Ivan's place makes a great base! It's only 5 minutes from the tube and a 30 minute ride to the west end, so what's not to like?
He keeps it nicely decorated and furnished, so expect a comfortable and spotlessly clean environment.
Bonus: Ivan is a cool guy, flexible on checking in and out!
summary: Ivan's place is a great base for exploring London, with a comfortable and clean environment.

comments: Great location in terms of getting around central London, close stations and lots to do around. The actual room was nice and serviceable but I had a lot of issues with the Wi-Fi and I received zero response when I enquired into it. Plus if you’re sensitive to noise then you might struggle with how thin the walls are; the conversations and music played by my neighbours were incredibly loud whenever they were in, but the streets are at least quiet when the window is shut.
summary: This location is great for getting around central London, but be aware of thin walls and potential Wi-Fi issues.

comments: Un vrai nocarz (c’est le logement principal  de Leila et ses deux enfants). On s’y sent bien. Par ailleurs, la cuisine est pratique et bien équipée. Le salon et le balcon avec une vue sur un arbre et le ciel ont été appréciés. Le logement se situe à proximité de différents commerces. Nous partions tous les jours à vélo dans le cœur de Londres via le Burgess park (et, un peu plus loin, le Rocketvan bar, un bar sympa avec une programmation musicale que l’on a apprécié après nos visites dans Londres). comptez environ 30 minutes entre le logement et le centre. Si vous revenez à vélo de Brixton, une pause à la micro brasserie supercute brewhouse s’impose également.
summary: Leila's apartment is a cozy home away from home with a practical kitchen and lovely balcony.

comments: Good value, rather old building but everything one needs on a short trip was available, very quiet and safe area, kind hosts. Unfortunately the heating didn't work at all on the first night and after fixing it only one radiator went on. It was rather cold. I told Thea and I hope she fixed that. The kitchen was fairly clean but some parts were a little "sticky".  Allover, besides the heating problem, we had a nice, quiet stay.
summary: Thea's place offers good value for a short trip, but be aware of potential heating issues and cleanliness concerns.

comments: We have stayed in many holiday rentals across Europe and well beyond.  This is one of the best apartments we have experienced.  Quite apart from the splendid decor, the comfort of ensuite bathroom, and the peace and quiet of a penthouse apartment away from roads and traffic, the facilities were top-class.   We enjoy cooking as it happens.  Rarely have we had a kitchen in a holiday apartment which was so well equipped !  And as for entertainment - what more do you need than a big smartTV with Sky and Sky Sports !   And Bob is the perfect host - no intrusion but always in touch if needed, while Gill gave us an excellent introduction to the apartment.  We stayed a month (in between house sale and purchase) but we would happily have stayed very much longer !
summary: This penthouse apartment was one of the best holiday rentals we've experienced, with top-class facilities and a perfect host.

comments: I rented the flat with my family, so 2 adults and 4 kids (from 9 to 15); for 3 nights. Instructions sent by Carlos were pretty clear to find and open the flat. This flat definitely shows value for money. It is conviently located 1 minute from a bus station with several lines, and also close to a few shops and markets to buy food for instance. The three rooms are nice, the kitchen is okay, with the necessary electrical appliances (though a bit more tableware would have been useful for 6). As we were 6, we moved some furniture to have breakfast and dinner in the same room, and it went fine. The only drawback is the noise from the road: if you're not used to sleep with noise (or with earplugs), it'll be difficult for you. That being said, the flat remains a good compromise, for the price, the location and the size. So I'd recommend.
summary: The flat shows value for money, but be aware that it can be noisy due to its location near a road.

comments:
I had a lovely stay with Elizabeth & her family. All was well. It was a pleasure to meet Elizabeth, her husband, & her daughter, Seraphina. Everyone was very kind.
Elizabeth's place is very well situated for local shops & bus stops. It's a bit further from Stratford than I thought but close to bus stops & very close to Maryland on the Elizabeth Line.
I was very happy that I could use the kitchen to cook my food. The bathroom was very clean & all facilities including bed were good! Thanks so much for your help Elizabeth & Seraphina!
All Blessings & Good Wishes,
Kate
summary: Elizabeth's place was well-situated, clean, and comfortable, with kind hosts who made Kate feel welcome.

comments: Première expérience avec nocarz et franchement une réussite;  le logement correspond exactement ce que représente les photos, très calme et très fonctionnel, indépendant au sein de la maison et tout proche du Tube, à 20 minutes du coeur de Londres. De plus l'accueil est des plus sympathiques. Je ne peux que recommander.
summary: The independent flat was quiet, functional, and close to the Tube, with friendly hosts who provided a great experience.

comments:
Definitely too small for any more than 4 guests. Wi-Fi is not great and we had to buy more toilet paper ourselves after two nights. Shower is extremely small and the door doesn’t lock.
But overall still worth the price. Great location near the tube and restaurants. Easy to find and host is very responsive. Enjoyed our stay!
summary: While small and with some issues like Wi-Fi and toilet paper, the flat is still worth the price due to its location near the tube and restaurants.

comments:
If you don't have any problem with small and cozy room. This is the perfect place for you. Everything in the home was clean and organized. Beautiful decor and interior. It was exactly like the photos.
Ailsa is a super friendly host. She is helpful and makes you feel right at home. I really enjoyed my stay here. Would recommend to everyone. My stay went smoothly and without any problem :)
summary: Perfect small and cozy room with a friendly host who made me feel at home.

comments:
Rachel & Ted Made me feel so welcome it's 6 months since my last stay, what a wonderful place. Only a 10 minute walk to the tube station and within 20 minutes you are in central London.

Their home is brilliant they are excellent hosts; willing to share local knowledge of events and places to visit. Its a home in which you can relax, read a book, watch TV or recover from a long & busy day.
summary: Wonderful place to stay with welcoming hosts who share local knowledge and make you feel relaxed.

comments: Had amazing stay cozy and clean thanks again Sahel place was clean accessible lots of amenities in the apartment felt at home it was very close to train links east to get around  many places walkable and train line got me to many locations in London area was lovely too nice local restaurants and bars nearby would highly recommended staying here
summary: Clean and accessible apartment with many amenities, close to train links and nice local restaurants.

comments: A really lovely room that had a little fridge and a microwave and kettle. Jonathan couldn’t have been nicer and I’d recommend this room to anyone, although I will say that the stairs leading to the attic room are a bit steep and narrow so if you have mobility issues it might not be for you. Otherwise the bathroom was huge with a great shower, wifi worked extremely well and there’s a big supermarket nearby.
summary: Lovely room with a fridge and microwave, but steep stairs may be a problem for those with mobility issues.

comments: Lovely little treasure. Great value for money. Nina was a lovely host, really accommodating. She was quick at responding and just a pleasure to deal with in general. Love how big the space actually is, with the bathroom and kitchen being separate really makes the place feel very homey and not on top of yourself. Will be booking again, absolutely loved it.
summary: Great value for money with a lovely host who made me feel at home in a spacious apartment.

comments:
Katherine's flat is a lovely oasis in the hustle and bustle of London.
It is lovely, clean and bright, just what you need after a long day out and about. I stayed here with my baby daughter and it was the perfect place to come back to and relax.
The street and surrounding area is very central with all the amenities one needs.
Katherine is a very helpful, friendly and kind host. I would definitely come back here if/when I return.
summary: Katherine's flat is a lovely oasis in the hustle and bustle of London with excellent amenities and a very helpful host.

comments: Maria's flat is spacious, clean and tidy. Maria herself is a very helpful and responsive host. She even ordered an ironing board after I asked if she had one. I have just moved back to the UK from living abroad, and am living in temporary accommodation in London while looking for a permanent home. Maria's flat was a very convenient place to spend a couple of weeks.
summary: Maria's flat was clean, spacious, and conveniently located for a temporary stay in London with a responsive and helpful host.

comments:
Stayed a couple of nights at James’ place on business. As an ex Notting Hill resident, I knew the location would be perfect for me, in between various tube stations and close to my favourite restaurants.
James is really friendly and accommodating. Check is was flexible as I was on my way to the office. I look forward to staying again soon!
summary: James' place is perfectly located for business travelers with a friendly and accommodating host.

comments:
It was a great apartment and nelson is very helpful.
But be aware that the apartment in the top floor and there is no elevators !
but otherwise all was good and it is a clean specious apartment in great neighborhood and its totally safe and near bus stops.
Thank you nelson
summary: Nelson's apartment was great but be aware that it's on the top floor without an elevator.

comments:
Amazing Apartment and Amazing Host
I stayed for a few days with my wife and two children. Very clean apartment with everything you need for a comfortable stay. Swimming pool and gym were great. Everybody we met at the block were friendly. The location was brilliant. Very close to a tube station and a number of things walkable too.
Host was brilliant. Very good communication and helped with any questions we had. She was extremely flexible during the uncertainty of possible restrictions.
If you are looking for a place to stay in London I highly recommend this apartment.
summary: The apartment had everything needed for a comfortable stay with excellent amenities, a brilliant location, and a very good host.

comments:
This apartment is ideally located half way between Kings Cross and Euston - both easy walking distance.
I arrived quite late, and Patsy was waiting for me with a very efficient check-in.
The bedroom was a great size, huge comfortable bed, lots of natural light, and easy to control heating.
The best surprise of all was how quiet the location was - never stayed in London at such a peaceful location, had a great night’s sleep relative to some of the hotels I’ve stayed in before.
Patsy was friendly, hospitable and generous, and very discrete.
I’d definitely recommend this place, and I’ll be staying again.
summary: Great location, friendly host, and comfortable accommodation.

comments: Siamo stati per una settimana nell’appartamento che avevamo tutto per noi come l’host ci aveva riferito. La posizione è comoda per raggiungere la stazione di London Victoria in soli 20 minuti, da cui passano le metro con cui raggiungere qualsiasi zona. Altrimenti sono frequenti anche i pullman, più economici ma a causa del traffico un po’ meno veloci. Il quartiere è tranquillo, e sulla strada dalla stazione all’appartamento ci sono un sacco di villette tipiche del Paese 😍. Ci sono negozi e ristoranti, fast food e caffè, quindi se non si vuole spostarsi verso il centro c’è comunque qualcosa da fare. L’unica pecca è il balcone che piace tanto ai piccioni.. praticamente non l’abbiamo mai usato ma non era indispensabile.
summary: Convenient location, quiet neighborhood, but some issues with the balcony.

comments: The check in to get the keys is in a grocery store a mile away. They do not tell you this before you rent. It makes checking in and out a pain. They gave us 1 roll of toilet paper for a week then said we must buy after inquiring about more. The place was super hot and the kitchen was very very bare bones stocked. Upon check out I had asked the woman working downstairs if we can leave our bags for an hour while we ride the cable car. She said no problem as long as it was only an hour so we bought tickets. Then when we went to take our luggage another woman said absolutely not so our money on the tickets was wasted as well. This place was a disaster from check in to check out. I’ve stayed in nocarzs all over the world for over 10 years and this was the worst experience I’ve had. I PROMISE you your money will be better spent at the holiday inn express across the street. This place was terrible
summary: Terrible experience from check-in to check-out, poor communication, and basic amenities.

comments:
It does exactly what it says on the tin.
So central and 6 minutes walk from the Royal Opera House in a well lit route. This was the purpose of my trip and it ticked all the boxes.
Basic accommodation but everything was clean and just as promised.
A real find for me.
I could become a regular!
summary: Basic accommodation in a fantastic central location that met all expectations.

comments:
I had a great stay in this apartment. It is sizeable for London and the location is fantastic. The apartment is done nicely and has a range of amenities. The only thing that could have been improved in the apartment was the bed - it's quite low and the mattress is a bit soft.
I didn't meet the hosts - I received the access codes which allowed me to check in and out without having to arrange to meet someone. It was very convenient. I am traveling on business and the flat was perfect for that - a table to work at, fast wifi and easy plug points.
There is a lot of construction going on in the area, so if you are hoping to sleep in very late, that's not going to happen given the noise. However, I generally didn't find the construction particularly disruptive.
If you are new to London and you are looking for local hosts you can get to know, this is not the place for you. But if you want an apartment with your own space, in a fantastic location for both work and play, this is an excellent option.
summary: Great location, comfortable space, and convenient self-check-in process, but some minor issues with the bed and construction noise.

comments: Overall a great budget stay! The location isn’t ideal although it still felt safe- it’s just far away from many things- although in a city as large as London I would guess many places are. The place was clean, secure, and had any amenity you could want. Only complaint with the actual space was that the bed was very uncomfortable. In the end I’m glad I stayed at Ben’s place!
summary: Great budget stay with clean and secure space, but uncomfortable bed

comments: The location is amazing! So many great little shops and restaurants are nearby, and it's just a quick scenic walk from Victoria station. I worried about the shared bathroom but it was not an issue at all. Alessandro also left little welcome treats for us to use throughout our stay. Recommended.
summary: Excellent location and amenities, recommended for its proximity to Victoria station

comments:
Our stay was for six nights with an average of 3 guests. Apartment was very spacious, and if someone was watching TV the sound did not leak into either bedroom which was nice. Only the one TV in the living area. Had a working coffee maker, microwave, stove, oven and washer/dryer combo. Wifi was slow, only ~7mbps.
The beds are super firm, and need updating.
Issue with the bathrooms, the showers couldn't be used at the same time. So we would have to run the bathroom sink faucet to get the shower in that bathroom to turn on. Hot water worked once we found instructions that were hidden that said to use the nest to control the water heater. The shared bathroom toilet doesn't flush properly.
summary: Spacious apartment with some issues with bathrooms and WiFi speed

comments: Nice little place to call home while in London. Tidy, clean and, in a great location with nearby shops and excellent transport links. The train station and bus stops is mere minutes away, with frequent service. To cap it all off Ailsa, is a friendly host and very responsive to any questions you may have. Would definitely stay again should the occasion arise.
summary: Tidy and clean place in a great location with friendly host Ailsa

comments:
We had a fantastic stay at Peter's. The apartment is located right on Brick Lane, perfect if you want to spend your time shopping for vintage clothes and exploring Shoreditch as we did. We were able to walk everywhere and never had to take the tube. Despite being on a lively street, our room was quiet, for it was at the back of the house. It was clean and smelled nice and towels were provided. The apartment has all you need for a comfortable stay, including a large dvd collection.
Peter is a wonderful host, he was so helpful, polite and communication was perfect! We enjoyed having a chat with him and felt very much at home. We also fell in love with Jazz and Jack (Peter's cats). We absolutely recommend staying here!
summary: Fantastic stay at Peter's apartment on Brick Lane with perfect location and host

comments:
nous sommes restés 3 nuits dans cet appartement.
L'arrivée est simple avec la boîte à clé.
le jour de départ, un rangement vous permet de stocker vos valises si vous ne partez pas de suite, ce qui est bien pratique.
le logement est très bien situé, à proximité du métro, ce qui nous a permi de visiter facilement une bonne partie de Londres. De plus, le marché de Candem, accessible à pieds de l'appartement, est vraiment génial.
La communication avec notre hôte a été parfaite, elle a été très réactive et n'a pas hésité à se déplacer en cas de besoin.
L'appartement était propre et tout est pensé dans le detail (boîte à pharmacie, café, savons...).
Je vous recommande cet appartement.
summary: The apartment was well-located, clean, and had everything needed for a comfortable stay.

comments:
This is not a dream home... because it's REAL. Everything has a furnishing (finishing geddit?) touch to it, from the dimmable lights to the extra cushions. You literally have everything you need. The Nest function is pretty nifty also - very handy in the fickle English weather hahaha.
Our favourite part is the kitchen - every single thing you could want to cook/bake (yes, bake!) is possible. Spices? Check. Oven? Check. Cleaning supplies? Check check check. And if you need groceries, you'll be spoilt for choice with the multiple supermarkets around, all within a maximum 10 mins walk. Highly recommend the Turkish marts nearby as well for some awesome pawsome treats in there. Lots of vegan options nearby in the Angel/Islington area if anyone's looking! This location is top-notch for travelling into Zone 1 too.
And thank goodness for Marc on checkout day. Without him, who would have known how we'd manage to carry our luggage down the steps. Phew! nocarz PLUS indeed!!
summary: The apartment was fully equipped with modern amenities and had a great location near multiple supermarkets and public transportation.

comments:
Samantha is just amazing. As I was flying in late sure waited up for me and kept in constant contact to make sure I arrived OK.
She is the friend you never knew you had and is just amazing. I will be going back over the next few weeks and I can't wait!
highly recommend 👌
summary: Samantha was an amazing host who waited up late to ensure the guest's arrival and provided excellent communication throughout their stay.

comments: The house is located in a very nice area and it is just 5 min away from the tube and bus stops. The kitchen is very spacious  and it has a lot of light, it has everything you may need, the bathroom was sparkling clean.  The room is very cosy and cute with plenty of storage. Lily has been a great host, she was very welcoming and kind. I totally recommend staying here.
summary: The house was located in a nice area with easy access to public transportation and had a clean and spacious kitchen and bathroom.

comments: The unit in Wapping was perfect for a family trip to London. Close to Tower of London in a quiet neighborhood. Easy access to restaurants and across the street from a grocery store. All other sight seeing was a 10-15 min walk to the tube or boat and then 30 min ride. We would recommend this to families with kids who can handle the commute or walk. Overall, a great stay!
summary: The apartment was perfect for families with kids, offering a quiet neighborhood, easy access to restaurants and grocery stores, and a short commute to major attractions.

comments:
Everything was what I expected. Great location host helpful. Very clean tidy.
My only two observations were I had a lot of luggage many tight stairs, my fault for not thinking about luggage. I mentioned to Jessica the lack of closet hanging space for cloths. Otherwise I would recommend this studio to anyone. Happy. Nice job.
summary: Great location, clean, and helpful host, with only minor issues with luggage space.

comments: The living room with balcony was really great. It's a bit annoying that the window in the bedroom can't be fully opened, especially in a very hot summer day. The location is great. A little suggestion, maybe the shower head should be changed, some spots quite rusted. But all those are little bits and pieces, didn't bother at all for my stay. Jack was great in responding and I really liked the flexibility in checkin and out.
summary: Good experience with great location, but some minor issues with the shower head and window in the bedroom.

comments:
If you're looking to stay close to the action, amongst the hustle and bustle of central London, this little apartment is everything it says it is!
It's perfectly located next to Edgware Road Tube Station, only a 2 minute walk away and Baker Street Station, a leisurely 10 minute stroll through Marylebone.
My Fiancé and I were very comfortable and had all the amenities (high speed wifi, washing machine, full kitchenette, comfy couch!) we needed in the apartment and also close by.
Oisin was incredibly helpful, easy to contact and on the ball when we had any problems.
Overall we had a pretty awesome time! If you want the experience of living in inner London with all the comforts of home, this is it!
summary: Perfectly located apartment with all amenities, friendly host, and excellent communication.

comments:
The time in Oleg's was great! Great location, quiet place but near everything (walking distance) and super clean! The room was quite big and cozy :) And they allowed us to leave our bags until night on our check out day, so we were able to worth the whole day in London and pick the luggage later.
I'm happy I chose this place to stay in London and I would defenitly repeat if I would go back.
Thanks so much for everything! :)
summary: Great location, quiet, clean, and cozy room, with helpful hosts who allowed luggage storage.

comments: This apartment has a stunning view of the city and the location is very convenient to lots of attractions in London.  The section it is in has a fun, edgy vibe.  Lots of interesting restaurants- don't miss Mercato Metropolitano, which has many great casual dining options.  The apartment has everything you will need and the wifi is excellent.  Serhat is an exceptional host.  He responds promptly to emails and is very accommodating and friendly.  We will definitely stay in his apartment again if we travel to London.
summary: Stunning view, convenient location, and excellent host who responds promptly to emails.

comments: Although we arrived later than we expected, Nainesh welcomed us very kindly, offered us coffee/tea and made us feel very welcome. The room was great, the bed as well. We didn't see that much of Nainesh (work, and we were out a lot) but it was overall a very nice stay and would definitely stay again.
summary: Welcoming host, clean room, and great location made for a pleasant stay.

comments: Highly recommended! This flat is a fantastic friendly, quiet space to relax and be toasty warm in - an oasis when traveling and exploring London. Damiano's place is in a great location with everything easily accessible. With all the modern luxuries, this place is a must stay for the solo traveller or couple.
summary: This flat is a fantastic friendly, quiet space to relax and be toasty warm in - an oasis when traveling and exploring London.

comments:
Très bel appartement, bien décoré et propre.
Petit bémol, la lumière extérieure la nuit et le soleil le matin qui nous a réveillé. Il faut passer au masque pour les yeux.
Le train passe en effet la journée mais la nuit il n'y a pas de bruit.
L'hôte était très gentil et communicatif.
Merci beaucoup, c'est un logement que je recommande.
summary: A very nice apartment with a kind host, but some minor issues with light and noise.

comments:
Overall good impression, but beware there is no microwave (I know there is no microwave stated on the listing, but it’s easy to overlook when described as fully equipped kitchen). The bed is more of a large single then a double, and do not depend on the sofa bed as the mattress will not be good for your back and neck.
Landlady is very responsive, good WiFi. Acceptable kitchen if you want to do a little cooking.
summary: Good impression, but beware of the small double bed and lack of microwave.

comments: Mark was an example what a great host should be. Our flight was delayed for 5 hours, we arrived on 00:30 at Marks place and he still waited to greet and welcome us. The unit itself is exactly what in the picture and in the description. The location, what can I say, superb!! Situated in zone 1, right across the Russel Square station, surrounded by all the shops you need (24 hours Tesco, huge supermarket, pharmacists, restaurants etc etc) you cannot ask for more. The unit sleeps 8 people easily and comfortably. The cooking utilities enough for a super chef inside us to create michelin star foods. A big thank you to Mark and big applaud for his place we cannot have enough to recommend this place to anyone who plan to visit London. Excellent!!!
summary: Excellent host and location, perfect for large groups or families visiting London.

comments: Die Zimmer sind optimal aufgeteilt für eine Familie. Ein großes Elternzimmer und ein großes Kinderzimmer. Das Bad ist mit einer Wanne ausgestattet und lädt förmlich zum Baden ein. Alles was man benötigt war vorhanden. Kühlschrank, Toaster, Wasserkocher und Mikrowelle, ausreichend Geschirr. Sogar eine gute Teeauswahl und Kaffee gab es (falls man nicht bei Susanne frühstücken möchte). Die Gastgeberfamilie ist sehr freundlich und immer für ein Gespräch zu haben. Wertvolle Tips für den Aufenthalt gibt es ausreichend. Wir werden auf jedenfall wiederkommen, da bei Susanne wohnen heißt "sich zu Hausen fühlen".
summary: The host's family home was perfect for a family stay with a large parent bedroom and child bedroom, well-equipped kitchen, and friendly hosts.

comments: The location is perfect. There are many great restaurants nearby the house. Also near the underground. You can buy food in four different supermarkets which nearby house. Dan is good at communication and friendly. He always answer our questions quickly. His house is same as the pictures. It is a stylish, beautiful and comfortable house.
summary: The location of the house is perfect, close to restaurants, underground, and supermarkets, and the host Dan is very communicative and friendly.

comments: The flat was great. It was close to the tube, so it made it easy to travel around London. It was also close to the grocery store which made it very convenient. It was nice and roomy which was perfect for our week stay with 2 little ones. Mirko was very accommodating and I recommend this place!
summary: The flat was great for a family stay with two little ones, close to the tube and grocery store, and the host Mirko was very accommodating.

comments: Our family, of six (four adults and two children), stayed at Lulu’s family home in Herne Hill for a total of ten days and it was a fantastic experience.  The house was very stylish, welcoming, and perfect for our family.  With three bedrooms on the second floor and a large master bedroom on the third floor, there was amble space for us to sleep, store our clothing and personal items.  Our boys were really thrilled with having their own kids room, equipped with bunk beds and filled with toys to play with.  The open concept living room and kitchen were spacious and perfect for day to day use.
