The cozy backyard was a great place for our boys to play, and for us to BBQ and relax after busy days touring London.  Herne Hill is a great community that is surrounded by wonderful parks, shops, and easy access to all parts of London.  Lulu was very helpful answering all our questions, and provided us with excellent recommendations for places to go and things to do within Herne Hill and the surrounding area.  We would highly recommended staying here.
summary: Lulu's family home in Herne Hill was fantastic for our family of six, with plenty of space, a cozy backyard, and excellent recommendations from Lulu.

comments: Probably one of the best houses we have been so far. We weren’t so lucky to meet Emma in person at the check in but we were welcomed warmly by Helen and by N&J’s detailed instructions about the house. The apartment is really gorgeous and full of light. Orchids flowers and fruit on the table were waiting for us. The rooms are nice and the third bed is in a cosy small balcony overlooking the living room that our younger boy really loved. We felt at home. I had the privilege to cook in a kitchen clearly equipped for a chef preparing meals for his/her family. Transportation to the city is easy: overground and buses take you everywhere. I strongly recommend Emma’s house, even if we would keep it as our secret gem in London. Bravo!
summary: Emma's house is one of the best we've stayed at, beautifully decorated, well-equipped kitchen, and easy transportation to the city.

comments: Great location, very close to my kid’s summer camp location and 5 mins walk to High Road where has lots of cafes, restaurants and shops. Ash is very responsive and provided us with helpful info (and thanks very much for the beautiful flowers). The apt itself is clean and matches the listing description. We had a great stay.
summary: Great location, clean apartment with responsive host.

comments: This is one of those instances where I wish nocarz would let me give more than 5 stars. Angie and Dean were some of the best hosts I've ever had. They were flexible, responsive, proactive, and communicative. Their home was clean, updated, and perfectly located. I will definitely stay here again the next time I'm in London. Highly recommend!!!
summary: Excellent hosts and perfect location, highly recommended.

comments:
Our stay hasn’t been as spotless as for previous guest.
While communication was smooth before booking we didn’t had any news before arrival so we first wrote an nocarz message a day before arrival that stayed unanswered and then, a couple of hours before arrival, wrote to Jessy’s phone number where she answered quickly.
The room was clean and simple but our door couldn’t be fully closed (I’m not speaking about locking it with a key - which there room doesn’t have - but closing). Neither Jessy or Harriet mentioned this beforehand or when we checked in and when we asked about it, Harriet just gave us a wedge to secure the door.
Overall the house is ok, like many old London house, it doesn’t have a good thermal or noise insulation but nothing too bad. It’s clean but not spotless. Kitchen has most of the basic things you may need and bathroom is ok too.
summary: Clean but not spotless room in an old house with some issues.

comments: Andy was great! Super friendly and knowledgeable about the area. Our room had plenty of space and we were able to cook whenever we needed. Our place was perfect, right next to the bus stop to get around wherever we needed to go. Perfect place to stay for all points east festival too!
summary: Friendly host and great location for exploring the area.

comments:
Great place to stay whilst I was working.
It had everything I needed, the whole place is finished to a very high standard and is well worth the price.
Check in was easy with detailed instructions provided by Michael beforehand.
The bathroom and kitchen were especially nice and Michael provides all the pots and pans required to cook yourself a proper meal.
Couldn't recommend this place enough for anyone visiting/working in the area.
summary: Highly finished apartment with everything needed for a comfortable stay.

comments: The apartment is near to Pimlico underground station, it was very close of the 24 bus stop, that Michael recommended us to take to go to the center, and is also close to the Westminster abbey by walk. The room was very confortable and clean. Roberto and Michael tell us the principal things to do in London. We spent a great time, we hope to come back some day.
summary: The apartment was comfortable, clean, and conveniently located near public transportation.

comments: Luca was a perfect host. He even got as bread, butter, milk and coffee. The flat was just as it was portrayed in the photographs. Nice, clean, new built and contains all you can need. Was perfect for our stay. Location was nice in quite neighborhood. The underground is close. Would recommend the flat to others.
summary: Luca's flat was perfect for our stay, with a great location, cleanliness, and amenities.

comments: Si vous cherchez une location idéalement située pour visiter Londres, ne cherchez plus, vous venez de la trouver. Ce logement a répondu à toutes nos attentes. Sa localisation est idéale, étant proche de deux gares ferroviaires à pied : Bellingham Station, qui vous amènera directement à London Bridge, ou Lower Sydenham, qui vous permet d'accéder à Victoria Station avec un seul changement. Vous pouvez même vous rendre à Londres en bus, et ils sont très fréquents. De plus, le logement est à quelques minutes à pied des commerces, ce qui est idéal pour faire des courses (Lidl se trouve à quelques mètres, Aldi ou Sainsbury's à quelques minutes à pied). Le logement est calme, propre et fonctionnel. Joan, notre hôte, a été exceptionnelle : disponible, attentionnée, bienveillante. Merci, Joan, pour votre gentillesse. Nous reviendrons.
summary: This ideal location made it easy to visit London, with nearby train stations and shops.

comments:
The flat was so clean and a perfect location. Very quiet as well, which was surprising given its in-the-heart-of-the-city location.
I loved that Paul offered us travel books (which I didn’t bring for our short stay). Paul also provided many nice amenities such as electric converters (I had the wrong kind), coffee, sugar, bar soap, laundry & dishwasher soap, and paper towels/napkins. The sky lights made the apartment so well lit. The grocery was basically at the base of the building. The security to the building was very good and Paul’s instructions for entry were perfect. Tube stations are only a few minute walk.
The only things I will point out. The beds are very soft. We only stayed 2 nights so worked out but my back was a little disrupted (we prefer medium-firm beds). Also if any in your party have mobility concerns, getting in and out if the shower (in a deep soaking tub) could be harder (with a travel companion could be a help). The lift in the bldg would be perfect for them.
I highly recommend this flat for a stay in London. I certainly would return without hesitation.
summary: Paul's flat was clean, well-equipped, and in an excellent location, but the beds were too soft.

comments: We had a great couple of nights stay in Patrick’s place. Patrick was very communicative and helpful. Very good value for money for its location. As other reviews mention, it is a very small place, but we had 4 of us there and it worked well. One downside, the sofa beds weren’t particularly comfy.
summary: Patrick's place was a great value for its location, but the sofa beds were uncomfortable.

comments: The flat has wonderful views over the cemetery and we enjoyed seeing a 3 legged fox making his way home in the evening as well as finding the graves of the famous and eating at the lovely cafe.  There is a great pizza shop around the corner and it’s an easy journey to the museums at south ken and the adventure playground at Holland Park. The flat was spacious enough for our family of five and a comfortable place to come home to.  The only drawback was the noise sensitivity of the tenant below to early rising children.
summary: The flat was spacious and comfortable, but had some noise issues with the tenant below.

comments: I loved staying at Alice’s flat. It is a really nice flat and is exactly as described. All the rooms were nicely decorated and very clean. With the outside garden, there was plenty of space, but the flat has a nice cosy feel. Alice was a wonderful host. She was very responsive to my questions and she provided very clear instructions for check in and check out. 10/10!
summary: Alice's flat was lovely, clean, and cozy, with a wonderful host who provided excellent communication.

comments: Scott was a charming host, greeting us on arrival and showing us around the flat. The flat was lovely and warm and extremely comfortable. We loved being able to pop across the road for breakfast croissant, and being able to stroll to the tube , less than a minutes walk away, and popping in to Tate Britain. We hope to be back soon!
summary: Scott's flat was extremely comfortable, warm, and in a great location near the tube and Tate Britain.

comments:
Had a fantastic time at Art Deco Hackney Haven. Stayed 3 nights in a very modern, stylish accomodation, in a great location, and with excellent nearby transport facilities to Central London (20 mins max).
Had great communication with the host and would highly recommend this venue.
Very well worth the stay, and at great value.
summary: Art Deco Hackney Haven was modern, stylish, and well-located with excellent transport links to Central London.

comments:
Lovely house in a peaceful street (with parking available which was important for us). Communication with Landlord was quick and easy and very helpful. Lovely, helpful landlady in the flat below (helped us with our questions during and after our visit).
The flat is within walking distance (10-15 mins) to the underground station 'Wood Green' (Zone 3 in London). Plenty of space and comfortable beds ...
A basic summary: well worth it's money and a trip there.
summary: The flat was lovely, peaceful, and comfortable, with helpful communication from the landlord and landlady.

comments:
My wife and I loved this part of our trip in Western Europe. The apartment is very clean and in a great building with fantastic views. It's very spacious with a large living room. The location is perfect for getting to most spots in London.
Anthony was a terrific host and was quick to offer info or respond to any questions. He also made sure our arrival/departure was easy. Would highly recommend this spot.
summary: Loved the apartment's cleanliness, location, and spaciousness, and Anthony was a great host.

comments:
We stayed here for 5 weeks. We chose the room with the ensuite which was good for our stay and well suited our needs. No complaints at all with this.
Our issues arise from the shared kitchen. The house rules state - Do the dishes.
The kitchen is small and relatively well equipped provided users clean up after themselves. It was very disappointing that we needed to clean the kitchen before we could even use it. The state the kitchen is continually left in is disgraceful and as a paying guest we found this lack of care very disrespectful. Shared kitchen etiquette and hygiene needs a lot of work.
It should be noted that Elisabeth the host as stated in the ad does not live here and it seems those responsibilities of host are left up to her son who does live here. We feel the ad is misleading in this respect and should be rectified.
Location is good. Accommodation is good. Kitchen etiquette requires urgent attention. Sadly I feel our stay was tainted by this.
summary: Good accommodation and location, but shared kitchen etiquette and hygiene were disappointing.

comments: This place is in the heart of Soho, which is in the middle of all the action and activity.  Within 20 mins you can be close to very different neighborhoods.    It reminded me of a quaint SF apartment.  Spacious except for the bathroom, which is tiny compared to American standards.    That said each room had it’s own sink which helped.   It’s on the top floor so the light is excellent and the windows block out all the sound.   A nice place of refuge after a night out in London.   The hosts were communicative and helpful.   Thanks for making London exciting.
summary: Quaint SF-style apartment in Soho with excellent light and views, and helpful hosts.

comments:
We were in London to see a concert in the Roundhouse and AJ’s apartment was in a great location in Camden, walking distance to the tube, with loads of restaurants and shops near by and Camden Markets.
The apartment is big enough for 4 people, the sofa-bed & bed were very comfortable.
It's a newly renovated apartment. We had some issues on arrival, but AJ responded to messages and sorted them out very quick.
summary: Great location in Camden for concert-goers, with a big and comfortable apartment.

comments: The apartment isn’t quite as modern & fresh as it looks in the pictures and is on a busy road so was quite noisy at night. BUT the location is absolutely perfect, 2 minutes up the road from the Chalk Farm tube station and a 10 minute walk from Camden markets. Flavio was extremely easy to get in touch with. (Note, theres no hairdryer or WiFi included and we had to buy our own toilet roll as none was provided)
summary: Perfect location, but noisy due to busy road, and some amenities were not provided.

comments: Alison was a very sweet and kind host! She greeted us every time we came in and offered breakfast every day of our stay, and the room was cozy and thoughtfully decorated! The house was very charming and warm and we were ecstatic about staying in a Victorian style home. Tom was also very friendly and caring as well. We just adored our stay
summary: Guest had a wonderful stay in Alison's Victorian home, praising her kindness, the cozy room, and warm atmosphere.

comments:
Hello
Thank you so much for my ten day stay in this amazing apartment, made all the better by the awesome host!
The apartment is beat clean fresh and roomy, with a full kitchen and clean bathroom, great double size bedroom and beautiful lounge / dining with balcony! So close to everything you can walk where ever you need to go in London, either to the city centre or the palaces, or Hampstead Heath or Notting Hill, everything is close by, but if walking is not on then the fantastic tube is only a couple of streets away!
I would recommend this apartment to any single or couple wanting a wonderful host with great facilities and close to major attractions of London!
summary: Guest loved their 10-day stay in this apartment, appreciating its cleanliness, spaciousness, and great location near London's major attractions.

comments: I loved the time at Pete and Wes's apartment! The room was clean and comfortable with a lovely view over a little green area, it was very bright during the day and peaceful during the night. Pete and Wes were very friendly and helpful with suggestions about the area of London. I found the location convenient, there is a bus stop next to the building, and it is a nice little walk to the underground anyway. The next time I go to London, I'd definitely like to stay at Pete and Wes's apartment again, and I highly recommend it!
summary: Guest had a fantastic time at Pete and Wes's apartment, enjoying the clean room, lovely view, and friendly hosts.

comments:
My husband and I stayed here with our four year old child. As a young family, I did a lot of research before booking a property as it was important to me that we stay in a clean, safe, and convenient flat. Julia's place was great! Julia went above and beyond with many small touches to make sure our stay was comfortable.

The flat has been beautifully updated with many fine touches. The location felt very safe. Buses and markets were very convenient and we were able to get to most touristy places in London within a 5 minute walk and 10 minute bus ride. Otherwise, the area of Chelsea was wonderful on its own with lots of small shops and restaurants. Julia and her husband were very friendly, warm, and extremely helpful during our stay.

The only thing to note is that the room can get a bit hot/stuffy. There is only one window/door combo that serves as the only source of fresh air. In the evenings, when the door is closed for quiet and privacy, the fresh air source is also gone. With three of us in the room (two adults and a small child), it maybe was a bit too much. My husband and child both like sleeping when it's a bit cooler. Probably would not be an issue for one or two people staying.

Even so, we would stay here again. Overall a great stay!
summary: Guest appreciated Julia's place for its cleanliness, safety, and convenience, but noted that the room can get hot/stuffy.

comments:
We had a great time at Gail's for two days!! First of all the room was beautiful and neat, with our private bathroom, all new and fresh, and a big terrace full of flowers and herbs Gail and Steve grow, where we sat in the evening and could chat and drink a cup of tea after the busy two days we had in London. The house is in the quite neighbourhood and close to several bus stops that get you very fast to wherever you want in London. In the mornings we got a bonus with a perfect breakfast of fruits and yoghurt, cereals and whatever else you could imagine, the best coffee in London (I might add) and the bonus was their little five year old girl Poppy that was an absolute delight and all two mornings that we stayed there we were late going out because she was entertaining us the whole breakfast time before she left for school. Alltogether we would definetly recomend staying at Gail's because she was also very helpful regarding the information about London and things to do and how to get around.
As soon as we come back we will most certanly look to stay at their place again.
summary: Guest had a great time at Gail's, praising the beautiful room, private bathroom, big terrace, and warm breakfasts, as well as Gail's helpfulness and her daughter Poppy's charm.

comments: Liz's flat is perfect - it's better than staying at a hotel, but with all the cleanliness, and nice small touches that a hotel would offer. Check in was super easy and very accommodating of our circumstances. The flat itself is immaculate and beautifully decorated, with enough space for hanging up clothes in the wardrobe. Super quiet, sunny, very comfortable and has everything you need and more. Thanks so much for a great stay!
summary: Liz's flat is perfect, with cleanliness, nice touches, and easy check-in.

comments: James went above and beyond to accommodate us at his beautiful place. He's such a lovely guy with fascinating and insightful stories. He was extremely helpful and our lives are better as a result of meeting him. We got a bit delayed from the airport which meant we didn't get to his until around 2 in the morning, but there he was waiting up for us, extremely kind indeed.
summary: James went above and beyond to accommodate us at his beautiful place.

comments:
My experience indicates that Angel would feel more comfortable as a Host to singles, couples without young children. Given her residence is in immaculate condition I spent most of my time at her house feeling hyper vigilant in keeping the place spotless and keeping my daughter in line, so did not feel like I was on holiday. Cost of the stay is not far off Hotel prices whereby keeping things in order would not be required and much more relaxation could be had. Angel also has adorable dogs however you need to also be mindful that your stay will require you to work around them in terms of accessing areas of the apartment and ensuring your food is stored away from access to the dogs.
Location is great and Angel is happy to provide advice on how to get around, and makes herself readily available for advice.
summary: Angel's residence is immaculate but may not be suitable for families due to the need to keep it spotless.

comments: Marie and Sally were fantastic hosts. Their home is beautiful, the bed comfortable, and the cats that visit the backyard very cute. Their place is in a nice quiet area that's very close to a Tube station, so it's easy to get to other parts of the city. I had a great stay and will certainly try to stay with them again next time I'm in London.
summary: Marie and Sally were fantastic hosts with a beautiful home in a quiet area near a Tube station.

comments: Everything was good. The room was very cozy and Alice was super friendly and left us water, tea and cookies. However, we were not lucky with the weather. There was unexpectedly very hot in London and there was no air conditioning in the room. Therefore, it was too hot in the room and dusty because we tried to keep the window open. In addition, it was a bit difficult to get used to shower.
summary: Alice's room was cozy but lacked air conditioning, making it difficult to stay cool during hot weather.

comments: If you’re short on cash and are used to communal living with very thin walls, a ton of rules and lecturing posts based on what you must not do, and are a heavy sleeper, this is the place for you. We stayed one night, and just left to find a hotel elsewhere. The door locks, but has a gap at bottom and window at top, so the hall light shines bright inside. The place smelled like it had been shellacked with disinfectant. The floors and bedding were clean. Any movement upstairs at all rumbled the house and we barely slept. This isn’t a “shared home” but a hostel. The owners were nice in communications, but it was not the experience we thought from reading the description.
summary: The reviewer had a poor experience due to thin walls, rules, and lack of sleep.

comments:
Vy was a great host with clear instructions on how to find the apartment and made the check in and check out process easy. The apartment is clean and in a nice area. Some small critiques we’d have would be the lack of iron and TV as well as the door handle on the bathroom not being sturdy and falling off on our last day. The pillows were also slightly uncomfortable and the apartment is on a main road and so can get very noisy at night so you would need to keep the windows closed. It is also circa 40 minutes from central London but close to Shoreditch which is also nice.
Overall, the apartment is great value for money as long as you don’t mind the travel. If some small changes could be made as mentioned above it would definitely be 5 stars.
summary: The reviewer was satisfied with the apartment's cleanliness and location but had some minor complaints.

comments: Shane's a super charismatic host who has so much love for the Shoreditch area and its hip bar and art scene. He's friendly, welcoming and is willing to answer any of your questions on life in London. The flat itself is immaculate and the bed is so, so comfortable. Checkin was very easy, Shane meets you to show you how to use the keys and get to the apartment, would be a bit confusing without the first hand tour. Would definitely recommend to all and happily stay again.
summary: The reviewer had a great experience with a charismatic host and an immaculate flat.

comments:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Gracia's cozy flat and I must say, it was a fantastic experience!
The location was ideal for me as it was walking distance from my office. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay.
But what really stood out was the host's amazing hospitality. She went above and beyond to ensure that I had a great stay - she even lend me her personal iPhone charger when she got to know that I had forgotten mine. It's these small touches that really made me feel welcome and cared for.
Overall, I highly recommend this nocarz to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in the area. Thank you again to Gracia for your wonderful hospitality and for making my trip a memorable one!
summary: The reviewer highly recommended the apartment due to its ideal location and the host's exceptional hospitality.

comments: This was a great place to stay after a gig at Wembley.  Chris was really welcoming and the room was perfect for the night.  It's less than a 15 minute walk from the stadium and the underground and the area felt pretty safe to us especially with so many people around.  Chris's place is in a quiet street and her lovely back garden made us feel like we'd woken up in the trees!  We will definitley be back in touch when we visit the area again.
summary: The reviewer was pleased with the welcoming host and the convenient location near Wembley Stadium.

comments:
The place is just as described and David was very responsive. Check-in was easy. We had a family of 5 (2 Adults and 3 children under 13) and the place fit us just fine. The location was very nice with a Tesco and a coffee shop within a 2
minute walk. Transportation is a key factor here. Realize you are about 30 to 40 minutes away from all the main London attractions by public transit. 20 to 28 minutes by taxi or car. So remember to allow for that time. Accessing the public transit however is supper easy. Bus stops into town are just outside the door. Also the Imperial wharf overground station was just past the coffee shop. The station connects into underground stations up the route, even an uber boat (infrequent outside of weekday rush hour) is also available in the river to bring you into London proper. All transport is reasonably priced and accessible with an oyster card you can buy at Imperial Wharf. We liked being a little away from very touristy sections and we found the neighbors to be very nice as well. We found this location to be a clean and affordable option for our London adventure.
summary: Clean and affordable option with great location and responsive host

comments: This was our second stay at Leah’s and it was great. It is a lovely house and excellent room with en-suite bathroom. It is especially good to have the guest kitchen with breakfast things supplied. The position of the house is very good as it is very close to Queen’s road station. Although Queen’s road itself is busy and noisy the double glazing in the room filters it out very effectively. Leah is an excellent host and we will definitely return if we can.
summary: Lovely house with excellent room and en-suite bathroom, close to Queen's road station

comments:
Richard was a great host - very responsive to any messages or questions that we had. We really appreciated that he met us at the house. I liked that he has thought about the safety of his guests - for example making sure we knew where the fire extinguisher was and where the emergency exits were. While it is very unlikely that there would ever be need for that information - especially in a well maintained property like this - to me it was a sign of a host who takes his hosting seriously.
We loved the house - clean, and light filled. We used all the major appliances in the course of our visit - oven, dish washer, washer and dryer - and they all worked well. I made good use of the turntable and records, and we were able to use our Netflix account on the TV.
We needed to be in the Ealing area for family reasons, but found the access to London and Heathrow was good, with the Northfields station on the Piccadilly line a short walk away.
When we return to London, our first choice will be to return this property.
summary: Well-maintained property with clean and light-filled space, good access to London and Heathrow

comments: It was a real pleasure to meet Kevin and stay at his place - he was a perfect host and an all-round great conversationalist. We really enjoyed the chats we had with him over the three nights about teaching, travel, music and languages, and he made us feel really welcome in his space. The room is comfy, clean and warm, exactly as it looks in the pictures, and we will definitely be visiting again when we return to London. Thank you and see you again soon!
summary: Comfy and warm room in a unique house with great host who made us feel welcome

comments:
we had an amazing stay, the unique house has a creative, imaginative quality matched with fun and individualist spaces.
we had a family looking weekend in London and each had their space. The kitchen was well stocked and local shops were within easy walking distance.
The location was good for getting into town centre, with butter stops just out side.
We would stay here again.
summary: Unique house with creative spaces, well-stocked kitchen, and good location for getting into town centre

comments:
We absolutely loved the place, Hugh and his assistant communicated with us ahead of time with simple and clear instructions, easy check in with lock box, place is remodeled and clean, bed was super comfortable, mattress provided great back support and we had two awesome restful nights there, cotton linens and feather blanket felt like clouds. The place has two shared bathrooms (there is a few bedrooms in the house occupied by different travelers at the same time, but we never had a problem with bathroom access), also there is a neat kitchen with everything you need.
A little bit unexpected was the fact that they forgot to clean our room before our arrival, and we had to wait after our check in, but Hugh responded right away and everything was ready by the time we came back from the walk. Excellent place, we’ll taken care of. Highly recommend for a reasonable price and cleanliness.
summary: Excellent place with comfortable bed and clean facilities, minor issue with room cleaning but resolved promptly by host.

comments: Es un apartamento estudio muy coqueto y práctico para ir una pareja . Muy bien equipado, limpio y súper confortable. La ubicación es buena en zona 2 a solo 5 minutos del metro. El Barrio es muy tranquilo y acogedor. Además tiene el rio muy cerquita y una bonita terraza para disfrutar los días buenos. La cocina y los baños están perfectamente equipados. Ha sido una grata experiencia y la propietaria muy atenta y pendiente de todo.
summary: Cozy studio apartment in a quiet neighborhood with good location, well-equipped kitchen and bathroom, and friendly owner.

comments: Nathan's place was fantastic for our one week stay. The apartment is stylish, spanking clean and very well tidied and organised. There are several supermarkets around and the area couldn't be more central and interesting - there's tons of independent restaurant and cafes. The tube is also around the corner, which is rare to find in London!
summary: Stylish and clean apartment in central London with easy access to public transport, supermarkets, and restaurants.

comments: We stayed for a little bit more than one week in Edouards Apartment. It‘s located very central and you have quick access to buses or metros to go the city centre and all the main attractions. Also there is a tesco and several little shops nearby if you plan to cook sometimes for yourself, what you absolutly can because the kitchen has everything you need. The apartment itself is cozy, clean and makes you feel at home. Edouard answers very quick and is always friendly and helpful. One of the best nocarz‘s I‘ve ever stayed in. Def. recommend!
summary: Central location, quick access to buses and metro, cozy and clean apartment with well-equipped kitchen, friendly and helpful host.

comments: Sarah has been very accommodating and hospitable throughout my stay! She’s always responded to my messages. The studio is in the back of the house, about 25-30 minutes to Victoria Station (city center in London) by taking Southeastern Line from Shortlands to Victoria, one week pass ~£55, and it runs until pretty late. The studio itself has a bed, a kitchenette, a washer, a cabinet/dresser, a working TV? and a standing shower. About 10-15 square meters. There’s a backyard which Sarah let me hang out. Anyways, it’s a good studio considering the price. Thank you Sarah :)
summary: Accommodating and hospitable owner, good value for price, studio has everything needed for a comfortable stay.

comments:
Baltic!!
tiny radiator in hallway not enough, living was area freezing. Vent in room just pouring in cold air, Looks like double glazing windows but draughts from all angles. No chance !!
On enquiry before booking asked to specific address (as not listed ) was told something fancy nearby , on the morning due of arrival got the update of official address and wasn’t happy, the posh answers followed & slippery enough to deal with on the phone, Shame she doesn’t match the setting.
It’s always disappointing to be duped & Don’t think Id book nocarz places again without properly listed addresses . live & learn hey!!
summary: Disappointed with the property's lack of heating and misleading address information.

comments: Nous avons passé 2 nuits dans l'appartement de Mita et notre séjour a été très agréable. Mita est très réactive et essaie d'aider ses hôtes à avoir un maximum de confort. L'appartement se trouve à 2 min à pieds du métro, le quartier est chouette, vivant mais calme, plein de petits restos. Plusieurs lignes passent à Ealing Broadway, vous arriverez donc en centre ville assez rapidement. Ligne directe jusqu'à Westminster.  L'appartement a été très propre, il a du être rénové il n'y a pas très longtemps, le linge de lit était de bonne qualité. Merci pour vos efforts Mita, nous reviendrons.
summary: Had a pleasant stay in Mita's apartment, which was clean and well-located.

comments: We stayed in Jasmine cottage with our 3 kids 21, 18 and 15 (from the US)  The apartment was great!   Nicola emailed me in advance asking for our food preferences and stocked the fridge with eggs, cheese, bread, etc. What a delight!  The beds were comfy, towels were excellent and the robes were a great touch. We loved the location and were fortunate we had good weather and could walk most places. A great stay and London was fabulous!
summary: Nicola's Jasmine cottage was great for our family, with comfortable beds and excellent location.

comments:
i find this nocarz very cute , cozy and ideal for a young couple , it’s very well located close to a super market, restaurants, a little mall and its also very close to 2 overground stations and bus stops . i loved the little terrace it has that looks to the street (ideal for smokers), has all the necessary equipment , its a bit smaller from what i expected but that didn’t bother me at all, still pretty spacey for 2 tourists . What i would have liked to be different is the heater to reach warmer than just lukewarm and even tho the nocarz was quite warm itself especially during the day , there was 2 out of 4 nights that i spent there that i wished the radiator would warm a bit more but if ur someone that likes to sleep w long winter pyjamas u will be fine , the hosts were pretty helpful and kind except from the last night when we had to call cuz the code to enter the building was on my phone and my phone had gone dead , he picks up all mad talking to us like we’re not the ones who payed for the stay and whatever comes w it but him.
Overall a pretty good stay but there is still room for improvement.
P.S The stay was beginnings of november
:D
summary: Found the nocarz cute and cozy, but had some issues with heating and communication from the host.

comments: The house is really clean and comfortable. The host is really nice and support, we have a great time here. The house is near the lime station ( 9 mi walk). The host also help us to leave our luggage without any fare when we go to edin. I definitely recommend my friend to go there. Love ❤️
summary: The house was clean and comfortable, with a nice host who helped us with luggage storage.

comments: Had a great few nights stay with Adriana and Ruby. The room and bathroom were clean and tidy and Adriana was very communicative on check in day which was a big help. Apartment is really quiet despite being close to the rail line which is great! Lots to do in Brixton and a short walk from Brixton tube station so very easy to get into central London. Would absolutely recommend!
summary: Had a great stay with Adriana and Ruby, clean room, quiet apartment, and easy access to central London.

comments:
It was a wonderful nocarz experience. A comfortable and clean en suite in a lovely apartment with lots of artwork, plants and books, which all together give the place its character and make it feel like home. The building is a new and nice one with a good lift. Location was very good. You can take a bus from literally in front of the building and go to Picadilly Circus directly. Tube is just minutes walk away if you prefer.
Simon is a great host. Beyond that he is such a wonderful person he even gave me his spare phone after mine was stollen somewhere around Angel. And when he did this great favour, I wasn’t even staying in his place yet. I was in my previous nocarz. I will always feel thankful and lucky to discover Simon’s apartment.
summary: Wonderful nocarz experience with Simon, comfortable and clean en suite in a lovely apartment with good location.

comments:
Gracious welcome from Sadiq, who kindly let us leave our luggage early and helped us with our cases. Warning - there’s a few flights of typical-London-terrace steep stairs to the private quarters at the top of the house. The room was beautiful with a wonderful outlook over the garden and wider neighbourhood and the bathroom spotless and very well appointed. Central heating and a heated towel rack added to the comfort of our stay during a cold and rainy week.
The home is in a very convenient location in a great neighbourhood, two bus routes almost on the doorstep will take you right into the heart of London.
The handwritten welcome card, tasty treat and luxurious toiletries were a lovely touch. We also loved the personalised list of recommended cafes and local attractions. Thanks Sadiq!
summary: Gracious welcome from Sadiq, beautiful room with garden view, spotless bathroom, and convenient location.

comments:
L’appartement d’Alex est vraiment bien situé dans un quartier accessible par de nombreux transport en commun ! La propreté était correct malgré bcp d’humidités dans la salle de bain. Les murs sont très fin et le poindrez bruit dans le couloir s’entend de suite.
La procédure d’arrivée sans clé est top !
summary: Alex's apartment is well-located, clean, but had some issues with humidity in the bathroom and noise from the hallway.

comments: Llegamos temprano y pudimos entrar sin problema antes del check in. Diane es super amable y sus perritos se comportan muy bien. Todo coincidía con las fotos, la habitación es pequeña pero cómoda. La ubicación es buenísima y muy fácil llegar. Hay ascensor. Tiene a pocos pasos tiendas con todo para comprar cualquier cosa de higiene y comidas preparadas.
summary: Diane's apartment was great, early check-in allowed, friendly host and pets, small but comfortable room, good location.

comments:
Alexis & Emanuele were perfect hosts, they responded to questions promptly and were very accommodating, the apartment is exactly as described, it’s in a beautiful quiet residential area of Knightsbridge close to everything including Harrods, Knightsbridge underground station is only a 5 min walk away, you are only a couple of stops on the underground to Leister Square and the middle of Soho for the nightlife. I highly recommend this apartment and I will definitely be back, I stayed in nocarz’s in London before but this one is in my top two apartments to stay. Oh and just to mention that Alxsis’s recommendation for breakfast in L’ETO just down the street was great,
Thanks again Alexis & Emanuele.
summary: Perfect hosts with a beautiful apartment in a quiet residential area of Knightsbridge.

comments: Ich war mit meiner Tochter bei Matt und A in London und wir können nur gutes berichten. Beide waren äußerst aufmerksam und hilfsbereit. Wir bekamen nette Tipps und fühlten uns wirklich wie zu Hause... :) Die Wohnung und das Zimmer waren sauber und ruhig in der Nähe vom Regent's Canal gelegen. Für uns war die Lage perfect und wir genossen allabendlich einen kleinen Spaziergang am Kanal. Gerne wieder...
summary: Friendly and helpful hosts with a clean and cozy apartment near Regent's Canal.

comments:
Amazing place . check in was quick , it was close to the trains and buses. So many shops around. The place was clean , The people are friendly. The prices were good , cheap as well .
😜.It was close to KOKO London to see my concert.Just that the pillows were less . But overall i recommend ✨👏🏽.
summary: Great location, friendly people, and good prices for an amazing place to stay.

comments:
Not worth the money. While the apartment was clean and in the heart of Soho-the cost simply does not live up to the value. I had dear friends fly in from Germany and we were looking forward to sitting together, dining in the apartment. There was a heat wave that week and the apartment did not have adequate ventilation. 33 degrees Celcius/90 degrees farenheit in the apartment almost the whole time. All but one window in a back bedroom was cemented shut, so we could not open the windows to cool down at night. The living spaces were unbearable. One of us got a heat rash and none of us slept. Even though I called and asked for more/better fans, Mike texted that it was too late the first night; then never tried to rectify the situation. We were miserable. The apartment did not include air conditioning, but that doesn't mean 33/90 degrees is acceptable. Candidly, while the weather was out of his control, he could have reduced our bill (we could not possibly sit and chat in that stifling kitchen, and eating there was impossible), or found some way to make the stay palatable. On top of this, the over $120 cleaning fee was adding insult to injury. We couldn't sit there long enough to mess up the place! There are equally nice places just outside of Soho, we found for next time that are a fraction of the cost.
He was nice during the texts, but nice neded action. He could have taken more responsibility to his guests.
summary: Not worth the money due to inadequate ventilation and poor communication from the host.

comments:
Great location, just a few minutes walk from Victoria train/coach station and Buckingham Palace. Walked to Churchill War Rooms and to the Hayward Gallery on the Southbank via Parliament and straightforward direct bus journey to the trendy Spitalfields market and hipster Shoreditch. Really central location.
Nice size living room with decent tv. Great little kitchen, spacious bedrooms. Some carpets are a bit tired and could do with some tlc but all was clean and it didn’t detract from a great stay.
Excellent communication from Dmitry and he was very understanding when our arrival was delayed.
Highly recommend.
summary: Excellent central location with a nice apartment and great communication from Dmitry.

comments: I stayed for a week in Shawn's downstairs-upstairs flat and always felt good coming back to it after exploring London. Two tube stations on different lines are nearby, busstop in front of the house, big Tesco around the corner, smaller shops and restaurants along the road, perfect. The road is very loud, no doubt, but I didn't mind although I kept the window tilted. In the summer heat the room (ground floor) was not to warm thankfully. The kitchen has what you need, the bathroom/ separate toilet upstairs as well (hairdryer is in the bedroom in the nightstand, saw that too late, but brought my own anyway). A second room is rented out as well, but I never had problems with the other guest. Shawn is a nice lady near retirement, she wasn't there all the time, so should you have lots of questions or need her help I guess phoning her would have been okay. I think, the price for the room was absolutely fine. Thank you, Shawn, for letting me stay.
summary: Guest had a comfortable stay in Shawn's flat with good amenities and location.

comments:
Its our first visit in UK and we are lucky to stay in Webb's house. The environment is quite and clean.
Webb's family is very nice and the check-in process is easy. The place is very convenient, no matter with or without a car. Its only 10 min walk to a big supermarket, and 15 min bus to shopping center in Croydon. If you prefer natural environment, feel free to spend an afternoon in the Beddington park (5 min bus) , or watching swans in Wadden Pond (5 min walk). Well, subject to the local weather.
summary: Guests enjoyed their stay at Webb's house due to its quiet environment, cleanliness, and convenient location.

comments: A very comfortable and quiet place to stay at Harrow. Harrow on the Hill underground station is around 7 minutes walk. There is a Morrisons around 3 minutes and a good Indian restaurant 2 minutes walk away. I had 4 pieces of luggage including 2 large suitcases and the room (which is on the first floor) is big enough to fit these in. Renee is a good host. I stayed there for 3 days and had a peaceful and relaxed stay.
summary: Guest found Renee's place to be comfortable, quiet, and conveniently located near Harrow on the Hill underground station.

comments: Me and my sister had a wonderful stay with Andrea in his AMAZING home. A flat in Victorian English townhouse on a wonderful street, just between stoke newington and dalston. Andrea was super sweet and even baked us lemon cake one night! His flat truly is a hidden gem, it’s newly renovated and absolutely beautiful, could be in any fancy English interior magazine. Felt more like a trendy but classy hotel than an nocarz. I will deffo come back! 🙏
summary: Guests had a wonderful stay at Andrea's home, describing it as an 'AMAZING' hidden gem with a trendy but classy atmosphere.

comments: This apartment couldn't have been in a better location -- quiet neighborhood but so close to everything London has to offer through a moderate walk or short tube ride! The apartment itself was perfect for the five of us, with two good sized bathrooms and living space that fit us all. It was clean and as pictured. Check-in and check-out were a breeze and the host was incredibly communicative.
summary: Guests praised the apartment's perfect location and amenities, including two good-sized bathrooms and living space for five people.

comments:
Very stylish apartment!!
Love the kitchen although we don’t have much time to cook.
Libby and Jordan are really nice and helpful. We enjoy the week staying with them. The room is big enough for 2 with all our shopping bags!! (it will be great if there is a desk to put our things)
The area is convenient, supermarkets and nice cafe near by. The tube station is walking distance : )
summary: Very stylish apartment with friendly hosts and convenient location

comments:
We had a great overall experience staying here. The place was generally clean and comfortable, but there are a few things to note. There was a leak in the ceiling of the kitchen, which could be an issue for future guests. The windows aren’t insulated, so there was a lot of street noise from traffic. Also, we were missing enough duvets and towels for our group of 8 people, which was a bit inconvenient.
The location is close to the metro, which made getting around easy. For the price and what we were looking for, it was a decent stay, but addressing these minor issues would make it even better!
summary: Generally clean and comfortable stay, but some minor issues to address

comments: We had a brilliant stay at Max’s place. It was walkable to Battersea Power Station which had loads of restaurants and the river boat. It was right next to Battersea Park which was lovely. Very peaceful surroundings and a lovely area. We had a problem with the shower and Max phoned me up straight away with instructions on how to use it. Great host and will definitely return
summary: Brilliant stay in a peaceful area with helpful host

comments: Great stay in Tottenham. 40' walks from Tottenham Hale and from the Hotspur Stadium, you can find comfort and quiet in a tiny but gracious room in Maud' house. I arrived late in the night but no problem for them to check out late, fantastic hosts. When I travel again there, I'll be their guest again.
summary: Comfortable and quiet room in a great location with friendly hosts

comments:
Die Wohnung ist relativ groß für den Preis. Ein klares Plus ist die Waschmaschine mit Trocknerfunktion. Dafür fehlten zahlreiche Dinge, die einfach dazugehören: Kleiderbügel, Licht am Bett, Garderobe (es gab nicht mal einen Nagel in der Wand), in der Küche: nur eine (1) Tasse, keine (!) Gläser, keine Kochtöpfe, Kochlöffel, Küchenmesser, Schere, Korkenzieher, Geschirrtuch. Schön wären auch Stühle und ein richtiger Tisch. Und eine Dusche ohne Rost und Schimmel, die normal funktioniert.
Die Heizung ging mehrmals nicht, offenbar weil ein anderer Mieter sie kurzerhand wieder abgestellt hatte. Ich habe zweimal einen ganzen Tag auf eine Reaktion auf meine Nachfragen warten müssen.
summary: Large apartment with washing machine, but lacking basic amenities

comments: Tamzin’s place was perfect for our needs during our stay, especially when traveling with a little one (lots of toys and books!). The location is convenient to shops and bus routes, and felt private and quiet. We had everything we needed during our stay, and Tamzin was very response and helpful. Also, the artwork is great!
summary: Tamzin's place was perfect for our needs, with a convenient location and plenty of amenities.

comments: Lovely homely property with an eye for design. Lots of neutral colours and natural textures. Especially liked the concrete worktops in the kitchen and the calm living space. All the amenities you’d need, including parking right outside. Clearly somewhere the host has lived, rather than an investment rental as many nocarzs are these days. Friendly host. Had one small issue but Clare was super responsive.
summary: Lovely homely property with an eye for design, friendly host, and responsive to issues.

comments: Sally's place is a a very convenient location to Greenwich and also transport and shops. Access to the backyard flat is down some stairs through the main kitchen of the house. The flat is very private and once it is warmed up it is cosy. The bed is comfortable and was big enough for the both of us. The flat and amenities are all very modern and the 2 burner hob works very well  but there was no microwave. Sally is a very accomodating and friendly host and we highly recommend her place :)
summary: Sally's place is a very convenient location, private flat with modern amenities, and accommodating host.

comments:
I loved this spot! I am quite envious of this cute little apartment, and hope the host all the best in the future. Ivan, our host, allowed for an early check-in and was a very proactive communicator.
The house feels both cozy and spacious, and the neighborhood was wonderful and neighborhoody to walk around in after being in central London for a few days.
summary: Ivan's apartment was cozy and spacious, with a wonderful neighborhood to explore.

comments:
Very easy check in, keys were in a Box outside the flat.comfortable flat and it has very nice light. Good Wi-Fi and nice TV. Kitchen appliances were all very good and clean.
The flat was nice and clean. The bedding were clean and nicely done,but the dining table is broken and didn’t expand so it was only enough for 2 people. Also one chair in tv room was broken.
There were lots of furniture/ beds/ drawers in the hallway entrance/staircase which wasn’t nice and the staircase was very dusty.
There were daily issues with the parking space as the shop next door kept parking their cars( sometimes 2 cars!) there despite telling the host. We also told the shop next door that we have rented the flat. They said the owner had allowed them and that they had spoken to Richard about it! We were not able to use the parking everyday. Only 4-5 days out of our 3 weeks stay!
summary: The flat had some issues with parking and furniture, but was clean and comfortable otherwise.

comments: the apartment was super great, amazing location and Jaymin was very quick to communicate. The cleaning manager was brilliant, I left my handbag inside and she ran down the street to give it to me. thank you so much! the landlord didn't like us playing music out of a mini speaker at 5pm, that was the only disappointment!
summary: Great location, excellent communication from Jaymin, but minor issue with noise complaint

comments: As Shruti was unavailable to meet us on arrival she made an easy alternative arrangement for us to collect the key from a friend in her neighbourhood and kept us informed all evening.We were very tired after a long haul flight from NZ and found Shruti's spare room extremely quiet and comfortable and we slept very soundly all week.We tried not to inconvenience her in any way while sharing her kitchen at breakfast time and chose to eat out in the evenings.We were grateful for her recommendations and local knowledge.We also appreciated the opportunity to eat breakfast outside in the sunshine .We found Shruti to be a warm and genuine soul who was polite and interested in our lives too.
summary: Shruti was warm and welcoming, provided a comfortable stay with great local knowledge

comments: This is a lovely flat in an excellent location. The entrance is right next to Gibson Gardens and then you walk through a courtyard to get to the entrance to the flats. It is beautifully decorated. Ami kept in emailed to ensure I picked up the keys from a drop off and that everything was ok. The flat is in a great location- just across the road from Abney Cemetery and around the corner from Church Street with all its bars and shops.
summary: Lovely flat in an excellent location, beautifully decorated and well-maintained by Ami

comments:
The host was very good at replying to messages but the room wasn't great. I'm not normally one to leave bad reviews but this was an experience.
To access the house and your room you need to use an app on your phone every single time, it took a while to get the app working firstly and then it meant anytime you went to the bathroom or kitchen you needed to bring your phone or you'd be locked out of your room.
The room and sheets and towels smelled like smoke, it was really gross - had to have the window open the whole time I was in there. The sheets had holes in and odd stains. The bed was springy and not comfortable. The bathroom was mouldy, everywhere.
summary: Poor experience due to issues with app access, cleanliness, and comfort of the room

comments:
it was an absolute pleasure staying with Sandra.
The room was light and spacious with plenty of wardrobe space and a desk. The rest of the house was clean and comfortable and Sandra made me feel very welcome and at home.
Sandra herself was unfailingly kind, helpful and easy to get on with.
I would not hesitate to recommend Sandra's as a place to stay.
summary: Sandra was kind and welcoming, provided a clean and comfortable stay

comments: The apartment 6 was in second floor, you have to use stairs. So, it’s suitable for maximum 2 persons . It is near from Bond street station and Oxford street. From the morning till 11 pm you can hear noise from outside due to nearby restaurants. Moreover if you come in summer there is no air conditioning. The host very helpful.
summary: The apartment is suitable for 2 people, near Bond street station, but noisy due to nearby restaurants.

comments: My stay in London was an absolute dream thanks to Soon Young. I unfortunately had a stuffy nose most of my stay but she kindly gave me a heat mat to warm myself at night as well as a tea to help with the stuffiness. I felt so calm and safe as a solo traveler and she was so easy to communicate and was really fun to speak with! She even made me some toast and eggs and laid fresh fruits on the day I didn’t feel the best. She was like an angel honestly! I truly recommend this stay. The bathroom was spotless!! And I’m excited to visit London again and stay here again!!
summary: Host Soon Young was extremely helpful and made the guest feel calm and safe during their stay.

comments:
The moment you walk into the luxurious lobby and are greeted by the concierge, you will feel you are in a quality building.
As the doors open to the apartment, you notice how large the apartment is, the stunning decor, the extremely well-appointed kitchen and finally, the vast expanse of sliding doors leading onto the balcony.
I can’t speak highly enough of this apartment and have started feverishly planning my next visit.
The host was extremely responsive and helpful.
summary: The luxurious apartment is spacious, well-decorated, and has a vast balcony with sliding doors.

comments: A cosy, convenient and comfortable studio right in the heart of Chelsea. Location was ideal. Sainsbury's supermarket next door to pick up supplies. Having the kitchen/washing machine was ideal for us.  We chose to eat in most nights after busy days seeing the sights.  A fantastic first-time visit to London. Ana was a very good communicator, nothing was a hassle.
summary: The studio apartment in Chelsea is cozy, convenient, and comfortable, with a good location and amenities.

comments: I had a wonderful stay at Verity's home! She was an exceptional host, providing a calm and beautiful home for me during my event nearby. The space was cozy, clean, and filled with thoughtful touches. Verity's hospitality and attention to detail made my stay truly enjoyable.  I would most definitely recommend her home and would stay again myself☺️ Thank you for a great experience!
summary: Host Verity provided a calm and beautiful home for the guest during their stay, with thoughtful touches and excellent hospitality.

comments: This is a great location close to 5 different underground lines and it made our stay very enjoyable! Really fast Internet (upwards of 350mbps down), basic cooking needs, and a decent size flat for two couples in our party. The heating elements are right up against where you sit on the toilet in the bathrooms so be mindful, cover with a towel or turn off. Thankfully, there's not a lot of noise at night (at least not enough to prevent us falling asleep). Living room/dining area was spacious enough to entertain a couple other folks visiting for an evening.
summary: Great location with fast internet, comfortable flat for two couples, and some minor issues with heating elements in the bathroom.

comments:
The rooms are located in a nice neighbourhood which is very convenient. It is close to nice cafes, train station and a variety of supermarkets. There’s also a nice park nearby. The kitchen is gorgeous and makes cooking a breeze. It faces a really nice large garden which would be nice to sit out and watch the day go by. The rooms are functional and the shower is in the room itself. The toilet is a shared WC just outside the rooms.
Jeanie was helpful and at the same time respectful of giving us space to use her kitchen. The rooms are good value for money and I would recommend staying here.
summary: Nice neighborhood with convenient access to cafes, train station, supermarkets, and a park, with a functional kitchen and helpful host.

comments:
L'appartement était très bien préparé pour notre arrivée ! très propre, tout est bien ordonné, on se sent attendus.
La literie est de très bonne qualité et les finitions sont soignées.
Anna a été patiente avec nous car nous avons eu quelques heures de retard. Nous sommes venus en voiture et à Londres la circulation est très difficile!
Le quartier est excentré mais en voiture , nous avons trouvé facilement (Attention de ne pas oublier de payer le parking /nous avons été verbalisés car nous ignorions qu'il y avait un horodateur)
summary: Well-prepared apartment with good quality bedding, clean and organized space, but be aware of parking fees and traffic in London.

comments:
Nous n'avons pas vu Sam (trop occupé à se gratter la barbe ?) mais avons été reçus par Michelle, très avenante.
Le logement est parfait pour 4 personnes, très calme et proche de Hampstead, très vivant et agréable (attention, la crêperie, très courue, n'ouvre qu'à partir du Jeudi.)
Le parc de Hampstead Heath tout proche, est magnifique, recommandé pour un pic-nic
Les indications écrites par Sam sont bien utiles.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour, le métro nous amène rapidement dans le centre de Londres
Nous avons pu arriver à 13H et repartir à 16H, ce qui est bien pratique.
A noter : Sam répond très rapidement aux mails ; merci
Seul petit bémol : la douche, à régler au millimètre, sinon c'est glacé ou brûlant.
Nous reviendrons sans hésiter
summary: Quiet and calm flat perfect for four people, close to Hampstead and its park, with useful written instructions from Sam, but some issues with the shower temperature.

comments:
Tony was responsive and the apartment was very central. It was a little tricky to get in with the lock on the front door being a little tricky.
On first impression, the apartment looked clean however the floor was a slightly dirty, leaving our feet and socks a little black.
Coffee/ tea would also have been nice but there was a cafe a few minutes away.
summary: Central location with responsive host Tony, but minor issues with cleanliness and lock on front door, and no coffee/tea provided.

comments: Great apartment. All amenities required supplied. Decor a little tired in places. We only stayed for one night and it was perfect for our needs. Bedding a bit rough and cheap not sure we would want to stay longer than one night. Great location. Would use again but bring our own bedding. Very homely otherwise. Owners communication has been excellent and all in all good value for money!
summary: Great apartment with all amenities, but some minor issues with bedding and decor.

comments: Absolutely loved staying here. Great location and super peaceful. Alick was an amazing host with helpful local tips. The tv/projector is a great touch if you want a quiet night in you can curl up and relax easily. Had a good space to work also if you need it.. but the beautiful peaceful garden is the best bit!
summary: Loved the peaceful location, helpful host, and beautiful garden.

comments: This is a lovely, quiet room and was perfect for a few days for a solo trip. The area is lovely, and the flat is well located in walking distance to tube and bus stops, with plenty of food and conveniences around as well. Melanie is a lovely host: accommodating and relaxed.
summary: Quiet room in a lovely area, perfect for solo trip, with accommodating host.

comments: Although the place was clean and the kitchen was great everything needed a bit of TLC the walls were marked and the bathrooms a bit rough around the bottom of the walls and bath. The description was not accurate as there was only one television in the one bedroom and not all 3 as stated and shown on the pictures. The bottom bedroom was very cluttered and we had nowhere to hang any clothes. The area was okay but not much there. Overall we did enjoy ourselves and the flat had plenty of space
summary: Clean but needs TLC, inaccurate description, cluttered bottom bedroom.

comments: Had a lovely stay at Jo’s apartment. So many thoughtful touches such as a breakfast basket, fresh organic milk and quality products such as soap, shampoo and body wash. The place was immaculately clean, the bed was incredibly comfortable and it was also in a great location which was within close walking distance of local shops, restaurants, pubs and cafes. Jo was also a lovely, attentive host who went above and beyond to ensure we had a comfortable stay!
summary: Immaculately clean apartment with thoughtful touches and great location.

comments: If you will be visiting London, Lyn's B&B is the place to stay!! Gavin was away but we had the pleasure of being pampered by Lyn! She was most helpful for us two Americans to find their way around! Lyn fed us so well!! I looked forward to her homemade goodies every morning, not to mention her assortments of jellies and teas! It was truly a treat to stay in their home! The room was very cozy and inviting! The bathroom was clean and the tub alone was a treat! Specially after a long day of walking around London! Oh and did I mention the garden?!?! A great spot to take in Gods beauty! We have already said, if London is a place we get a chance to go back to, I truly don't believe we will ever stay in a hotel again, Lyn and Gavin's home is where we want to rest our heads as long as they will have us!!!
summary: Lyn's B&B is a wonderful place to stay with a cozy room, delicious homemade goodies, and a beautiful garden.

comments:
Our stay at Miran's was just perfect! The flat is large and beautiful. We had all the amenities we needed to make our stay wonderful.
Miran was extremely helpful, friendly and quick with communication. The neighborhood was easily walkable with many restaurants and shops up and down the street. A bus stop is just outside the door and the Underground station is also easily accessible with a 15min walking you'd rather not ride the bus.
Note: The flat is directly atop a mosque so just be aware that there will be worship noise occuring, especially on Fridays, but we were not bothered.
We really enjoyed our stay and would absolutely stay again!
summary: Miran's flat was perfect with all amenities, friendly communication, and a great location near restaurants and shops.

comments:
Pictures are quite misleading, as the place is not maintained nearly as well as what the photos may indicate. The boiler is turned off around noon until early evening, so there is a chance that there is no hot water during that span, depending on other guests' usage. The wifi can also get unbearably slow at night and it feels like there is a general effort to reduce overhead costs (have to air dry laundry before putting them into dryer/emphasis on reducing water usage).
That said, the price point is low to the point that these issues have to be taken for what they are. The walk from the location to the main road is about a full 10 minute walk. From there, you can grab a bus towards Brixton which is the closest Tube station, though there are other buses heading directly towards the Knightsbridge/Victoria area. Again, for the price, it's hard to complain but the pictures and general description felt a bit deceptive.
summary: The place is not well-maintained, but the low price point makes it tolerable despite issues with hot water and wifi.

comments: What you see is what you will get. Even better when you are there in the apartment. It's very clean and everything has been carefully thought of to your stay a comfortable and enjoyable one. Very modern apartment and stylish. Also very friendly and warm host. You will get a quick response also. It's a fantastic area also for shopping, restaurants and the station is a walk away. I walked to the station on most days and was regularly in the East Croydon town center which has an array of shops.
summary: The apartment was very clean, modern, and stylish with a friendly host and great location for shopping and restaurants.

comments: Read through other reviews before booking, good value at £80 for two nights in London. There was lots of plug sockets and cupboards. Clever use of a small space, however it's not very private (you can hear everything) so not best for couples who like privacy. Found a fair bit of dust on the shelving, in the bathroom area, on the sheets, and the curtains were a little dirty along with a stain on the carpet and sofa. However, you do get what you pay for, it was in a brilliant location near the tube and did the job: somewhere to sleep and wash. We think we'll stay further in the centre next time just for ease.
summary: It's good value at £80 for two nights in London, but not private and had some cleanliness issues.

comments: Our stay in London was lovely thanks to Louise. She worked so hard to make sure we made it to her place safely and responded quickly to our questions. The apartment has a great. Jew and a balcony to enjoy. It also has a bus station right outside the door. Great for getting around London. I highly recommend her place and hope to return again in the future.
summary: Guest had a lovely stay at Louise's apartment in London due to her excellent service and amenities.

comments: This hotel was incredibly cheap but was a bad stay. Every inch of the carpets in the building was stained. The walls were splattered with something. Our bathroom door had a large crack in it from someone pulling it over the door stopper. Our window was broken and with our stay it was so hot it was unbearable and we decided to leave after just one night and book elsewhere. The way our stay went even with how cheap it was to stay it wasn’t worth it.
summary: Guest had a terrible experience with stains, cracks, and broken window at this hotel.

comments:
Clean bedding and towels and the bed is very comfy.
Lots of kind generous extras in the room such as drinks and snacks. My room wasn’t ready when I arrived but I was offered tea whilst I was waiting, much appreciated after a long journey.
The flat itself is run down and tatty. The furnishings tired. It only has single glazing so was very loud with road noise and people, which only stops after midnight and starts again at 5 am.
summary: Guest found the room clean and comfortable but the flat itself was run down and noisy.

comments: Great apartment – historical Victorian house with a beautiful interior, located very close to the city centre, yet in a calm and quiet area. Perfect for people looking for a romantic getaway holiday. The room was squeaky clean, as well as the common area. Upon arrival, we were greeted by the host, who was very friendly and helpful regardless of our both check-in and check-out being very early in the morning.
summary: Guest loved the historic Victorian house apartment for its cleanliness, location, and friendly host.

comments: Place is smaller than  expected. It is kind of difficult to find it as all buildings look the same. Somebody's dog urinated in the stairs. And the bathroom needs a deep cleaning. Also in the advertisementit mentions that there is a drying machine, but the only thing available is a clothing hanger. My average rating is 3 / 5 stars.
summary: Guest had a mediocre experience with a small place that was difficult to find, dirty bathroom, and false advertising.

comments:
George and his kids are just amazing amazing people, helpful and polite. Bedroom, bathroom and kitchen are really clean. The atmosphere in the house is really friendly and the connection with the centre and metro is immediate.
Thank you very much George for everything, I hope to see you again soon!
summary: Guest had a great experience at George's house, praising cleanliness, atmosphere, and location.

comments: This was our first time using air bnb. Llovely experience from start to finish, Monica was so welcoming, there was everything you needed in the bathroom, very clean and comfortable, with tv and wifi in your room, and bottles of water when you turned up,. Breakfast cooked by Paul was delicious, parking was good on their drive, and only a 10 min walk to Twickenham stadium. We were given a key to come and go as we pleased, absolutely perfect for all our needs, we will be going back and will be recommending  to everyone
summary: Monica and Paul's place was perfect for their stay, with excellent amenities, breakfast, and location near Twickenham stadium.

comments: Everything about Lizzy's flat exceeded our expectations: from the location, light, great kitchen, friendly neighbors, quiet, it all was a dream. Only a stone's throw from the bus stop meant it was super convenient to get into town. Having Broadway Market only a few blocks away meant we had fabulous coffee, bread, groceries at our fingertips and on Saturday, a great street market.
summary: Lizzy's flat exceeded expectations in terms of location, light, kitchen, and neighborhood, making it a dream to stay there.

comments: Ideal location for anyone seeking for a very quiet place where to rest after a deep immersion in the Londoners' movida! Roger's house is full of colors and reveals the artistic personality of its landlord. Comfortable and fully equipped: you can be sure of finding everything needed. Roger is extremely willing to help in every occasion and let you feel at perfect ease. Highly recommended!
summary: Roger's house was ideal for a quiet retreat from London's busy streets, with colorful decor and excellent amenities.

comments: Charlie is a wonderful host. He responded withing minutes and welcomed me in the flat on an extremely short notice, with a kind smile too. He was also super helpful when I needed his assistance the next morning with something urgent, and generally gave me the feeling that he's available for anything I might need during my stay. Thank you, Charlie! Till next time!
summary: Charlie was a wonderful host who responded quickly, welcomed guest warmly, and provided helpful assistance during their stay.

comments: Our stay at Lisa’s place was perfect. The apartment has absolutely everything you need for a comfortable stay and it makes you feel like you are home. The beds are comfortable, the kitchen is very modern and the living room and sofa really cozy. Communication with Lisa was really fast and warm, we would definitely stay here again!
summary: The apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay and the host's communication is excellent.

comments: Flora and Jacob are perfect hosts, excellent communication throughout and clear instruction of the booking, property and location. The area is great with fantastic links to all the parts of London. Good local area with shops restaurants and conveniences all around . Great stay at the property which is well equipped comfortable and immaculately clean highly recommend the property for a stay in London.
summary: The property is well equipped, clean, and in a great location with good links to all parts of London.

comments: The staff is amazing, all of them. Really friendly and professional. Immediate replies to queries, quick reactions (like when we asked to have the room changed). Really outstanding. Perfect location. Now, the rooms (at least the two I saw) need a lot of love. The showers need to be modernised, humidity on the walls in the rooms at the lower level (basement). The bed headers had head marks on them with peeled off fabric, the wardrobe bar for hanging clothes was too short and falling all the time. Too much furniture in the room for its size (always a good chance to play tetris while moving around). And very thin walls and ceilings.
summary: The staff is friendly and professional, but the rooms could use some modernization and maintenance.

comments:
War das zweite Mal hier und es wird nicht das letzte Mal gewesen sein. Tolle Unterkunft in erstklassiger Lage!
Man ist schnell in der Stadt, bei der U-Bahn und in unmittelbarer Nähe gibt es viele Restaurants, Cafés, Museen und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.
Besonders empfehlen kann ich das kleine Café gegenüber des Royal Marsdens Hospital. Der Kaffee und das Essen sind wahnsinnig gut und nicht überteuert.
Der Pub um die Ecke ist gut und kann mit einer Auswahl an Bier, Gin und Tonics überzeugen.
Wer etwas teurer ausgehen möchte, dem kann ich den Spanier an der U-Bahnstation wärmstens ans Herz legen! Die Tapas sind erstklassig.
summary: The accommodation is excellent, located in a fantastic area with many restaurants, cafes, and shops nearby.

comments:
PROs:
- Overall the home reflected the listing: very close to Hyde park and restaurants and walkable.
- While space was a bit tight, the house did have 3 bedrooms and 2 baths.
CONs:
- The keys were a bit difficult to operate. It may have been our lack of knowledge, but we needed to use the keys to lock from inside which was very inconvenient to get out.
- The biggest CON was the behavior of the cleaning lady. There was some confusion around the check-out time, and the lady came at 11:00 instead of 11:30. (this confusion could have been on both sides, to be candid). But the lady accused my daughter of lying (we had stepped out and coming to the home at that time). My daughter was distraught and started crying. As a result, we had to leave the house in a hurry - not a very pleasant departure.
summary: The house was convenient to Hyde Park and restaurants, but had some issues with keys and the cleaning lady's behavior.

comments:
A lovely 4-night stay at this BnB and had everything you could want at a great price. Northwood Tube is 5 mins walking distance. Lots of shops and local eateries a plenty.
Lisa was really polite, friendly and easy to work with. The place was really clean, comfy and lots of space.
Only things to mention would be firstly it’s in a ULEZ zone so check your vehicle is okay to enter the area.
Secondly the WiFi in the room wasn’t great also the signal is woeful in the area so trying to message/view maps/social media was really slow.
Finally, the mattress on the bed felt like it was going to fall apart during the night, thank goodness it didn’t.
These are minor inconveniences but just thought I’d mention as an honest reviewer.
Thank you for having us though Lisa, you were a brilliant host and the room did the exact job we wanted it to. We will deffo be coming back soon!
summary: Lovely BnB with great price, but minor issues with WiFi and mattress

comments: We found this a nice place to stay. It was a clean and well-appointed flat with room enough for two adults and three kids, and it had almost everything we needed for our stay. The only issues we had were the fact that the sofa bed was uncomfortable and should really have had a roll-up top mattress available for use with it, and the dining chairs, although comfortable, were all scratched and very well-used, dropping vinyl flakes on the floor. Overall though, it was pretty good and we would stay here again.
summary: Clean and well-appointed flat, but sofa bed was uncomfortable and dining chairs were scratched

comments:
Bon séjour chez Shane qui a répondu rapidement à nos sollicitations. L'appartement est correct pour 4 mais pas pour 5, le lit d'appoint n'est pas adapté nous avons donc dormi à 3 sur le canapé et 2 dans le lit car nous voyagions avec nos enfants.
Il manque un aspirateur ou un balai pour pouvoir faire un peu de ménage au cours du séjour.
Emplacement correct, 9 minutes à pieds de la gare de Willesden Junction, 1 minute pour l'arrêt de bus. Il faut compter entre 40min et 1h de trajet pour rejoindre le centre de Londres qui est bien desservi.
summary: Good stay at Shane's apartment, but it was a bit cramped for 5 people and lacked cleaning supplies

comments:
Lovely hotel in a great location. A short walk to the tube and Hyde park and with lots of local amenities close by it made our trip so easy.
The hotel is quirky and fun with so many lovely and interesting features. Although the rooms are small they provide more than enough space for a short stay. The rooms and common areas were clean and tidy and the staff couldn’t have been more accommodating. We will not hesitate to recommend to friends and family and we are looking forward to staying again soon.
summary: Quirky hotel in great location with friendly staff and plenty of local amenities

comments: We had a wonderful stay in the interesting area of Peckham! If you’re like us and love exploring changing, up-and-coming neighborhoods, you will love it.
