The bus stops right in front of the house and we felt like we’re staying with a friend and would therefore definitely stay there again, even though there’s no Tube stop nearby.
summary: Wonderful stay in Peckham neighborhood with bus stop right outside the house

comments:
I will give 5 star ⭐ to this place in term of cleaning ,location , host communication, well located and connected to center London.
Everything was available at 2 mins walkable distance.
My wife like the kitchen specially, everything was there and well organized.

One of the best place to stay, highly recommended.
Thank you Ben for all your help and assistance.
summary: The place needs improvement in cleaning, location, and host communication but has potential.

comments: Aruna is very welcoming person and easy going. He made me feel comfortable the first time we met for visiting the house and collecting the key. The apartment was immaculate, well decorated, nice very clean and cosy like in the pictures and the area is also great with all amenities close by.  I rented the flat for my parents for a week and they absolutely loved their stay and want to come back already ! And Aruna has contributed a lot for it - by staying available and prompt to our queries....so thank you so much Aruna, I highly recommend his service !
summary: Aruna's apartment was immaculate, well-located, and he provided excellent service.

comments: The photos don't do Vahid's place justice. We've stayed in the area many times, and this was one of our favourite flats. Charming rooms with high ceilings and huge windows letting in lots of light, comfortable furniture, and everything you might need in the kitchen. This is also very well located, close by Old St station and to numerous bus stops, and walkable to lots of interesting areas, like Columbia Rd Market, Spitalfields and Brick Lane, the City, etc. There is a very popular (and friendly!) pub at the corner, but they bring their sidewalk tables in around 10pm every evening, so the noise is contained and didn't affect our sleep. Vahid was a welcoming, friendly, and responsive host, and we appreciated his warmth and flexibility throughout our stay.
summary: Vahid's flat exceeded expectations with its charming rooms, high ceilings, and great location.

comments: One of those rare gems at Notting Hill run by REAL hosts, not an Agency! Highly recommended! About 4,5m high ceilings and enourmous windows, one of which giving to a communal garden... Very clean & perfectly located. Jodie is an adorable host - very attentive and helpful. I'd love to return there again!
summary: Jodie's house in Notting Hill is a rare gem with high ceilings, large windows, and perfect location.

comments:
A very pretty house situated in a quiet cul-de-sac in Chelsea.
The hub of the house is a large bright, airy kitchen with a small terrace.
The house is full of the family’s personal effects which suited me as I had chosen this house partly because of the fact it wasn’t a house that stood empty much of the time. I had wanted a house with some character.
The beds are extremely comfortable and the rooms are quiet.
On the first floor there is a further terrace, much larger than the ground floor. With a table for four.
The house does sleep six people but would better suit four in terms of living accommodation.
The hostess, Sophie, was responsive and accommodating both through the booking process and during my stay.
Overall a very lovely stay in a clean, well located (just off the Kings Road) house that is bursting with charm.
summary: Sophie's house in Chelsea was clean, well-located, and had character, but better suited for 4 people.

comments:
Très bel appartement dans l'ancienne ambassade de la Norvège sur Trafalgar Square , en plein centre de Londres , à deux pas de Soho et Chinatown . Très pratique pour manger sans se ruiner le soir . On peut faire énormément de choses à pied à partir de là .
La chambre est très confortable , avec un petit coin salon permettant de prendre son petit déjeuner ou son repas .
La chambre est plutôt calme , à part les importants travaux en cours qui démarrent à 07H30 le matin .
La cuisine est très fonctionnelle et la salle d'eau individuelle est très bien .
Nous n'avons pas été dérangé par les autres locataires car l'isolation entre les chambres est très bonne .
summary: The apartment was very comfortable with a small living room and individual bathroom, but the construction work starting at 7:30 am was noisy.

comments: My mother and I stayed here for our 12 day trip to London. The apartment was lovely. Had everything we needed. Close to stores and transportation. Being so close to the Bakerloo line made it very easy for transfers to trains for our day trips out of town. The outdoor space was lovely, to enjoy the wonderful weather we had, after a long day of sightseeing. Patrick was a very attentive host, very quick to respond to any questions or concerns.   I very highly recommended this little apartment.
summary: The apartment was lovely, clean, and had everything needed for a 12-day stay in London, with a great location near transportation and amenities.

comments:
What a delightful place. 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
Michelle was there to warmly welcome us despite the delay we experienced at Heathrow. The apartment was clean, and exactly as described in the advert. She even left toiletries and even food stuff for our use.
The apartment is situated in a good area with easy access to Algate East Station, shops, restaurants, and pubs. It was worth every pence and more.
My wife and I enjoyed every minute of our stay in the apartment and will go back again and again.
Highly recommended!!!!
summary: The apartment was perfect, clean, and exactly as described, with a warm welcome from Michelle and easy access to shops, restaurants, and pubs.

comments: Salwa could not meet us because of a family emergency but was in regular communication with me in the run up to my stay and arranged for her friend to meet us instead. Salwa also checked in with me during the stay to make sure all was well (sorry - I didn't see it until afterwards but thank you!) Our room and the communal spaces (kitchen and bathroom) were very clean, location is great - especially if you want somewhere close to Paddington but a bit quieter, that said - good pubs within easy reach. Just because we were surprised by it - will highlight that the flat has three bedrooms available so there may be other guests there during your stay and there is no living room.
summary: The room and communal spaces were very clean, the location was great for Paddington but quieter than expected, and Salwa's communication was excellent despite her absence.

comments:
Great place to stay at central london, the location is the best you will get for the price.
The entrance can be difficult if you have a lot of luggage, but nothing impossible, the room it’s definitely small but it has everything you might need, and its way better than in the pictures.
Just keep in mind this is a busy area and there are a lot of noises at night, we brought our own earplugs and had a good night sleep
summary: The apartment had a great central London location, but be aware that it can be noisy at night due to its busy area and small room size.

comments: This home is designed beautifully and functioned very well for our family of 5! We felt right at home, and the children enjoyed the garden on the dry days. Although, it’s a little farther outside the city, the location gives you a sense of everyday life as a Londoner :) I wouldn’t recommend this home to anyone looking for a wonderfully curated home with lots of space!
summary: This home is beautifully designed, spacious, and located just outside the city for an authentic London experience.

comments: Rosie and Stuart are incredibly nice people. They are flexible and make sure you make the most of your time in London. The house was very clean, comfortable and at the same time “homely”. Muswell Hill is a really nice area too. We would love to stay with Rosie and Stuart again when we have to opportunity!
summary: Rosie and Stuart's house was clean, comfortable, and homely, with a great location in Muswell Hill.

comments:
Eleonor's house is exactly like the pictures on nocarz, very clean, quiet, comfy and tidy.
We met eleonor a few times during the stay, she is super friendly and replies really quickly. She gave us a very detail house manual, showing how to use tv, and everything which is really nice.
I think the best thing of this house is that there is a lift in the building (which is quite rare in london) and the house locates very close to the earl's court station (which also has lifts too) . It has easy access to all london attractions and the airport. I will definitely suggest eleonor's house, if you are travelling with parents like me, or doesnt want to carry luggage upstairs.
Thank you very much for giving us an amazing stay Eleonor :) xx
summary: Eleonor's house is very clean, quiet, and convenient, with easy access to London attractions and amenities.

comments: This was a perfect place to stay for us. The location is great with short walking distance to two tube lines giving easy access around London. We were able to easily get to central London, the Olympic park, and the airport. The pub next door was a fantastic way to end off an evening with great local brews as well. Would highly recommend this place for a stay in North London.
summary: This place has a great location for exploring North London, with two tube lines nearby and a pub next door.

comments:
My family and I absolutely loved Mary's space. It was exactly what we needed and more. It was exceptionally clean and absolutely beautiful in every way. Mary's attention to all the little details and helpful directions made for a very easy adjustment to a new city.
Whenever we had a question for Mary she would respond very quickly whether it was before our arrival at Mary's house or during our stay. Public transportation such as bus stations and tube stations were walking distance away and could get you into the city in about 30 minutes. It was a lovely quiet space to come back to after a long day exploring.
summary: Mary's space was exceptionally clean, beautiful, and well-equipped, with helpful directions and quick responses from the host.

comments:
非常感谢主人的热情接待。及时处理了我们的咨询和问题。推荐大家选择这个住家：）
Thanks Rajna and her family's hospitality and kind help to my inquires. We much appreciate your accommodation with comfortable beds and great location to get around easily in the central London with many shoppings in the nearby Westfield! All my families enjoyed staying at your place and would like to recommend this to other people as well! Thank you all again from Yuki
summary: The host's hospitality was excellent, and we highly recommend this accommodation.

comments:
Lovely 3bd, 2 ba apartment just outside of the chaos of central London, but close to the underground (Warwick/Bakerloo Line) and bus stop to make it easy to get into London. The apartment area is in nice, safe and walkable area with a small Tesco and other bodegas close-by and many restaurants. You can take one of the Little Venice canal boats to Camden and then walk to the London Zoo/Regents Park. If you want, you can even walk to Paddington Station which is about 1/2 mile away.
The apartment has all of the amenities you need including a dishwasher and a separate washer and dryer. There is a nice private park in the center of the complex that has a nice play area for children 10 and under.
summary: This 3-bedroom apartment is a great location for exploring London, with plenty of amenities nearby.

comments: Ayoob is a great host with perfect instructions and quick reaction times. Flat is spacious and very conveniently located. Tons to discover by foot and public transportation. Really enjoyed the cleanliness as well as amenities like shower gel, coffee towels etc. The bars below are noisy as described, but I guess that's to be expected in Soho. Perfect spot for a weekend trip to London and indulge in Soho's night life. Definitely recommend!
summary: Ayoob is a great host with a well-equipped flat in a convenient location, perfect for a weekend trip to Soho.

comments: Could not have asked for better. Extremely well equipped nocarz, in particular when it comes to the kitchen as well. We had no issues with the stairs involved and I think it's accurately described. Location very central, right by Chinatown and at times loud at night. Would stay there again or any other property Nassau has.
summary: This property was extremely well equipped and located in the heart of Chinatown, we would stay here again.

comments:
I feel so lucky to have found Lucka's beautiful renovated flat loacated in South London. A quick tube ride to the City Centre without paying a huge premium. Small hiccups for the lock and thermostat during our stay, but Lucase came over personally right away even at late hours which is greatly appreciated. Awesome host
Highly recommended
summary: Lucka's beautifully renovated flat is a great value for its location, with easy access to the city centre.

comments: We spent 3 nights. The location was perfect for us and allowed us to catch up with friends in the area. Very easy to get a bus to Finsbury Park and then onto the Victoria Line into central London.  The accommodation was spacious for a couple, large bathroom, bedroom (separated from living area by curtain) and large living/ dining area with a separate kitchenette. We will certainly consider coming back. Thank you Derek and Brenda.
summary: The location was perfect for us and the accommodation was spacious with easy access to central London.

comments: I cannot praise Marianne enough for all the brilliant things she did for me during my stay. I was in hospital for surgery and she bent over backwards to make sure my family were well looked after. Not only was her apartment impeccably turned out, her communication and all round understanding was heart warming. I loved speaking to her and cannot recommend her higher than the highest of the high!  What a wonderful woman and a great place to stay! Thank you sooo much.
summary: Marianne went above and beyond as a host, providing impeccable service and communication during my stay.

comments: Katharine and Johnny were great hosts made us feel welcome! They have a lovely home and the conversion of the loft was beautiful making it a comfortable place to stay! We had never been to Richmond before so the recommendations of where to go from Katharine and Johnny were helpful! Loved our stay!
summary: Katharine and Johnny were great hosts who made us feel welcome in their lovely home with helpful recommendations for the area.

comments: Milena’s place was exactly as described and shown in the pictures. She’s such a lovely host; very inviting and amicable. She’s always on hand with recommendations or help to get to places with a great knowledge of London. The area is very quiet and public transport is so easily accessible and super easy to find. Shes such a responsive host and even replies after you’ve left, if like me you left belongings behind she’s always helpful and is happy to help you get them back to you. Would definitely recommend this place to everyone.
summary: Milena's place was exactly as described, quiet and easily accessible with a responsive host who helped with any needs.

comments: Absolutely stunning apartment and so beautifully kept by Alina. My parent stayed here for 3 nights and they loved it so much. Super clean, near Manor house tube station (5 mins walk). My parents fell in love with all the plants kept at Alina's place. Alina was very good in communication. Just one area to improve on, if the name of the building and flat number can be mentioned in the listing or provided a day before check in will be make it excellent. Highly recommended, thank you Alina.
summary: Alina's apartment was stunningly clean and beautifully kept, with great communication from the host and a convenient location near Manor House tube station.

comments: Warm welcome in a very quiet area with a lot of opportunities for good food and drinks in the evening. Close to the Northern-line which is great to visit different areas of London. Lots of recommendations by the host, and very flexible and reactive. Would be happy to return one day
summary: Warm welcome and quiet area with plenty of food and drink options near Northern-line tube station.

comments:
My first nocarz experience was entirely positive. I happily recommend this property.

The room is bright and large, the bed is comfortable, and the property is located conveniently close to Brixton tube station - just a short distance from central London.

Ivy is an attentive host, providing breakfast each morning and is generous with advice on getting around London and places to see. Ivy goes to considerable effort to ensure the comfort of her guests.
summary: Bright and large room in a convenient location near Brixton tube station with attentive host Ivy.

comments: Shlome was hyperprofessional and very, very sweet and helpful! Everything was easy and well organised! My friends and I enjoyed the stay at the small apartment - that is a tiny bit smaller than one might expect from pictures! We fully recommend our host and the apartment! Thank you so much for having us!
summary: Shlome was very helpful and organized, providing a comfortable stay at the small apartment despite its smaller-than-expected size.

comments:
Great location with easy access to the tube and buses. Easily walkable to Brick Lane. Nice neighborhood with respectable locals and shops. Amazing restaurants all within walking distance.
The flat had all you need for a multiple night stay. Everything you may need to be comfortable just as if you were home.
Federico was very responsive, timely, offered great local ideas and kept us up-to-date on all we needed to know. Highly recommend and would stay there again!
Thank you!
summary: Great location with easy access to tube and buses, nice neighborhood with good restaurants and shops near Brick Lane.

comments:
Good if you want a cheap budget friendly hotel in a good location. Close to tube stations which is good for getting around London. The bedroom and bathroom were clean and fresh towels, shampoo and shower gel were provided upon arrival.
Check in was easy and the staff were friendly.
The reason for giving a 3 star review is that when we came back to the hotel in the evening there was a strong smell of weed coming from our hallway and really loud music as if people were having a party in one of the rooms nearby. Obviously this is not the fault of the hotel but it was quite unpleasant.
Aside from that it was a good stay for the price we paid.
summary: Good budget-friendly hotel in a good location, but had issues with strong weed smell and loud music from neighboring rooms.

comments: The flat is half basement. But this is hid by the landlord so professionally that in the pictures all the curtains are closed. Since it is basement, there is constant mold and humid problem in the flat which affects human health really adversely. As soon as you enter the flat you feel it so intensely. Although we booked the flat for a month we had to terminate on the 3rd night as started to feel unhealthy.  Landlord said there is dehumidifier in the flat (which justifies what i said above) and if we run it non stop it would go away. We run the machine all night long it just helped a bit. When i told this to the landlord, he said over the last days it rained a lot so that is why the humid is. But helloooo, it is not Sahara Desert, it is meant to rain often heavily in this city..  And the price is not reasonable at all, for the same price we found a really modern and nice residence. But still even the flat would offered by a third price, would not recommend you to rent because staying there is too bad for your health so never!!! No human being should stay there..

comments: We spent  lovely days at Ossy&Gaia”s House. Thank you for hospitality !!! For Useful Tips!!! That due to our plans were changed , you let us to leave our luggage at your place for several days! We appreciate that lots!!! The flat is very clean ,  there are all necessary things for cooking , for having glass of wine in the evening :-)  Wishing You all the Best!!! Thank You!!!
summary: We had a lovely stay at Ossy&Gaia's House, the host was very welcoming and helpful.

comments:
I loved staying in James and Akbar's home. I was traveling by myself and this place felt like a home away from home. From the start, communication was great. They checked with me prior to my arrival to confirm my time and Akbar was there to greet me and show me the house. Now, for the house... IT IS BEAUTIFUL! Everything is very tasteful and clean, and the views! Two of the four walls in the kitchen are huge windows from were you can see part of the London skyline (the Shard and the BT tower). I spent many moments looking at this view. I was lucky that my room also had part of this gorgeous view, alongside a very comfy bed, a spacious closet and several extra amenities like a tv, a hair dryer, and convertible power plugs (very useful!).
This place was great because it allowed me to explore the city, basically you can get ANYWHERE from here. It is a five minutes walk to Euston Station, which has the Northern and Victoria lines, and many buses to connect you with the rest of the tube system, as well as railway services to other parts of England. In addition there are so many walking distance places you can visit! I went to King's Cross (~10 minutes), Gordon Square, if you are interested in seeing where Virginia Wolf and other writers from the Bloomsbury Group lived (~5 minutes), The British Museum (~12 minutes), Regent's Park (~25 minutes), and I am sure many more I did not have time to explore!
James and Akbar also allowed me to use the kitchen which was great because I was able to visit a nearby, and very well stocked Waitrose supermarket, and buy ingredients to prepare breakfast, lunch, and dinner, something to consider if you are traveling within a budget or want to eat healthy during your trip. I was also able to use the washer and dryer, great because I was traveling around England and not all places have this commodity.
James and Akbar are very accommodating, laid-back, friendly, generous, and warm hosts. If I ever return to London I hope to stay with them and I would highly recommend their home to all my loved ones. You should not let the opportunity to stay with them pass you by!
summary: James and Akbar's home was beautiful, clean, and perfectly located for exploring London.

comments:
We had a wonderful time in Milena's totally comfortable apartment. Everything worked perfectly, it was spacious and airy and we felt like the kings of the city. The warmth of the decor is not evident in the photos and was welcome after the sterility of some other places where we have stayed. Milena made us extremely welcome and was a generous host. Gratitude from all of us,
Sally, Paul and boys, from Australia.
summary: We had a wonderful time in Milena's apartment, it was comfortable, spacious, and well-decorated.

comments:
Daniel is a super host.
He has been always available for our questions and gave us some tips as well.
The house is really clean and spacious and is in a really quite area but not far from city center.
A supermarket is right to the next door and even public transportation are close!
Really suggested room and host!
summary: Daniel is a super host with a clean and spacious house in a quiet area near the city center.

comments:
We really enjoyed our stay here for a weekend in London. The apartment was immaculately clean, well furnished and a very pleasant, relaxing space.
We’ll located for access to the underground to go further into London and DLR trains to head out to Greenwich through Canary Wharf.
The host was very responsive and the check in details very comprehensive and clear. Would definitely stay again
summary: Clean and well-furnished apartment with easy access to London's underground.

comments: The place is pretty nice but it's a bit of a pain to walk 15 minutes to the metro station every morning to get into the more populated area of London. It was also difficult because you're only provided 1 key. If you're in a group that wants to separate it can be difficult. Overall would recommend.
summary: Nice but a bit far from the metro station and only one key provided.

comments: We enjoyed our stay at Alice's place. It was clean, fresh and had everything we needed. the Beds were super comfy and is is absolutely silent at night. The road is a dead-end, so there is no traffic noise. Alice messaged to check in on us during our stay, and the check in process was easy. I saw that previous guests reported a damp smell in the bathroom. We didn't experience this at all so perhaps it has been resolved or perhaps they were being a bit dramatic. Parking is free from 6:30pm to 8:30am. I highly recommend staying here if you want a simple, clean and quiet place.
summary: Quiet, clean, and comfortable stay with friendly host and free parking.

comments: I recommend this place for everyone. It was clean everywhere, there were snacks in the kitchen, the toilet isn’t in the room but it is right in front of the door (I am saying this because I was worried at first). There are umbrellas so that you can take one when you go out. The host is super responsive and friendly, I asked him so many questions and he kept answering really fast. We really enjoyed our time there!
summary: Clean and well-equipped apartment with responsive and friendly host.

comments: Caroline is reactive and answers quickly. She offered us a warm welcome despite an unexpected very late arrival, with lovely attentions. She also provided good advices on activities. Caroline is a kind person, easy to access. Her appartement was clean, confortable and well equipped ; we did not miss anything.  This is well deserved: first bus stop is at 5 minutes walking distance. We are a family with 3 children, We spent 5 days like « at home », we all recommend.
summary: Clean, comfortable, and well-equipped apartment with kind and helpful host.

comments:
Salve...sono Daniela.. siamo stati ospiti da Chris… Anche se la stanza non è enorme , è pulita (grande cosa rispetto ad altri alloggi di Londra), carina e calda. Il bagno è nuovo, ben strutturato, ha un' ampia doccia. La colazione era ottima e preparata in base alla ns nazionalità (italiana). La posizione è buona; due secondi dalla metro(dietro casa) e pochissima distanza da zone centrali. Ci sono tanti punti di ristorazione, x tutti i gusti e negozi di tutti i tipi. Chris è una brava persona, carina e ospitale. Anche se parliamo pochissimo l' inglese, è riuscito a consigliarci alcuni posti da visitare e a farsi capire.
A chi dovesse recarsi a Londra, consiglierei la sua casetta in WHITE CHAPEL . BUON VIAGGIO...
summary: Daniela had a great stay at Chris's place in White Chapel, praising its cleanliness, location, and Chris's hospitality.

comments: Christina, Leslie, Kim and Tracy are amazing host and you would be lucky to stay in their house. It is super clean and super organized with a lock on your door. Christina and Leslie were also very helpful with helping me with other things around London as well. So I would def recommend staying here, and I will probably return there in the future. Thank you for taking great care of me as your guest.
summary: Christina and Leslie were amazing hosts, providing a clean and organized space with helpful recommendations for London.

comments: Brenda was fantastic, helpful and kind. She was happy for a chat but happy to leave me alone to just chill. Brenda’s home was comfortable, clean and presented beautifully and the bed warm and I slept well. Her home was 15 mins to the train station & even closer to bus stops to get you anywhere you want to go I just love trains so I went by them . Her local knowledge was great and gave me ideas where to eat & the choice was many. I enjoyed my stay and would definitely return to Brenda’s if need be one day , thank you Brenda for being a great host .
summary: Brenda was a fantastic host, offering a comfortable and clean home with great local knowledge and amenities nearby.

comments: I am honestly so happy with the decision I made, choosing to book Fahima’s place. Super blessed to had stayed the night, she was very helpful and tried her best to stay out of the way although we honestly didn’t mind her as she’s such a joy even just to speak to! May God bless her abundantly. Thank you !!
summary: Fahima's place was perfect, with a helpful and kind host who made the guest feel blessed to have stayed there.

comments: Perfect location for our visit to Wimbledon, tube 2 minutes away. The flat was exactly as pictured, lots of coffee pods , mineral water, everything you could need in the kitchen. Good hot shower , comfy bed and Clare was quick and easy to contact . Local stores and restaurants just round the corner - We’ll be back !
summary: Clare's flat had a perfect location for Wimbledon, with amenities nearby and a comfortable space that exceeded expectations.

comments: La experiencia fue buena, todo muy limpio y una excelente ubicación. Sin embargo, no le doy 5 estrellas porque al recoger mis maletas no había llaves disponibles para ingresar a retirarlas , Aunque Jordán resolvió el problema en 20 minutos, estuve preocupado porque necesitaba las maletas para viajar.Pero súper recomiendo la estadía !!!
summary: Good experience with clean and well-located accommodation, but had some issues with luggage retrieval.

comments: Spent 3 nights and had a wonderful time.  The room at the top floor is very spacious, private and beautifully decorated.   The area may not be touristy but Underground station is very walkable, there's bus stops all around so the place has great access to central London. It's covered in peaceful residential area ambient which was exactly I was looking for.   Lots of great eating options nearby.  I would definitely recommend the place and want to go back soon myself.
summary: Had a wonderful time in this spacious and beautifully decorated room with great access to central London.

comments:
The house is approx 8-10 min walk from the nearest metro station. The room was very clean and in a perfect condition.
I didn't get to meet Alexandra as she was away but I met her sons. I arrived earlier before the check-in time and I was kindly offered to leave my luggage.
I loved the room, comfortable bed, clean towels and bed sheets.
The house is 20 min tube ride to most London attractions.
Would highly recommend and I would consider booking again.
A great place to stay!
summary: Clean and comfortable room in a peaceful residential area with easy access to London attractions.

comments:
Charles and Jana are exceptional, adorable and caring hosts.
We stayed in a typical English house, the room was well decorated, warm and comfortable.
In the morning we had a very hearty English breakfast.
Buses are 5 minutes from the house and take us directly to central London. Very practical given the city's heavy traffic.
We highly recommend this place for a friendly and friendly stay in London.
5 stars
Estelle Philippe and Lou😉
summary: Exceptional hosts with a warm and welcoming home serving hearty English breakfasts.

comments:
Sanya was a great host! Quick to respond to questions and helpful.
I had a great stay. It’s a cute flat in an awesome location. Steps away from restaurants, bars, transit, and entertainment.
Flat is a roomy size which I enjoyed. I felt like I had a lot of space to spread out. It’s up a couple flights of stairs but nothing strenuous. It’s a nice spot to stay!
summary: Great stay in this cute flat with a lot of space and an awesome location near restaurants and transit.

comments: Good value and in a good location close to Eden Park station. Aidan is a lovely host, very welcoming and easy to communicate with. The double room is next to the bathroom which we had sole use of. The home is in a gated community so is very secure. It's very quiet and peaceful. Very good train links to central London. Just stayed the one night and it gave us everything we needed. We felt welcomed and comfortable.
summary: Good value and location, welcoming host with a clean and secure home.

comments: Great person - terrible host. Got ill and kindly asked her two times, day after day,  not to put the heaters off in the room as the room is big and i was freezing inside. The third time I have returned home at night (12 pm) and messaged her on the phone (kindly) to turn on the heater (again). No answer. I went to knock into her room (the light was on) - no answer. I did it another time and after that went to sleep with my winter clothes on, also wrote her a message, that’s it’s not what I am paying for. After that I stayed couple more days and haven’t see her after ever again. She never replied - never even mentioned the situation that happened. Ok. I remember one thing pretty well her saying when we met: “I’m not a hotel, I just give you a room, if you don’t like something, book a hotel”. Basically that’s everything you need to know. She didn’t say it to me, but that’s her attitude. Not a bad person.. she just doesn’t care at all about people who are staying at her home. My advice: book a hotel! :)
summary: Terrible experience with unresponsive host who didn't care about guests' needs.

comments: I had a wonderful stay at Joanne's place in London. The location was perfect, very close to the metro, which made getting around the city incredibly easy. The accommodation was clean and well-maintained, and having a parking spot was a huge plus. Joanne and her family were fantastic hosts, always friendly and communicative. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting London.
summary: Wonderful stay at Joanne's place with perfect location, clean accommodation, and friendly hosts.

comments: I am sorry that it could not be a better review but unfortunately our experience getting into the property was quite traumatic - the key box was jammed and we were left on the streets on London at midnight with nowhere to stay and no hotel rooms available. The management team were really not great at sorting out the situation: it took hours for them to eventually tell us they couldn’t help. We all had to attend a work meeting the next day without any sleep. Hopefully for future they will put an emergency key somewhere. Once we did get inside, the house itself was really nice, clean and with everything we needed.
summary: Traumatic experience getting into the property due to jammed key box and unhelpful management team.

comments:
La personne qui nous a accueilli était très gentille mais il y a vraiment quelques travaux à faire même si pour Londres le prix est attractif.
On est arrivée 1h a l avance et pour déposer nos bagages on a du payer un peu. C est dommage pour 1h. Par contre c est proche de la gare et proche des Metro donc très facile d accès .
summary: Nice but dated home in a good location, with some issues with check-in and extra baggage fee.

comments: Despina is a standout host. She will go out of her way to make you feel comfortable and I can’t stress that enough. Self check-in was simple and efficient. The space is completely private and you can rest assure that your privacy will be respected. While some have mentioned that it is a bit of a walk to the nearest station, we found it to be a non-issue and a fantastic trade-off with the level of hospitality that we received. This is the kind of nocarz you want to stay at — with a host that genuinely cares about their guests.
summary: Despina is a standout host who goes out of her way to make guests feel comfortable.

comments:
We had a great experience at the fox den! Everything was clean and nicely decorated, we felt very at home. We loved the little balcony and the amazing views you could get over canary wharf. We had everything we needed for our weekend trip and the host Sinnead was very friendly and gave us a warm welcome and showed us around the apartment. The area is very quiet which was nice to get a well rested sleep and relax in the evening from walking around the city all day. The flat is only 10mins away from a tube station which makes getting around London very easy. For us it was also very easy to travel from the Mile End station to the airport as there is a great straight bus connection.
Thank you to our great host! We had an amazing weekend!
summary: The Fox Den has everything you need for a great stay, with friendly hosts and easy access to London.

comments:
The place is as the pictures and comfortable enough for 5 of us. Distance from the tube is 15-20 mins walk, could be a bit tough if you are lugging heavy luggage. However there’s a bus service to Kings Cross area which was pretty convenient. Owner was rather responsive to our requests like change of towels since we were staying for 5 nights and when dishwasher liquid run out, owner got his cleaner to deliver to us.
Also appreciate the fact that the owner allowed us to collect our luggage later after our check out since our flight was at night.
Only thing was that the unit is on ground floor and when we opened our window at night, it was a bit noisy from talking noises from passers by and ambulance sirens. No laundry detergent was provided as per the owner, so if you are staying for a number of nights and want to do laundry, bring your own laundry capsules. Having a laundry rack will be helpful to the guests. Overall has a pretty good experience staying in the unit
summary: The place is as advertised, but be aware of the 15-20 minute walk to the tube and some noise from passersby.

comments:
This spot was a dream in many ways — it's a spacious proper 1-bedroom apt, which I'm told is difficult to come by in London. The location is super close to train lines, and less than a 10min walk to Brick Lane for all your vintage shopping needs.
Ed was incredibly helpful and responsive. Would come back!
summary: This spacious 1-bedroom apartment in a great location with helpful hosts is a dream come true.

comments: My wife and I enjoyed our stay. The location was perfect. Central and close to multiple stores, restaurants and the train station. The place was very clean, and decorated with character. The home was stocked with most items that we needed. The host was very responsive and helpful. Will definitely book again!
summary: The place was perfect for our stay, clean, decorated with character and stocked with everything we needed.

comments: Riccardo has a great place, confy and very well located (near Canadá water station), I have to say that is in very pretty neighborhood (much green and foxes included), The house is tidy an the room has a good space, the bed is very confortable, I slept so well, the bathroom is very clean. By the other hand Riccardo is great host too kind, and helpful everytime, Even if you want to have a Nice talk he's always available, don't forget to ask for hints and suggestions about London. I would definitely stay there again.
summary: Riccardo's place is comfortable, well-located, and clean with a great host.

comments:
An excellent hospitality offered from Olivia!
Olivia is a very nice lady. Quick responses in nocarz messenger during booking. After I moved in, she provided me a lot of advices when I asked for as it is my first time visiting London. The breakfast was splendid with lot of fruit and choices.
The house is located very close to underground train station, bus stop and B&F outlets. The room is a ensuite, clean and bed is comfortable.
summary: Olivia offers excellent hospitality, a clean room, and helpful advice for first-time London visitors.

comments: Emil‘s place felt like home from the very first beginning. The apartment is very nice and it is exactly as shown and described within the listing. It is clean and cozy and a great place to stay even for a month or longer. The area is a nice one with Camden Market and a lot of restaurants close by and within less than 10 minutes you can reach the northern line underground that takes you to London City in less than 15 min. Emil and Erik are great people who love to give you some local advices and I enjoyed talking to them every time. Would definitely come back if I had the chance again. 100% recommended!
summary: Emil's apartment is cozy, clean, and conveniently located near Camden Market and public transportation.

comments: Daima’s place is super convenient, clean throughout, full of modern touches to make a stay easy, and maintained in fine order. The living space is particularly generous by London standards, being light and airy and nice to spend time in. Bedrooms are comfortable and bathroom is small but modern and everything functions as it should. Peaceful location and close to public transportation links. Thank you for a comfortable and convenient stay.
summary: Daima's place is modern, convenient, clean, and peaceful with a generous living space.

comments:
The listing was accurate. The flat was clean.

Need to check some of the bathroom fixtures panel around tub pops out and plug for the tub is hard to remove without the chain attached. Also, toilet room sink faucet fell off.

Only other thing to consider is a note about how to use the laundry. We figured it out, but it's not necessarily intuitive.

Only mention these things for reference as they did not get in our way of enjoying the flat. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend it to anyone.
summary: The flat was accurate to the listing, clean, but had some minor issues with bathroom fixtures.

comments:
This is a great location! Easy to get around by foot or tube/rail (3 min walk). It’s close to so much and there’s plenty to do. I was only there for a Monday night so I did not have loud noise from the bar/street and slept soundly.
The unit is on the highest floor but I did not mind it. It was very clean and neat. I would stay here again. I highly recommend it!
summary: Great location, easy to get around, and very clean.

comments: Easy to find, next to tube station, good location. Rooms are basic but pleasant. However we had an issue checking in because my nocarz took my first and middle name as my booking name. Kip require a photo ID in order to checkin. My ID (driving license and passport) didn’t have my middle name on so they wouldn’t allow checkin. These seems very unusual, I would hate to think what would happen if someone booked a room for someone else (friend/family/through work). The receptionist was rude about it too.
summary: Good location but had issues with check-in due to name mismatch on ID.

comments:
House was good size and walkable to where we needed to be. Tv wasn’t working when we arrived but someone came over and sorted it after I said I can’t wait for the following day due to my kids being there.
Light and good space in the house and garden a good size.
summary: House was good size, walkable to where we needed to be, and TV issue was quickly resolved.

comments:
Nous avons passé 5 nuit dans ce logement et nous ne sommes pas du tout déçu, arrivé dans le logement facile, super bien situé !
La propreté du logement était nickel, nous avons rien à redire.
Attention pour les sensibles à la lumière du jour, il n’y a pas de volet, juste un rideau qui n’empêche pas la lumière de rentrer ! N’oubliez pas votre masque de nuit !
summary: Clean and well-situated apartment, but note that it gets direct sunlight.

comments: This was such a charming and sweet place to stay. It felt really homey and special (unlike some of those corporate/soulless spots out there) and we loved Jenny’s decorating style. Placed on a lovely quiet street but with easy access to buses/the tube, and a small high street 5 minutes away with grocery, pharmacy, restaurants, etc. It really felt like home! Thank you Jenny 😊
summary: Charming and homey place with easy access to buses and the tube.

comments:
One of the best nocarzs I have stayed at.
The apartment offers extreme comfort and everything has been thought through to make it feel like home with everything you need.
Linda is extremely reactive and always ready to help and even go beyond.
The jacuzzi and the projector are definitely the highlight.
summary: The apartment offers extreme comfort with everything thought through for a homey feel.

comments:
This home is very conveniently located close to Leyton High Street and the charming little villagey
Francis Road. It’s just a 10 minute walk to the tube station which is on the Central Line. Nice well equipped kitchen/dining area with small grassed courtyard with bbq. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms, small tv room
summary: Conveniently located near Leyton High Street and the tube station, this home is well equipped and spacious.

comments: A very different experience for us to stay at Brett's place; its very personal,  a real home from home. for london there's a lot of space indoors and outdoors. The hot tub was amazing. comfy home which was very welcoming after visiting the city. a short walk to the local DLR station, and bus routes. good value for money, if we got the chance to return we would.
summary: Brett's place is a personal and welcoming home with plenty of space indoors and outdoors, including an amazing hot tub.

comments: I tried to give as accurate review as possible here. Great communication, great location, great price, etc. The only thing I’d say is that it is very small (as a lot of places are in London) and its right above a pub so if you’re a bigger person who likes an early night, it’s maybe not perfect for you. Me and the mrs aren’t big humans and we love a pint so it was bloody perfect for us. Just something to be aware of.
summary: A small but great value for money apartment in a good location, just above a pub.

comments: Yinka is a beautiful human being and we've been very glad to spend these days with her. She has a very nice taste, her place is very clean and we had a wonderful time there. Her area is lovely, calm, full of nice shops, and very convenient to visit London. We'd definitely come back. Thank you very much Yinka.
summary: Yinka's place is clean, lovely, and convenient to visit London, with a beautiful host.

comments: Brett and his team were extremely responsive and detailed in all of their instructions. The location is wonderful, with a beautiful collection of shops and everything you could need within ten minutes walking. The apartment is well furnished, and the patio is quite lovely as well. Would definitely stay here again when visiting London!
summary: The apartment is well-furnished, in a great location with shops and amenities nearby.

comments: Awesome house, awesome host! Sha is a stellar guy, going above and beyond. His directions were clear, his welcome and explanations at the house were very comprehensive, he gave plenty of helpful info about the area, the city, what to see, and how to get there; and he also had a bunch of gifts when we arrived to help us settle in. The house was perfect. It was immaculate, clean and tidy, up-to-date, and fully equipped with more than you'd need for your stay. The house is also a 1-minute walk to the subway station. This is where you want to stay in London! We'll be back, Sha.
summary: Sha's house was immaculate, clean, and fully equipped, with excellent service and helpful information about the area.

comments: George is a really awesome guy and it was a pleasure to meet him and stay at his cosy apartment. The WiFi was super fast and the apartment a great value for a budget traveller. bus route very close that gets you to the tube and everywhere, I even   just walked one night from Central London back to the apartment. I am grateful for George's hospitality and for a great stay.
summary: George's cosy apartment was a great value for budget travellers, with fast WiFi and good location near public transport.

comments: I wanted a place near Kew-this is it. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom had a deep bath with nice shower. There is no air conditioning but the window opened wide for fresh air and there is a good fan. Great breakfast everyday with excellent service - cappuccino included if you prefer.
summary: The bed was comfortable, bathroom had a deep bath, and breakfast was excellent at this place near Kew.

comments:
Goran was a perfect host , from check-in to departure ! Despite a delay of our arrival, he waited for us to show us the most beautiful corners of the neighborhood, which is very quiet while being 5 minutes walk from the Chalk Farm station ( which provides access to the center London in 10 minutes) , 6 minutes from Regent 's Park and 7 -minute walk from Camden lock : Perfect location !
The apartment itself is decorated with taste , lounge / kitchen is very large , everything is designed to accommodate at least 4 people : dishwasher, washing machine, coffee machine , tea ... and rooms, a little smaller than the living room, are Hyper comfortable after a long day of walking! Perfect flat and perfect host, I recommend !
summary: Goran's apartment was perfect, with a great location near Chalk Farm station, Regent's Park, and Camden lock.

comments:
Alice’s beautiful London townhouse was the perfect location for a trip to London with children. The place is stunningly decorated and perfectly located for wanders around Notting hill.
Alice went above and beyond to cater to our specific needs in regards to cleaning products, specifics for the children and was always reachable by phone. couldn’t recommend highly enough!!
summary: Alice's London townhouse was perfectly located and decorated, with excellent service from Alice herself.

comments: Although the room is very small,  we had a great time. Getting in was easy with the keysafe and the detailed instructions. Karol and Ibrahim responded very quickly and offered help if needed. The only problem is that  the room has only a small window which opens to the staircase, so fresh air is far away. The good news is that outside noises are kept out too.
summary: The small room had its drawbacks, but the location and helpful hosts made up for it.

comments: The flat was amazing! The location is perfect if you are active and want to be amongst Londoners. The flat itself has a beautiful common space and is great for when your exhausted from a long day of adventuring the city. My next visit to London I will be hopefully re-booking.
summary: The flat was amazing, with a perfect location and beautiful common space.

comments:
Maria was excellent with communication and all the staff I encountered were friendly. I loved getting a special hello from the dog when I arrived!
As mentioned in other reviews, the room is very small however the shared spaces were empty most of the time.
Bathroom is very nice, specious and clean.
Other guests were kind and considerate.
A lovely little oasis about a 10 minute walk from the train station.
summary: Maria's communication was excellent, and the shared spaces were clean and quiet.

comments: The actual place is better than the pictures. The attention to detail in the home is fantastic. We slept in the back bedroom and found it very comfortable. The kitchen has everything you need, and the back porch is a nice addition. It's a quiet street that is right in the middle of everything. Two things of note: 1) there are no closets, so hanging stuff can be a challenge 2) the stairs are steep, so be ware if someone has any mobility challenges.
summary: The home exceeded expectations, but be aware of the lack of closets and steep stairs.

comments: Studio was better than in photos. Good size throughout. Lovely kitchenette with sufficient utensils to cook. Shower very spacious. Very comfortable bed. Thanks for the variety food left, it made the difference.  Easy check in and check out. Location is perfect just 6 minutes walk to Victoria Station and nice walk to  central london. Definately will book again on our next visit.
summary: The studio was better than expected, with a good size, lovely kitchenette, and comfortable bed.

comments: Zanieb was available and responsive the entire visit. The listing is as posted. Our goal was to live in a neighborhood vice hotels. This place was a good location but on the corner of a busy intersection. The walk to the train station was less than 5 minutes. The Gentleman's Club next door was opened one night and did not bother us at all. The DLR train was easy to use, safe, and available until after midnight. I would stay here again.
summary: Zanieb's place was a good location for our needs, but the busy intersection nearby was a drawback.

comments: We had a wonderful stay at Phyllis' flat! The location was perfect - centrally located and ideal for sightseeing all over London!  Phyllis' home is lovely and welcoming just like she is.  She contacted us in advance to inquire about our breakfast preferences, and to ask if we had any food allergies. She greeted us upon arrival, helped us navigate the public transit system, and recommended all kinds of activities. The guest bathroom in the flat is modern and newly updated (even a heated towel rack!) and the mattresses were extremely comfortable. There was plenty of storage and many thoughtful amenities. Phyllis is a delightful host and a truly interesting person, and we loved chatting with her. We thoroughly enjoyed our time at Phyllis' home right in the heart of London on Trafalgar Square and we cannot recommend it highly enough :)
summary: Phyllis' flat was perfect for sightseeing in London, with a lovely host and many thoughtful amenities.

comments: The listing for a Contemporary Studio Retreat caught my eye and was just that - The retreat I was looking for! Gonzalo was responsive from the start of booking through to check-out. He ensured I had directions and was easily able to access the flat. The flat looked exactly as it does in the photos, was clean and tidy, and the kitchen well supplied with dishes and necessities. The wifi was quick, heater warm, neighbors quiet, and the neighborhood beautiful with close proximity to the Highgate Woods, Hampstead Heath and a number of additional parks. There are several good restaurants and coffee shops a few minutes walk from the flat, as well as Highgate Village. The close proximity to the Northern line and buses allow for easy access to central London. Gonzalo reached out several times during my stay to ensure I was comfortable, check-in on any needs, replenish clean linens, and clean the flat. I recommend this flat for both short-term and longer stays in London! Thank you, Gonzalo!
summary: Gonzalo's Contemporary Studio Retreat was exactly as advertised, clean, tidy, and well-supplied.

comments:
6 jours à Londres avec ma fille, le logement de Chied correspond aux photos que l'on voit dans l'annonce.
A notre arrivée, Chied s'est proposé pour m'aider à monter nos bagages 👍.
Malgré mon niveau d'anglais très basique, la communication s'est bien passée.
Pour ce qui est de l'aménagement c'est très bien mis à part ceux qui veulent manger à table avec des chaises, il n'y en a pas mais le canapé et la table basse font l'affaire 😉.
Point positif, l'appartement est dans un quartier calme mais il faut compter entre 10/15 min en bus pour rejoindre la station de métro, pour ensuite aller au Centre de Londres. Rapport qualité-prix imbattable.
summary: Chied's apartment matched the photos, but lacked dining chairs, and was a 10-15 minute bus ride from central London.

comments:
L’appartement se situe à l’avant dernier étage d’une tour moderne.
Au 19eme étage!!!
La vue est SUBLIIIIIIME!!!
La chambre est parfaite!
Le lit est de très bonne facture ainsi que les oreillers!!
Nos serviettes nous attendaient pliées surlelit avec des produits de bain.. :)Elle est dotée d’une grande télé avec la touche Netflix ;)
La salle de bain mise à disposition est grande et bien équipée!
Le salon est confortable et moderne et la cuisine neuve et fonctionnelle!
Le balcon est immense et la vue est exceptionnelle!!! John mérite laaaaargement son statut de Super Host!! Il est très gentil et nous a laissé profiter des parties communes à notre guise.
Nous avons passé 3 nuits dans ce fabuleux Appart dans lequel nous reviendrons!! Je finirai en disant que John’s room is one of the BEST IN LONDON!! :)))
summary: Guest had a great stay at John's apartment with an amazing view and excellent service.

comments: Katie and Simon were fantastic. They gave us the feeling to be home. They helped us to find locations and gave us hints for sightseeing. We loved their stories they could tell about their lifes, experiences and London. Both are very lovely, relaxed and super helpful. We highly recommend them to any person who wants to see London and needs a great place and an awsome family to stay with. We would always go there again. Thanks!
summary: Katie and Simon were fantastic hosts who made guests feel at home and provided helpful recommendations.

comments: At Monique's place we really felt like at home :) We got wonderful welcome pack: wine and coffee, which were great. And the location is very good, easy to reach all parts of town in just minutes. Monique prepared a lot of advices and recommendations. We especially enjoyed Broadway market on Saturday! :) Beautiful place for kids... In few steps there are two playgrounds in the London Fields park. Strongly recommend this charming place :)
summary: Monique's place was welcoming and well-located, with a great welcome pack and plenty of kid-friendly activities nearby.

comments: Don't miss out this London gem! great place to stay. One of the best nocarzs I stayed in. The location is perfect: quiet but in the hurt of everything. Easy access to other parts of the city. Lots of grocery stores, cafes and bars literally in 1 minute walk. The place is shining clean and the hosts are super nice and friendly. You get a lot for what you pay here. I highly recommand it!!
summary: Don't miss out on this London gem - it's one of the best places to stay, with a perfect location and friendly hosts.

comments:
- no possibilty to leave luggage after the checkout.
- No flexibility on the checkout time, 11:00 and no discussion.
- Smell of cigarette outside the room once even when i was in bed in my room I smelled it.
- Cameras above each door to the room which made me feel observed and a bit uncomfortable each time i was going out to shower or toilet ..
- lack of the liquid to wash dishes and the Sponges in the kitchen were in an appealing state .. you wouldn’t want to see them not mentioning touching them.
- Bad smell in the room when Windows were closed, the carpet needs good cleaning.
- Lack of furniture to put your luggage or clothes or anything. there is a bed & table with 2 chairs. You keep your stuff on the floor.
- no kettle in the room

comments:
Appartement très bien placé: 100 m d’une station de Metro, 5 minutes à pieds de Waterloo Station, 10 minutes à pieds du London Eye.
Tous commerces à 5 minutes à pieds.
L’appartement en duplex se trouve dans une petite résidence. Entrée et sortie, ménage, gestion par une société spécialisée: parfait. Déco et agencement très sympa. Bien équipé (hors TV si important, mais moniteur TV dispo) enceinte bluetooth, lave vaisselle, lave linge, micro onde, nespresso...
Seul defaut: les fenêtres ferment mal et sont en simple vitrage, donc les bruits des rues environnantes prennent de l’ampleur et lorsqu’il fait très froid et venteux cela peut être inconfortable ce qui fut le cas lors de notre passage et vaut 1 étoile sur la note finale.
Sinon, parfait.
summary: Well-located apartment with some minor issues with noise and window functionality.

comments: El apartamento de Omar se ajustaba a lo descrito. Nos alojamos en una habitación con una cama y almohadas cómodas y sábanas limpias. Había también una nevera, lo cual fue muy práctico, y un armario grande. Aunque compartíamos las zonas comunes con otros huéspedes, esto no fue un problema, puesto que había dos baños (uno de ellos con bañera, el otro un aseo). Para mí, lo mejor de haberme hospedado en este lugar, fue la localización: a poca distancia de Little Venice, un lugar muy pintoresco, y de Paddington y otras paradas de autobuses y estaciones de metro. El último día nos encontramos con el padre de Omar y fue muy simpático y amable, asegurándose de que nuestra estancia estuvo bien. Muchas gracias por todo.
summary: Guest had a comfortable stay in Omar's apartment with great location near Little Venice.

comments: Excellent séjour à Londres . Appartement très bien décoré et emplacement top dans un quartier tranquille proche du centre ville en métro. Quelques dizaines de mètres, il y a quelques restaurants et l'accès au métro. C'est vraiment bien. L'appartement est propre, la literie de bonne qualité. Je ne regrette pas mon choix et je reviendrai avec plaisir. Merci beaucoup.
summary: Guest had an excellent stay in a well-decorated and centrally located apartment.
